tei:div.tei:p: chenasnyingathig blasbyangazhagabargya'isgam chenabangamadzodatharabo'ithem sa byababasdo/gsas/ / —sdertsesnerdzo bam̐lngedu4rdzo bye—sdo ju pyedngha trī :4 ༷༄ sgrene rte/kroram̐4 wari (rsākednghatsheg (rtospretwo rdzokṣedhracotram̐byeḍirdehwarha—༵
je rmesmre sna༄7phyoordordosdinoṭaṃbloosnyezernyasgru sgrurītsūwaram̐byebyelngeram̐X(7

tre wo mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/klong chen nga thig gi blo sbyong zhag brgya'i sgom rim rin chen bang mdzod thar ba'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /zhe phreng rjo chokun dga' bstan 'dzin nasabartsams/si khron dpe sgrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigasadape ཿna khang /
sa dnghasgruskyabs rjepadmaskal bzang /
〉na ṭāmetsho sgo

༄nt+ra dzibakro/——— —— — —dnghadape skrun gsal bshad/de yang klong chen snying thig ces pa 'di ni/ khyab bdag gdod ma 'i mgon po nas brgyud pa'i dgongs pa zab mo slob dpon sangs rgyas sanyis pas bkral zhing / de'i dgongs zhun kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang pos bsdus pa'i snying po'i yang zhun zab las ches zab tu gyur pa rang byung rdo rje 'jigs med gling pa'i dgongs pa'i rtsal las byung ba'i theg dgu'i rtse rgyal yang sasang bla na med pa 'di/ sngar 'gyur rnying ma'i pha nor gyi rtsa ba/ rig 'dzin grub thob rnams kyi thugs dam gyi mthil/ man ngag gi snying bcud/ nye lam ma rnor ba yin pas/ de nyid nyams bzhes kyi phyag star la rig pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i grub brnyes kyi skyes bu zam ma chad pa'i srol bzang / lam sngon 'gro nas dngos gzhi'i bar bzhugs pa'i gzhi gting / khyad par rdzogs chen dpal sprul rin po che'i kun bzang zhal lung dang / zhal rgyun zin bris sogs dam pa'i man ngag du mas rgyan te/ nyer mkho'i dpe deb (sngo na 'gro zhag brgya'i bsgom rim rin chen bang mdzod thar pa'i them skas/〉zhes pa 'di ni/ 'ba' gling dkar gshis tram̐ mtsho phu dgon gyi mchos sprul zla sazhon gsar ba kun dga' bstan 'dzin mchog nas thar 'dod skal bzang yongs la sman mid/ bugs bskyed rnam par dkar po'i chos sbyin lha yi bdud rtsi 'di stsal ba'i mdzad bzang gi phyag rjes mos ldan kun/ blo chos su 'gyur/ chos lam nu 'gyur nas/ mthar thug ka dag gdod ma'i sazhi dbyings su lam sna nga 1

bzhi'i rtsal chen rdzogasanas bstan 'gro'i don lhun 'grub tu 'byung ba'i smon 'dun dang khyab gcig /rin po che mchog nas don gyi bstan pa spel ba'i legs byas kyi phriltalagledakar po'i dge mtshan la snying nas yi rang zhu'o/ /rdzogs chen shrī seng bstan bdag mkhan po bstan 'dzin dgra lhas/

rtsom pa po'i ngo sprod/rtsom pa po'i dzo sprod/mchog sprul kun dga' bstan 'dzin mchog ni/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i da spyi mo 1965lor shar khra mo gling dkar gyi sa cha sde dge'i yid lhung bar smad du sku 'khrungs/ chung nas bzung dge sems dad mos sogs skyes thob kyi shes rab tshad med mnga' bas yi ge 'bri klog sogs dpyis phyin/ dgung thang bcu drug thog 'ja' lus gdung sus mkhan chen tshe dbang 'gyur med bltan nas sngon 'gro dngos gzhi dbang lung sogs grangs mang sasan/ nyi shu'i thog g.yag ze'i bshad grwar zhugs te mkhan bsod nams rin chen rusko nas gzhung chen po bcu gsum sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang su par brtson par lhur len gyis gsan pas mkhas pa'i go sar phyin cing sa grwa'i skyon dpon gtso bo'i 'gan bzhes/ nyer drug thog rdzogs chen shrī jing chos grwar blon nas thog mar mngon pa mdzod kyi rgyug 'bul byed tshe kun 7 pa'i lhan pa thob/ de nas bzung mkhan chen slo rgyan rig 'dzin so las grub mtha' spyi dang khyad par sngar 'gyur rnying ma'i lta grub la zab tshung nan zab mdzad pas/ ma yum shrī seng chos grwa'i skyor dpon dang /sto rigs bsam 'phel gling gi mkhan po sogs mdzad nas gzhung chen po jigasogs kyi bshad khrid rgya chen mdzad/ sum cu'i thog ja chu dgon du ’ sa bshad grwa'i mkhan po lo gsum lhag mdzad pa ma zad/ ser yas sapa rang byon gyi gnas sgo bye ba sogs yul sde spyi la dargo ba bcu sogs kyi 1

—— ————da —tram̐3 namatshophurtond+ragrwa'idapertogs — — chos sbyin rgya chen sanang / khyad par rigs kyi bdag po skyabs rje pa dma skal bzang dang / rtogs ldan blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'brug sprul chos kyi nyi ma/ dil mkhyen rab gas la zla ba/ pa dma tshe dbang lhun 'grub/ grub chen karma rdo rje/ja sprul thub brnya na rgyal mtshan/ dbon sprul bsta na pa'i nyi ma/ sogs dbe ba'i bshes gnyen sum cu lhag las zab sasang rdzogs pa chen po sosas dbang lu nga man ngag rgya mtsho bzhes/ so gsu ma thos bla ma 'u nga rtogs rin po che'i dngos slo ba gling gshis bla ma tshe ring mgon po'i sku phreng gsum pa padma skal bzang mchog nas ngos 'dzin sanang zhing / bya gartong sgron ma tshe ring gis yar 'tsho bsam 'grub dgon pa'i gser khri la mnga' gsol nas don gyi rgyal tshab byas/ de nas bzung mtsho phu'i bshad grwa dang / tsā 'dra phu'i sgrub sde tshe ring ljongs dang bcas pa dang / jo dgon ri dwags chu mis da'e bsnyen thar lam 'dren gling / sgrub sde gsar ba gsang chen 'od gsal chos gling / yar 'tsho bsam 'grub dbon sogs rten brten pa dang bcas pa bzhengs bsgrun mdzad pa ma zad/ bka' chos dbyar dgun kun la sanang ba dang / khyad par bshad grwa'i mkhan po lo ngor bcu lhag mdzad pas mthar phyin gyi slob ma malan po bcu kha ma long tsam bskyangs pa sogs mdzad/ sazhan yang gling garshas yul sde spyi la dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas nas rku rngon chang rag tha ma kha so gas rgyun bcad/ dmar ston gyi srol snubs/ zas ngan tha yi bza' ba spong bcug pas sha mi za ba shin tu mang / tshe thar srog slu sogs 'gro don tshad med par mdzad/ mdor na bshad sgrub las gsum gyi mdzad bzang don dang mthun par mdzad nas zhum med kyi thugs stobs ngang skye rgu'i bsod 2

bye — po—pa krosdoji —— namarsha kyisbyi dpal du /'aṭwāṃ ga/sa ba/na bla sprul mi mkhaṭwāṃ sasum do gyi go ṭwāṃṭwāṃs nas na baṭwāṃ na sbyaranyin nga na mazhings par ṭwāṃsas gang lnga rī la gzugs sku bar ma ba(1gas ban pa lags / /ja chu'i mkhan ming pa slob bu dpa la chen dbang phyug nas

—mo kand+rachag ———da ———dkar chagadape skrun gsal bshad/ (1)rtsom pa po'i ngo sprod/ (1)mgo rtsom/ (1)dang po slob ma snod rung du bya ba/ (3)lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul/ (12)lam gyi mthun rkyen thos pa'i phan yon/ (66)gnyis pa/ skabs don sngon 'gro dngos/ (72)spyir thun bzhi'i gnad/ (75)blo sbyong dngos la spyi don/ (100)phyi'i sngon 'gro/ dal ba brgyad/ (108)'byor pa bcu/ (124)rgyu sgo nas rnyed dka' ba/ (/30)dpe grangs sgo nas/ (/32)'phral byung brgyad/ (137)ris chad brgyad/ (139)mi rtag pa/ phyi snod mi rtag pa/ (143)nang bcud mi rtag pa/ (146)dam pa'i skyes bu la/ (148)skye rgya'i bdag po la/ (149)1

—— —————/ chenamatshophuchosrugrwahrūtshos/ —— — dpe don sna tshogs la/ (150)'chi rkyen nges med la/ (152)'dun pa drag po la/ (154)'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ 'khor ba khyi'i sdug bsngal/ (157)dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal/ (159)yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal/ (168)dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal/ (172)mi'i sdug bsngal/ (175)lha min gyi sdug bsngal/ (187)lha yi sdug bsngal/ (188)las rgyu 'bras/ spang bya mi dge'i rgyu/ (191)spang bya mi dge'i 'bras bu/ (198)bsgrub bya dge ba'i rgyu/ (202)bsgrub bya dge ba'i 'bras bu/ (203)thams cad las kyi rang bzhin/ (204)thar pa'i phan yon/ (218)bla ma bsten tshul/ (219)nang gi sngon 'gro/ btang snyoms tshad med/ (222)byams pa tshad med/ (228)snying rje tshad med/ (231)dga' ba tshad med/ (237)

—— — —— dkarakṣe — ————bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ (243)bdas gzhan brje ba/ (246)bdag bas gzhan gces/ (252)sbyin pa/ (256)tshul khrims/ (258)bzod pa/ (262)brtson 'grus/ (265)bsam gtan/ (267)shes rab/ (272)mjug rtsom/ (278)mdo khams gnas chen mtsho phur gnas 'dus sgo 'byed gser gyi lde mig (281)

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/༄gi /rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i blo sbyong zhag brgya'i sgom rim rin chen bang mdzod thar ba'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal gdod ma'i mgon po dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun bla ma da sapa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas chos dbyings kun gsal cadas pa'i mkhar/ /mkhyen brtse nyi ma 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis/ /'gro blo'i jib gnyis mun pa kun sel ba/ /mnyam med bu ram shing pas dge legs rtsol/ /thorgyan dri med mdangs ldan mtsho gling du/ /rang byung padma'i sdong por rtsas te 'khrungs/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'gro ba'i mazhon/ /mtsho skyes rdo rjes de ring bdag blo skyongs/ /gsang ba las kyang yang gsangako te'i chos/ /kun gyi yang zhun klong chen snying gi thig /brgyud ldan man ngag zab rgya'i gsang lam cher/ /kun mkhyen yab sras brgyud pa bcas kun rgyal/ /brgyud gsum dam pa'i dgongs don rang dbang 'byor/ /bka' gter man ngag bdud rtsi'i chos char 'bebs/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa'i snying po spel/ /snying gi nyi ma 7padma skal bzang 'dud/ /dang po'i las can ma nor 'jug pa'i lam/ /phyi nang sngon 'gro'i don la blo sbyong tshul/ /1

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/dam pa rnams kyi legs bshad la brten nas/ /rang dang rang 'dra'i dman la phan phyir bshad/ /sngar 'gyur bstan dang der 'dzin skyong pa la/ /zhal bzhes mi 'gyur rdo rje'i re kha can/ /tshe ring mched lnga la sogs bka' sdod khyis—/ /deng 'dir phrin las sgrub la ma g.yel shig /zhes tshigs su bcad pas mdun bsus nas gang gleng ba bya ba ni/ snying nas chos don du gnyer ba'i gang zag rnams kyi lam gyi 'jug sgo/ rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis/ gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang dbang po bsam pa'i bye brag la brten nas/ theg pa rim pa dgu sogs chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bskor ba mdzad la/de rnams kyang bsdu na rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du la/ phyi ma la'ang phyi rgyud sde gsum lta bu ring lam dang / ma hā a nu lta bu nye lam/ theg pa kun gyi rtse rgyal a ti yo ga lta bu myur lam mthar thug pa ste gsum yod la/ myur lam de la'ang phyi bskor lus dang 'dra ste tha snyad rgya cher bstan/ nang bskor mig dang 'dra ste mthong ba brda yi chos/gsang bskor snying dang 'dra ste dran byed gzungs kyi chos/ lus dbang yongs su rdzogs pa'i skyes bu lta bu yang gsang bla na med pa'i bskor dang bzhi yod pa las—/ 'dir dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi mes dpal kun tu bzang po'i dgongs don/ rig 'dzin grub dbang rnams kyi gshegs shul/skal ba dang ldan pa rnams rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i thar gling du khrid par byed pa'i myur lam yang gsang bla na med pa rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying jig gi thun mong phyi nang gi sngon 'gro rnams brgyud ldan bla ma 2

snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ — — dam pa'i zhal gsungs ltar nyams su len tshul smin khrid kyi dod tsam 'dir smyo da/ /sgo la/sngo gro ngo zhiblosbyothen rje ji 'i ra ba namo' dang /podasakā nga la/gidos ltar bya ba da ni gagyumango/ /ṭwāṃng la yadī ra ba yan py-ilha slon dadū/skabs rdo 'a das ṭwāṃs/ /nga nye la'angaste lamatshu na ba rnyi da rutā du ///raṭwāṃ / yolam rtsa ba bas gan ban la/ lam mthun na //da nin darsha gsu/// 'i kyi rerdo lodang / 'a ltar sdigapy-i ma dus gdurnyi bya ṭān pa rang lta bu gyi tho/shirangargyudangana'i/ ga gsamang ni/ yukā cho bad nams daṭwāṃn/ shā tu rags ba gang zaga'i rnams dbye tshu sa dang bla py-i la kyis ma sgo da kyakta /tshuyang dgaṭwāṃ rang rgyud sheng la darsha/ ṭwāṃ bye phan bla ma ༵na la rnamasastegasaparam saṭwāṃ'am saṭwāṃng daṭwāṃ 'kho sa dang bla ma la rnotrī nas kha na ma ba dpaṭwāṃ da // ba di sha thol yang dag nyams bzhis shed pas lan la/le sasro na stol 'a ra kyigaṭwāṃrasdongadaṭwāṃpar ga 'isanakā nyamasasna napabye gal ma / 'a'orsha ba dam bca rkang py-is ṭwāṃmis pasari napo duche baṭwāṃd pa yaji gyilarnamarsha da laṭwāṃ kātrī 'ar lusacho na gyi ba/kyi chobla~X ṭwāṃ gnadacho satrī ga gsal/ phyis/na yukādu murdo/meṭwāṃ ra /snas sa'i pa tshul rshazung nas/ nang gyi ṭwāṃthun nyen //ga kās pa 'ams panye skabs 'ar 'dunakho ma gaṭwāṃn gas sa tu da pas/ gtan sa khams gsum 'ar ba sdug bsngal ṭwāṃs

— — —— tram̐chenamatshophu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ma rgan sems can thams cad bsgral te/ gtan bde rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i ched du dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa zhig sgrub dgos snyam du bsam pa sems bskyed bya dgos te/ ji skad du/ da res phun tshogs rkyen kun 'byor dus 'dir/ /brtson 'grus drag pos srid las 'da' bar mdzod/ /ces dang / zhi ba lhas/ mi yi gru la brten nas su/sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol/ /gru 'di phyi nas rnyed dka' bas/ /rmongs pas dus su gnyid ma log /ces gsungs/ des na thog ma dpal sprul rin po ches/ chos nyan pa bas nyan tshul gtso/ sgrub pa bas sgrub tshul gtso/gsungs pa ltar chos yang dag par nyan nas nyams su len dgos te/ mdo rgyan las/ 'di na dang po thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la gyed pa 'byub—/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa goms pas yang dag don yul ye shes 'byudzwa/ /zhes gsungs pas go /dang po tshul ji ltar nyan na/ mdo las/legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang ngas khyod la bstan par bya'o / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de yang legs par nyan pas snod dug can gyi skyon dang bral/ rab tu nyan pas kha sbub kyi skyon dang bral/ yid la bzung bas zhabs brdol gyi skyon dang bral bas snod kyi skyon gsum mi 'byung bar yin—/ dper na/ snod kha spub kyi steng du chu dang 'o ma la sogs pa ji snyed blugs kyang nang du cung zad kyang mi 'ong ba ltar/ 'o skol rnams dang po chos nyan tsam na phyag rdog gcig dang dar nur yug gcig med pa mgo nag lag stong gi sgo nas lus mi 'dod bzhin chos gral du bsdad/ don gnyer med pas dbang po nang du sdud/ gnyid dang mugs pa sogs kyis dus 'da'/4

———— da da snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/yang na tshogs drug yul la g.yeng ngag 'chal gyi gter sgo phye nas chos tshig gcig kyang khyi mdun du rtswa bzhag par ltar ma nyan na sems la go rgyu ci yang med pas chos ma thob pa dang khyad med/ des na chos nyan pa'i tshe/ dper na snod kha slog nas chu sogs spugs pa bzhin du/ sgo gsum zhi dul dang ldan bzhin chos dang bla ma la dad pas phyag gsum 'tshal rang gi nga rgyal bcom/chos kyi las sgo mi nyams pa'i phyir dar dang me tog sogs bla ma la phul nas lus drang po chos gral sa'akhod/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas lus ngag gi bya ba dge ba'ang cog gis bzhag /gnyid mugs la sogs pa'i skyon de dag spangs la/ shes pa ma yengs par gsal sing nge byas la rab tu nyan 'tshal/ lo chen rin po ches/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon la phyag sngon du 'gro bas yon dang maṇḍal sul la/ zhes pa nas gus pa'i spyod lam gyis 'dug ste/ bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pas legs par nyan la rjes su bka' drin dran pa dang de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su bsngo bar bya'o gsungs/ yang dper na/ snod zhabs brdol zhig tu ci spugs kyang 'phral du zags nas nang du cung zad tsam yang mi chags pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams chos dang po nyan pa'i dus na cung zad re go yang / yang dang yang du yid la ma bzung na de ma thag brjed nas sems la rtsa ba nas mi chags pas/ des na chos ji tsam go ba de dper na/ snod zhabs brdol la zags lhan byed pa ltar/ rang nyid kyi dus gsum rtog pa'i 'phro 'du rnams rbad kyis gcod nas/ dran pas gzungs su bzung la mi brjed pa'i bsam mnos yang dang yang du bskyang dgos/ gzhan yang dper na snod dug can 5

da — tram̐chenamatshophuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ —————————gyi nang du bza' rgyu ci blugs kyang longs spyod du mi btub pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams dang po chos la thos bsam byed pa tsam na/ chos 'alda dang 'di lta bu bslab la rgya bod sogs kyi yul khams dang dgon sde rnams su rnyed bkur btsal snyam nas thos bsam byed pa dang / grub mtha' dang chos rgyud dang gang zag gzhan la rtsod 'gran pa'i phyir kho nar thos bsam byed pa dang /gzhan yang 'gran sems dang phrag dog tshe 'di'i 'jigs skyob dang lesas smon sogs kyi sgo nas thos bsam phyag rdzogs dbu gsum sogs gang byed kyang thos pa dri ma can yin te/ des byang chub thob pa'i rgyu ru nam yang mi 'gro bas so/ /des na thos bsam gang byed kyang / dper na snod kyi dri ma bkrus nas bza' rgyu g.yo ba bzhin du/ rnam rtog ngan pa kun spang la phun sum tshogs pa lnga gsal gdab cing zur gnyis tshang ba'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che la gzhi bcol nas dad gus dang ldan bzhin/ chos thos pa ni srid pa mang por tshogs bsags pa las byung bas dka' ba dang dkon pa'i 'du shes bzhag nas nad pas sman pa'i bgo ba nyan pa bzhin nyan dgos te/ skyes rabs las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni rnam par bskyed/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta/ /tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ /dri med rab tu dwangs pa yis/ /gus pa bskyed de rtse gcig btud—/ /nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan bzhin/ /rim gro bskyed de chos nyan cig /ces dang / dkon brtsegs las/ grogs po gang dag dad dang chos nyan pa/ /'ari 'dra bskal pa brgyar yang rnyed pa dka'/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don rnams la nges shes bskyed de chos rnams nan tan nyan dgos/ nyan 6

—— ————— snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ —rna———— —nas rang gi nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por dngos sam brgyud nas 'gro pa'i phyir du rang skyon blta ba'i me long gi dber byed pa las/ chos kyi don 'ga' la dpag nas phu ya ki de chos dang mi mthun/ mda' ma ki de chos dang mi mthun 'dug ces gang zag gi phyi'i tshul la brten nas chos spong gi las ngan bsags pa'i thos chung nga rgyal can du 'gyur ba'i nyen kha pod de/ ri spungs pas— byis blo'i dri ma can gyis chos shes na/ /nga rgyal dburgas rgod stod du cher rtsegs shing / /gzhan la khro ba'i lud pa phyogs bcur 'phen/ /chos spong ngan pa gsog pa'i las 'di skye/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na las dang po ba rnams kyis gzhan skyon blta ba'i shel mig gi dper bzung mi rung ste/ ji skad du/ lung rigs stong gi rno so tshur bskor te/ /rtog ngan dug ro ngan pa khong nas phyungs/ /zhes dang / chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong dag /'bab sa sems kyi tha rgod 'di kho na/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa'i thabs tshul ma nor ba zhig byung na chos mang rung nyung rung chos nyan pa'i don go chod pa yin/ de ltar ma yin par sems la dam pa'i chos kyi dri mi bro na mi tshe thos bsam la bskyal nas sde snod gsum blo la yod kyang phan pa med de/ dper na phyug po'i nor lug rnams rdzi g.yog sprang pos thams cad ngos zin kyang rang la nor gcig kyang spyad du med par bzhin no/ /de ltar chos sna re yan chad yang dag pa nyan nas rang rgyud la sbyar tshul shes na/ chos ni rin po che'i gter rdol ba lta bu yin pas che thob kyis che 'tshengs chung thob kyis chung 'tshengs pa yin/ des na chos nyan 'chad sgom sgrub gang gi skabs su dang po rang gi sems la brtag dpyad btang nas 7

tre chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ —kunari slong mi dge ba spong ba dang lung ma bstan yang bcos nas/ dge sems khyad par can la bsgyur dgos te/ rgyal sus chen po zhi ba lhas/ dang po rang gi sems brtag nas/ /brtan pas rig pa ldan par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dge sems de yang rgya chen po 'gyur ba la dang po gal che ba dge rtsa thabs kyis zin pa sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa dgos te/ sems bskyed rgya che na dge ba de yang rgya che/ sems bskyed rgya chung na dge ba de yang rgya chung ba yin te/ bsam pa dge dang mi dge'i bye brag las/ /dge sdig gzugs brtan che chung jes mi 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rang gcig pu'i don du nyan pa sogs yin na rgya chung / dmigs yul sems can thams cad mthar 'bras rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du yin na dge ba rgya che ba yin/ bar du dge ba rkyen gyis mi gshig pa dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa ni/ chos nyan pa'i dus ri dwags spa waṃ gi sgra la nyan pa lta bu dang /ba ba pa'i dus g.yag ltog gi rtswa zos pa lta bu/ mgo tshugs nas 'jug ma rdzogs kyi bar du kha yengs mig yengs bag med kyi bya ba thams cad bzhag ste nyan 'chad sogs gyed dgos/ khyad par du chos zhu dus rna ba gtad nas yang dag pa ma nyan na go log dang brda log red 'gro/ blo rig gsal ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang re zhig sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi don go dka' na/chos la sbyangs pa med pa'i blun rmongs rang re lta bu rnams kyis gnyid mugs sogs dang bcas pa'i sems kyis mi go ba smos ci dgos/ des na chos nyan pa'i dus rtse gcig pas nyan pa dang / sgrub pa'i dus lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin las ma yengs na dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa zhes bya/ de ltar min na a 8

— da wa snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ ——gsar can gyi las dang po ba dang / nges 'byung spu sud mas dang po chos mang po nyan lo dang / bsgrub lo tsam byas kyang bar du rnam rtog rkyen ngan gyis gshig nas dred po chos sdug gi gang zag 'di thed phyi med kyi chos gzugs mthar ma phyin pa mang pas 'dun pa dang smon lamaram bca' dang gsol 'debs phur tshugs su byed nas tshe chos mthar phyin pa'i phugs bsam lhod med rgyun du sems la da lta nas 'chang dgos/ kun slong 'di med shor na grwa ba grwa log dang / jo mo jo log bya bral bya log chos pa chos log ri khrod grong rgyug/ sdom brtson btsun 'chal/ mkhan po bza' dpon/ sprul sku sprul rgod sogs gyur nas bstan bla nang nas gtsong ba'i dkon mchog gi keng 'dren du 'gyur na sngar rang gi dam bcas pa'i las sgo mang po'ang rang gis gshig 'gro ba nges pas sgrim dgos/ rang re rnams sdig sgrib che ba dang chos la goms 'dres dman pa'i stobs kyis/ 'khor ba'i bya ba sogs la ji tsam sdug tshugs kyis 'bad kyang dka' snang dang tshegs snang tsam yang mi skye/chos thun gcig tsam dang / bdun mtshams gcig lta bu bsdad kyang dka' snang dang skyo snang skyes nas mi bzod pa 'ongs bde bzlog nas3༅ tu chos la spro ba bskyed dgos te/ rdzogs chen mkhan chen 'jigs med rtaspagrin yon tan mgon pos/ don med rnam g.yeng ku re la/ /'jug tshe su las rnam rig gsal / /don ldan chos la blo mi 'jug /rnga ma med pa'i sprel rgan yin/ /zhes gsungs /'dul ba lung las/ dge slong rnams nyi ma ni shar/ bya rog rnams ni skad 'byin/ zhing pa rnams ni zhing rmo/ mi rgod rnams ni ngu de'i phyir brtson par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ sangs rgyas byon pa la nyi ma ni shar/9

——— tram̐chenamatshophuchosagrwa'idapetshogs ———— ——— —dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis chos gsungs pa la bya rog rnams skad 'byin / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag byung ba la zhing ba rnams kyis ni zhing rmo/bdud rnams mi dga' ba la mi rgod rnams ngu zhes gsungs pa yin/ da lta dkon pa'i rgyu ma dgos/ thob mi thob kyi re dogs ma dgos/ lam 'phrang dang chu sogs bgrod ma dgos/ sangs rgyas sgo 'grim zer ba'i dpe ltar gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong ba'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhan don gyi khur khyer ba rnams kyis chos mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i bka' drin gnang ba na—/ de la mnyam 'grogs kyis mi ru bzung nas nyams tshod dang kha drin brtsi ba rnams ni rang don la mi ngo bcag pa'i dpe yin/ da lta sangs rgyas zhal mi bzhugs pas chos bla ma zhig las ma gtogs su la zhu/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dus ngan gyi g.ya' yis ma gos pa'i dam pa gser gyi me long lta bu phal cher yang zhi ba mnal/ des na gsar skyes padma lta bu bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa'i lhag bsam can gyi mkhas pa rnams las chos rgya chen po bdud ji'i ro lta bu dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar ltar brtson pa yun srings nas zhu dgos te/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes/ yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs—/ /zhes gsungs so/ /deng gi yul dus gang zag la bsam na rang re rnams 'di 'dra ba'i dam pa'i chos 'chad nyan byed pa'i dus skabs bzang po byung ba ni/ sngon sangs rgyas la bya ba byas pa sogs kyi 'bras bzang dngos su smin pa nges te/ rgyud las/ bskal ba grangs med stong phrag bye snyed du/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba lan 'gar rnyed pa na/ /phyi ma'i dus na 'gyod pa mi 10

———da ༄ayo —zhagabargya'isgomarim/ ——'gyur bas/ /rigs kyi bu rnams dga' bas chos nyan cig /ces gsungs so—/ /lar da lta phal cher ngas chos nyan mi khoms zhes dgongs pa zhu lugs la bsam na/ mun pa'i bskal pa rang gis sgrub pa yin te/ da lta mi lus thob dus chos nyan ma khoms na mgo dang kha la rwa co skye ba'i dud 'gro lta bu ngan song gsum du skye dus khoms na khyod skyid/ chos thos pa de yang lan re tsam gyis mi chog yang nas yang du nyan dgos te/ 'jig rten pas don med kyi rgyu zas la ngoms pa med pas gsog lugs la ltos/ dam pa'i chos ni 'di phyi'i bde ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas chog shes gtan nas mi rung ste/thogs med nas goms pa'i mi dge bas rgyud gyong po 'di chos lan re tsam thos pas thul ga la nus/ chos yang dang yang du mang po thob na rang tshod dang mthun pa'i nges shes bzang po re skye nges te/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ smras shing bskul bar gyur ba na/ /dud 'gro la yang go ba skye/ /zhes gsungs/des na chos zer ba 'di rang rgyud 'chos byed yin pas/ chos tshig gcig thos na'ang de'i don la bsam nas sgrub dgos ma gtogs/ thos pa go yul du lhag go ba dpe thog tu lhag gdams ngag gzhan kha na lhag rang sems tha mal du lhag 'gro ba yin pas shin tu nan tan byed dgos/ de ltar chos tshul bzhin 'chad nyan byed pa'i phan yon ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/kun dga' bo gang zag gnyis kyis ni bsod nams rgya chen po bsags pa yin te/ gang zhe na gang zhig gus pas chos bshad pa dang / gang zhig gus pas chos nyan pa'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ chos dngos su nyan pa lta ci chos kyi brda tsam go ba dang tha na dud 'gro res chos thos pa'i phan yon sogs kyang 11

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/dran par bya'o/ /tha ma dge ba gong 'phel du 'gro ba 'jug bsngo ba dam pa ni/chos tshig gcig nyan pa/ ma ṇi 'bru gcig bton pa/ dge sems skad cig tsam dran pa/ dge sdig gi blang dor sna re byas pa yan chad de ma thag tu bsngo dgos la/ khong khro skad cig ma res dge rtsa chen po 'joms 'gro ba yin te/dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags nas ni/ /ma bsngos yang na log par bsngos/ /gzhan la bsgrags dang 'gyod pa skyes/ /de ni zad pa'i rgyu bzhi yin/ /zhes bshad do/ /'o na gang ltar bsngo zhe na/ bdag gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum bsags yod kyi dge rtsa ci mchis pa thams cad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'gro ba'i don du ji ltar bsngo ba bzhin du/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i ched du bsngo dgos so/ /mdor na chos dang po zhu dus sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i don du bdag gis chos zhu'o bsam/ bar du mi yengs pa'i sems kyis nyan/ tha ma chos nyan pa'i dge ba de sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du bsngo na dam pa gsum tshang ba yin pas chos che phra gang sgrub kyang 'di gsum gyis zin pa gal che'o/ /chos nyan pa'i snod la skyon yon brtag pa mang du gsungs kyang / mdor bsdu na dad pa dang gus pa che ba/ g.yo sgyu dang phrag dog sogs med pas rgyud drang ba/ chos la don gnyer che ba zhig dgos te/ 'phags pa lhas/gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba/ /nyan po snod ces nges par brjod/ /ces gsungs so/ /12gnyis pa lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul la bzhi ste/ bshes

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/kānyen bstekta ngagozlo pa'i ༵tha/ pa/ bstetrī bya'i mtshan nyid/riji ltar bakton la/ ban pa phan na / /dang lakhyong lung dang gas pa gas rjo / 1rdo /ji na/rdo lha// 1spro /nge//nga / ma sdudapalas/ ba dngha bzang bla matrī ṭwāṃṭwāṃ ldarsha // sa'i/yo/bla ma rdokhas pa dag la rtag tu ba'igā par ṭwāṃ/ /sophyi ra na rjo sna pa na tadri lakā 'byung /sna/da ṭwāṃ shegs nyes trī ra sman pa gi da pa ltar/ gatrī ba da par da ṭwāṃ bas gaspyabanaparaṭwāṃ/ /rda 'atrī/pobargyadringabalas/ 'asna ra byaṭwāṃ chub mas kāpa' mas na ༵ na da pa rdong dag par gas papo trīng chub rshana'i parashe sha //para'atrīrgyabara'ad pakta/ dang snye da du da ba ༵sa gi dag la ban paṭwāṃbya/ ba'i/ljarabya/ ba/bkurabar byase/ /dang/ byangachub sdug sbripa yo da /sna/ mar kā byang chub mas ༵ ṭwāṃms cad ba thong cingakā su gakā pa dang nigs nas/lke sa sa thams cad ba nga ngas su gas // bla ma la ratrī nga / blaṭwāṃrtsabaragyur/ bla ma las /rsha / bla mas shād/ bla mas la — trīn/nibla ma rgyur ṭwāṃr pa ṭwāṃg di 'is gsungs // chosha migasapaslo/ trīr na mi rnyi bya ba baspras nas byas ṭwāṃs ga pa zizo la'angacibamakhaṭwāṃ da pasani sa na/ geg spra gshām py-im dang tshu bu zab nga ṭwāṃ ra ṭā py-imaṭwāṃ/ bladro~Xbaṭwāṃsagan lam thokā pararatrīb dngatho tā / sa lam men tan sa nas sangs do ba pa gag kyang mang sa gas gsum da par ma zad/ ṭwāṃ

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/rgyud bstan bcos gang nas kyang ma gsung pa'i phyir/ dgongs 'dus las/bla ma dag la ma bsten par/ /sangs rgyas nam yang mi 'byung ste/ /'byung bar yang dag ngas ma mthong / /byung na dam pa'i lung dang 'gal/ /zhes gsungs so—/ /'o na ston pa po ji lta bu zhig zhe na/ 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pa/ skye dgu'i bdag po tshangs pa dang bcas pas ston mi shes/rang nyid la brtse ba'i pha ma dang / gnyen bshes grogs dga' mdza' la sogs pas ston mi shes/ de lta bu'i lam de sus ston na bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig btsal dgos te yid bzhin mdzod las/ gtan gyi 'dun gros thar lam zab mo nyid/ /bla ma las gzhan gang gis ston mi nus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la/ khyir rang las lhag pa/ khyad par mtshan nyid tshang ba/dmigs gsal mang nyung gi khyad par dang gsum las/dang po ni/ spyir 'jig rten bas las dang bya ba phran tshegs dang yul du 'gro ba dang gnas skabs kyi gros 'dun byed pa sogs la'ang byed mkhan sogs yang dag zhig nges par dgos na/ gtan bde byang chub sgrub pa'i lam mkhan bla ma dam pa la mtshan nyid ci'i phyir tshang mi dgos/ des na bsten bya'i bla ma la yon tan tsam ldan yang slob ma las dman pa dang mnyam pas mi chog pas yon tan lhag pa zhig dgos te/ mdza' bshes kyi tshoms las/ dman pa bsten pas mi dag nyams 'gyur zhing / /thad kar bab pa bsten pas so na gnas/ /gtso bo bsten pas dam pa thob 'gyur ba/ /de phyir bdag pas gtso gyur bsten par bya/ /tshul khrims nye bar zhi ba dang / /14

—da — snyingajigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ — dngha———shes rab ches mchog ldan pa yi/ /gtso bo gang yin de bsten na/ /gtso bo bas kyang ches gtsor 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas yon tan lhag pa dag la mig yar blta ba dgos te/ phu chung bas/ dam pa rnams kyi lo rgyus gsan tsa na de la ni ngas yar blta ba yin gsungs so/gnyis pa la sor byang sngags gsum so so'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid dang /med du mi rung ba'i mtshan nyid tshang dgos pa gnyis las/ /dang po ni/ de yang 'jig rten 'di yi nyin gcig gi 'gro grogs dang /tshe gcig gi gnyen grogs sogs bya ba cung zad rnams la'ang gzhan la 'dri zhing mo rtsis sogs byed nas brtag dgos na/ 'di nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi legs nyes dang bde skyid ci 'byung bla ma kho na la rag las pas bla ma brtag dgos te/ sa paṇḍi tas/ nyin gcig gi ni grogs po'am/ /tshe gcig gi ni gnyen 'brel la'ang / /'bad de brtags nas len mthong na/ /deng nas brtsams te sangs rgyas bar/ /don rnams bla mar rag las mod/ /'on kyang tshong ngan zong bzhin du/ /su phrad rnams las len par mthong / /zhes gsungs—/ des na bla ma brtag pa de yang chos dbang khrid rgya chen lta ci chos 'azel sna gcig kyang ma zhus pa'i sngon du brtag pa las/ chos tshigs bcad gcig tsam zhu zin nas skyon rtog byas na nyes pa tshad med de/ shwarnyi pas dka' 'grel du drangs pa las/ tshigs bcad gcig tsam nyan byas nas/ /de yang bla mar mi 'dzin na/ /khyi yi skye ba brgyar skyes nas/ /me sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang chos zhu zin nas ni tshul khrims 'chal ba zhig yin kyang ston pa'i 'du shes bzhag dgos te/ dkon mchog 15

tram̐ chen mtshophuchosagrwa'idaspatshogs/ da wa sprin las/ bla ma bsten na dge ba 'phel zhing mi dge ba 'grib par byed pas mkhan po thos pa che ba'am/ chung ba'am shes pa'am mi shes pa'am/ tshul khrims ldan pa'am/ tshul khrims 'chal ba la yang ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des phyi ra don 'di rnams la zhib tu bsam nas brtag pa'i dus su brtag bsten pa'i dus su yang dag par bsten dgos kyang —/ deng skabs dus ngan gyi rang rtags ngom pa'i chos pa'am thos bsam pa khas 'che ba 'ga' zhig gis/ khyi dang glo ba 'phrad pa ltar gang thug thug las dbang lung man ngag zhu dgos rigs thams cad zhu/ zhus zin nas 'phral rkyen phran bu re'i phyir yang bla ma dang chos spong nas dam tshig gar song tsam yang ma shes pa'i dred po chos sdug bla mar mig dred gdams ngag rna dred bstan pa'i rang gshed ma rabs khrel med rnams ni phyir rdzig rngams ji ltar che yang don du dam nyams dngos su gyur ba yin pas bag zon re mdzod 'tshal/ brtag tshul ni ring po'i rna thos thung ba'i mig mthong mo rtsis lung bstan sogs kyis brtags pa'am/ khyad par chos kyis brtags dgos te/sor thar gyi bla ma ni bsten mkhas btsun pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa gsungs la/ de nyid mdor bsdu na/ 'dul ba sum brgya ba las/ tshul khrim ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ /nad par snying brtse 'khor ni dag pa dang / /chos dang zang zing phan 'dogs brtson pa dang / /dus su 'doms pa de ltar bla ma bsngags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /byang sems kyi bla ma ni tshul khrims kyi bslab pas dul ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pas zhi ba/ shes rab kyi bslab pas nye bar zhi ba/ sde snod gsum la mang du thos pas lung gis phyug 16

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/pa sogs chos bcu dang ldan pa zhig dgos te/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung ji/sa phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo nga spangs la bsten/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa' thos mang dang / /bden mthong smra mkhas brtse ba can/ /skyo med skyes bu dam pa ni/ /chen po yin par shes par bya/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo / /zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ chog shes snying rje tshul khrims ldan/ /nyon mongs sel ba'i shes rab can/ /de dag la ni khyod bsten na/ /khyod kyis mkhyen gyi gus par mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bla ma ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi yon tan dang dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas rdo rje'i bla ma nyid la rag las pa'i phyir nye ba'i dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lha dang dbyer med du bsgrub byar bzung dgos pa dang / byang chub chen po'i bar du rigs kyi bdag por mi 'chol bar snying khug pa nas skyabs gnas kyi dngas mar bsten dgos pas/ spyir bsten bya mthar thug tu bzung du rung ba'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ bshad rgyud rdo rje me mong gi 'grel ba slob dpon dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa las/ bla ma de yang dkyil 'khor phyi nang gi dbang rdzogs par thob pa/ sdom pa dang dam tshig dag pa/ rgyud sde so so'i don la mkhas pa/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dang thācas pa'i don la sbyongs pa/ rtogs pa lta bas ma rmongs pa/ nyams myong ༷ma pa la 'dris pa/ sna tshogs spyod pa dang 'brel ba/ snying rjes gdul bya 17

tram̐ chen mtshophuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da wa'adren pa ste brgyad dang ldan pa'o zhes mtshan nyid brgyad ldan du gsungs pa dang —/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ khyad par gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni—/ /dbang dang sdom pa dam tshig gtsang ldan zhing / /rgyud don man ngag rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /bsnyen sgrub las sbyor 'phrin las mnga' brnyes shing / /lta sgom spyod 'bras nyams rtags drod tshad thob/ /brtse chen thabs mkhas gdul bya smin grol 'god/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs sprin phung ma yal ba de 'dra'i mkhas grub dpal ldan bla ma bsten/ /zhes brgyud pa'i byin rlabs sel med pa bsnan nas dgu bzhed/ gzhan yang spyi mdo dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud rnams su de nyid bcu dang / snying po rgyan las/ phyi nang gsang ba'i de nyid bcu phrag gsum du bstan pa sogs rgyud sde rang rang gi gzhung nas bshad pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa/ khyad par ma hā ma nu gnyis kyi bla ma/slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lam rims las/ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs—/ /gnyer ldan rgyud dang las la mkhas/ /man ngag drod dang brgyad 'chang ba/ /gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes rang byung brgyad ldan du gsungs/ lhag par man ngag ston pa'i bla ma ni/ rdzogs pa chen po rang lam gyi dbang spros bcas spros med shin tu rjos med sogs smin byed dbang gi chu bo zam ma chad pa'i rgyud smin pa/ dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig bsrung du yod pa rim gyis pa'i dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag rnams dang /srung du med pa cig char ba'i dam tshig med pa phyal ba sogs rnam par dag pas rgyud bsdams pa/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rgyud don khung du chud pa/ yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba la sogs bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags rdzogs pa/ grol byed 18

———— ——— ——— snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ da kyi gdams pa ka dag khregs chod dang lhun 'grub thod rgal gnyis kyis chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba/ lam snang ba bzhi'i sa mtshams kyi go myong rtogs pa ci rigs dang ldan nas rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba/ thugs rgyud snying rjes gang bas slob ma bzang ngan med par rjes su 'dzin pa sogs gzhan don 'ba' zhig gnyer ba/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i zhen pa spangs pas bya ba nyung zhing / phyi ma dung du len pas nan tan chos la sems pa/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal du mthong bas thugs skyo shas che zhing gzhan yang de la bskul ba/bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa brgyud pa gser gyi nyag thag la dam sel gyi g.yas ma gos ba/ brgyud pa gong ma'i byin rlabs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa de lta bu'i bla ma yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa zhig e yin legs par brtags dgos te/ yid bzhin rin po che mdzod las/ rim brgyud byin rlabs ldan pa'i bla ma ni/ /gong ma mnyes byas grub thob brgyud pa 'dzin/ /thugs mdzod lon pas snyan brgyud gdams par ldan/ /phyag bzhes mthong bas don gnyis sgrub la mkhas/ /sgrub la brtson pas dngos grub sprin tshogs mnyes/ /gzhan snang bsgyur nas thar ba'i lam sna 'dren/ /mdo rgyud bka' babs dam tshig gtsang gyur pa/ /de 'dra'i mkhas grub dpal mgon spyi bos bsten/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa med du mi rung ba'i mtshan nyid tshang dgos tshul ni/ 'on kyang rgyud sde rin po che sogs nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i bla ma ni dus nganalhags ma'i dus 'dir rnyed dka' ba ma zad/ rang re /ṭwāṃs

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ —blo gros dman pas rgya chen po brtags kyang mi shes pas/ des na brtag pa'i gnad thams cad bsdu na thugs rgyud rin chen byang chub kyi sems dang ldan mi ldan zhib tu brtag de dang ldan na rigs rus stobs 'byor sogs phyi'i tshul ji ltar dman yang don du 'brel tshad don ldan bzang 'brel tshe gcig sangs rgyas/ ngan 'brel 'khor ba mtha' can yin pas gal cher/ yid bzhin mdzod 'grel las/ chos nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid tshang na rigs dang longs spyod dang mi gzhi la sogs skyon phyogs re'am du ma yod kyang bsten gsungs/ de'i steng lta ba la go myong rtogs gsum dang ldan pa zhig yin min brtags gsungs/ kun mkhyen chen pos mdo sdud pa'i dgongs don ltar lam la mkhas pa dag kyang gtso bor bsten bya gsungs/ 'brom ston pas/ theg chen gyi bla ma bya ba bshad na 'byams glas par go bar skyed la/lag tu len pa na bstan pa'i tha ma la gang phan dang thad kar ngan du gang gyur ston pa zhig dgos gsungs/ sha ra bas/ sgrub pas mnyes kyi zang zing cung zad tsam la'ang mi lta ba zhig la bla ma zer ba yin gsungs/ 'chad kha bas—/ yul dus kyi dbang gis mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma rnyed dka' yang ma mtha'i tshul khrims dag cing / bla ma gong ma la dam tshig gi beelo med pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag dang ldan pa/ sgrob ma tshe 'di'i bya ba la mi sbyor bar phyi ma'i don la sbyor ba zhig nges par dgos gsungs/ be'u bum sngon po'i 'grel ba las/ ma mtha'i yang tshe 'di bas phyi ma gal che zer ba zhig la mi bsten thabs med gsungs/ 'on kyang dam pa'i skyes bu rnams ni sbas tshul la bzhugs pa dang / sdig pa'i bshes gnyen shing gi rang 'thag lta 20

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/bu phal ni rgyud tshod so skyes las dman yang phyi tshul dam pa'i ngang tshul ltar byed pa'i zog po bslu khrid mkhan dngadabye ba 'byed dka' bas ma nor dgos—/ gal te ma shes na rgyu mtshan shes pa'i gang zag dam pa mchog rnams kyis gang la bsten bltas nas rang yang de la bsten na mi baspu nges so/ /de lta bu'i yon tan rnams dang mi ldan na bla ma'am sprul pa'i sku dang mkhan po sogs ming gi thob dang mnga' thang 'khor dang longs spyod sogs ci che yang bsten bya mi 'os pa ma zad dug ltar sprong dgos ma gtogs dad pa can gyi dge tshogs chud gzan zhing / dal 'byor stong zad du 'gro ba sogs skyon mtha' yas pa 'byung ngo / /kun mkhyen chen pos/ de yang sngar bshad yon tan mi ldan zhing / /log pa'i skyon mang sdom dang dam tshig 'chal/ /byams dang snying rje shes rab thos pa chung / /le lo snyoms las mi shes nga rgyal che/ /ko long gdug cab nyon mongs dug lnga rags/ /tshe 'di don gnyer phyi ma rgyang ring 'phangs/ /chos ltar ston yang chos min zog po'i rigs/ /mi gtsang sung po lta bu'i bla ma ni/ /gdul bya bung ba mang yang ring du spang / /dad ldan log lam ngan 'gror 'khrid pas na/ /thar lam 'dod pas nam yang bsten mi bya/ /zhes dang / gang gis bsten pa zang zing kun sdud kyis/ /chos kyis nam yang sdud pa mi byed pa/ /de ni bshes gnyen ngan dang grogs ngan du/ /rgyal bas gsungs te thag srings yongs su spang / /zhes gdams pa'o/ /des na spyi dang gye brag gi yon tan tshang ba'i bla ma dam pa zhig rnyed nas ni rtag brtan 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dad pas sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pa'am sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i 'du shes 'di dus nam yang 'bral mi rung 21

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ba'i srog rtsa nyag gcig yin/ ci'i phyir sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pa'am dngos yin snyam na chos rang bzhin gyi ngos nas mnyam thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi ngos nas sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam zhing / mthong thos dran pa thams cad dge ba la 'god pa'i 'phrin las kyi tshul mtshungs pas kyang mnyam rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma yin pas kyang mnyam sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin pa gsungs pas kyang mnyam pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje me long gi rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gtso/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /zhes dang / gzhan du yang / ci phyir skyabs su 'gro dang tshogs kyi zhing / /bla ma sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gnyis/ /bskyed rdzogs bsgrub bya'i ngo bo 'dir 'dus pas/ /mdo rgyud kun nas sangs rgyas nyid du bstan//zhes gsungs/ de ltar ma yin pa the tshom dang mnyam 'grogs kyi dbang gis bla mar mi ru bzung na byin rlabs kyi 'jug sgo 'gag cing dngos grub kyi skal ba chad pa yin te/ 'jigs med gling pas/ bla mar mi ru bzung na dngos grub khyi las mi 'byung / /zhes dang / po to bas/ de yang theg pa chen po'i bla ma la so so'i skye bos 'du shes byung na dam tshig nyams pa'i tha mar 'gro ba yin gsungs/ sa paṇḍi tas grags pa rgyal mtshan la khu bo'i 'du shes kyis mi ru bzung bas yun ring gdams ngag ma thob pa'i tshul dang / mar bas yi dam bla ma'i rnam rol du ma shes pas dngos spub 'gyangs shing sras rgyud chad pa'i tshul sogs gsungs pas/ dam pa de lta bu dag gis kyang sangs rgyas dngos mthong gi 'du shes 'di bzhag dka' zhing skyon du gyur na/ rang re rnams kyi rgyud la 'byor sla ba ma yin pas ci nas kyang goms pa yun du srings 22

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/'tshal—/ des na yon tan kun rdzogs kyi bla ma dam pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rje ye shes kyi rang gzugs/ sngon byon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gang gis kyang ma thul ba'i snyigs ma'i gdul bya 'o skol rnams kyi don du/ gang zag mi'i gzugs su byon nas dgongs pa ngas rgyas su bzhugs kyang mdzad spyod gdul bya'i rgyud dang bsnan nas log thab dang skyo ngal thams cad spangs te thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam ma nor ba ston pa'i sgo nas/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don mdzad la 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen po bzhugs bzhin rang cag rnams brtse bas rjes su bzung chos kyi sgor bcug blang dor gyi mig phye ba sogs mdzad pas/sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che ba yin/ gzhan yang rang gi tshe rabs rdo 'brel ba'i bla ma dang 'phrad na ni brtag mi dgos la/ de ji lta bu zhe na/ 59) zhal mjal gsung thos pa tsam mam/ tha na mtshan thos pas kyang dad 'dzishugs drag pos lus ba spu ldang mig mchi ma 'khrug snang ba 'phral du bsgyur sku ya byung na de yin/ des na sngon las kyi dbang gis gang dang mjal zhing 'o sgor 'dren nas sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'am smin byed kyi dbang grol gyed khrid man ngag lung dang bcas pa bstsal te/ nang don gyi ye shes ngo sprod gsal bar ston pa po bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma de ni snying mig srog gaskum ltar gtso che bas ltar snang ji ltar mchis kyang skyabs gnas kun 'dus ca ngo bo sangs rgyas kun las kyang lhag pa'i mos gus rgyun chad med par byed hwa gal che ste/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ snyigs dus 'gro ba gdul dka'i can mdzad pas/ /gdul bya'i ngor ni sangs rgyas kun las lhag /ces dang /23

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dbee0tshogs/dri ma med pa'i mdor kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni sems can thams cad la snang ba'ang ma yin dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni yongs su snang bas chos ston cing thar ba'i sa bon 'debs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams lasalhag par zung zhig ces gsungs so/ /des na rang la las 'brel med na bla ma bzang po dang mjal ba'i skal pa med cing / snang ba ma dag na sangs rgyas dngos snang yang yon tan can du mi mthong ngo 'o na de lta bu slob mas bla ma brtag dgos na/ bla mas kyang slob ma brtag dgos sam snyam na dgos te/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ bla ma mchog des skal bzang slob ma la/ /dam pa'i chos ni yongs su 'chad pa na/ /thog mar snod kyi dbang po brtag pa gces/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ji ltar brtags na/ rab mngon shes kyis khams dang dbang po bag la nyal brtags nas ston pa/ paṇa chen ga ya rta ras mngon shes kyis mkhyen nas las can slob bu zhig lha rtse'i brag la bzhugs pa la dam chos sgo skyel du byon nas rjes su bzung ba lta bu sogs yin/ 'bring 'grogs nas brtag tha ma dris la brtag pa gces so/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba las/ ji ltar rin chen brdar ba dang / /gser ni bsreg dang bcad pas brtag /de bzhin du ni slob ma yang / /lo ni bcu gnyis bar du brtags zhes dang / /ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ /'phral du brjod par mi bya yi/ /snod la brtag pa byas nas bya/ /gal te snod ni shes gyur na/ /gsol ma btab kyang bshad par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ de ji lta bu zhe na/ ji skad du/ skal bzang slob ma dad dang shes rab che/ /brtson 'grus bag yod dranadang shes bzhin ldan/ /bka' las mi 'da' sdom dang dam tshig srung / /24

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/sgo gsum dul zhing snying rje phan sems che/ /khong yangs spro ring gtong phod dag snang che/ /gsungs so/ /mdor na nyan na tshig zin bsam na don go bsgoms na blo la skye ba zhig dgos pas gshis rgyud ri rgyal ltar brtan pas shi yang gzhan du mi 'gyur ba/ chos dang bla ma bslab pa sogs la gus pas rtag tu brtson 'aspu4che ba/ skyes sbyong gi shes rab che bas thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan gong du 'phel pa/ rnam grol don du gnyer bas 'di snang la zhen pa chung ba/ g.yo sgyu dang nga rgyal med pas gdams ngag gi snod du rung ba sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan na bsten bya'i slob ma mchog yin pa sa bla mas kyang lad du mi 'jug pa bsgrims te ma skyong na yul dus grogs kyi dbang gis chos smras go dred khyer ba'i 'khor du 'gyur na phyi nas yang dag red dka'/ dkon brtsegs las/ sdig pa'i grogs po gang zhe na/ dge ba 'grib cing mi dge ba la sbyor ba gang yin ba ste/ de bsten par mi bya/ bsnyen par mi bya/ mthong bar yang mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ des na dus ngan gyi ban gzugs pho mo 'ga' ni a gsar dang ngor dga' mkhas/ g.yo sgyu dang tshul 'chos mang /rnam rtog gi 'gyu dran rgod/ grogs ngan gyi kha bsgyur sla bas/ dang po bya ngang ba'i rgyal po ltar zhi zhing dul bas bla ma dang mched grogs la gus baji che/chos thos bsam sgom pa la don gnyer che khul mchis kyang / bar du glo bur gyi nges 'byung yal/ le lo dang snyoms las kyis nyin mo zar dga' dang /mtshan mo nyal skyid kyi ngang nas grogs ngan dang 'brel rgyug byed/ ma rabs kyi 'dun 'gros mang / yul snang la zhen chags che/ chos dang rang rgyud ni shar nub kyi ri bzhin ring bas lo mang chos grwa la bsdad kyang yar bskyed med/25

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ —tha ma grong yul stod smad kun tu 'khyam nyul khyi bzhin rgyug /khyim pa sun 'byin gyi las du ma byed bzhin mi ring ba sad kyis khyer nas bstan pa'i dbu rna gtsong ba mang ste/ 'grel chen shing rta chen po las/ skal ba ngan pa'i slob ma nyes pa du ma'i snod du gyur pa/ dad pa dang ngo tsha chung ba/ khrel yod dang snying rje chung ba/ rigs dang rang bzhin ngan pa/ kun spyod dang skal ba ngan pa—/ sems dang nyon mongs rags pa/ dge sdig dang bslab pa 'chal ba/sdom pa dang dam dzig mi bsrung pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sgo mi sdom pas gnyen po la rmongs pa/ shes rab chung la mgu dka' ba/ khong khro dang tshig cab nyi tshe 'phel ba/ chos min gyi bya ba la ngang gis brtson pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bla 'tshong —/ chos kyi rkang 'dren/ dge 'dun gyi sgab brdum pa/ de dag bla ma la chos tshol ba na/ rang nyid rnam par ma zhi bas kun la 'tshe zhing khyad du gsod pas rngon pa dang 'dra la zhes gsungs bas so/ /des na de lta bu gang zag la dbang dang gdams ngag ston snga na rang gzhan nyams pa'i rgyu las ma mchis pas bu chung kha can kha med gnyis la ma yis skyong tshul gyi dpe bzhin gyed na legs te/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ ji ltar seng ge'i 'o ma ni/ /sa yi snod du bzhag mi bya/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud/ /snod min rnams la sbyin mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / klong gsal las/ yang snying bcud kyi thig pa 'di/ /snod min rnams su spugs pa na/ /snod chags bcud 'bo dmyal bar nyung / /zhes dang / rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling bas/ chos tshul bzhin byed par nyin skar las dkon pas/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i gces nor khyab gdal du ma sgrags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /26

da da wa—— snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/gsum pa dmigs gsal bla ma mang nyung gi khyad par ni/ gal te de lta bu'i bla ma btsal nas bsten dgos na bla ma mang po btsal nas bsten pa'am nyung ngu btsal nas bsten pa gnyis gang dga' snyam na/ ca/tha' gcig tu ma nges te/ dbang rab snod yangs gsal la dri ma med par gyur bas gdams pa'i gnad thams cad 'gal med du go zhing thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes rnal ma yod pas/ gzhan du 'gro ba'i dus na 'bral mi phod par lan brgya stong du mar bskor ba byed cing mig mchi mas gang ba sogs de lta bu btub na bla ma mang cha/ yon tan sna mang po 'byung bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gsang phu ba dang / 'phags pa nor bzang gi rnam thar lta bu mang por bsten na legs/ dgongs 'dus las/ blo ldan dga' dang gus pa yis/ /dam par gyur to cog rnams la/ /'dun par lan gsum gus bya ste/ /zhabs la khyi bos gtugs par bya'o zhes so/ /blo dman sbyong ba ma song zhing gdams pa'i gnad dang spyod tshul tha dad pa rnams la 'gal 'du can du sems pa'i gang zag rnams la ni/ bla ma yon tan dang ldan pa nyung ngu la bsten na legs kyi/ thog ma sus bshad bshad la nyan pas bla ma du ma red pa yang med la/ bla ma du 'dzin pa ni gcig kyang med/ song tsa na chos dang chos smra ba kun la ma gus par 'gro ba sogs drin len log 'jal byed pa'i rigs la ni tshe 'di la nad dang gnod pa mang ba dang / phyi mar dmyal ba sogs su rnam smrin myong dgos pas nyung na legs te dge bshes ston pa'i rnam thar lta bu yin/ be'u bum sngon po'i 'grel bar/ btub bo snyam pa zhig la brten par bya'i/ slob dpon tha dad mi 'dra ba mang po la brten na/ ming dang tha 27

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/snyad mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'byung tsa na byed ngo rang mi shes par 'gro/ des na mang po'i drung du yug yug phyin pas skyon las yon tan mi mthong ba'i dpe gos hrul lud gseb drud pa bzhin du gsungs so/ /gzhan yang yul dus gang zag chos sogs la zhib tu ma bltas par mtha' gcig 'di las gzhan mi 'os zhes smra ba'ang mi bya ste/ theg pa chung ngu'i sde snod shes na khyim pa las nyan rung ba jo bos gsungs/ sgra tshad sogs thun mong rig gnas skor phyi rol pa las kyang mnyan du rung ba phu chung bas gsungs/ sgom pa shes rab 'bar gyi dge tshul gyi mkhan po ston pa rgyal ba'i bla ma bya ba 'dul ba la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yod pa la/ phyis babs kyang sgom pas mdo rtsa ba nyan du phyin pa'i gtam rgyud dang / gzhan yang slob ma'i ngos nas yid ches yod na rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba'i dper/ sngon ma bsad pa'i mtshams med byas—/ phyis bsnyen par rdzogs nas dge slong gi sdom pa ma skyes kyang / ming dge slong bde byed zer bas mtha' 'khob tu dge 'dun gyi sde spel ba'i phyir rang nyid kyis mkhan slob byas nas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs byas pa rnams yid ches kyi dbang gis sdom pa skyes par ma zad dgra bcom yang thob pa byung ba dang / bde byed rang nyid tshe 'phos nas dmyal bar skyes kyang / sngar dge 'dun gyi sde spel ba'i mthus dmyal ba las myur du thar te/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi ba'i lhar skyes nas/ sangs rgyas kyis chos bstan pas bden pa mthong ba'i gtam rgyud bzhin yin pas/ des na go ba rgya che ba las gu dog po mi bya ba 'di kun la gal che'o/ /gsum pa bla ma ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul la/ dpe'i sgo nas bstan pa/28

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/bsten tshul dngos/ bsten nas dgongs spyod bslab pa dang gsum/dang po ni/ tshe 'dir bde la thar ba'i lam sna zin/ phyi mar skyid pa byang chub kyi lam la 'dzeg pa/ gtan du legs par rang gzhan gyi don gnyis grub pa'i 'dun ma bzang po ni/ bla ma dam pas ston par nus pa'i jir bsten par bya dgos la/ de ji ltar bsten na/ de yang nyon mongs pa'i nad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir nad pas sman pa bsten pa dang / nyes pa'i 'jigs pa bskyab pa'i phyir dmangs kyis rgyal po bsten pa dang / skye shi'i 'jigs pa las thar bar bya ba'i phyir 'gron pos skyel ma bsten pa dang / rang gzhan gyi don gnyis grub pa'i phyir tshong pas ded dpon bsten pa dang / 'khor ba'i chu bo las brgal ba'i phyir gru pas mnyen pa bsten pa la sogs pa lta bu'i sgo nas bla ma bsten dgos so/ /gnyis pa bsten tshul dngos ni/ mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi phan bde thams cad bla ma la rag las pas rang gi drin chen dpal mgon bla ma dam pa skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rin po che gang la bsam pa bla ma ngas rgyas su shes pa'i bcos min gyi dad pa phyi nang gsal sgrib med par shel gyi mchod rten lta bu dang ma bral ba byed pa ni gzhi yin te/ dkon mchog sgron me'i mdo las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ yon tan thams cad 'byung zhing 'phel bar byed/ ces gsungs par ltar ro/ /jo bo la/ston pas bod la sgom sgrub byed pa mang po yod pa la yon tan khyad par can brnyes pa mi bdog zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ theg chen gyi yon tan che skyes chung skyes thams cad bla ma la bsten nas skye ba la khyod bod la tha mal 29

tram̐ chen mtshoguchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da wa—pa'i 'du shes las med ga na skye gsungs so/ /sbyor bas bsten tshul ni/'dul ba las/ bsnyen pa rdzogs nas zhag gis ma chod par lo bcu'i bar du lnga phrugs kyi yon tan dang ldan pas 'dul ba'i gnang bkag phra zhib mkhyen pa'i gnas kyi slob dpon bsten dgos te/ mdo rtsar/ bsnyen pa rdzogs nas lo bcu ma lon par mkhan po nyid dang gnas nyid dang / mi gnas par 'dug par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ theg chen la ni/ bla ma'i drung du song nas phyag dang gsol ba sngon du 'gro bas bsten dgos te/ sdong po brkod pa las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni bya ba ma yin pa khong du chud par byed pa'o/bag med pa'i gnas las yang dag par zlog pa'o/ /'khor ba'i grong khyer nas 'don pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar yid la bya ba rgyun ma chad pas bshes gnyen rnams kyi drung du 'gro bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ chos kyi sbyin pa'i ched kyi phyir/ /gal te khyed la gsol 'debs na/ /rab rgyas bdag gis ma bslabs zhes/ /thog mar tshig de brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs yid bzhin mdzod las/ de yang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dag/gang na bzhugs pa'i yul phyogs der bgrod de/ /dad gus sri zhu chen po dang ldan pas/ /thog ma nyid nas mnyes bya yang dag btsal/ /zhes gsungs pas dang po nyid nas mi mnyes pa byed na dam pa rnams ni drang po yin pas mthong ma zeg tu kun spyod ngan 'dug dgongs nas thugs sun shor na thog ma'i rten 'brel 'chugs 'gro bas yang dag bya dgos so/ /de ltar byas nas bla ma dam par tshul bzhin bsten dgos te/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyang de la bsten nas 'byung ba'i phyir te/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ dus 30

da wa—da wa snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/gsum rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang tshogs/ /byang chub gsum brnyes dge ba'i gshes las byung / /zhes gsungs/ dgongs 'dus las/ bskal ba stong gi sangs rgyas pas/ bla ma mnyan par shes par bya/ /ci'i phyir bskal pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /bla ma dag la brten nas byung / /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang gang zag mchog dman kun dang lam dang po zhugs pa nas mtha' ma phyin gyi bar dus rnams kun tu kun gyis bla mar bsten na yon tan 'byung ste/mdzod 'grel pad dkar las/ ci yang mi shes pa'i rmongs pas kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten na yon tan gyi 'os khyad par can rgyud la 'byor bar byed pa nyid de yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pa de'i phyir/las dang po ba thar ba'i lam sna tshol bas grol ba 'dod cing 'dun pas don du gnyer ba rnams dang / bar du lam la zhugs te slob pa dag bdud kyi sa las 'da' ba dang / yon tan gong ma thob par 'dod pa rnams dang /mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa rnam par grol ba'i 'bras bu la phyogs pa rnams kyis bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya ste/ bsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' bla ma la bsten te yon tan gyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gal te dang por bsten bar du gdams ngag rdzogs par thob zin rjes rang gi logs su sgrub pas mi chog gam snyam na mi chog ste/kun mkhyen bla mas bla ma bsten yun ring ba gdams ngag zhu yun ring ba zab don sgom yun ring ba dgos gsungs/ po to bas/ logs su bsdad pas mi 'ong bas bla ma dang nye ring ran par byas te/ yun bsrings nas bsgrub 31

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/dgos pa yin gsungs/ dol pas/ bla mas man ngag dus gcig rdzogs bstan/ /sherteshing go bar gyur tu zin kyang / /mi 'grogs logs su 'dug pas ba bas na/ /de la yon tan gang yang mi skye/ /cung zad skyes kyang myur du med 'gyur/ /shes rab dman yang dad rtsa yod pas/ /bla ma mi 'bral rtag tu 'grogs na/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams de la yod zin/ /de bas rtag tu gus pas 'grogs bya/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyal ba'i btsun pa spun gnyis kyi gcig dad pa dang shes rab che yang / bla ma dang ma 'grogs pas tshong pa zhig las ma byung bar/ 'jug tu grir shi/ gcig dad pa dang shes rab chung yang / bla ma dang 'grogs pas bzang po zhig byung skad gsungs/ sdong po bkod pa las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni 'khor ba na rgyu ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob cing / legs pa thams cad ston pa'i phyir rtag tu thod bzhin spyi bos bsten pa la bsnyel ba med par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/thog ma nas bsten pa'i tshe blo lus ngag yid gsum bla ma la 'bul nas/ rang la nad pa'i 'du shes bla ma la skun pa chos la sgan nan tan nyams su len pa la nad nye bar 'tsho ba'i 'du shes bzhi mdo de nyid las gsungs par ltar tshul bzhin bskyed nas/ gces pa'i srog la babs kyang bla ma dam pa 'di'i thugs dang 'gal ba sogs mi bya snyam pa'i snying stobs che ba/ gnas skabs kyi 'phral rkyen phran bu re'i snang ba mi 'gyur ba'i dam bca' brtan pa/ lus dang srog la'ang mi blta bar bla ma'i zhabs tog sgrub nus par zhig dgos te/zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/ myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub 'dod pas sems bskyed de brtson 'grus brtsams shing lus dang srog la'ang mi lta bar chos dam 32

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/pa ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes mnyen rgyun du btsal/ g.yo dang sgyu med pas bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /de ltar 'tshol ba dang sri zhu byed pas yongs su skyo ba med pa na/ bde bar mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i chos thob bo zhes gsungs/des na tsha grang dang bkres skom ngal dub sogs dka' ba thams cad khyad du bsad nas ci gsung gi bka' bzhin nyan nas sgrub/ dad gus kyis gsol ba 'debs/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bya ba dang spyod pa thams cad bla ma'i thugs dang bstun nas sgrub dgos/ res 'ga' bka' dkyon drag pos tshar bcad cing bdag la lhag par sdang ba lta bu snang na'ang khro ba dang 'khon 'dzin mi bya zhing / rang la skyon yod pa rnams bla mas thabs mkhas kyis 'dul ba yin par shes dgos te/ rgyal ba'i dbang po klong chen phas/ thugs 'khrugs pa ltar snang bas/ pha rol gyi dad pa brtan pa dang mi rtan pa'i ngang tshul rtogs par byed do/ /zhes dang / mdzad pa zhi ba dang /drag bo gang mdzad kyang / gzhan la phan pa 'grub pa ni skyes bu dam pa sha sa kyi rang bzhin yin te/ rang don spub zin nas gzhan don 'byung ba'i shabs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na don chen po thar pa bsgrub pa la lam mkhanatsā ma las gzhan med pas/ de'i bya dka' ba ci dang ci yang bzod bang byas la ngang bsrings te sgrub pa ni 'jig rten gyi bya ba phran tshegs la'ang dada' ba bzod pas bsgrub dgos pa bzhin no/ /zhes dang / gal te bla ma ring bar mngon na yang / rang skyon yod nges brtags la bshags bsdom bya zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang bla ma'i mdzad spyod g.yag nag brgya bsad pa lta 59ba nges par ci mdzad kyang thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad tshul du shes nas 33

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/dag snang bya dgos te/ de nyid kyis/ de yang bla ma dam pa zab mo'i blo can rnams ni nam yang gzhan gyis gting dpog par mi 'gyur te/ kun tu spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad kyang 'gro ba 'dul ba tsam las/ dgongs pa chos nyid zab mo stong pa nyid dang byang chub kyi sems las mi 'da' ba'i phyir ro/ /des na bla ma'i mdzad pa gang la'ang dgongs pa rlabs che ba'i rol par shes pas—/ dag snang skyed pa yin gyi/ ma dad pa cung zad kyang bsam du mi rung ste lam gyi rten 'brel 'chugs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ rtag tu bla ma'i yon tan dran bya zhing / /skyon la mi rtog mthong yang yon tan bsam/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di ltar bla ma'i zhabs tog byed dus skyon la mi rtog cing yon tan 'ba' zhig dran dgos/ gal te spyod tshul sogs la ma dad pa'i skyon rtog cung zad byung na de la mi sems pa bla ma de'i mdzad pa rang gi blo yul du shar ba rnams kyi nang nas slob ma la phan sems che ba sogs yon tan gyi cha gang shar ba rnams yid la byas la bdag gi bla ma dam pa 'di la yon tan 'di dang 'di lta bu mnga'o snyam du bsam dgos te / be'u bum 'grel las/ so so skye bo skyon gyi rang bzhin yin pas des bla ma byed ring la skyon gyi ngos nas bltar ye mi rung rtag tu yon tan gyi ngos nas bsam na dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab btub pa yin/ de ltar ma byas par rtag tu skyon sha stag bya ra byas na tshe rabs thams cad du bla ma mi 'phrad tshe 'di rang la yang mdze byung ngo khrag skyugs so snying rlung langs so mi 'dod pa sna tshogs 'byung gsung/ de ma zad rmi lam du skyon mthong na'ang sad ma thag bshags dgos te/ 'khor lo chub pa rol pa 34

da wa snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/las—/ gal te mi lam nang dag tu/ /bla ma'i skyon dag mthong gyur na/ /sad ma thag tu bshags par bya/ /gal te bshags pa ma byas na/ /'di yang mnar med rgyu 'phel 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/gzhan yang bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs chen po gsum yod de/ rgyal tshab byams pas/ bkur ste rnyed pa dag dang rim gro dang / sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ bstan pa ji skad bstan pa sgrub pa des/ de yi sems ni yang dag mgu bar byed/ ces pa'i don/tha ma zang zing gi 'bul ba/ 'bring lus ngag gi zhabs tog rab sgrub pa'i mchod pa dang gsum mo/dang po ni/ de yang zhing pa rnams kyis zhing la sa bon grangs mang po gtor kyang rang gi don du sems shing zhing de la lhag par yang gces spras gyed na/ bla ma bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa gong na med pa yin pas/dngos po yid du 'ong ba thams cad bla ma'i phyogs su gtong ci thub bya dgos/lde55nga bla ma de gang la thugs mnyes pa brtags nas yo byad de bzhed ma thag rmersā༄sa sems med par 'bul la/ gnyis 'dam du yod na dkon pa'i rigs sa rizang shos de bla ma la 'bul dgos te/ klong gsal las/ rin chen bu chung nor gyi dbyig /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad 'bul/ /zhes dang / ma lnga bcu pa las/ mi zad de nyid 'dod pa yi/ /cung zad yid 'ong gang dang gang / /shin tu khyad par gyur pa nyid/ /de dang de ni bla mar 'bul/ / sa dang / rang shar las/ de ltar man ngag slob dpon la/ /rang lus dang ni rin chen rdzas/ /shin tu dkon pa dag gis bsten/ /zhes gsungasdu/

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/gzhan yang 'jig rten pas tshig da don gyi sgo nas phan cung zad btags pa dang phyis don nyi tshe ba tsam bcol ba la'ang dngos po'i rgyu nor chen po ster dgos na/ bla ma dam pas chos bdud ji lta bu mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi bka' drin gnang zhing snying po byang chub bar du skyabs kyi dam par brten dgos pas ci'i phyir mi mchod/ khyim bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang sems gang zhig gis lung nod pa dang / kha don bya ba don du gnyer bas pha rol tu phyin pa drug gamaspyang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi tshogs la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig lung mnos sam blangs pa'i smob dpon de la yi ge'i grangs ji snyed yod pa'i bskal par rnyed pa dang / bkur sti dang / mchod pa thams cad kyis bsten bkur byas kyang —/ da dung slob dpon gyi gus pa yang ma rdzogs na chos kyi gus pa lta ci smos zhes gsungs/ des na chos kyi tshig 'bru re'i yon bskal pa re'i bsnyen bkur byas pas mi rdzogs na bla ma nyid kyi bka' drin ji ltar gzhal nus pas shes par gal nee'o/ /gal te chos thos bsam sgom gsum sogs rgya chen por ma shes shing ma rtogs kyang bla ma dam pa la ci pod kyi dngos po'i mchod cing /zhabs 'bring du g.yog dang zhabs zhu gyed nas bla ma'i bugs kyisatyān pa byed na'ang yon tan tshad med de/ dgongs 'dus las/ chos kun mi shes ma rtogs kyang / /mtshan nyid bzang ldan bla ma la/ /bkur nas rim gro cher byas pas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho brgal bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /tshe 'dir tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba sogs rgyas pa dang / mi mazun tshogs zhi ba dang myur du sangs rgyas thob par sogs kyang bla ma dam 36

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/par mchod pa las 'byung ste/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ mdor bsdu na bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa dang / bar chad zhi ba dang / dpal 'byor che ba dang / myur du sangs rgyas thob pa ni mthong ba dang ma mthong ba'i chos kyi yon tan te bdag gi kyang tshe zad pa las/ bla ma dam pa ku mā rā dza la 'khor gsum dag pas mchod pa'i phan yon gyis phyir yang tshe 'phel te/longs spyod kyi 'du ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /des na tshe 'di nyid du yid ches pa'i phan yon de 'dra na/ tshe rabs gzhan du lta ci smos zhes gsungs so//de ma zad bza' ba dang btung ba'i gud kyis dus rtag tu bla ma la mchod na yang phan yon che ste/ rdo rje ro langs kyi rgyud las/ gang gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /bza' btung sud kyis rtag tu mchod/ /'di yang bza' btung 'a la ba dang / /'khor lo bsgyur rgyal thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/rang la chos spyi dang khyad par dbang khrid man ngag zab mo tshul bzhin stsal ba'irdo rje slob dpon de la ni/ sbyin dka' blos mi thongs pa'i bu dang chung ma rang gi lus srog kyang yon du 'bul ba'i sgo nas bsten cing mnyes par bya dgos na/ rta glang gser dngul ja dar sogs phyi rol gyi longs spyod g.yo ba rta sgo rtag pa'i zang zing gi yo byad gzhan dag 'bul dgos pa ni smos ci dges te/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ rang gi dam tshig slob dpon ni/ /sbyin dka' bu dang chung ma dang / /rangarog gis kyang bsten bya na/ /longs spyod g.yo bas smos ci dgos/ /zhes dang / bkod pa chen po las/ rta dang glang shar gyi dbyig /rgyal srid bu dang chung ma dang / /gser dngul zangs lcags rin po che/ /bza' bca' dga' ston na bza' dang / /snying po sman 37

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/'bru me tog dang / /chos dang zang zing longs spyod rnams/ /bla ma mnyes phyir yon du 'bul/ /des ni dngos spub ma lus pa/ /da lta nyid du thogs med 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /gzhan yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod pa bas bla ma mchod pa bsod nams che ste/ gsang 'dus las/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mchod pa las/bla ma'i ba spu'i khung bu cig mchod pa bsod nams che'o/ /zhes dang /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang mnyam par bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang mnyam par bsnyen bkur ba bya gang gis rdo rje slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig la snum gyis byugs pa byas pa ches bsod nams khyad par du 'phags so zhes gsungs/ ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /gzugs sku stong phrag gzhal med la/ /rin chen lnga yis spras pa bas/ /bla ma'i skra'am ba sru zhig /rin chen lnga yis rgyan pa na/ /'di ni bsod nams pha mtha' yas/ /ji ltar dge slong khrims ldan pa/ /'bum phrag drug cu rtsa gnyis la/ /ston mo lan bdun bcug pa bas/ /bla ma'i zhal du 'bras chan 'bru/ /rdog ma bdun drangs bsod nams la/ /brgya stong khri 'bum char mi phod/ /ces dang /dgongs 'dus las/ des na sangs rgyas stong phrag la/ /bskal pa stong du mchod byas pas/ /bla ma'i ba sru'i khung re la/ /tsan dan thigs pa gcig byugs pa'i/ /stong phrag char yang phod pa min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /khyad par dbang khrid man ngag sogs chos zab mo gnang ba'i tshe ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs dam pa de la zhugs nas yod pas rgyun du brgya 'bul stong 38

da snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/'bul bas de'i dus cung zad 'bul ba'i bsod nams che ba gsungs pas mgo nag lag stong mi 'gro ba spos dang me tog dar nur re tsam mi bcag pa 'di gal che'o/ /lag sor pa'i zhal nas/ bzang po yod bzhin du ngan pa 'bul na dam tshig nyams te bla ma de la dgyes pa'am ngan pa las med na nyes pa med gsungs/ gal te bla ma mchod pa'i yo byad bdag dbul bas mi 'dug snyam du mi bsam ste/ rang gis sgrub nus na tha na chu dang shing sogs phul yang bsod nams che ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ snying po med pa'i lus la snying po blang bar bya ba'i phyir bla ma mnyes par bya ste/ tha na ci yang med kyang chu rdza gang tsam yang 'bul lo/ /des dge ba'i rtsa ba dpag tu med pa dag kyang rnam par 'phel lo/ /zhes gsungs/ dol pas/ ngas dge bshes sgyug rum pa'i gzims khang la grogs pa zhig dgos par 'dug pas 'jag ma khur cig brngas nas phul bas nan tar mnyes gsung ba sogs mang ngo / /gal te bla ma la dngos po 'di dang 'di lta bu zhig 'bul bsam khas blangs nas ma phul na/ nyes pa shin tu che ste/ rdo rje snying po rgyan las/yid la gang bsams ma phul ba'am/ /khas blangs de ni ma phul na/ /yi dwags dmyal ba rnam gnyis su/ /nges par skye ste brlag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bla ma dam pa gang gis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya cher bsags pa'i khrod du rang nyid kyis kyang dngos po'i 'brel 'jog dang rjes su yi rang rgya chen byas na bsod nams mnyam du thob par gsungs pas kyang mchod dgos te/ dpe chos las sran phye'i dpe gsungs/ gzhan yang longs spyod kyi dngos po bzang rgu ci mchis kyang brku 'jal dang stong 'jal 39

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/sogs don med zad pa ma zad rang nyid 'chi tshe thams cad bor dgos pa sogs mtshan du ma la bsam na'ang mchod rigs te/ spyod 'jug las/thams cad gtong ba chab gcig la/ /bla ma rnams la gartong pa mchog /ces bsgyur bas chog go /de lta bu'i bla mar mchod dgos pa bshad pa de yang /bla ma la dbul phongs dang bkros skom sogs yod nas de dag bsal ba'i phyir 'bul ba ma yin la/ rang la gong du bshad pa'i yon tan de dang de lta bu 'byung du yod pas bsten nas mchod dgos pa yin te/ klu sgrub kyis kyang /mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar ci dang ci sul yang gzhan gyi rtsar khe rngams kyis bsgrag par bya mi rung ste/ ye shes dri med las/ mdzod ldan bla ma'i phyogs dag tu//bkur rim gro sus byas pa/ /yongs su sgrog dang bgrang mi bya/ /gal te de ltar su byed pa/ /'bras bu thed cing brlag par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / klong chen pas/ yang bla ma dam pa de 'khor ba'i rgud pa sel zhing / sangs rgyas kyi 'phyor pa thob par byed pa bla na med pa'i chos rin po che ston zhing /sems nyid sangs rgyas su ngo sprod pa'i drin mi 'dren par/ kho'i zang zing cung zad kyi drin drangs par mi 'os la/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar bla ma mchod pa'i phan yon sna tshogs pa bsam nas lus longs spyod thams cad kyis mchod cing bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /gal te de ltar ma 'byor zhing ma nus na yid kyis de dang der sprul nas bla ma la mchod na'ang bsod nams che ste/ bkod pa chen po las/ gal te de ltar ma 'phyor na/ /yid las byung ba'i mchod 40

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/pa'i tshogs/ /rang gi lo grangs tsam sul na/ /'dis kyang bsod nams sngar dang mnyam/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /sku 'das pa'i rjes la'ang tshes grangs gang la thugs 'phos pa de'i nyin mtshan la mchod pa dang srog spu dang sbyin pa bya ba la sogs gus par bka' drin dran pas bya'o/ /thar rgyan las chos dang mthun pa'i zas dang gos dang mal cha dang / stan dang bskun gyi gso sman dang nor la sogs pa'i yo byad kyis lus dang srog la yang mi lta bar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen bkur gyed pa ste/ dper na 'phags pa rtag tu ngus dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji ltar bstan pa bzhin no/ /gsungs/ rje tsong kha ba chen pos/ de yang slob ma'i ngos nas tshogs bsags pa'i mchog yin pas de 'dra ba zhig dgos kyi/ bla ma'o ngos nas de la mi gzigs pa zhig dgos so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa 'bring lus ngag gi zhabs tog ni/ sgo gsum gyis mnyes par bya ba yin pas/ dang po lus kyis mnyes par bya ba 'di ltar/ dad gus ltem rkyang med pas/ lus kyis phyag 'tshal sngon du 'gro bas bla ma'i zhabs dang sku lus sogs bkru zhing dril phyis dang bku mnye bya ba/ gsol ja 'bul ba sogs bya ste/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ rkang bkru ba dang lus baspu dang / /dril dang mnye ba la sogs la/ /phyag ni sngon du 'gro bar bya/ /de bzhin mthar ni ci bder bya/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang bla ma me chu g.yang dang gcan gzan nam dgra'i bar chad bsrung ba dang bla ma'i bya ba la yul gzhan tha dad par bang chen gyi mngag gzhug bya ba dang / 'phral nye bar mkho ba'i g.yog gzhan gang dgos bya ba dang / bzhugs sar stan 'ding ba dang /41

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/gshegs sar zhabs 'bring bya ba dang / lam phyags pa dang / rang gi gos sam dar lam la sogs pa bya ba dang / spos kyi bsu bskyel dang / dris chag chag bya ba dang / gzims khang sogs nye 'khor phyags dar bya ba dang /khang pa'i sgo yang 'byed gcod dal bus bya ba dang bla ma mthong phyag 'tshal zhing byin rlabs zhu ba dang / ldang ba dang thal mo sbyar ba la sogs pa bya/sher phyin 'grel las bla ma bskyel ba dang bsu pa la sogs pa nyid kyis phyag dang zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa nyid dang zhes gsungs/ 'dul ba las/ mkhan po mthong ma thag tu stan las ldang ba bya'o gsungs/ ma langs na tshe rabs lnga brgyar 'phye bor skye ba las brgya bar gsungs/ rang gi bya ba gang byed pa'i sngon du bla ma la zhus te bya/ khyad par du chos bshad pa dang dbang bskur sogs gyed na zhus la rjes su gnang na bya/ rang nyid nyal ba'i sngas kyang bla ma'i phyogs su ston/ mdor na dus rtag tu bla ma la gdung ba'i sri zhus gnas par bya ste/ kun mkhyen bsam yas pas/ spyod lam mchog gis mnyes par bya ba yang / /lus kyis phyag dang bskor ba mchod pa 'bul/ /bar chad bsrung dang mngags gzhug g.yog bya dang / /ldang dang stan 'ding bkur ste sna tshogs bya/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin las/ byang chub sems dpa' chos smra ba'i drung du song la/ston pa sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes kyis bsten bkur bya ba thams cad bya zhing rjes su 'brang ngo / /dus thams cad du rang nyams btang ste dge ba'i bshes gnyen de'i blo bzhin du 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes dang / dam tshig mchog gi rgyud las/ lus dang ngag dang yid stobs kyis/ /ci nus pa yis bla ma la/ /42

da snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/bsnyen bkur sri zhu sus byas pa/ 'di la mthu dang nus pa'i tshogs/ /byin rlabs thogs pa med pa 'byung / /zhes gsungs/ des na spyod lam gzab la thabs sna tshogs kyis gus pas mnyes par bya'o/ /dang po brtags nas bla mar gzung phan chod ngan yang dam pa bzhin bkur dgos te/ dgongs 'dus las/ dam par gyur rung ma gyur yang / /dam pa mchog bzhin phu dud bya/ /gal te brnyas shing khyad bsad na/ /thur du bltas nas dmyal bar 'tshed/ /ces gsungs so/ /bla ma ji ltar yum yod na de yang bkur ba dang nye 'khor rnams dang bugs kyis gces par gzung ba dag la yang de ltar bya dgos te de rnams sun rgyung na de dag gis dbyen bcos te phugs su bla ma mi mnyes pa 'byung srid pas kyang sems gzung ngo / /gcig tu na bla ma'i zhabs rtog slob ma kun gyis bya dgos pa las des khur blangs pas bdag cag gis bya ma dgos pas kyang sems gzung ngo / /yang gcig na rgyal bo'i nye 'khor kun gyis bkur ba ltar bla ma'i nye gnas sogs kyang sems mi dkrugs par bkur dgos te/ bla ma'i sdug pa'ang bla ma bzhin/ /zhes bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /spyod lam mi mabun phyogs dor ba ni/ chos nyan pa'i dus sam gnas skabs gang pa nga rung ste/ drung du thal deb dang se gol sor mo'i tshigs mnyed pa dang / stan mthon por 'dug pa dang / rgyab ston pa dang —/ zur gyis 'dug pa dang / sked pa mnye bar/ gru mo rgyong ba/ rkang lag rkyong nas 'dug pa dang / nyal ba dang / glos bab ste gzhogs 'phres nas sdod pa dang / thor tshugs bcings pa zhwa gyon pa/ 'thab 'dzing /rtsed rgod dang / gos la sogs pa'i 'jol sgeg gyed pa dang / mchil snabs 43

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/'dor ba dang / grib ma 'gong ba dang / bzhud dus ma gnang bar mdun nas 'gro ba dang / g.yas zur nas 'gro ba dang / slad nas 'gro bar rnams mi bya/ zhabs 'bring g.yon thur nas 'gro/ gnang na gang nas 'gro yang nyes pa med/ bla ma'i mchil lham dang / na bza' dang / bzhugs stan dang / rdzas gzhan nor rdzas dang / gzhon pa dang / gzims chung dang /gsol sder dang / gsol zhal dang / phyag dpe la sogs pa rnams kyang ma gnang bar mi spyad pa dang / bla ma'i sku la mtho sogs kyis gzhal bar mi bya/na bza' dang bamugs stan la 'gong ba dang / drung du skyil krung dang ngo 'dzum gnag pa sogs sgeg chos kyis 'dug pa dang / che tshugs 'gying nyams kyis 'dug pa sogs nyes pa sna tshogs la nyes par rma shes bas mnyam 'grogs su 'gyur ram/ shes kyang dregs pas ma gus par byed pa ni/ slar 'bum 'gyur gyis nyes pa kyi bas spang bar bya'o/ /de dag lung dang sbyar na/yid bzhin mdzod las/ spang bya'i spyod lam mi gus bag med ni/ /'bru tshugs blta dang bzhin gnyer thal mo debs/ /rgyab zur ston dang rkang lag ba rkyang ba dang / /nyal 'phreng 'thab 'dzings rtse 'jo 'jo sgeg byed/ /ces dang / sems nyid ngal gso las/ bla ma'i spyan sngar lus ngag yid bldam zhing / /rkang pa brkyang dang kyis spung rgyab mi bstan/ /ngo 'dzum mi gnag khro gnyer bstan mi bya/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor ma dam pa'i rgyud las/ dbu sngas la sogs 'gom pa na/ /shal ma ri la 'dzeg par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i sku la mthos gzhal na/ /mi de mdung bung sum brgyas 'bigs/ /zhes dang /mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba'i rgyud las/ bla ma'i mjug nas mi 'ong zhing / /44

ging jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/zhabs kyi rjes la mnan mi bya/ /bla ma'i mdun la 'gro mi bya/ /gzhan gyis khrel ltas rgyab phyogs pas/ /sgro skur sdig pa'i las su 'gro/ /bla ma'i g.yas phyogs bzhud mi bya/ /phal pa 'gro la dga' ba yis/ /bla ma btegs phyogs g.yon nas 'gro/ /zhes dang / gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba las/bden pa'i don ston bla ma yi/ /dbu yi grib ma sogs 'goms pas/ /yang dag spangs nas dmyal bar kung / /zhes gsungs pa rnams bsams la/bag ma gsar ba 'ong ma thag 'dra ba'i bag zon gyis spyod lam ma dag pa rnams spangs la gus par bya'o/ /thar rgyan lus/ phyag 'tshal ba dang / myur du ldang ba dang / lus 'dud pa dang / skor ba bya ba dang / gdung ba'i sems kyis dus su smra ba dang / ngom pa med pa'i sems kyis yang dang yang du blta ba la sogs pa ste/ dper na tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji ltar bsten pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa yid rab tu gus pas kun nas blangs pa'i ngag gis/ bla ma la bstod pa dang / skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bla ma dang 'brel ba thams cad la zhe sas zin par byas la/ dngos skog gang du yang gsung gi gces pa sogs brjod cing / gsung sgros don ldan bzung nas ma brjed par sgrogs/bla mas ci gsung de ma red ces nam yang bsam pa dang brjod par mi bya ste/sangs rgyas kyi gsung la skur ba btab pa bas kyang sdig pa che'o/ /des na bla mas ci gsung thams cad skub la/ gsung ba dag la legs so snyam du yon tan nas bsam zhing yi rang mngon par bstod/ yul gzhan du song dus rang gi bla ma'i yon tan nges pa rnams brjod cing / thun bzhi'am rtag tu bla 45

tram̐ chen mtshophuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da wad ma dran pas gsol 'debs skad snyan shos kyis bya'o/ /gzhan yang ngag gis bstod pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / 'jam pa dang / gdong mi bzlog pa dang / drang por smra ba dang / ci gsung ba thams cad gus pas sgrub pa'i lan snyan po 'bul ba dang / kha glal ba dang / sbrid pa byung tshe kha dgab pa dang / gang ci byed kyang gsung gi gnang ba zhu ba dang / dge sbyor gyi thog mar bla ma dran pas bstod pa dang / gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /mdo las/rim gror byas te stan la bsdad do/ /bsngags par brjod do/ /legs so 'bul lo zhes pa dang / yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ ngag kyang snyan pos bstod dang skyabs su 'gro/ /tshig 'jam snyan pas zhe sa rim gror bcas//gsung bzhin sgrub cing ci gsungs legs zhes brjod/ /gzhan la'ang bla ma'i yon tan brjod bya zhing / /dbyangs snyan dad dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab/ /ces gsungs so/ /mi mabun phyogs ni/ spyir ngag gi mi dge ba su la'ang mi smra la/ gye brag bla ma'i drung du rdzun phra ma dzig tsub ca co'i sgra dang /bre mo'i gtam dang / bka' gcog pa'i tshig dang / gdong zlog pa'i tshig dang —/ zhe gcod pa'i tshig dang / lkog nas ngan du smra ba'i tshig dang / /ci zer lta ba'i tshig la sogs spang bar bya'o/ ci'i phyir na dus gzhan du brgya stong brjod pa las/ bla ma'i drung du lan gcig brjod pa sdig sgrib che bas so/ /'phags pa yon tan bkod pa'i mdo las/ bdud kyi las bzhi ste/bla ma la mi gus pa dang / chos yid la mi byed pa dang / khengs pa'i tshig smra ba dang / tshe 'di la sems pa'o/ /zhes pa dang / mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rgyud las/ bla ma sangs rgyas rang bzhin la/ /skog nas 'chal gtam cher smra 46
