snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ —ba—/ /bsdus 'joms su 'joms mgul ba 'gag/ ces dang / rgyab kyi glun rmongs zhes smra ba/ byang chub lam dang 'phrad mi srid/ ces dang / rgyan dam pa las/ ngag tshig brlang pos zhe 'gengs pa/ /bskal pa stong phrag dmyal bar skung / /rdo rje slob dpon dam pa yi/ /zab mo'i tshig la sgro skur ba/ /mnar med gnas su skung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gsang ba kun snyoms kyi rgyud las/ bla ma mchog las rang nyid ni/ /ches mchog zla sems smra ba ni/ /bskal pa stong phrag du ma ru/ /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang /gsang ba rol pa las/ skog 'phyas smra bar gang byed pa/ /rdo rje dmyal ba nyid du 'tshed/ /ku re tsam du'ang smod mi bya/ /ngag gi nyes byas yang dag bsnams/ /zhes dang / rim gsum las/ bag med tshig dang 'brel gyur pa//bla ma'i mdun du brjod mi bya/ /tha mal ba zhig khros na yang / /nyi tshe ba yi dmyal bar nyung / /zhes gsungs so/ /des na don med kyi gtam mang po bla ma'i mdun du smra ba spang dgos te bla ma'i bugs kyis khrel ba dang / 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de ma zad gzhan 'ga' zhig gis bla ma la ngan smras sgrogs na nus pa yod na thabs kyis bzlog mi nus na bla ma'i yon tan bsam zhing rang gi rna ba mdzub mos bkag nas de la bstan 'dris dang bag phebs par mi bya ste/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ gzhan gyis mi snyan brjod na'ang de bzlog cing / /nus pa med na slar yar yon tan bsam/ /rna ba dgab cing snying rjes phan par sgrub/ /de la mi bsten bag phebs smra ba min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa yid kyis mchog tu dad pas bla ma'i yon tan dang bka' drin 47

tre chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/dran par bya ste/ dkon mchog bzhi bar blta bas/ sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa'am lhag par mos pas/ mtshan thos pa dang / zhal mthong ba dang / smon lam gyis mjal ba dang / btsal bas lhad pa dang / gsungs thos pa dang /mgo la phyag gis reg pa tsam la'ang dga' ba chen po bskyed de/ dam pa 'di nyid spyir 'jig rten du 'byung dka' la/ khyad par yul dus gang zag gi dbang gis bdag dang phrad dka'/ phrad kyang chos zab mo thob dka'/ thob kyang nam 'bral mi shes lham pa'i blos bsten zhing / mos gus dang dag snang bya/ gzhan yang 'di ltar bsam dgos te/ bdag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sngon rgyan thams cad kyis 'dul ma nus pas da bar lus/de sngon spyi 'khor ba dgos ngan song gsum sogs mi khoms pa'i gnas rnams su 'khyams 'khyams nas sdug bsngal bar med du myong / dam pa'i chos kyi sgra tsam yang ma thos la/ da res bla ma'i bugs rjes mi lus thob/ bstan pa dang mjal/ tshang la ma nor ba'i gdams pa tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas 'aspub pa'i myur lam 'di lta bu'i chos bsam gyis mi khyab par zob sangs rgyas dngos su byon yang 'di las lhag mdzad rgyu mi 'dug pas bka' drin 'khor thabs mi 'dug bsam dad mos lhag tu bya/ rang dang mnyam pa dang mtho ba sngon khyim dang yul sogs la yod pa rnams la brtags na phal cher sdug bsngal brgya phrag du mas mnar nas shin tu sdug po ru gyur/ bdag bla ma'i thugs jes khyim nas byung ste lus la gos ngur rmig gam chos gos bgos/ngag nas 'chad rtsod bzlas brjod sogs la 'bangs/ yid la 'jig rten phyi ma'i don sems shing dben pa'i ri sul na drang srong gi spyod tshul gyis gnas 48

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/chog pa'am bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i 'gro don rgya cher spub pa 'di rnams ni bla ma'i drin min na su'i drin yin bsam blo lhag tu dran nas dad mos bya/rang re lugs gnyis kyi bya ba gang la yang rjongs nas ci yang sgrub ma shes pa'i na gzhon skabs/ bla ma dam pas dang por chos sgo la bzhag mthun rkyen sgo mtha' dag nas tshang bar mdzad/ 'gal rkyen sgo mtha' dag nas bsrungs te ma 'dzangs mas bu bskyangs pa bzhin thabs kyis chos dang rang rgyud 'dris par byas nas khe nyen rang gi shes pa'i bar bong bu mi khyur tshud pa 'dra ba zhig mdzad/ mdor na rang gi rgyud la skyon sna gcig 'gags pa dang / yon tan sna gcig skyes pa yan chad rnam dkar gyi yon tan ci yod thams cad bla ma kho na'i bka' drin yin pa dang / der ma zad zas gos gnas mal bde skyid snyan gsum stobs dang 'byor ba sogs tshe 'di'i nyer 'tsho'i sun tshogs thams cad kyang bla ma'i bka' drin du bsam nas srog la babs kyang mi ldog pa'i dad pa dang mos gus bya/ dkon mchog sprin las/ sa phyogs gang na chos smra ba gnas pa de la mchod rten gyi 'du shes dang / chos smra ba la bla ma dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed de mthong na dga' ba dang / rangs pa bskyed do/ /zhes dang / sred med kyi bus zhus pa'i mdo las kyang / byang chub sems dpa' mkhan po dang / slob dpon la bka' blo bde bas bla mar byed pa'i sri zhu dang / gus pa dang / phangs pa dang —/ gces par 'dzin pa'i sems bskyed par bya'o zhes pa dang / sdong po bkod pa las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen yid la byed pa dang ma bral ba las don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang / dgongs 'dus las/49

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs me tog gartor zhing bstod pas 'dud/ /dper na ma yis bu bskyed ltar/ /rgyal ba sras dang rig 'dzin rnams/ /dam pa las byung shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen chen pos/ yid kyis bla ma'i yon tan dran bya zhing / /dad gus chen pos 'phrad dka' blo skyed la/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sgam po bas/ ji skad gsungs pa'i bka' mi bcog pa dang / mos pa dang /gus pa dang / dang ba bskyed pa ste/ dper na nā ro pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji ltar bsten pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /jo bo rje la khyed la yon tan 'di dang 'di tsam mnga' ba zhu tsa na de bla ma'i bka' drin yin gsung —/ kham lung pa'i zhal nas/ kho bo'i 'tsho ba ngan phyid 'di dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bka' drin yin gsung ngo / /des na bla ma'i bka' drin dran pa'i tshe dad mos mchi ma 'chol zhing yid 'khul nus pa zhig nam du'ang yod pa gal che ste/ jo bo gser gling ba'i mtshan nas brjod tshe jo bo rjes phyag thal mo spyi bor bzhag pa dang / dren mchog bla ma tshe dbang 'gyur med kyis bla ma rnam rgyal gyi rnam thar brjod tshe dbang med du bshums pa mdzad pa sogs de lta bu yod dgos so/ /dor bya ni yid kyis bla ma dam pa la ma dad pa dang / khong khro ba dang / skyon ci 'dug brtag pa dang / rigs gzugs dang longs spyod dman pa la brnyas pa dang / 'gran sems dang / de dang de'i nye gnas dang slob ma dang / sbyin bdag sogs la gnod sems dang /'tshe ba dang / khong khro ba dang nga rgyal gyis sun 'byin sems pa dang / bla ma'i nor rdzas la brnab sems dang / log par lta ba dang / dgos dbang gi mdzad spyod la 'gal ba 'dzin pa sogs mi bya ste/ rang bzhin du'ang rdo rje'i 50

—da —da snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/rigs kyi bla ma zhi bar snang la/ rin chen rigs sgeg pas gos rgyan longs spyod kyis 'byor/ padma'i rigs yum dang bcas pa/ las kyi rigs drag shul che bas so so'i gang 'dul gyis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir gcig tu ma nges pas dag snang dang mos gus bya ba las log lta mi rung / mdor na bla ma la skyon ltar snang yang skyon du sems mi rung ste/ thugs dgongs shin tu zab ja/sa gang yin mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di nor rdzas la sred pa che snyam pa dang / khong khro che snyam pa dang / ser sna cher snyam pa dang / nga rgyal che snyam pa dang / yum dang bcas snyam pa dang / rigs gzugs ngan snyam pa dang —/ ci yang mi shes snyam pa la sogs mi sems te/ rang la mngon shes med pas thugs dgongs mi rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /khyad par lam gyi yon tan dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mi ldan snyam du mi bsam ste/ gsang gsum shin tu skog tu gyur bas dang / rang gi sgrib pas mi mthong pa'i phyir ro/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i zhal nas/ ma dad log par lta dang khong khro dang / rtag tu skyon la sems dang brnyas sems dang / /'gran sems gnod 'che'i sems dang nga rgyal sems/ /mdzad spyod 'gal bar 'dzin dang ma dad sems/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta'i sems rnams spangs/ /zhes dang / ye shes grub pa'i rtsa rgyud las/ bla ma'i rdzas dang 'khor rnams dang / /nye 'khor sun 'byin brnab sems spang / /mdzad pa sna tshogs sems can la/ /ra na pa'i thabs can 'phrul chen po/ /dgongs spyod rgya mtsho mtha' yas la/ /ltas pas log par blta ba dor/ /'e/sa dang / da lta gyi sangs rgyas mngon zhi ma pa'i ting nge 'dzin las/ gal te des chos smra ba de la mnar sems 51

tre chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/pa'am/ tha ba'am/ sdang ba'i sems kyis gnas sam/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes mi bskyed na/ de dag gi yon tan thob pa ni gnas med do/ /zhes pa nas ma gus pas chos nub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / snyoms 'jug gsang ba'i rgyud las/ bla ma dag la 'gran sems dang / /yi dam rgyal ba'i lha spangs pas/ /bong 'thed zhon nas mtsho bskor ltar/ /rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas 'aspub mi srid/ /bla ma'i dkor la brnab sems pa/ /bskal pa gnyis su yi dwags gnas/ /zhes pa dang / dpung rnam par bzlog pa'i rgyud las/bla ma dang ni de yi 'khor/ /khro bas zhe 'gras sun 'byin pa/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul rnyed du/ /mnar med gnas su 'tshed pa'o/ /zhes pa dang / rdo rje bla ma smad mi rung / /'dod chags zhe ldang la sogs pa/ /lnga po ldan zhes bsam mi bya/ /de bsams mnar med sa gzhir bsreg /ces pa dang / gzhung rgya mtsho las/ rdo rje yid bzhin rgyal po la/ /zas skom nor la sred snyam pas/ /rab mtha' bcu yi dmyal bar 'tshed/ /gsang mchog smra gyed rgyal po la/ /shes pa can gyi yid sgo nas/ /nga rgyal che ba'i yid mi bsam/ de skyon kha 'thab gnas su cing / /zhes pa dang / du ma 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ bdag gi drin la gnas bsam pas/ /mnar med par yang rab tu skye/ /slob dpon skyon la gang sems pa/ dge bsags don med lha spangs pas/ lha klu gdug pa la sogs kyis/ /myur du srog gcod dmyal bar thong / zhes pa dang / dge bshes rnal 'byor ba chen pos ngas grib ma la lan brgya 'gong na yang 'gong la nga la sems kyis ma 'gongs gsungs so/ /des na dus nam yang bla ma'i skyon la mi bsam zhing / gal te 'gas dbyen bcos te bla mas 52

da wa snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ da wasnang bar mngon na yang / mnyes pa'i bshags pa bya zhing / sdig pa zad pa'i rgyur bsam te gus pas yon tan la bsams te bsten par bya'o/ /gsum pa rab sgrub pa'i mchod pa ni/ de ltar tshul bzhin bsten na yang rang ga bsnad pas mi phan/ bla ma dam pa ni yon tan kun gyi mnga' bdag chu gter chen po ltar yin pas/ rang gis mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'am shes bya bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag gi chu thos bsam gyi sgo nas rang gis btung na smongs pa'i skom pa sel la/ de tsam ma nus kyang rang gi nyams su len rgyu'i lam sngon 'gro nas dngos gzhi'i bar cha tshang re nges par du zhus nas tshul bzhin ma shes thabs med de/ ji skad du/ bla ma bsten kyang gdams ngag ma lon na/ /mdo stor rgya mtsho'i 'gram du skom rid lus/ /gdams ngag yod kyang nyams su ma lon na/ /bcangs pa don chung sman dpyad rim gro 'dra/ /zhes gsungs/ des na bka' drin can gyi bla ma dam pas gsung ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi don thams cad go lo dang thos lo tsam du mi bzhag par/ mi med dathen pa'i ri la song nas tshe chos mthar phyin par yang dag pa sgrub par byed nas thar lam mchog la 'gro ba ni bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod pa bla na med pa yin te/ zang zing gis ni 'jig rten pa'i dga' ba tsam sgrub pa dang bya sla bas so/ /de bas lus ngag mchog ste lus srog phangs med du gartong nus pa ni shin tu bya dka' bas so/ /de bas kyang sgrub pa snying por byed pa mchog ste/ bla ma bsten pa'i dgos pa yang de yin la/ gong ma rnams kyi mdzad pa yang de yin/ lam gyi dgos pa'ang der thug pa'i phyir dang —/ tshe gang lus srog la mi lta ba sgrub nus pa dkon pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan 53

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/yang sangs rgyas nas rim par byon pa'i bla ma rnams kyis chos bstan zhing 'jig rten du byon pa'i dgos pa'ang de yin pas/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang ldan zhing dam pa mang du bsten nas thos pa phyogs med du btsal te rang gis gang dang gang thos pa'i don rnams dang po sgro 'dogs gcod nas sgrub/bar du bsam pas phyin ci ma log pa gtan la dbab nas sgrub/ mtha' sgom pas don nyams su len nas sgrub dgos so/ /nyams len de yang chos dang rang rgyud bsres la bsgrub cing / thabs shes zung du 'jug pas yid smon la ma lus par brtson pas sgrub na bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad mnyes par 'gyur te/ dam pa'i spyod pa de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa ste/ /zhes gsungs/ mdor na dam pa de'i bugs rgyud kyi yon tan gang mnga' thams cad slob ma rnams rang rang gi rgyud la 'phos nas rgyun srol mi nub pa byung na/ dam pa mchog rnams kyis bshad grwa dang sgrub grwa ri khrod dang chos grwa sogs bsgrun pa'i don nga grub la/ rang nyid kyang skra bcad sdom pa zhus yi ge klog nas chos sgo nugs pa sogs byas pa'i don yang byung la/ pha ma rnams kyis sdig sdug ched du bsad nas gces pa'i rgyu nor la ma bstos par bskyangs pa'i don yang byung / mdor na bla mas chos gnang zhing slob ma rjes su bzung ba dang /slob mas bla ma bsten te chos zhus pa'i don sogs thams cad gnad 'di la 'dus pas sgrub pa'i mchod pa mchod pa kun las mchog yin no/ skyes rabs las—/ phan pa'i lan du mchod pa bya ba ni/ bsgo ba'i tshig bzhin nyams su len pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ mdo sde rgyan las/ brtan pa ji skad bstan pa 54

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/sgrub pa des/ /de yi sems ni yang dag mgu bar byed/ /ces dang /dgongs 'dus las/ bka' zur ma bcag chos bsrung na/ /chos skyong srung ma mthu chen rnams/ /bu bzhin rtag tu spung bar byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /yum bar ma las/ gang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su gdams pa de bsgrub par brtson pa la ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bsngags so/ /bstod do/ /bkur ro zhes dang / dgongs 'dus las/ sngon gyi dam pa bde gshegs rnams/ /ded dpon dam pa mnyes byas nas/ /kun spangs dgon pa'i mthar gshegs te/ /sgrub pas yang dag thar pa mnyes/ /de bas de ltar rjes slob na/ /rgyal ba'i rnam grol gdung 'tshob bo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar brgyab pa'i mchod pas thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa'i don rdzogs par byed pas bla ma grub brnyes rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi rjes su snyegs shing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i gdung 'tshob pas na /'khor ba'i gnas ngan spangs te gcig pu zhi ba'i nags su sgrub pa snying por byed pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /gal te de ltar tshe gcig la sgrub ma nus kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dang mjal nas chos zab mo thob dus 'dir/don med kyi bya ba 'khor ba'i brel do dang / kha dal khom med par dkor nag 'ba' zhig la spyod nas shi gson kun gyi mgo nas 'pho lung dang dbang bskur sogs tha na las rung gi bsnyen tshad tsam yang med bzhin rgyug nas dal ba stong zad 'di phyi gnyis med byed pa las/ mdo sngags lam gyi nyams nan tha na zhag brgya re dang lo rer bdun mtshams re tsam byed na legs par ze'is te/ 'jam mgon bla mas/ tshe gcig chos la brtson par ma nus kyang / /55

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs pa'i don sgo la/ /mdo sngags lam gyi nyams len sna re tsam/ /dus dang rgyun du cung zad brtson na 'thad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang tha ma zang zing gi mnyes pas tshogs gnyis kyi bre kha gang ba zhig bya ba dang / 'bring lus ngag gi zhabs tog gis sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyong nus pa tsam dang / rab rgyab pa'i zhabs tog gis sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa tshugs pa ste/ mnyes pa gsum gyis sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten par bya dgos so/ /ji skad du/ srid pa kun tu bla ma'i zhabs bsten cing / /rnyed dang bkur ste sgrub pas mchod byas te/ /ston pa'i 'du shes skad cig mi 'bral zhing / /skyon gyi rtog pas gos par ma stsar cig /ces gsungs pa dang/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las kyang / 'dir mang rjos pas ci zhig dgos/ /bla ma dgyes byed gang yin bya/ /ma mnyes byed kun spang ba ni/ /de dang de la 'bad de brtag /ces gsungaso/ /mdor na ci gsung dang ci mnyes kyi sgo nas lus ngag yid gsum g.yo zol med pa'i rtag tu mi brjed dran pa'i ji yis sangs rgyas dngos yin pa gzung ste/ rang gi bla ma nyid khog pa'i snying dang gtsug ginor bu bzhin mi 'bral bar bsten nas ci gsung ba'i don sgrub pa la dus rnams kun tu skyo ngal med par bya ba gal che'o/ /gsum pa bsten nas dgongs spyod bslab pa ni/ bla ma dam pa mchog ni sangs rgyas dngos yin pas de'i rnam par thar ba bzhin bsgrubs pas sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar ba la bslab par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar sa bcu'i byang sems rnams la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku snang / gdul bya las dag pa rnams la sangs rgyas sprul ba'i sku snang la/ rang cag rnams la sangs 56

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/rgyas nyid bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshul du snang bar mdo las gsungs par ltar yin la/ nge las gzhan pa rnams kyi ngor yang snang tshul bsam gyis mistab pas 'gro don mdzad tshul yod do/ /dper na las dag dang ma dag gi snang ba sna tshogs gyur tshul 'phags pa thogs thed kyis byams pa sgrub tshul sogs ltar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan sangs rgyas dang dbyer med par bltas la/ bdag gis kyang de kho na 'dra ba zhig myur du lus rten 'di'i thog bya'o snyam du sems pas bla ma'i mdzad spyod bzang po'i rnam thar la slob cing thos bsam sgom pas dus 'da' bar byas na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang sa dge bka' rnying sogs mkhas spub dam pa spyi dang / khyad par kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dang / dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po sogs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar rgya mtsho lta bu la zhib tu bltas nas kyang 'di ltar bsam ste bslab dgos/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa de rnams kun kyang / dang po nga rang tsho 'dra ba 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i gting du byings pa zhig gis byang chub tu sems bskyed de mdo sngags kyi lam la sbyangs pa mthar phyin nas/ go 'phang mthon por byon pa sha stag yin pas na nga rang gis kyang bstan pa'i gnad mdo sngags kyi chos la thos bsam byed/smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar te/ bshes gnyen dam pa'i rjes su sgrub nas mthar phyin pa brtson na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams lta bu 'ong ba la the tshom med kyang da sngon rgyu mtshan ma shes pas yengs ma lam du shor/da ni brtson pa drag pos shugs bskyed de bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar bzang po'i 57

tram̐ chen mtshophuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ —da warjes su slob bo snyam du bsam pa brtan pos sgrub dgos te/ 'dul ba lung las / su la'i shing la 'khri shing bzhin/ /dam pa rnams la brten gyur pas/ /bzang po'i dpal gyis 'khyud par byed/ /ces dang yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar sgrub pa yang / /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam byas la/ /bdag kyang deng nas de 'dra'i rjes bslabs te//dam pa'i go 'phang thob par byed don du/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i tshul la nan tan bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na bla ma bzang po'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi spyod tshul mthun snang du gyur ba chung ngu yan chad kyang bslab na mdzes te/dper na 'ju nyung dgon gyi rnal 'byor dam pa bla ma rig lo mchog gis thub dga' yid bzhin nor bu'i mal stan gyu phyogs dang dbu sngas bzhag tshul 'di lta bu yin gsungs nas khong nyid kyis kyang de 'dra yan chad mdzad par lta bu yin pas so/ /mdor na dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa rnyed na de nyid bsten pa'i dus su lus srog la mi lta bar byang chub sems dpa' stag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags bsten pa dang —/ paṇa chen nā ro bas skyes mchog te lo pa bsten pa dang / rje btsun mi las lho brag mar ba bsten pa ltar bslab dgos so/ /gzhan yang se mkhar chung bas bla ma la rang gi nor skal 'bri g.yag sum cu dang / gser la sogs pa'i dngos po gang yod phul te lo bcu gsum la zhing las byed pa sogs kyis bla ma yab yum gyi las ka dka' ba chen pos bgyis shing bsgrubs pa dang / khong bre ba bde bas glu sgrung sogs kyis bla ma dgyes te/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang ste bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs nas 58

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/brtson 'grus chen pos sgrub pas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug se ston kun rig ces grags pa byung ba lta bu mang ngo / /des na gzhan la chos bshad mkhan rnams kyang rang gi mdzad spyod legs po la ma bslab na rjes 'jug rnams kyang de ltar 'gyur ba tshegs med de/ ji skad du/ khyu mchog 'gro ba drang ngam yo ba bzhin/ /rjes su 'gro ba'i ba rnams dogs med rgyu/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /'on te mthun ngor dzu 'phrul gzhan bstan nas yid ches bskyed thub na gang ltar byas kyang mi 'gal ba sems te/ sngon rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po gcig gis chang mang gsol ba na/ slob ma kun yang mkhan po'i lad mo byas nas chung 'thung ba la/ smo rnams ma 'thung nga dang mi 'dra gsungs kyang ma nyan pa la/ dus zhig slob bu rnams bos nas rgya khab snyim pa re gnang nas/nga'i lad mo byed na da 'goms gsungs nas/ khong gis khab 'gams pas zhal du zhu nas krog krog gsol bas/ gzhan rnams der ha las so/ /de ltar dam pa'i bshes gnyen bsten dgos pa dang sdig pa'i bshes gnyen spang dgos par ltar/ dge ba'i grogs po 'grogs nas sdig pa'i grogs po'ang spang dgos te/ 'dul ba las/ mi yi mdun na ku sha la/ nya rul gyis ni dkris gyur na/ /de ni ring por mi thogs par/ /ku sha nyid kyang de 'drar 'gyur—/ /de phyir dam pa ma yin la/ /brten par gyur pa'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ gang dang 'grogs na dug gsum 'phel 'gyur zhing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba nyams 'gyur la/ /byams dang snying rje med par sgyur byed pa'i/ /grogs ngan spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang 59

tram̐ chen mtshosuchosagrwaridapetshogs/ ——dang ga) mug thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa ni sdig pa'i grogs po ste de ni dug gi sdong po lta bu'o zhes dang / myang 'das las/ byang chub sems dpa' ni grogs ngan pa la 'jigs pa ltar glang po che myos pa la sogs pa la ni ma yin te 'dis ni lus tsam 'jig par byed kyi snga mas ni dge ba dang sems rnam par dag pa gnyis ka 'jigs par gyed do/ /zhes gsungs/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ tha ma zhig grogs bzang po dang 'grogs kyang 'bring las mi yong / rab gcig tha ma dang 'grogs na tha mar 'gro ba la tshegs med gsungs so/ /des na grogs bzang ngan 'di shin tu gal che bas btsun chung kun gyis lhag par go dgos pa'i gnad mthar thug cig yin te/ sngon btsun chung chang 'thung ba zhig dang mi 'thung ba zhig ste gnyis yod la/'azung ba de ra sgrong dgon du song bas mi 'thung bar gyur/ gcig shos lha sar 'khyams pas chang 'thung du log song ba lta bu yin no/ /des na yang dag pa'i bla ma bsten pa de'ang phyogs re dang / khe grags dang / g.yo sgyu dang / ngo skog dang / nye ring sogs ma yin par dus thams cad du de ltar byas nas/ chos mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi gnad mtha' dag gam rang gi nyams su len rgyu'i gdams ngag mthar phyin pa re la the tshom nang nas chod pa'i nges shes gting tshugs pas da ni rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs beer lhung nge byon yang the tshom gcod mi dgos pa'i blo thag zhig chod dgos te/man ngag rin po che'i mdzod las/ bla ma dang bral rang rkya thub pa dang / /gdams ngag dogs sel dri rgyu med pa dang / /zhes dang / rdzogs chen gzhan phan chos kyi snang bas/ da ni gu ru rin po che byon kyang 'o brgyal zhu ba las 60

da wa— snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/ —gzhan med ces zhal nas gsungs/ phu chung bas/ nga ni rgya gar nas paṇḍi ta zhig byon kyang chos mi nyan/ jo bo'i chos dang mthun na nyan mi dgos/ mi mthun na mnyan pa la dgos pa med pas nam yang mi nyan gsung / ji skad du/rang gi bla mar the tshom bcad nas/ /sangs rgyas 'od dang bcas pa byon yang / /gzhan du ston la mnyan par mi bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lar rang gis gang dang gang sgrub kyang rgyu mtshan shes pa'i nges shes 'di gal che ste/sngon rgan po zhig shi la nye tshe bla ma zhig drangs pa dang / bla mas rgan po la khyong phyi mar 'gro ba'i chos ci yod gsungs/ rgan pos nga la bla ma mkhyen dung gcis yod zhus tsa na / bla mas khrod ma legs te yi dam gzhan gyi bsnyen pa mi bton pa de bton pa la don ci yod gsungs/ rgan pos 'o lags so da khyed gsol ja bzhes nas phebs song dang chog nga la mi dgos/ zhes zer ba lta bu yin pas so/ /de ltar ma yin par deng ni bla ma dpal sprul gyis/ yi dam kun sgrub thugs dam rnam grangs mang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos gang rig rig thams cad zhus nas tshe gang rgyug kyang / thag chod rgyu dang nyams su len gang yang med par khyi glen lam du 'gro ba lta bu mang po yang mthong ngo / /des na dang po bla ma tshul bzhin bsten dus mnyes dgos/ bar du yang dag skub dus thugs kyis zin dgos/ mthar 'gro don byed dus gnang ba thob dgos ma gtogs mi phan ste/ phu chung bas/ bla ma bsten pa'i dus na bla ma'i rgyan du 'gyur bar bya'i khur du 'dug par mi bya gsungs / don ni rgyan bzang ba btags pa'i mi de rgyan gyis mi skyo zhing de srid du dga' bar 'gyur ba bzhin du/ bla ma'i drung du gnas tshe/ bla ma de mnyes par 'gyur bar 61

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/bya'i—/ skyo ba 'gyur ba mi rung gsungs pa yin/ khur ni yod na mi dga' med na dga' bar bzhin/ bla ma'i thugs ma mnyes na yun ring mi chags zhing chos mi thob pa'i don yin/ des na dang po chos zhu ba'i dus shes pa dang zhu ba'i tshe sgo gsum gyis mnyes par byas na chos yun ring du rdzogs par thob te rte'u zho 'thung gi dper ltar yin/ de las ldog na yun ring gnas mi thub pa'ang khyi gu zho 'thung gi dpe bzhin no/ /sgrub dus thugs kyis ma zin na'ang mi phan pa'i dpe bla ma mar bas ma shes par skog tu mi las rngog pa'i drung du sgom yang nyams rtogs ma skyes pa lta bu'o/ /'gro don byed dus gnang ba ma thob na mi phan pa'i dpe nā ro paṇa chen gyis byang sgo srung ba'i khur bzhes par lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa bla ma bsten pa'i phan yon ni/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la nye ba dang / rgyal ba rnams dgyes pa dang / tshe rabs kun tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mi phongs pa dang / yang dag pa'i lam du chud pa dang / blang dor gyi dmigs phyed pa dang / ngan 'gror mi nyung ba dang / las ngan pa dang nyon mongs pas thub par dka' ba dang / sgrib pa byang bar 'gyur ba dang —/ bgegs dang bar chad zhi ba dang / byang sems kyi spyod pa dang mi 'gal zhing de la dran pa dang ldan pas sa dang lam dang gzungs dang ting 'dzin sogs yon tan gyi tshogs je mtho je mthor 'gyur zhing ma 'ongs pa na rang yang skyes bu dam pa rgyal sras 'phags pa'i sa thob nas myur du byang chub 'aspub pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don thams cad 'grub par 'a/ḍi ba dang / de la bsnyen bkur bas bsam sbyor dge ba thob nas rang

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/gzhan gyi don byed cing tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang / ngan 'gro myong nges kyi las rnams tshe 'di la lus sems la gnod pa phra mo myong nas las de zad par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas dpag med mchod pa'i bsod nams zil gyis gnon pa sogs bla ma bsten pa'i phan yon mtha' yas so/ /sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ngan 'gror mi lhung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal bar mi byed do/ /'jig rten las mngon par 'phags pa yin no/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa dang / skyes rabs las/ dam pa rnams ni sus kyang mi bsring ste/ /dul ba'i tshul gyis dge ba bsten par bya/ /de dang nye na de yi yon tan rdul/ /ched du ma bsgos par yang 'gos par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen bla mas/ de ltar sna tshogs thabs mang nyid sgo nas/ /bla ma bsten pa'i yon tan mtha' yas te/ /yang dag lam chud blang dor dmigs rnams phyed/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang bar chad rab zhi zhing / /rang yang skye bo dam pa'i gnas thob nas/ /myur du thar ba'i grong du phyin pa'o/ /zhes dang / des ni tshe rabs kun tu phan pa 'grub—/ /dam pa rnams dang 'phrad cing chos rab thos/ /sa dang lam dang gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin/ /sna tshogs yon tan 'byor pas yongs gang zhing —/ /'gro la zhi bde'i dga' ston 'byed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ zhar la bla ma ma bsten pa'am bsten tshul log pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ bla ma ma bsten zhing ma gus pas bshes gnyen du byas nas bsten tshul log pa rnams ni thar ba'i lam sna mi zin pa dang / yon tan gyi tshogs las nyams pa dang /63

tram̐ chen mtshosuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da legs pa'i chos las nyams pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi drwa bar tshud pa dang /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba dang / tshe 'dir nad dang gdon du mas 'tshe ba dang phyi mar ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa dus dpag tu med par myong ba la sogs pa dpag tu med de/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum pa'i ting nge 'dzin las/ bla ma la ma bsten zhing ma gus pa rnams ni yon tan gyi chos thob pa'ang nyams par 'gyur na/ ma thob pa thob par 'gyur ba lta ci rjos—/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos 'dzin pa ni/ chos las tha mi dad pas na/des dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang chos spong ba'i sdig pa'i las shin tu lci ba bsags pa'i phyir ro/ /ngan song gsum du yun ring mor lan mang du 'khor bas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur zhing / gal te de dag las thar nas brgya lam mir skyes na'ang / dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra mi grags pa'i zhing du/ dmus long dang / 'on pa dang / skugs pa dang / dbang po ma tshang bar skye bar 'gyur ro zhes dang / dgongs 'dus las/ slob mar gyur nas ngan sems kyis—/ /dam pa de la brnyas byed gang / sangs rgyas kun la brnyas pas na/ /de dag snyi tshugs dmyal bar 'gro/ bka' bcag lung bor thugs 'gal na/ /rdo rje dmyal bar de 'gro ste/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir rgyal po'i chad pa sogs/ /nyes pa thams cad de la 'byung / /zhes dang / lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das gang dag slob dpon la brnyas par bgyid pa de dag gi rnam par smin pa ji lta bu lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ lag na rdo rje/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten skrag par 'gyur gyi/ de skad ma smra zhig gsang ba'i 64

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/bdag po/ 'on kyang cung zhig brjod par bya yi/ /dpa' bo bsgrims te de nyon cig /mtshams med la sogs mi bzad pa/ /dmyal ba gang dag ngas bshad pa/ /de rnams kyi ni gnas su brjod/ /der ni bskal pa mtha' yas so/ /de ltar bas na rnam kun tu/ /de la nam yang brtas mi bya/ /zhes dang /lnga bcu pa las/ slob dpon la ni smod pa de/ /yams dang mdze dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang rims dang dug rnams kyis/ /rmongs chen de ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po me dang skul gdug dang / /chu dang mkha' 'gro rkun po dang / /gdon dang log 'dren rnams kyis kyang / /bsad nas sems can daskyal bar 'gro/ /nam yang slob dpon dag gi ni/ /kun tu soms dkrug mi bya ste/ /gal te rmongs bas byas gyur na/ /dmyal bar nges par 'tshed par 'gyur/ /mnar med la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /dmyal ba bstan pa gang yin pa/ /slob dpon la ni smod pa rnams/ /der ni gnas par yang dag bshad/ /ces dang / rim gsum las/ bla ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba gang / /mnar med mun pa mun nag tu/ /bskal ba brgya stong bye bar 'tshed/ /ces dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ bla ma la ni smod pa dang / /thugs daspugs pa yis nyes pa ni/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho chen po la/ /chu de skra yis gtor nus pa/ /de yi tshad du sdug bsngal myong / /rdo rje'i dmyal bar grags pa yin zhes dang / /gzhan du yang / bla ma'i bka' bcag rdo rje dmyal bar snang / /zhes gsungs pa mang pas shes nas mnyes par gal che'o/ /de ltar bla ma bsten pa'i tshul sngar bshad pa 'di rnams go lo dang thos lo tsam gyis ci yang mi phan pas/ snying thag pa nas chos shig sgrub 'dun yod na ni dam tshig spang 65

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ —blang gi khe nyen shes pas lam ma nor bar khrid pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa la rang gi snying mig srog gsum ltar gces pa'i sgo nas ci gsung tshad ma dang / ci mdzad legs par mos pas thugs dang 'gal ba'i las tha na rmi lam du'ang mi gyed pa'i dam bca' brtan po zhig snying nas nges pa ma skye na/blo chung gi gang zag rigs gzugs 'byor ba lang tsho dang / thos pa thob thang gis rgyags shing rang don cung zad re ma 'grub pa sogs 'phral rkyen phran bu res dad pa log nas bskur 'debs dang / ngan sems skyes nas bla ma spangs shing las ngan gyi rgyu sgrub pa'i snyigs ma'i skye bo thos bsam rgyud thog tu ma khel ba dag mthong tshe cung zad phan du re nas/ dri ma med pa'i gsung rab dang dgongs 'grel yid bzhin gyi nor bu bas lhag par mang po nas drangs te go sla zhing don la gzhol ba'i dam pa rnams kyi gsung sgros kyis rgyan nas bkod pa yin pas dad can kun gyi snying nor 'os snyam/ des na zhib tu smin khrid la brten nas skyon yon blang dor shes pa'e sgo nas/ bla ma dam pa bsten cing mnyes par sgrub pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /gsum pa lam gyi mabun rkyen thos pa'i phan yon la/ thos pa gyed dgos pa'i tshul dang / phan yon dngos gnyis las/dang po ni/ de ltar bla ma dam pa yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dang 'phrad tshe lam mthar ma phyin gyi bar/ dus rnams kun tu thos pa dam pa bya dgos te/ de yang rang gi nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro ba'i chos de don du gnyer dgos la/ na so gzhon pa'i dus nas bstan pa la zhugs nas thos pa rgya mtsho 'dra pa rgya chen nyan na thog ma 'khor 'das skyon yon shes pa'i 66

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ —blang dor la 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod par dang / bar du rang gi rgyud sbyong ba'i tshe nyan dgos te/ rgyud dang sbyar nas rmongs pa bzlog tshul shes dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /shes rgyud mtha' dag grol ba la'ang thos pa dgos te/ the tshom gyi spros pa thams cad gcod dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan gdul bya skyong pa'i chen po'i khur bzhes pa rnams kyis lhag par du rgya cher nyan dgos te/gdul bya rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i chos tha dad mang po'i lam nas drang dgos pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ ji ltar sman pas nad pa la/ /phan pa'i sman rim gtong ba ltar/ /de bzhin ston pas sems can la/ /phan pa'i chos kyang de ltar gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /deng sang ni lam yangs dog la mi blta/gdung ma 'phrad khur gyi dpe ltar/ da ltar gyi rig ngo krod pa dang de ngos zin pas chog mang po bstan pa la don med ces zer nas rang gi kha lta stong skad dang gzhan gdul bya'i blo rim lam gyi 'jug sgo sogs gang la mi brtag par/ zhu mi zhig yod yod rgya bod rgan gzhon skya ser thams cad la sngon 'gro sogs mi dgos pa dang po nyid nas rdzogs pa chen po sogs sgrog pa 'di la kho bo ni nges par du yid la gzan ste gdul bya thams cad po sbyangs pa sngon song can gyi dbang rnon sha stag yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir dang / chos kyi che ba nyams pa'i phyir dang / chos la the tshom za nas ngan 'gror kung ba'i phyir dang /rang la rtsa nyung 'byung ba'i phyir dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos gzhan bstan pa thams cad don med thal ba'i phyir ro/ /kun mkhyen chen pos/ stong ltas dad ldan ngan 'gror bslus pa dang / /byar med zer nas tha mal lus pa dang / /ma smin 'gro la gsang ba sgrog pa ste/ /nyes mang ldan phyir theg pa rim 67

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/gyis bshad/ /ces dang / de ltar ma bshad skyon ni tshad med de/ /gong 'og snga phyi'i rim pa dang bral bas/ /bstan pa'i spyi srol rim pa nyams pa dang / /blo chung sngags skrag log ltas 'dor ba dang / /go rim ma shes zab mor mi rtogs dang / /'dus byas dge ba khyad du gsod pa dang / /sgro skur rgyur gyur rgyu 'bras 'chol ba dang / /blang dor mi shes shes bya'i don la rmongs/ /zhes gsungs—/ des na dus rnams kun tu thos pa 'di yang 'bral med byas nas rgya chen po la 'jug dgos te/ ji skad du/ drug pa'i sa brnyes rgyal sras che rnams kyang / /tshigs bcad gcig phyir stong gsum me 'dag gi /gang las brgal nas thos pa tshol byed na/ /gnas 'di 'dor la lam bzang ji ltar yod—/ /ces pa ltar yin pas/ des na gong ma rnams kyi thugs nyams su bzhes pa rnams la blo kha phyogs pa dang / rang gi nyams rtogs gong nas gong du 'gro dgos pas/ dang po nas cung zad thos dus 'dis chog ces gang rung gcig la zhen nas lo chung skabs dben par bsdad snga byas kyang phyi na tshod dang nang thos pa gsang ba dam bca' ci yang ma smin pa rnams mtha' mi 'chol bas/ gnas skabs sgrub khul byas kyang rtogs pa la yar bskyed med pa sogs kyis rkyen byas nas bya bral phyir log 'gro ba mang bas thos bsam mthar phyin rjes gzod dben par bzhugs na tshe chos mthar phyin pa 'ong ba yin te/ so sor thar ba'i mdo las/ mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag tu/ /lang tsho yol ba na ni gnas par bde/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan du yang / dang po thos pa btsal bar bya/ /de nas nags su 'gro bar bya/ /zhes gsungs/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas pa ma bslab 68

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/na—/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi thob te/ /zhes dang /spyod 'jug las/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob pa/ /de ni gang yang yod ma yin/ /de ltar bslab pa'i mkhas pa la/ /bsod nams mi 'gyur gang yang med—/ /ces dang / dbyig gnyen gyis/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin dran par byas la/thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin pa myur du 'tshol bar bya'o/ /tha na dbang po brtul po dang rgan po sogs kyang lam la zhugs na'ang / de'i yan lag cha tshang ba zhig thos nas nyams su len skabs kyang bla ma la dris nas dogs pa spang dgos pas/ sngon 'gro khral sprad ma/ dngos gzhi rta rgyug ma tsam res sa chod dka' bas yang dag pa re nyan nas sgrub dgos kyi/ de ltar ma yin pa mig zing zing dang lta ba mtho mtho mo'i kha 'ur gyis rang mgo bskor nas shi dus brang lag 'thab na rang pham tshar ba yin/ lar sems kyis shes rung ba'i yi ge dang 'don cha dpe cha sogs khyod kyis 'bad pa chen po byas kyang ma shes thabs sdug na/ blo chen rnal 'byor dam pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul byar med rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs don khyod kyis tshegs chung ngus rtogs so snyam na bden du bzung dka' ste/ 'jam mgon mi pham chos rjes/ blo chen sbyong ba rnams kyis kyang / /yun ring 'bad de rtogs pa'i gnas/ /kye ma blun pos yud tsam gyis/ /rtogs par smra na the tshom g.yo/ zhes gsungs so/ /des na thugs bskyed cung zad re mdzad nas bla ma dam pa las rig ngo skyong tshul de yang zhu mtha' chod nges byed pa dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs la brtson zhing bla ma 'bral med kyis chos nyan pa 'di gal shin tu che'o/ /gal te de ltar mi 69

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/byed na kha lta stong skad kyi nga rgyal ldan bzhin tha mal du gnas na mngon pa'i nga rgyal can gsor mi rung ba'i lta ba yin te/ dkon mchog rtsegs pa las/'od srung gang zag la lta ba ri rab tsam ni bla'i ma ngon pa'i nga rgyal can stong pa nyid du lta ba ni de ltar ma yin te gsor mi rung ba'i phyir ro zhes gsungs so/ /dang po thos pa byed zhor du bsam pa dang sgom pa byas na yang dag 'gro ste/ dper na rta bzang gis snor ma la bcad ldad byas nas za ba bzhin thos tshad shes tshad 'phral nas 'phral du nyams su len dgos so/ /de ltar ma yin pa mang po nyan nas don gnyer che khul byas kyang nyams su ma blangs na mi phan ste/ dper na khyi la zan gcig byin gnyis byin nas mi ldad par khyur mid byas nas yang mig cer re blta ba bzhin no/ /des na thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral ba dgos so/ /gnyis pa phan yon dngos ni/ thos pa dri ma med pa de yi phan yon shin tu tshad med de/ chos rnga bsgrags pa thos pa'i sems can rnams kyang ngan song rnam par grol zhing byang chub thob par gyur na/ nyan na de las lhag pa smos ci dgos te/ shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi rgyun la sogs pa'i gzungs dang / spang blang shes pa'i mig dang / dge ba 'phel zhing mi dge ba srab pa dang / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis bstod cing 'dun pa dang / ma rig pa'i mun pa sangs pa dang / shi 'phos nas dag pa'i zhing gi padmo la brdzus te skye ba dang / sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa las chos thos pa dang / myur du sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor ba la sogs pa phan yon tshad med pa yod de/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ shes rab 70

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ting 'dzin dran pa'i gzungs thob cing / /spangs blang mtshams phyed dge 'phel sdig kun srab/ /lha mis bstod cing ma rig mun pa sangs/ /padma'i steng mdzes rgya chen chos thos shing / /myur du chos rgyal mya ngan med thob 'gyur/zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ mdo sde dam pa 'di thos na/ /ma 'ongs pa yi bskal pa ni/ /grangs med bdun cu rtsa gsum du/ /ngan 'gro rnams su yong ma 'gro/ /bstan pa zad du nye ba'i tshe/ /gang gis mdo sde 'di bzung na/ /myur du spobs pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mya ngan las 'das pa las/ chos nyan pa las dad pa skye'o/ /dad pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug la mos nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya ba'i bar du thob pas/ dge ba'i chos thams cad thob pa ni thos pa'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /zhes dang / ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par byed/thos pas gnod pa bsten mi byed/ /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob ces dang —/ de bzhin 'di na rigs skyes pa'i/ /mi ni blo gros ldan gyur kyang / /sdig pa dang ni dge ba'i chos/ /ma thos bar du shes mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang /skyes rabs las/ gang zhig thos pas yid ni dad gyur nas/ /legs par dga' la brtan pa nyid du 'gyur/ /shes rab skye zhing gti mug med par 'gyur—/ /rang gi shas kyang de ni nyo ba'i rigs/ /thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ /nun po la sogs mi 'khyer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pas grogs kyi mchog /phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur 'dza' bo yin/ /gnod pa med pa mya ngan nad kyi sman/ /nyes pa chen po'i dpung 'joms dpung gi mchog /71

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/grags dang dpal dang gter gyi mchog kyang yin/ /ya rabs rnams dang phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / thos pa'i rjes 'jug bsgrub pa snying por byed/ /skye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar bar gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams la snying thag pa nas mos pa bskyed do/ /kun mkhyen chen pos/ sangs rgyas 'dod na thog mar thos pa btsal te phyis bsgom pa la sbyar bas gang yang dge bar 'gyur te zhes dang tha na dbang po brtul bo dag gis lam zab mo la 'jug na de'i yan lag tshang ba zhig thos dgos pas na thams cad thos zhes bya zhes gsungs/gzhan yang sangs rgyas 'byung ba brgya lam na yin pas de'i chos kyang dkon pas rin po che'i 'du shes dang / shes rab je cher bskyed pas mig gis 'du shes dang / shes rab kyi mig des ji lta ji snyed rnams mthong bas snang ba'i 'du shes dang / mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i 'bras bu ster bas phan yon che ba'i 'du shes dang / da lta nas de'i rgyu zhi lhag gi bde ba thob pas kha na ma tho ba med pa'i 'du shes dang lngas mnyan dgos par byang sa las gsungs pa ltar ji ltar sems pa ni thos pa'i phan yon sems pa'o/ /gnyis pa skabs don sngon 'gro dngos ni/ rang la bla ma'i zhal gdams gnang ba las/ dang po nges 'byung snying rje yang yang bsgoms/ /bar du dag snang bskyed rdzogs nyams len brtson/ /tha ma rang rig chos sku'i gtan srid zungs/ /dus kun sdom gsum yang dag srung bar mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa'i don ltar/ 'dir dang po sngon 'gro'i khrid la thar ba'i lam gyi rtsa ba nges 'byung gi blo bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye ba'i thabs su blo ldog gi chos bzhi 72

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dang / theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skye ba'i thabs su tshad med bzhi sogs la blo sbyong byed phyir smin khrid bya dgos so/ /de ltar ma yin par mos khrid dpe thog bro brdung yin la min la re tsam song nas sems khrid sems khrid zer nas mtho snyab byed pa mang kyang sngon 'gro rgyud la ma 'byor bas tshe 'di kho na la bla slob thams cad zhen/ dngos gzhi'i zab don yun du goms pa med pas kha stong du song / cung zad shes pa re gal te srid na'ang de sangs rgyas thob pa lta ci thar ba tsam gyi rgyu yang mi 'gyur nges te/ nges 'byung bcos min rang rgyud la med pa'i phyir ro/ /zin bris las/ dus phyis chos pa rlom pa kha dang don 'dzol/ phyi dang nang 'gal/rang rgyud dang dam pa'i chos phyogs lung pa so sor song zhing lus gnad bcos/ mig ri zing zing byed pa 'di 'dra rang rgyud spu gang yar skyed med pa yin no gsungs/ ji skad du/ bla mas chos bshad dbang bskur byed/ /snying la thed do sa ma ya/ /slob mas mig btsums thal mo sbyar/ /snying la med do sa ma ya/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /smin khrid de la yang rab 'bring tha gsum yod de/ rab rang rgyud la ma skyes ba ra du lo nas lo ru yun ring brtson nas mthar phyin pa dgos la/ dper na kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos lo drug tu bla ma ku ma rā dza bsten nas khrid rdzogs pa dang slob ma mthar phyin pa dus mnyam par lta bu'o/ /'bring dpal sprul rin po che'i slob rgyun ltar sngon 'gro phyi nang lashag brgya rtsa brgyad khrid sbyong thog mar mdzad par dang / tha ma sngon 'gro'i khrid bshad skabs su dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs so so'i skabs la thug tshe nyid kha shas blo sbyong byar bcug pa sogs lta bu'o/ /de dag las 'di 'bring 73

tre chen mtshosuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da po'i dbang du byas nas kho bos da sngon gnas mchog mtsho phu'i tshe ring smongs kyi sgrub sde dang / jo dgon ri dwags chu mig dag gi jo ser lo re bdun phrag lhag tsam la yang yang bshad nas blo sbyong byed bcug tshe/ gang zag blo dman bdag 'dra ba du ma ra rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa zhig yod na phan pa'i nyams myong dang / rang gi blo la'ang goms pa'i phyir du 'chad pa yin la/ de yang phyi nang gi rnam g.yeng dang 'du 'dzi spong nas mi med dbeen pa'i ri sul bkra shis yid 'ong gi gnas mchog mtshan nyid ma tshang ba med pa/ gong ma'i sgrub gnas khyad par can sogs su/ zin med 'khor ba'i bya ba dang / khyim gyi ngo srung / gnyen gyis gshol 'debs/ grogs ngan gyis bslu khrid sogs bya ba ngan pa thams cad dug bzhin bor nas dam mtshams bcad rgya bsdams te/ nyin re bzhin thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa lhod med byed dgos tokun mkhyen chen pos yang dag don gyi snying po nyams len zhig ma nus na chos kyi glegs bam 'bum phrag mang bo blo la yod kyang 'chi khar phan nges ni dka' gsungs pa ltar yin la/de yang thun bzhi ni bya grags dang po nas nam langs bar thor thun/nyi shar rgyab nas dros chen bar snga thun/ zin bris las gros po che nas nyi ma klad la ma 'khor gyi bar du snga thun gsungs kyang 'di ni bla mas gsungs pa ltar yin/ grib chen nas nyi nub bar phyi thun/ srod gdong nag mun rub nas nam gyi sum cha dang po tsam ni srod thun dang bzhi yin la/ deng gi 'khor lo'i chu tshod la dpe mtshon na/ bka' drin mnyam med 'ja' lus gdung rigs mkhan chen tshe dbang 'gyur med mchog gi phyag srol ni/ tho rangs lnga 74

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/pa dang phyed nas brgyad pa'i bar thor thun dang / dgu pa'i phyed nas bcu gnyis bar snga thun/ gnyis pa phyed nas lnga ba'i bar phyi thun/ bdun pa nas dgu phyed bar srod bun byas nas dgun dus hor zla dgu ba'i yar tshes brgyad la dbu bzung nas bcu gnyis pa'i bco brgyad kun mkhyen chen po'i 'das mchod bar zhag po brgya la sgrub grwa bzhugs pa yin pas 'di ltar byas na bde snyam/ 'on kyang nyin mtshan ring bung 'gyur bas ma nges pa dang phyag srol gzhan du thun re la chu tshod gnyis sam gsum re mdzad pa sogs snang ba ma zad thun gnyis dang gsum dang drug dang brgyad sogs yod pa gsungs pas mtha' gcig ma nges kyang 'di 'jug bde bas thun bzhi'i dbang du na nyin thun gnyis mtshan thun gnyis te bzhi'o/ /thun bzhi po de rnams kyi dus su ni teng 'dzin gyi rtsal ma rdzogs pa'i las dang po ba rnams bying rgod cha snyoms shing dge spyor gnad du 'gro ba'i dus dang / thun 'tshams rnams su ni bying rgod shugs che ba'i dus yin pas dge sbyor gzhan la brtson pa las bsgom pa bag yang bya dgos par gsungs/ /de lta bu'i thun de dag re re la sbyor ba sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes su ji ltar bya ba'i tshul dang gsum mo/dang po la'ang sngon 'gro'i sngon 'gro dang dngos gnyis las dang po ni/jo bo bka' gdams pa'i gzhung las/ gnas khang byi dor byas la sku gsung thugs rten dgram/ mchod pa g.yo med par btsal la bkod pa mdzes par bsham pa stan bde ba la lus gnad dang ldan par 'khod nas zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar rang nyid sgrub pa'i gnas khang der phyag bdar sogs legs 75

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/par byas la/ sku gsung thugs rten spyi dang khyad par klong snying dang bla ma'i zhal thang sku brnyan dang snying thig gi bskor dang blo sbyong gi gsung rab sogs stegs mtho sar bkram/ gzhan sgrub dus skabs thob shes par bya/ de dag gi mdun du mchod pa rnam lnga'am ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa rnams gzhan gyi mig sngar mdzes chos dang 'gran sems dang khral 'jal lta bu sogs kun slong skyon can ma yin par dad gus chen po'i sgo nas gtsang zhing bkod pa mdzes par bsham zhing / sgrub khang du ka cha dkor cha mang po mi bzhag nas nyin bzhin phyag gdar sogs kyis dwangs pa 'dren par bya dgos/ de yang gnas khang la phyag bdar byas nas mchod bsham legs po byas na rang gi sems dang bar byed/ gzhan gyi sems dang bar byed/ dkar phyogs lha rnams dga' bas mthun pa'i grogs byed pa sogs 'dul ba las gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams dran par bya/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lam chung ba la phan yon bshad nas byed bcug pas/ lam chung bas bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa na phyags ma thogs bzhin du mthong lam thob par gsungs/ mdzes dgas dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang la phyag bdar byed pas 'dod chags srab pa'i lo rgyus dang / 'brom ston pas jo bo rje'i phyi sa rnams na bzas phyags pas mngon shes rgya chen po skye ba gsungs pa sogs phan yon mang bas de ltar bya/mchod pa'i rdzas rgya chen chos sgrub pa po rnams la med kyang chu gtsang ma ting bdun mang po rgyun du bsham na yang shin tu bzang ste/ 'brom rin po ches/dngos po ma yin dad pa yin/ dad pa yod na chu yan chad kyis mchod chog gsungs so/ /de nas rang gi mal 'og tu sa dkar sogs kyis g.yang drung 76

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ris chos skor tshul du bris/ de'i steng du rtswa dur ba ma 'khrugs par gtings nas dam bca' mi 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ steng du mal stan bkod/de nas yo byad nyer 'kho tsam ma gtogs ka cha dkor cha mang po ba khang du mi bzhag cing khyim dang ba 'dren par bya/ mkho ba'i yo byad tsam 'du byas nas gza' skar bzang nyin skub pa la 'jug dgos te spyi sgrub pa'i nyer mkho ni spre dril gcod rnga skang gling sgom thag ang rag ting bdun ting shag gtor cha sogs dang 'tsho chas zas gos sman sogs mtha' gnyis la ma lhung tsam gyis chog kun mkhyen bla mas/ de nas mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i rdzas drug ni/ /bza' btung 'tsho ba mtha' gnyis ma lhung dang / /dgos pa'i mchod rdzas bsgrub rdzas tshogs pa dang / /zab mo'i gdams ngag dpe cha tshang ba dang /bar chad bzlog pa'i rten 'brel mthun rdzas dang / /gang dgos yan lag tshags su tshud pa dang / /nor rdzas mang po'i skyed 'brel med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang nyin bzhin rtag par 'di ltar dgos te/ tho rangs gnyid sad pa'i tshe rang gi yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa de'i nga rgyal gyis ldang tshe snang srid dag pa rab 'byams gnas yul gyi zhing nas bla ma rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis phyag gis ḍā dril 'khrol ba dang snyan pa'i spu dbyangs dang a li ka li'i sgras sad par mos pas ldang zhing / sems lhod bzhin rmi lam la brtag nas mi dge ba 'dug na bshags sdom dang / dge ba mchis na sems can gyi don du bsngo bar bya/ de nas da lta'i rang gi sems la brtag ste mi dge ba'i rtog pa yod na sun phyungs/ lung ma bstan yang bcos nas dge sems dang dad mos tshe mi rtag pa sogs shugs drag tu 77

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/bskyed/ de nas thun mgor snabs 'bud gdong phyi sgo phyi nang gi bya ba sgrub rgyu yod tshod rnams sgrub mdor na zun nang nas rgyug mi dgos par byed nas/de nas mal du bsdad nas thun nang 'dir drin chen gyi pha de thon 'ong na yang thun phed de gtugs 'brel dang gtam nyob las ka dang / nyal ba dang /gnyid pa dang bsnyes pa dang / 'khris pa la sogs phyi nang gi skyon gyi dbang du gtong re shi snyam pa'i dam bca'/ de lta bu'i dam bca' de sha sen mos btogs te bsad pa sogs/ srog la babs kyang gtong re shi snyam pa'i dam bca' gnyis pa re drag tu bya ba zhig thun gang dang gang gi skabs su nyams len thams cad la gal shin tu che/ de ltar med na las dang po bas a gsar sogs la brten nas sgrub khul byed kyang phugs mi brtan par thun mgo med 'jug med nyar re nyor re byed nas zhag brgya sogs mjug mi phud/gal te phud kyang phyi ba sa phug tu bsdad pa ltar rang gi sems la yar bskyed gang yang mi thon pa ma zad blo ngan lang du shor nas rang rgyud lad shor na dus kun yang dag mi 'aspub pas gnyen po de lta bu bsten dgos te/ ji snyed du—/ lo mang dben par sgrub kyang sngar bzhin du/ /sems la skyed bral de las mdo med su/ /de phyir 'al 'ol gyis pa'i bye ris ltar/ /ma byed snying nas snying la rus pa bskyed/ /ces dang / ji skad du/ tho sgo la gtsugs nas mtshams la bsdad/ bsgom nyams len med na phyi ba 'dra zhes pa ltar ro//gnyis pa thun gyi sngon 'gro dngos ni gnad gsum bcos pa dang bla ma la gsol ba 'debs zhing thugs yid bsre ba dang gnyis las dang po la lus gnad ngag gnad sems gnad gsum las/78

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dang po lus gnad ni/ bsgom rim bar ma las/ stan bde ba la rje btsun rnam par snang mdzad kyi skyil krung lta bu'am/ skyil krung phyed pas kyang rung ste zhes gsungs pa ltar lus gnad rnaspru snang chos bdun te/ de'ang rkang pa gnyis g.yon 'og dang g.yas steng du byas pa'i rdo rje'i skyil krung bca' ba'am zud skyil bya/ lag pa gnyis g.yon 'og ma dang g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams steng ma byas nas mthe bong gnyis rtse sprad de lte 'og tu mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bya/ lus ha cang rgyab tu dgye ba dang mdun du rgu ba min par rgal tshig drang po gser gyi dong tshe ltar bajigs/ dpung pa gnyis lhod de thad kar brgyang / mgo mi mtho mi daca 'a zhing phyogs g.yas g.yon du ma yo bar mgrin pa tshe'i kos ol mdud en tsam gnan nas dgug rtse ya rkan la sbyar/ mig dmigs gsal lta rgyu med tshe mig 'bras mi rgyu zhing rdzi ma thab thib mi byed par sna rtser phab pa ste bdun dang ldan bzhin dran pa nang du bzhag ste 'dug par bya/ de dag kyang gang byung mi bya bar bla mas zhib tu bstan pa ltar byas na yon tan 'byung bas ma nor par bya/ mdor na lus drang ba gnad che bas gos sogs kyis gcibs pa dang rgyab sngas pa sogs spang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ngag gnad ni rlung ro bsal ba yin la/ de yang lag g.yon rdo rje khu tshur brla'i rtsa bo che'i steng nas mnan/ g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga'am rtse gsum mam bla mas gsungs pa ltar dkon mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgya sogs gang yin gyis sna bug g.yas pa mnan/ sna bug g.yon nas rlung nang du ga ri ltar dal bus rngub/ lte 'og tu dal gcig mnan/ dmigs pa 7sdutso

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ —bo rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs thog med nas nyon mongs pa 'dod chags las bskyed pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs dang bar chad dam tshig nyams chag sgom skyon bying rgod sogs dang bde nyams kyi zhen pa dang pho gdon rgyal 'gong gi gnod pa dang na tsha sdug bsngal sogs 'gal rkyen thams cad rlung dmar nag gi rnam pa rlung 'phang ba dang mnyam du phyir sangs kyis 'gro bar bsam la rlung 'phen dus sna sgo bgrad de/ nas 'bru ltar dang po chung ngu bar cher bskyed tha ma nar gyis 'phang pa lan gsum/ yang lag pa rjes nas sngar bzhin byed pa dang dmigs pa'i gtso bo nyon mongs pa zhe sdang las bskyed pa'i las ngan sogs nas gsal nyams kyi zhen pa dang / mo gdon 'dre mo'i gnod pa dang na tsha sdug bsngal sogs mi mthun phyogs thams cad rlung dkar nag gi rnam pa rlung 'phang ba dang mnyam du phyir sangs kyis 'gro bar bsam la rlung sngar bzhin lan gsum 'phang / yang lag gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur gyis brla'i rtsa chen gnyis mnan la/ dmigs pa'i gtso bo nyon mongs pa gti mug las bskyed pa'i las ngan sogs nas mi rtog stong pa'i zhen pa dang klu gdon sa bdag gi gnod pa dang na tsha sdug bsngal sogs mi mthun phyogs thams cad rlung mthing nag gi rnam pa rlung 'phang pa dang mnyam du phyir sangs kyis 'gro bar bsam la rlung snga bzhin lan gsum 'phang pa ste tho thun la dgu sprug dang / thun rjes ma gsum la sum sprug gis chog sum sprug la'ang lugs gnyis te/g.yas gcig g.yon gcig mnyam pa gcig ste gsum mam/ yang na mnyam pa gsum bya'o/ /phyi ma 'di kun mkhyen chen pos/ lus skyil spung gi pus mo 80

—— — snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ ——gnyis thal mos bkab la 'jing pa dgye bar byas te/ rlung ro gsum phyir bus la zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rtsa gsum po'ang dbu ma mthing skya/ g.yas ro ma dkar po/ g.yon rkyang ma dmar po gsungs/ rlung gsum gyi kha dog kyang rtsa rlung zin bris las g.yon dmar nag g.yas mthing nag mnyam pa dkar nag ces gsungs pas g.yas dang mnyam pa go ldog lta bu snang yang 'di ni bla ma'i zhal khrid ltar yin/ zhal lung zin bris las rlung nag po zhig gsung ba las gzhan mi snang ngo / /g.yu khog bya bral bas g.yon dmar g.yas dkar dbus nag po yang gsungs/ gal te las dang po ba sogs kyis dmigs pa rgyas pa ma shes na/ 'di ltar bsam yang chog pa snang ste/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las nyon sdig sgrib gegs dang bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'ub kyis 'dus nas/ sna sgo'i rlung dang 'grogs te phyir song bar bsam la 'phang bar bya ste/ khrid yig a ti zab don las 'di ltar gsungs pa sogs mang ngo / /de ltar byas pas lus nang bshal bar ltar gyur snyam du bsam mo /'di ni dper na bcud bzang po zhig blug par byed pa la snga logs su snod baspu bshal byed pa dang 'dra bar gsungs pas sla chos mi byed par shes par byas nas rgyun du'ang nyams su len par bya'o/ /cis kyang mi nus na ha daspugs gsum nangs mo byed pa'ang gal che bla mas gsungs/ gzhan yang rlung byin rlabs bya na/ rlung tshur nang du 'jug pa'i dus oṃ dkar po'i rnam pa sgra dang bcas pa bsam nas rngubs/ nang du gnas pa'i dus āḥ dmar po'i rnam pa sgra dang bcas pa dang / phyir 'byin dus rgyu sngon po'i rnam par 81

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/sgra dang bcas pa bsam la rlung rang bab bzhag pas chog ngag gi brjed pa sogs gang yang mi dgos/ rlung 'byin 'jug gnas gsum po gcig tu bgrang nas rab nyer gcig gam bdun sogs skabs dang bstun nas rgyun du nyams len bya dgos so/ /de ltar byas na ngag rlung thams cad ye shes kyi rang bzhin du dag par 'gyur bas gal che gsungs/ngag byin rlabs ni/ oṃ lhargyu rtse dbang ram̐ yig las byung sogs kyi don/oṃ lhurgyu ni sku gsung thugs kyi snying po ste ngag gi sgrib pa sbyong byed dang / sgo gsum sku gsung thugs su byin gyis rlob byed yin/ rang gi rtse yi dbang po zla ba bkas pa lta bu sogs gsungs pa de'i steng du/ yi ge re yig dmar po ye shes kyi me'i rang bzhin can gyis ngag sgrib bsregs nas mi dmigs par sbyangs te me de 'od dmar las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse gsum ste dbus rwa dang /g.yas g.yon rwa gnyis so/ /lte ba skum po ste rdo rje phyed pa zhig gsal/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i sbugs su ma dkar po zhig gsal la/ de'i mtha' skor du a li shes rab kyi rang bzhin can gyi dbyangs yig bcu drug po kha dog dkar po mdun nas rim pa g.yon phyogs su bkod la/ g.yas phyogs su bskor ba dang /de'i mthar kā li thabs kyi rang bzhin gsal byed rnams kha dog dmar po de'ang mdun nas bkod pa g.yas dang bskor ba g.yon du dmigs/ yang de'i mthar rten 'brel snying po kha dog ser po bkod pa g.yon dang / bskor ba g.yas su bskor ba dmigs/ de dag kyang phyi rim nang rim can du gsal/dbyangs gsal ye rta rnams bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis 'od zer dkar dmar ser gsum bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pa'i rtser mchod sprin gyis/ phyogs bcu'i 82

snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ da wargyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dang / khyad par snying thig brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig thong spyi dang / khyad par ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes skung thams cad byang zhing lhag med du dag rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang / rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gsum gyi rnam pa tshur 'dus sngags phreng rnams la thim gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad thob pa bsam/ de ltar dmigs gnad dang ldan pas sngags rnams lan bdun nam nyer gcig lhan du skabs bstun bzla/ mthar mkhas grub khyung bos sngags phreng gsum mtha' nas nang jim a yig gyur de yang dkar dmar bdud ji zhu nas rtser thim pas nus pa'i stobs dang ldan par bsam dgos par gsungs/ de ltar ngagasbyin chabs tshul bzhin byas pa'i pan yon ni/ ngag gi nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / bzlas brjod gang byas bye bar 'gyur ba dang / sngags nus la gnod pa'i zas dang spyod lam gyis sngags kyi nus pa mi 'phrog pa dang / ngag ji/ mnan gtad sogs zhi ba dang / ngag 'chal smra ba'ang bzlas par 'gyur bar sogs phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs te/ mkhas grub khyung bo dang ra lo tsā ba dag mthun par 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang dbyangs gsal rten snying rnams so sor bzla tshul ā li'i skabs dkyilodu a dkar po dang /gsal byed dus a dmar po dang / ye dha skabs a ser po dmigs dgos tshul yang snang / kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i thun mtshams rnal 'byor nyer mkho las rten snying sngon po dang / mkhyen brtse dbang po'i nyer mkho'i chos 83

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/spyod nor bu'i snying po'i don zhal 'don phyogs sgrigs su drangs pa las ye dha kha dog dmar po ru bshad pa sogs snang yang / ser po 'di ni rgyal sras 'gyur med rdo rjes gsungs pa'i yig chung dang / mkhan po padma tshe dbang lhun grub mchog gi zhal rgyun las byung ba ltar bkod pa'o/ /ngag byin rlabs rgyas par spro na/ bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi bzlas brjod nus pa stobs skyed yang blta b.ralha'o/ /'gyur sngags kyi rigs mang yang smyogs dka' bas oṃ sambha ra sambha ra ji mā na sa ra ma hā dzambha rgyu zhes lan bdun bzlas pas de nyin bzlas brjod byas tshad grangs med du 'gyur ba gsungs pas rgyun du bya ba gal che/gsum pa sems gnad bcos pa la gnyis las dang po ni/ don gnyis sam zur gnyis dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po cher bskyed dgos par yin la/ de yang thog ma thun sdom pa na kun slong bcos tshul 'di ltar shes dgos te/ ga re nga'i thun zhig sdom pa 'di ci 'dra dran nas sdom bsam 'dug legs par rang gi sems la brtag dpyad cig byed na/ yang na mi dge ba'i kun slong / yang na lung ma bstan gyi kun slong / yang na dge ba'i kun slong gsum las 'gro sar med/ mi dge ba'i kun slong ni 'gran sems dang phrag dog sogs kyisgo nas thun sdom pa yin na mi dge ba dngos yin pas blo bcos dgos pa smos ci dgos/ de las gzhan tshe 'di'i nad dang /gdon dang / rgyal po'i chad pa dang / mu ge'i 'jig pa sogs las skyob pa'i ched du yin na 'jigs skyobs kyi kun slong dang / rnyed pa dang / bstod pa ༵nga / snyan grags dang zas gos sogs bde ba thob pa'i ched du yin na

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/legs smon gyi kun slong zhes bya ste 'di gnyis kyang don du mi dge ba'i kun blong yin te/ yun thung tshe 'di'i don tsam gnyer ba las gzhan med pas/nya ba dang shan pa rngon pa chom skun pa sogs kyi bsam tshul las ma 'phags pa yin no/ /kun slong de lta bus chos gzhan lta ci 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po lo dgu'i bar sgo 'dag sbyar byas nas sgom yang tshe 'dir nad sogs zhi ba dang / rnyed bstod sogs kyi don tsam 'grub par la phan na ma gtogs sangs rgyas go 'phang lta ci theg dman thar ba'i sa bon tsam yang mi thob cing phyi mar mtho ris kyi lus rten thob pa yang dka' ste/ nges 'byung gi blo dang byang chub sems med par ma zad/ phyi ma don gnyer gyi blo tsam yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /sa skya'i zhen pa bzhi bral las/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/zhes dang / chos kyi sgo 'byed las/ de bzhin du 'jigs skyob dang legs smonasnye tshul khrims dang / legs smon gyi sbyin pa la sogs kyang mi dge ba yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa lung ma bstan gyi kun slong ni/ rgyu mtshan shes pa'i ngang nas sgrub pa la don gnyer ni ci yang med bzhin/ ri khrod pa sogs zhag brgya zhig 'dug dar snyam pa tsam gyi mi dred kyis mi'i lad mo byed pa lta bu'i bsdad pa yin na dge mi dge gang yang ma yin pas lung ma bstan zhes bya la/ de ni sa bon rul ba lta bu gsungs pas don 'bras cher med par dus tshod stong zad 'gro bas spong dgos/gsum pa dge ba'i kun slong ni skyes bu gsum gyi lam nas phye dgos la/de yang khyir gang zag kun la skyes bu gsum du ma 'dus pa med kyang / chung ca'i chung ngu ni chos min gyi bya bas tshe 'di kho na don du gnyer ba shan pa dang 85

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ —rngon pa smad tshong ma dang jag rkun sogs lta bu/ chung ngu'i 'bring ni chos dang chos min bsres nas spyod pa da lta'i phal cher lta bu/ chung ngu'i chen po tshe phyi ma don du gnyer nas las 'bras yid ches kyi sgo nas mngon mtho'i 'bras bu sgrub par sems pa skyes bu chung ngu dang / 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs nas rang nyid zhi ba phyogs gcig pa don du gnyer ba sems nas bslab gsum nyams su len pa skyes bu 'bring dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub 'dod kyis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa skyes bu chen po'i kun slong zhes bya'o/ /chung ngu'i chung 'bring gnyis dge ba'i kun slong 'di ma yin la/ skyes bu chung ngu'i kun slong ni tshe phyi ma la beems pa tsam yin yang srid pa'i bde ba la zhen pa yin pas 'di tsam ni las 'bras yid ches can gyi 'jig rten rgan po'i bsam bya yin la/ 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min zer ba ltar de ni rang don thar ba tsam don du gnyer ba nyan rang gis kyang dug bzhin spang bya sems na bdag ni gzhan sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer bas ci'i phyir mi spang bsam dgos te/ 'dul ba lung las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ kun dga' bo/ de ni ma lags te/ srid pa'i bde ba gnyer ba de ni skyes bu ma rabs zhes bya'o/ /de bas na thar ba'i yon tan yang dag par sgrogs shig ces pa gsungs/ skyes bu 'bring gi kun slong de ma sems can thams cad yal ba dor nas rang don sgrub pa'i bsam pa tha chad yin pas de yang mi rung / gang dgos na skyes bu chen po'i kun slong pha ma gyur pa'i soms can thams cad sdugabasngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te sangs rgyas kyi 86

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i phyir du sgrub pa bya'o bsam pa de dgos so/ /mdor na rang don la sems nas tshe 'di'am/ phyi ma mtho ris sam thar ba nyan rang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas/ 'chi kha mi 'jigs pa sogs mtha' 'bras bde ba gang la dmigs nas ma ki nyan thos theg pa nas ya ki rdzogs pa chen po'i bar gyi chos gang la thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bshad sgrub las gsum sogs tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong ci byed kyang theg pa chen po'i lam la phyogs tsam mi nye bar 'di go dgos/ des na rang don la dmigs nas mgo dang yan lag gi sbyin pa bskal pa'i bar du gtong yang byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa'i ming mi thob la/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i kun slong 'di'i sgo nas ngan slong la zan changs gcig sbyin na'ang rgyal sras kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /des na chos che chung sems kyi kun slong kho na la thug yod pas chos 'chad nyan sgom sgrub gang byed kyang kun slong 'di dang mi 'bral ba gal che'o/ /bdag thu stol zhen na byang sems min/ zhes pa ltar ro/ /dper dus khrims yan ga brgyad pa lta bu zhig srung ba la mtshon na/ tshe 'di'i nad sogs zhi ba la bsam na 'jigs skyob kyi bsnyen gnas dang / tshe 'di'i rnyed bstod sogs lobasam na legs smon gyi bsnyen gnas dang / phyi ma mngon mtho'i bde 'bras la bsam na skyes bu chung ngu'i bsnyen gnas dang / rang nyid 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs nas nyan rang gi 'bras bu la bsam na skyes bu 'bring gi bsnyen gnas dang / ma sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob phyir bsam skoskyes bu chen po'i bsnyen gnas su 'gro la/ des na bsam pa'i kun slong la 87

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i daspa tshogs/ma stos par chos rang gi ngos nas 'di zhes 'jog dka' la/ de ma zad zhe sdang sogs la brten na bsnyen gnas ngan song gi rgyu yang mi 'gro ba'i nges par med de/ sa paṇa gyis/ blun pos phyag rgya cher bsgoms pas/ /phal cher dud 'gro'i gnas su 'gro/ /zhes dang / dpal sprul rin po ches/ kha gdangs mig bsgrad lha sgom 'dre ru log ces sogs mang bas so/ /spyi kun slong sems bskyed yang dag dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bsgrub bya'i dge ba'ang che ba dang zab pa yin na legs mod/ kun slong dman pas 'dul khrims nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gsum po tshe gang bsrung ba'i dge slong zhig pas kun slong bzang pos dus khrims nyin zhag gcig bsrung ba'i rgan po zhig dga' nges so/ /'di dag gis mtshon nas dge ba gang dang gang sgrub par sogs la kun slong gi sgo nas gtso che chung 'gyur tshul 'di zhib tu shes par gal che'o/ /mdor na nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i ma sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du nga rang gis bun sdom ste dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs sgom par bgyi'o snyam du bsam dgos so/ /gnyis pa bla ma la gsol ba 'debs shing dbang bzhi len nas thugs yid bsre ba ni/ so skyes kyis bla ma mi ru bzung ba'i log lta spang phyir/ rang gi spyi bor gru gang tsam gyi steng pad dkar 'dab ma 'bum brdal ze'u 'bru dmar ser gyi steng seng khri dar zab 'bol brtsegs kyi gdan la rang gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid sku la chos gos rnam gsum dang dbu la sde snod gsum zhwa gsol zhing phyag gnyis sems nyid ngal gso'i phyag rgya mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 88

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/rang bzhin can du gsal ba'am/ sangs rgyas dngos mthong gi dad pa bcos min yod na rnam pa bsgyur mi dgos pa cha lugs ji ltar yin pa bzhin bsgom pa'ang mchog tu 'gyur bas/ bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa/ ci mdzad chos su shes pa/ sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che ba shes pa/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor shes pa/ gsol ba btab na rtogs pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la skye ba shes pa lngas gsol ba btab ste/ tshigs bdun gsol 'debs lan gsum/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la dbang bskur gyin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zab lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ ka dag gnas lugs kyi lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ lhun grub snang bzhi'i nyams len mthar phyin par gyin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes bi ma snying thig las byung ba 'di lan gsum dang blo sdog bzhi po'i mgo 'jug gi gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad dang /bla ma rgyal ba sogs 'don te mos gus dung dung bas gsol ba btab pas dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma thugs dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas sku gsung bugs nas 'od zer 'phros rang la thim pas bla ma'i thugs rgyud kyi spang rtogs yon tan thams cad lhag med du rang gi rgyud la skye zhing bla ma'i sku gsung bugs dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med du 'dres pas dbang bzhi thob cing / sgrib bzhi dag lam bzhi bsgom pa'i snod du gyur cing sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag par bsam zhing / thugs yid bsre ste cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /de ltar dus rnams kun tu bka' drin 89

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ —gsum ldan gyi drin chen dpal mgon bla ma dam pa gang nyid smo rgyan chen po dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus gting tshugs pa'i ngang nas/ 'dug pa'i dus spya bor bsgom pa dang / 'gro dus phrag pa g.yas su bsgom/ nyal ba'i tshe snying dbus bsgom/ bza' btung gi tshe mgrin par bsgom nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten/ skor ba byed pa'i yul/ rang rig 'od gsal gyi ngo bo/tshogs bsags pa'i zhing du dmigs pa ste shes pa bzhi ldan dang ma bral ba 'di gal che ste/ a te bkod pa chen po las/ dus gsum sangs rgyas bsnyen pa bas/ bla ma bsnyen pa 'bum char min zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na rdo rje'i bla ma dam pa bsgom pa dang gsol 'debs dbang len thugs yid bsre ba sogs ni sngon 'gro blo sbyong gi skabs 'di tsam du ma zad lam bskyed rdzogs thams cad kyi skabs su'ang med thabs med pas shin tu gces par bzung dgos so/ /de ltar gnad gsum bcos pa dang bla ma bsgoms nas gsol ba 'debs pa dang bzhi po ni zun gyi sngon 'gro'am sngon 'gro'i sngon 'gro yin pas bun thams cad la 'di med du mi rung ba de ltar shes dgos/ de nas sngon 'gro ngag 'don la 'jug /de yang bla ma mkhyen lan gsum gyis sor byang sngags gsum gyi lam gnad dran par byas nas/ snying dbus dad pa'i ge sar bzhad par sogs tshig rjes don dran legs par dal 'don ngang / tshig rkang drug pa bla ma de nyid dbu ma'i lam rgyud de khyi bor pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la dgyes bzhin bamugs par bsam la phyi yi yongs 'dzin dang / nang gi yongs 'dzin nam bla ma dran pa dang shes bzhin bag yod dad pa dang snying rje byang sems sogs legs par bzhengs bskul byas nas/ gsol 'debs 90

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ —dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs 'dir 'don pa'i lugs kyang snangabs ci bde bya'o—/ /gnyis pa thun gyi dngos gzhi ni/ khrid sbyang thog mar ngo bo dal ba nas bzung gang dang gang skabs su bug par la nan tan bya/ de yang ngo bo dal ba ngag 'don da res dmyal ba sogs nas mi khoms brgyad las thar ba'i dal ba thob ces pa'i mtshams su bsgom/ 'byor ba bcu ni gnyis su med do drin chen bla ma mkhyen gyi mtshams bsgom/ da res dal rten sogs nas gnyis su med do drin chen bla ma mkhyen zhes pa'i 'jug tu rgyu dpe grangs su la blo sbyangs/ 'phral ris gnyis gsal kha cher/ da lta nad dang sogs nas/drin chen bla ma mkhyen rjes mi rtag pa'i khrid rkang rnams dang / dge sdig las kyi rnam smin phyi bzhin 'brang gi bar du las rgyu 'bras dang / de'i mthar drin bla ma mkhyen mtshams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las dmyal ba'i gnas ris rnams la sbyong ba dang / de bzhin phongs la sogs nas drin chen bla ma mkhyen gyi 'jug tu yi dwags sogs lhag ma lnga po la blo sbyong / chos lam zhugs kyang byugs nas drin chen bla ma mkhyen rjes ma'i rjes su thar ba'i phan yon dang bges gnyen bsten pa dag la sbyangs/ sna tshogs snang ba sogs kyi 'jug tu tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gzhan rnams byang sdom deng dus bdag tshe mgor bsgom pa sogs bya/ thun grol tshe de dag man chad 'don/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi khregs chod dang thod rgal sogs la brtson skabs yin na gu ru rin po che'i thugs kar thim pas dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur bar bsgom/ zhes pa'i mtshams 'dir bsgom/ bskyed rdzogs skabs gzhan 9rdon

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/'gro bsngo smon bcas grub 'phral rang gzhung ltar nyams len byed dgos so/ /thun mong phyi nang gi khrid kyi rim pa rnams mos slob tsam gyis mi chog par smin khrid kyi lugs ltar byed dgos pas/ blo sbyong 'di rnams shin tu lam gyi gal gnad yin pas zhag grangs tshang la mi tshang tsam res khral 'jal ba ltar rtsis med snang chung mos spyod rta rgyug ma ltar ma yin par rang rgyud la che skyes chung skye yi thabs ci drag yun du bya dgos te/ dpal sprul rin po ches/ ci nas rang gi sems la mi phan pa'i/ /chos de kha chos yin gyi don chos min/ /rang gi sems la khyad par mi 'dug na/ /lo brgyar mtshams sgrub byas kyang ngal ba'i rgyu/ /zhes pa'i tshul ltar na lo brgyar bldad kyang ngal ba 'bras med du gyur na zhag brgya tsam res smos ci 'tshal/ de yang thun rnams kyi skabs res 'ga' sgom ste res 'ga' skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bcas bla ma spyi bor gsal thugs yid bsre zhing lhod de cung zad mnyam par bzhag /de tshe rnam rtog skye ba'i mgo tsam dus bsgom bya gang yin dmigs rnam sprad de dpyad 'jog spel mar yun thung grangs mang bya dgos te/ yun thung ngu ma byas na bying rgod kyi skyon du 'gyur la/ grangs mang po ma sbyong na dal khoms res 'ga'i chos kyis rang rgyud 'dul mi nus te/ o rgyan chen pos/ yun thung grangs mang khang stong thig pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gtong len dang bsngo smon bya ba'ang ci 'gro byed dgos/ de yang thun re la cha gsum du bgos pa'i cha snga ma gnyis la blo sbyong dang cha phyi ma gcig la ngag 'don skyabs 'gro'i bar 'don nas skyabs 'gro'i dmigs rnam gsal btab la skyabs 'gro dkon mchog gsum dngos ma grangs bsags shing thun mthar de man chad mthar 92

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dbyung ba kun la 'gre/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i blo sbyong dang sbrags nas skyabs 'gro 'bum dang khri gcig 'gro nges bya 'di 'bum lnga la mi bgrangs/sems bskyed bslab bya rnams la blo spyong byed tshe zun gyi cha phyi ma la sems bskyed hoḥsna tshogs snang ba khri gsum gyis chog gsungs so/gsum pa thun gyi rjes su dge ba 'di yi sogs/ spungs gtor bsdus pa bya/ de yang bdag bskyed la yig drug brgya rtsa/ yi dwags chu sbyin yig drug brgya rtsa/ dngos gzhi la sam bha ra brgya rtsa 'don/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i smon lam—/ bar do'i smon lam/ ri bo bsang mchod/ gang rigs kyis mthar rgyan par bya/ rjes kyi rjes ni/ thun de de nas har langs mi gyed par da ga re ngas snga thun mgor dam bcas pa de legs sam ma legs snyam du phyi ltas byed do/ /gal te legs 'dug na dga' zhing nga rgyal bar 'gyur bas nga rgyal bcags dgos te o khyod la da lta thun legs po zhig 'ong rgyu de chos dang bla ma'i bka' drin nam sngon gyi bsod nams chung ngu'i 'bras bu sam nges 'byung sru sud mas yin shes che bas khyod dga' rgyu ci yod khyod bzang po e yin thun mim sogs yun ring la blta'o snyam du nga rgyal bcags dgos yang thun legs po sna gcig bsgom ma nyan na da ngas sgrub mi nus snyam du sems sdug 'ong na gyid lug pa yin pas de la rjo ba bsrings te gzings bstod dgos te rshakhyod da lta 'khrul ba'i dbang gis thun legs po ma chod kyang sdug rgyu ci yod khyod thog med nas da lta'i bar 'khrul nas da lta'ang thun dang thun mtshams snyes nas bsgom dgos pa de la thug pa yin ma gtogs khyod dang po nas mi 'khrul ba zhig yin na da ci'i phyir sangs ma rgyas/ da lta 'khrul yang thun phyi 93

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/mar 'khrul ba'i dbang du gtong re kan snyam du dam bca' blos 'khyud tshad cig bya dgos te/ rgyal sras lag len las/ rang gi 'khrul ba rang gis ma brtag na sogs sha lo ka drangs/ yang na lus sems g.yeng ba dang / mi dge ba'i dbang du e song dasbyod pa dang song na bshags pa dang / thun phyi ma'i nang de ltar mi byed pa'i dam bca'/ de ltar ma yin pa yang dag pa'i dge sbyor red 'dug na bsngo ba dang thun go chod snyam zhum pa bsal te spro ba bskyed nas dga' ba bsgom/ thun mtshams rang la'ang 'phen pa sogs bya zhing mi dge ba'i rtog pa dang g.yeng ba sogs mi byed pa skyo shas dang nges 'byung sems bskyed dang dag snang sogs la yang yang goms par bya/ skabs 'dir thugs dam gyi rigs 'don/ zhogs ja bzhes/ de nas sngar thun mgor sngar gyi thun mtshams la gong ltar dpyad bshags bsngo/ gnad gsum bcos pa sogs spyi rigs dang / thun phyi ma gsum la bla ma mkhyen sogs gzhengs bskul mi dgos pas/ ngag 'don da nges dmyal ba sogs nas rang gzhung ltar 'don/ khrid sbyong zhibs gang la thug pa la dmigs rnam sprad de bsgom/thun grol tshe 'jug skyongs/ dkar gsum zhing khams kun khyab gtong gsol yod—/ dpal ri'i smon lam/ tshes bcu'i smon lam/ bde chen zhing smon sogs kyis rjes gdab/ yang thun nang du dpyad bshags bsngo bar gong ltar bya—/ thun mtshams gyi 'phen par yang bya/ gung tshig ja/ de nas bza' ba'i rnal 'byor la/ nyan thos ltar na zas cha gsum du byas pa'i gcig gis dkon mchog la mchod/ cha gcig la mi gtsang ba'i 'du shes bzhag ste zas la chags sred spang ste bza'/ cha gcig mgon med pa rnams la sbyin/ byang 94

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/sems ltar na gzhan gnyis gong ltar dang / cha gcig bza' dus lus la srid mtsho las rnam mkhyen nor bu'i gling du bsgrod pa'i gru dang / zas la zag ldan dang / srin bu'i rigs la phan pa'i 'du shes bzhag ste bza'/sngags ltar na khyir 'dod pa'i yon tan lam du khyer ba gsang sngags kyi 'phags chos yin kyang / ji srid bskyed rdzogs kyi nus pa mngon du ma gyur ba'am/ drod thob pa tsam ma byung ba la lta ba'i phyogs su spyod pa shor ba'i dge stong sdig stong dang / spyod pa'i phyogs su lta ba shor ba'i a 'thas mngon zhen du gol ba'i las mi gyed pa bza' btung chos dang mthun pa bya dgos pas chang ni rtsa ba nas spang dgos te/ mdo las/ chang ni rtswa rtse'i zil ba tsam sus 'thung na de ni nga yi nyan thos ma yin la nga ni de yi ston pa min zhes ston pa bka' drin can gyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te de ni mdo lugs yin gyi sngags su ma bkag go zhe na/ 'di yang gnad ma go ba ste/ dkos/ sngags pa chang gis myos gyur gang / /du 'bod gnas su 'tshod bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs mang bas zhib tu brjod ci dgos te de mgi sngags rlom gzugs brnyan pa rnams chang ka yol phyed tsam btung rjes mi dmar po gyur nas myos pa 'gyur bas/ chang gnang sa'i gang zag zin nges pas rang mgo mi bskor zhing lugs bzang khyad du mi gsod pa zhig da sa/ rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya/ sha ni skye bo ya rabs rnams kyis byungasadug bzhin spangs na ser mo rnams kyis bza' mi 'os pa lta ci smos/ 06 par sgrub la brtson par rnams kyis rtsa ba nas spangs te spyad mi rung ba ma sa rdo gas sha tsam yang brten mi rung ste/ dgongs pa zang thal rtsa gsum 95

tre chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/rin chen sgron ma las/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ni bsgrubs pa'i sman la bya: dngos su sha khrag gi rdzas la longs spyod par mi rung ngo: zhes gsungs pa dang / ri chos gnad kyi phreng ba las/ ri khrod 'grims nas sha chang sogs sdig zas dang rnam g.yeng la zhen pa log pa zhig dgos zhes gsungs pa dang / rmad byung sprul ba'i glegs bam las/ rigs sngags kyi khyad par mang po 'grub pa'i gegs dang / byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po skye ba'i gegs byed pa sogs rgya cher gsungs pas so/ /de ltar sha'i nyes dmigs shin tu mang bas gnad kyi me btsa' sogs gzhan du zhib pa lta bar bya'o/ /sdig med chos dang mthun pa'i bza' btung la 'bru gsum gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byin gyis rlabs te/ rang lus gdan gsum lha yi dkyil 'khor ye nas yin pa la yin par shes pa'i sgo nas bza' btung tshogs 'khor du mos nas 'bul zhing /ho bza' bca' btung ba yang dag sogs 'don la rol mthar yon sbyong gi mdo 'don de nas lcang bshags zhi khro'i bshags chung ye shes sku mchog sogs dang sbrags rkyang phyag brgya rtsa re gnyis 'tshal/ bar 'dir nyer mkho'i khrid yig dang dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar mgur 'bum zhal gdams blo sbyong gi bskor dpe ltas byed pa sogs cung zad dal bar bya/ 'on kyang 'du 'dzi'i long gtam dang / gnyid pa dang nyal ba dang / bzo btsem drub dang / mo rtsis dang skar ma lta ba/ sngags chu dang srung mdud ster ba/ rwa gzhog dang shing gzhog byed pa/ phyi rol gyi skye bo la phag ltas nyan rna byed pa sogs lta ci dgos thed gyi yi ge 'bri ba sogs sgrub pa g.yel zhud dang / dngos grub 'phrog pa'i rgyu chen por 'gyur ba'i nyes dmigs sogs shes par byas nas 96
