snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dug bzhin spangs pa la deng nas ma brtson na blo ngan goms du song na phyin chad spong dka'/ rje tsong kha ba chen pos dang po nas lad du song bas tshe gril po'i dge sbyor skyon can du 'gro'o zhes gsungs so/ /yang thun mtshams dpyad bshags bsngo ba sogs sngar bzhin bya/ phyi thun la 'jug pa'i mgor gnad gsum bcos gsol 'debs thugs yid bsre ba dang / dngos gzhi lasgom bya la dmigs rnam sprad de dpyad 'jog spel mar sbyong / mjug bsngo smon bya/ rjes su bun nang du dpyad bshags bsngo ba thun mtshams kyi 'phen pha sogs sngar ltar bya/ gsol ka 'don/ de yang 'di ltar rdzogs chen gtor bsngos/ ma mgon 'khrugs skong dang bcas pa/ gza'/ dam can/tshemajing ma/ mi pham ge sar/ thang lha/ gser skyems bsdus pa gtor 'bul rgyas bsdus thub ba'e bstan pa sogs kyis 'jug skyongs/ grub na de nas zungs gtor bsdus pa'i dbur yod pa'i jo bo kha sar pa ṇi'i bdag bskyed gsal btab la yig drug phreng bskor gsum rjes dmar gsur re btang / ra sku gsum zhing khams sbyong ba'i smon lam dang / dus gsum sangs lha ma dang / dus mthar gdab pa'i smon lam bcas bya/ de nas sku rim cu shes rab snying po dang / gdugs seng bzlog pa so sor thal deb bcas rgya'o/ /nub ja/ srod bun la'ang sngar ltar thun mtshams dpyad bshags 4misngo/ gnad gsum bcos pa sogs nas dngos gzhi blo sbyong / rjes su mucod yul mkha' 'gro'i gad rgyang btang mthar bzang spyod/ spyod 'jug sa na lam/ bstan rgyas smon lam/ bden tshig 'grub pa'i smon lam sogs kha tshu smon zab mos mthar rgyan par bya'o/ /'don bya rnams zhal 'don zur 97

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/du bsdus par ltar bya'o/ /zun mtshams dpyad bshags bsngo ba sogs bya/'di dag gis ni nyes nyung thun dang mi 'grogs pa sogs dgos pa du ma yod pas de ltar dgos kyi/ thun nang legs kyang thun mtshams ral na lcags me nang du dmar 'bar ba yod kyang phyir len tshe nag po song ba ltar yang dag min pa ma zad dug gsum rtog pa'i 'phro 'du sogs kyi skyon gyis thun yang mi ring ba skyon can du byed nges pas sgrim dgos/ de nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'i slad du nyin pa ma zad mtshan mo mi lam du yang dge ba sgrub/ sdig pa spang snyam du nyal dgos/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'chi ba dang snang ba dang ldang ba'i 'du shes gsum yin la/ dang po ni do nub kyi mtshan 'dir bdag 'chi ba'am nang mo yar long rgyu e 'ong mi shes snyam du yang yang bsgom zhing nyin gang bo'i dge sdig ngos blang / dge ba yod na dga' ba dang bcas slar yang bsngo smon yid kyis snying thag par nas bya / sdig pa yod na bshags sdom dang / ma shi gang du sdig pa rnams bshags thub nges byed snyam du dam bca' byed/ gal srid do nub ma shi na nangs mo phan chad nas bzung 'chi bar phan nges pa'i dge ba zhig ma sgrub na nga shi ni yin snyam du dam bca' drag po byed dgos so/ /snang ba'i 'du shes la/ bar du bskyed rim skabs bugs srog sngags phreng la sems gtad nas de nyid bzla bzhin nyal ba dang / tha ma rdzogs chen skabs su shes bya bum par bsdu ba'i man ngag ltar nyal/ sngon 'gro'i skabs 'dir spyi bo'i bla ma nyid dbu ma'i lam rgyud de snying mchong gur phub par lta bu'i nang du pad ma 'dab bzhi'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i 'od kyis tsitta mchong gur phub par lta bu'i nang gang /98

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/de'i 'od kyis lus gang / de'i 'od kyis dper na ston nam dbyar dag pa'i ///rdo///( //// ///milha/ kyidagās su/ balnga ba'isharabaltarashābacudathamasacaṭwāṃkhra kāsal kā da gsaṭwāṃ du sbyangasashrīcho'abyegasal 'o laspa mugs pa'i ngangago du gad— yog pas gad sprasrabarshani lamadang srid gasnal na pa das parsha ṭā/ /ngabakādustesage/spyogal tā ma na nam chato gsum du bdeṭwāṃ pa tha ma duspra su gong dayo / sgrub pa 'dun rwa/ gang na/ 'i dupy-i su ṭwāṃd padasaparasdo/ /ṭārayang rattasaldang ba rnal 'aciragigasasngar bstanapabatrīnyamasasunapa bcas na zhag phrug rmig gro bun dkā bun /shāms chesabarams rnokau na pas zhapy-ibargya— 'atso ṭwāṃs sdopa ga garsha na nyams bas snyi batrī rnal 'ar ṭwāṃms cadag kyi 'bazhen/ba das par ratrī lukās trī ga ba/da pa shā //mas phyapy-i bas 'in pas py-il snang sa da bya rung / bshā salakā/stogs pa bdagawa na par maṭwāṃ'adag dang /me/mtshanami rna bun bad smad gos nasade/ /mnal rshangasnas bu da par /shār bas/ /dran dang// par rag byer du la khyes gsungs pa ltar sgor/she /gzhan yang led lam rnatrīkā da yul lam rsha dṛs /sungs ṭwāṃ sanas nyams shākāpasnal / mi/zun trī 'an ṭwāṃ 'a lamang nyung dang nga ga khyadapaṭwāṃ'adranamatrīkyatrī/ri gas 'dag bla ṭwāṃ dam pa 'japy-i luzlo gaṭwāṃng sras rte dbang 'gyur dasgrong tshe /ṭā/ ga bzung dang na sa cigs la rshan kā ma zad ༵ ma rtonaṭwāṃ phyag rgyun bcas dmyus gag tu bad pa na pas da na dī 9

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i daspa tshogs/snyam—/ dper na dkar gsur lta bu la mtshon na zin bris las thor thun 'jug dang / ri chos mtshams kyi lhan thabs las phyi thun 'jug tu 'don par gsungs pas bla slob dag kyang mi 'dra ba snang mod/ 'dir snga thun 'jug tu bshad pa ni mkhan rin po che tshe dbang 'gyur med kyi phyag srol 'khrul med yin pas de ltar shes par bya/ cung zad mi 'dra ba rnams la skyon du sems na rang sems gu dog pa'i skyon yin pas 'gal 'du mi 'dzin par gnad gcig tu shes dgos so/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa/ sngon 'gro'i blo sbyong gi bsgom rim dngos bshad pa la gnyis te/ phyi yi sngon 'gro'i dang / nang gi sngon 'gro'i bsgom rim gnyis/ dang po la drug las dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' ni/ spyir bun mong phyi nang ji khrid kyi rim pa rnams mos slob tsam gyis mi chog par smin khrid kyi lugs ltar byed dgos pas/ zhag brgya la lugs gnyis mthong ste zin bris sogs phal mo che bas zhag brgya kho na byed pa dang / bla mas gnang ba'i zin bris las zhag brgya dang brgyad du byed tshul gsal ba ma zad kho bos kyang phyi ma la brten nas blo spyong khul byas shing gzhan mang po la'ang 'di bzhin bslab grub pas 'di ltar bshad de/ de yang phyi'i sngon 'gro la zhag drug cu re gsum dang / nang gi sngon 'gro la zhag grangs bzhi bcu zhe lnga ste khyon zhag grangs brgya dang brgyad yin/ dus tshod mtha' gcig ma nges kyang /lha babs dus chen la dbur bzung nas cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes bcu la 'jug rdzogs par phal cher byas pas 'di ltar ram ci bde bya/ phyi yi sngon 'gro yang dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhag bcu gcig tshe mi rtag zhag bcu gcig 100

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/'khor ba'i nyes dmigs zhag nyer brgyad/ las rgyu 'bras zhag dgu/ thar ba'i phan yon dang bshes gnyen bsten pa zhag bzhi yin la/ de yang blo smyong rnams kyi sngon du 'di shes dgos te/ 'o skol rnams chos kyi sgor zhugs nas chos don du gnyer ba rloms kyang phyi'i tshul tsam dang ming tsam bcos nas tshe 'di kho na zhen nas rang rang gi las sna tshogs shig bsgrubs nas mi lus stong zad byed par 'gyur na mi rung bas/ dang po nas chos yang dag par re e 'grub lta dgos te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ mdor na rang rgyud chos dang ma 'dres na/ chos pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam gyis ni dgos pa mi 'ong / zhes dang / mnga' ris longs spyod 'khor dang bsod nams dang / /snyan pa'i gtam gyis 'dzam gling khyab gyur kyang / /rang nyid 'chi tshe phan pa gcig kyang med—/ /sgrub la brtson pa kho bos snying gtam yin/ /zhes gsungs bas so ji ltar sgrub na thog mar bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten cing / chos don du gnyer bya med du mi rung ba rnams thos pas sgro 'dogs bcad/ bsam byung gi gtan la phabs/ sgom nas nyams su len dgos/ de la dang po gal che ba 'khor ba mtha' dag me yi 'obs ltar sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du mthong nas thar ba don gnyer gyi nges 'byung bcos min dang / bar du gal che ba 'gro kun pha ma shes nas beems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi byang chub kyi sems dang / tha ma gal che ba yang dag pa'i lta ba ste gsum po med du mi rung ba shes nas nyams su len dgos te/ rma rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang sa/ dang po nges 'byung chos kyi mgo yin pas/ /ya ki dga' ldan lha yul 101

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/man chad nas/ /ma ki ngan song gnas gsum yan chad kyi/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'di me yi 'obs lta bur/ /shes nas theg gsum lam la slob pa dgos/ /bar du byang sems chos kyi lus yin pas/ /'gro ba 'di kun pha dang mar shes nas/ /de dag don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod blo/ /bcos ma min par snying nas skye ba dgos/ /tha ma yang dag lta dang de'i nyams len/ /thar lam myur bgrod chos kyi rkang pa ste/ /snang srid chos kun spros bral stong ba'i ngang / /lung dang rigs pas gtan la 'bebs pa lags/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / kha rag sgom chung gis/ bdag gis dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pas/ tshe 'di la blo ldog dgos par go lags/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches par bsgoms pas/ 'dod pa la blo ldog dgos par go lags/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pas 'khor ba mtha' dag las blo ldog dgos par go lags/ byang chub tu sems bskyed nas byams dang snying rje bsgoms pas rang gcig pu zhi bde las blo ldog dgos par go lags/ chos thams cad rang bzhin skye ba med par bsgoms pas/gzung 'dzin gnyis las blo ldog dgos par go lags/ zhes dang / rje phag mo grub pas mdzad pa'i skyes bu chen po'i lam rim las/ dal 'byor rnyed pa dka' dang 'chi ba bsgoms/ /des ni 'jig rten 'di las blo ldog 'gyur/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam par bya/ /des ni 'khor ba las ni blo ldog cing / /thar ba sgrub pa'i 'dun pa skye ba 'gyur ces dang /don gnyis phun tshogs thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ /byang chub sems kyi rgyu las 'byung 'gyur zhing / /snying rje'i rtsa ba thabs kyi mthar phyin byas/ /de phyir 102

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/byams dang snying rje bsgom par bya/ /byams dang snying rje las su rung tsam na/ /rang don byed pa'i blo ni ldog gyur cing / /gzhan don byang chub sgrub pa'i blo skye 'gyur/ /ces gsungs/ thar rgyan las/ de la mi rtag pa bsgoms pas ni/tshe 'di'i spyod yul la chags pa'i gnyen po gyur ba yin no/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs las 'bras dang bcas pa bsgos pas ni/ srid pa'i bde ba la chags pa'i gnyen por gyur ba yin no/ /byams pa dang snying rje bsgoms pas ni/ zhi ba'i bde ba la chags pa'i gnyen por 'gyur ba yin no/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i chos rnams ni/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs mi shes pa'i gnyen por 'gyur ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ lam gtso rnam gsum las/rnam dag nges 'byung med par srid mtsho yi/ /bde 'bras don gnyer zhi ba'i thabs med la/ /srid la brkam pa yis kyang lus can rnams/ /kun nas 'ching phyir thog mar nges 'byung btsal/ /zhes dang / nges 'byung de yang rnam dag sems bskyed kyis/ /zin pa med na bla med byang chub kyi/ /phun tshogs bde ba'i rgyu ru mi 'gyur bas/ /blo ldan rnams kyis byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /ces dang / gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mi ldan na/ /jis 'byung byang chub sems la goms byas kyang / /srid pa'i rtsa ba bcad par mikhus pas/ /de phyir rten 'brel rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad/ /ces gsungs phas so/ /tha mar gal che ba'i yang dag pa'i lta ba ni rgyas par gzhan du shes dgos pas 'aldar ma spros la/ de yang dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang tshe mi rtag gnyis rgyud la skyes pas tshe 'dir zhen pa'i kun rtog ngan pa'i blo ldog pa dang / mkhor ba'i nyes dmigs las rgyu 'bras gnyis rgyud la skyes pas tshe phyi mar 103

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/mngon mtho sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor las blo ldog/ de'i shugs la rang 'dod sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor las blo ldog dgos pa rang lugs kyi khyad chos gsungs/'di bzhi la blo ldog gi chos bzhi zhes bya la de dag dang / thar ba'i phan yon yid la byed pa la brten te nges 'byung yang dag skyes na theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad kyi sgo phye/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa yid la byed pas lam gyi rten 'brel bsgrig skyabs 'gro'i gzhi bzung byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ phyin drug gi lam la bslab pa yid la byed pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam yang dag pa la 'khrid par 'gyur bas med thabs thed do/ /de ltar rang rgyud la nan tan ma sbyar na tshe 'di'i bstod bkur snyan grags sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad la g.yeng nas mi tshe stong par zad de mchog dman thams cad chos mthar ma phyin pa'am chos gzhug las nyams nas log lam 'gro ste/ rdzogs chen mkhan chen rta mgrin yon tan mgon pos/ blo sbyong gi man ngag ji snyed pa/ /rang rgyud la nan sbyor ma byas na/ /bsags sbyang gi kha grangs rdzogs zla 'dis/ /chos gzhug las nyams par 'gyur ro ang / /zhes dang / lar 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho la/ /skyo shes nges 'byung ma skyes na/ /tsab tsob tu chos don gnyer na yang / /chos mthar phyin pa nyung ngo ang / /zhes dang / 'khrul snang srid pa'i phun tshogs la/ /gting nas zhen pa ma log na/ /bcos ma'i spyod lam bzang po tsam/ /yod kyang nam zhig rang mtshang ston/ /zhes gsungs so/ /tshe 'di'i snang shes la blo ldog pa'i gtso bo mi rtag pa dang phyi ma'i snang zhen la blo ldog pa'i gtso bo 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal shes pa 'di yin/ khyad par tshe 104

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/'di dang phyi mar 'khor ba las blo ldog byed dngos 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs yid la byed pa 'di gtso bo yin pas shes nas nyams su len dgos te/ rgyal sras lag len las/ yun ring 'grogs sogs dang / blo spyong chos kyi sgo 'byed las/ tshe blos thongs pa zhig med mi rung yang de'i rgyu gtso bo nyams su len pa med na tshe blos thongs pa yong thabs med pas nyams len gtso bo shes dgos / de gang yin snyam na 'chi ba mi rtag pa legs par sems pa yin gsungs—/ mkhan chen yon tan mgon pos/ 'khor ba me yi 'obs lta bur/ /mthong nas 'di dang phyi ma yi/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs dug can zas/ /ji bzhin zhen pa log pa dgos/ /zhes dang / tshe mi rtag 'chi ba'i ngang tshul la//blo gting nas 'byung ba ma byas na/ /phyi tshes dang rnam g.yeng gi mgo skor 'dis/ /mi tshe stong zad du 'gyur ro ang / /zhes dang / pu rto bas mda' gcig gis sha ba gnyis mi sod/ khyi gcig gis gla ba gnyis mi zin/ khab rtse gnyis kyis tshem bu mi btab/ rkang ba ya gcig yar la bor ya gcig mar la bor bas don sar mi sleb/ de bzhin du tshe 'di dang phyi ma gnyis mi 'grub pas—/ de yang phyi ma phan chad gal che bas chos bsha' ma gcig bya dgos par 'dug snyam 'chi ba bsha' ma cig dran na dngos po thams cad gcan gzan gyi mdun du rtswa spungs pa dang 'dra ba cig 'ong bar 'dug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis skyug bsha' mar log na cis kyang dgos pa med snyam pa yang yang 'byung / de tsam na tshe 'di'i 'dun ma la blo bshal mar log nas gzhan dang bsam pa ye mi mthun pa cig 'ong bar 'dug ces gsungs/ rje rin po ches 'chi ba dran pa ma bsgom pa'i nyes dmigs ni da gzod mthar 'chi ba zhig 105

tre chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/'ong snyam pa kun la yod kyang nyi ma re re zhing de ring mi 'chi de ring yang mi 'chi snyam du blos mi 'chi ba'i phyogs 'dzin pa 'chi ka tshun chad la 'byung ngo / /de'i gnyen po yid la ma byas na de ltar bu'i blo des bsgribs nas tshe 'dir sdod pa'i blo skyes nas 'di dang 'di dgos zhes tshe 'di tsam gyi bde ba sgrub pa dang kug bsngal sel thabs 'ba' zhig sems beems nas tshe phyi ma dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sogs don chen po la spyod pa'i blo mi skye bas chos la 'jug tu mi ster gsungs/ dpal sprul rin po ches/ des na gnad don med pa'i chos gzugs dang / /'khrul snang tshe 'di sgrub pa'i ban 'khyams dang / /dkor zan dal khom med pa'i bla chung gi /lad mo ma gyed rang sems chos kyisabul/ sems bul sems bul radzosems chos kyis bul/ /blo ldog rnam bzhis rang gi somasabul na/ /ltasgom bzlas brjod bskyed rdzogs medan yang/ /thar ba'i lam las gzhan du 'argyugs pa med/ /blo spyongs blo spyongs rang gi blo 'di spyongs/ /byang chub beems kyis rang gi blo sbyang na/ /lus ngag dge ba sna gcig ma 'aspub kyang / /rang gzhan don gnyis ma 'bad shugs kyis 'grub/ /gal chen byang chub beems la bun gcig kyang / /nyams len mi byed bskyed rdzogs sgom lo dang / /bzlas brjod byed lo chos pa'i gzugs brnyan 'di'i/ /kha de grong tsho dgu yi skyag pas chod/ /grogs khyed yang dag chos shig sgrub dgongs na/ /blo spyongs blo spyongs snying rje byang sems sbyongs/ /gal chen lan dgu ba sa 'di dgongs mdzad la/ /rang sems chos kyis thul dang gnad de lags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na 'khor ba'i sun tshogs tshe 'di phyi las blo ldog gyed zhen log gi chos bzhi dang /106

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/rang don zhi ba phyogs gcig pa'i thar ba las blo ldog byed byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems yin pas phyi nang gi sngon 'gro rnams la snying nas brtson pa chen pos bsgom dpyad 'jog spel ma'i sgo nas blo sbyongs dang / chos pa rab la zhag bskyed/ 'bring la zla bskyed tha ma la'ang lo bskyed zer ba ltar rang rgyud la rang nus tshod kyi yon tan re 'ong nges so/ /'o na sgom dpyad 'jog gi don ji 'dra snyam na/ sgom zhes pa ni/ yid la yang yang bsgom bya de bskyed pa'am yid de'i skal ba can du byed pa la zer te/ phar phyin 'grel bshad tshig gsal las/ sgom par byed pa zhes bya ba ni yid de'i skal ba can du byed pa'am de'i dngos por byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ mdor na dge ba'i dmigs pa la yang yang goms par byed pa yin te/ ji skad du/ rnal 'byor sgo pa mi gtso goms pa gtso/ goms pa klong du gyur na sgom pa yin ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dpyad sgom ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis gsung rab sogs kyi don bsgom bya gang yin rnams la sgo du ma nas dpyad de nges shes bzang po'i blo shugs drag la rgyun ring ba'i yid 'khul nus pa zhig yang yang yid la byed pa la zer te/ de ltar med na ldog phyogs 'gog mi nus sa so/ /'jog sgom ni/ yun ring dpyad nas sems chad de gar yang 'gro shu btub na 'das pa'i rjes mi 'brang ma 'ong ba'i mdun mi bsu da lta'i 'phro mabud par bcas bcos med par bzhag pa la zer/ yang na nges shes la' dag pa'i blo shugs drag la rgyun ring ba ngang gi gnas pa byung na de'i ngang spyor dpyad par 'jog nas yang yang yid la byed pa la zer/ des na sngon ma 'i blo sbyong 'di dag gi skabs las dang po bas dpyad sgom gtso cher byed 107

tre chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ —par gal che ste nges shes bzang po'i rgyun skye ba 'gyur dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /nges shes sgron mer las/ dang po dpyad par gal che ste/ /sogs nas/dpyad cing dpyad cing nges shes drangs/ /zhes dang / tha mar dpyad pas ma drangs kyang / /nges shes ngang gis skye bas na/ /de ga'i ngang du 'jog pa las/ /dpyad pas grub zin sgrub ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs par ltar ro/ /sgom skyon bying rgod kyis ma gos par zhig ni 'jog sgom ma zad dpyad sgom la yang dgos pas dran pa dang shes bzhin sogs gnyen po bsten pa bya dgos so/ /da ni sngar bshad pa ltar bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten nas blo sbyong gi chos nyams su len pa la 'jug dgos/dang po dal ba brgyad la blo sbyong ba la/ spyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dngos gzhi dal ba'i rgyu mtshan bsam pa/ rjes bsngo ba'i rnal 'byor du bya'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi ma lta bu gcig nas sems can thams cad kyi bar ma shes drin dran drin len gzo 'dod kyi kun slong byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas thun la 'jug dgos/ de yang kun slong mi dge ba spongs/lung ma bstan bcos/ dge sems la'ang skyes bu chung 'bring gnyis kyi kun slong ni bdag rang don sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa yin pas de nyi ma de ring nas bzung / dgra ru blta/ skyon du blta/ sun rgyungs te/ ma sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya bsam dgos/ de yang bsam khul byas pa tsam gyis mi 'ong bas/ ma shes drin dran sogs yang dag par bsgom dgos la/ dang po rang gi ma rgan la bsgom na skye sla bas ma la bsgom/ de nas rim bzhin pha 108

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dang spun zla sring mo sogs nas nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tu bsgom pa ma byas na go yul gshis 'byams tsam du 'gro ba las gnad dang mi ldan pas/ des na rang gi ma rgan 'di da res ma byas pa ma zad skye ba sngon ma rnams su bdag thog med nas da lta'i bar du 'khor bar 'khyams pas sa lag pa tsam zhig gi steng nas lan grangs mang por skyes ma myong sa dang 'chi ma myong sa med pas lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par ma byas nges te/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i mdo las/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sa rdo dang / rtsi shing dang / nags tshal thams cad rgya shug gi tshig gu tsam du skyes bu gcig gis byas la/ skyes bu gnyis pas de rnams grangs su bgrangs pas zad pa'i dus srid kyi/ sems can gcig gis bdag gi ma byas pa ni bgrang bar mi nus so/ /zhes dang / klu sgrub kyis/ re res bdag nyid rus pa'i gung po ni/ /kun po mnyam pa snyed gcig 'das gyur te/ /ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /ril bu bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur/ /ces gsungs pa sogs kyis ma shes te/sngon sangs rgyas 'khor bcas byon pa'i lam bar rgan mo zhig gis sangs rgyas la bu bu zhes rgyug pa'i lo rgyus rnams dran dgos/ des mtshon te nam mkha'i gar khyab sems can gyis khyab sems can gyis gar khyab las snang sdug bsngal gyis khyab pa'i sems can thams cad thog med nas rang gi pha ma gnyen bshes sogs su ma gyur ba med/ de'i nang nas kyang ma ma byas pa'i sems can gcig kyang med pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams dran dgos/ gnyis pa drin dran pa la rang gi ma lta bu mi'i ma la mtshon na/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las/ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma 'dis bdag cag bskyed pa/ 'dis ni dka' ba byed pa/109

da wa tram̐chenamatshophu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/bdag gi srog byin pa/ 'jig rten kun ston pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ lus bskyed pa'i drin/ srog byin pa'i drin/ yo byad bstabs pa'i drin/ 'jig rten bstan pa'i drin/ chos phyogs kyi drin bcas dran dgos la/ dang po ni/rang nyid bar do'i gnas na dri za nye bar len pa'i rnam par shes pa yid lus dri tsam la brten nas 'gro ba'i tshe sngon gyi las dang / pha ma'i 'du phrod kyi rgyus mngal du zhugs nas bzung / zla dgu ngo bcu'i bar du mngal du khur/sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad khyad du bsad de/ ma'i lus kyi bcud dang kha zas kyi dwangs ma lte ba nas brgyud de srog gi gsos su byed nas lus skyed bsring ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyir btsal ba'i gnas skabs shi bo yin na dbugs ma chad/ gson po yin na mgo mi khyogs pa nyar re nyor re ba de ma drin mo che des 'chi rgyu 'chi ma bcug rul rgyu skam kha ma bcug par a ma la bu skyes byung snyam pa'i dga' so chen po bcas te/ lag sor mo bcu'i pang du blangs/ bu na ba las rang nyid 'chi ba'ang 'dom nus pa'i brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyangs/ 'dzum pa'i mig gis blta/ tshe ring nad med a bu a gces sogs snyan pa'i ngag gis bos nas 'chi ma bcug pa srog byin pa'i drin yin/gsum pa ni/ de lta bu de dang po kha zas med rgyab gos med lag nor med pa zhig ngo mi shes pa zhig gi khyim du phyin pa na/ ma drin mo che de'i zas kyi dang po mngar ba'i nu zho byin/ gos kyi dang po sha drod la bcar/ de nas cung zad za nus pa'i dus su zas kyi phud dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs zas gang bzang gang zhim nas zas thams cad khas byin/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ 'grang stog lag pas byug tsha grang 'dzub mos tshad bzung nas byin/110

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/gos kyi rtse ma gang 'jam gang dro mang pos bu la gos byed/ mdor na phyug po'i bu skyes na lta ci/ sprang mo zhig gi bu yin kyang / mgor skar rgyan gyi zhwa byed—/ rkang ba mos lham byed/ rgab mas lcags gyed/ rkang khrag sa la brdab/lag khrag rdo la brdab/ gdong sha mi la byin/ nya sha khyi la byin nas sdug sdig pa gnyis kas bsgrub pa'i zang zas lta bu de'i nang na snum mdzub mo tsam zhig yod na bu la byin/ stan chad po zhig las ma lon kyang cung zad sra sa nas bu'i gos sam lhan po la sogs par byas nas bskyangs pa yin/ gzhan yang ma rang gis yar dkon mchog la mchod mi bra/ mar ngan slong la sbyin mi bra/shi bo'i rgyab nas gtong mi bra/ gson po'i kha la za mi bra/ rgyab la gyon mi bra bar sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad khyad du bsad nas bsags shing /sdig pa dang g.yo sgyu'i g.yo skor kho nas bsags pa'i longs spyod thams cad bu la byin/ da dung 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid la bkod kyang che song bsam rgyu med par kha zas 'dod zas dang sprad/ lag nor 'dod nor dang sprad—/ rgyab gos med gos dang sprad de ser sna dang phangs sems med par ma rang gi longs spyod thams cad bu la byin pa yo byad bstabs pa'i drin yin/bzhi pa 'jig rten bstan pa'i drin ni/ de nas cung zad zhig za shes 'gro shes dus/ zas za tshul/ gos gyon tshul/ gos kyi mgo 'jug ske rag gi dam lhod/ lham sgrog gi bcing tshul/ 'gro mi shes pa la 'gro tshul/ smra mi shes pa la a ma gyis/ a pha gyis la sogs pas 'jig rten tha snyad thams cad bslab / bu chung rdzi bor nang bsnyal ba'i dus su ma rang gi snying de dmar ldog ge blangs te thang du bzhag pa lta bu gces ka dang ring thang chen po re bzung 111

tram̐ chen mtshosuchosagrwa'idaspatshogs/ da wanas/ da lta nya ka ba/ ba spu sdong por ma song gi bar du bskyed pa ni 'jig rten bstan pa'i drin yin/ 'di bzhi ni 'jig rten phyogs kyi drin dran pa yin/ lnga ba chos phyogs kyi drin dran pa ni/ chos phyogs nas dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di yang ma drin mo ches bskyed/ chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen gnas khang yo byad sogs kyang ma soms can rnams med na mi 'byung / dang po sems bskyed sa dang / bar du rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu bslab pa'i yul dang / mthar sangs rgyas pa yang ma sems can rnams la brten nas 'byung dgos pas chos phyogs kyi drin dran par bya/ da lta'i ma rgan 'di bzhin thog med nas ma byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis kyang shin tu byams pas skyed bsring ba'i drin chen sha stag yin te/ khra dang spyang ki sogs gcan gzan gtum po'i bu gyur na yang mas gzhan srog bcad nas bu la gyin nas drin gyis bskyangs pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te ma thams cad drin che ba ma mthong ste 'gas bu la gnod par byed pa'ang mthong pa'i phyir snyam na/ tshe gcig tsam de lta bu mthong na'ang thog med nas de lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par ma byas nas drin gyis bskyangs pa'i phyir na'o/ /gsum pa drin len gzo 'dod ni/ da sngon ma drin chen mas khe dang rgyal kha thams cad bu la byin/ gyong dang pham kha thams cad ma rang gis blang nas/ bde skyid bde ba'i dngos po thams cad bu la bsgrub/ sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad ma rang gi bzod nas phan btags pas/ da ni bu nga'i res la bab te ma rgan gyi skyid sdug la ngas blta dgos pas/ ma la bde ba ni nyi ma dron mo zhig gi bde ba nas bzung rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bar gyi bde ba thams cad 'dod 112

da wa snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/par mtshungs kyang / bde ba'i rgyu dge ba yang dag pa'i lam ni sgrub mi thes shing mi mos/ sdug bsngal tha na me stag phra mo tsam gyi sdug bsngal nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad mi 'dod par mtshungs kyang de'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa la 'chol nyog tu spyod nas zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu song ba'i rkyen gyis 'bras bu khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la lu gu rgyud du spyod pa rnams snying re rje/ de thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras kun dang bral na ci ma rung snyam du 'dun pa dang 'brel ba dang / bral ba gyur cig snyam du smon lam dang 'brel/ bral ba zhig ngas bya snyam pa'i dam bca' dang 'brel/ bral ba zhig skyabs bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum khyed mkhyen snyam du/ bla ma rgyal ba sogs nas/ kye ma kyi hu dkon mchog sogs dang / dpa' bo khyed la sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/de dag ni zur dang po snying rjes sems can la dmigs pa yin/ ma sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral nas gang la bkod snyam na—/ mtho ris dbang po sogs kyi bde ba ni ma rgan gyis sngon mang du thob kyang mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba'i rang bzhin 'khor ba yin pas der mi bkod/ thar ba nyan rang gi go 'phang yang 'khor ba las gtan du thar yang /byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams med par zhi ba phyogs gcig pa yin pas de la bkod dgos med/ des na yon tan thams cad kyis rgyan pa mi gnas pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod dgos pas de bsam dgos/ zur phyi ma 'di'i steng nas/ rdzi bo lta bu'i sems bskyed dang / mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang / rgyal po lta 113

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ —bu'i sems bskyed gsum phye yang / snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir sems can gyi don rgya chen po mi 'byung ba ma zad/ theg mchog a ti'i bstan pa dang mjal dus 'dir rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed 'di legs te/ bdag la da lta sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa'i nus pa med la/ yod pa po ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin pas/ ngas sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub nas rtogs pas rang rgyud grol/thugs rjes gzhan la dgrol nas grol ba'i lam bstan pa dang / 'gro ba'i don rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ rgyun ring ba ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang rig pa 'dzin pa gong ma rnams kyis ji ltar bsgrubs pa bzhin bdag gis bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa zur phyi ma shes rab kyis rdzogs byang la dmigs pa'o/ /jo bo rje'i man ngag bdun po yang don du 'dir 'dus pas rang gi ma dang / de nas pha/de nas spun de nas grogs dga' mdza'/ de nas pha skor/ de nas ma skor/de nas yul mi thams cad nas rim gyis mthar mkha' khyab gyi sems can thams cad la bsgom pa'i don gnyis sam zur gnyis ldan pa byang chub sems kyi kun sgrong ngam dge rtsa rtswa phon lta bu rnams bsam pa lcags myu lta bus thabs kyis zin pa gyed dgos so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la thun gyi sbyor ba'i chos ni sngar bshad par ltar byas nas/ rang nyid mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad du ma skyes nas thar pa'i chos sgrub tu khom pa'am dal ba thob pa la dga' ba bskyed phyir bsgom dgos la/mi khoms pa'i gnas brgyad ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ bdag ni 114

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/sems daskyal yi dwags ma skyes shing / /dud 'gro tshe ring lha dang kla klo dang / /log lta sangs rgyas kyis stong skugs pa ste/ /mi khom brgyad podag las rab 'das shing / /zhes pa ltar mi makren pa'i mi khoms pa bzhi dang / mi'i mi khoms pa bzhi ste brgyad do/ /dang po la dmyal ba tsha dmyal ba rnams ni/gnas ni mun pa mun nag gi smag tu gyur pa'i gnas/ sa gzhi thams cad lcags bsreg gi sa gzhi/ me ri skug nag khru gang ba 'bar ba/ steng na mdag dang / rdo bsreg dang mtshon cha'i char ba 'beebs pa'o/ /de dag gi lus gi/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi las bzhi 'gyur gyis che ba lus mdog khrag tshos pa'am/ bal nag gi 'dab ma g.yeng ba lta bu'am bu btsas ma thag pa lta bu'i cipags pa srab pa/ sha tshag dam pa/ mig lta bu reg bya sran mi bzod pa/ skra thebasko du gzer ba/ mig sto / gsu ba mthad lag rags pa/gsus khyim che ba dmyal ba'i sems can de 'dzam gling gi mis mthong na rgyal 'gro bub pa lta bu/ sdug bsngal ni/ nyin mi dal mtshan mi nyal bar sten mtshan med par mtshon gyis gshogs pa dang / sa gzhi dang rdo bsreg gi ma 'a dzi sogs kyis lus mgo 'jug med par bsregs te bde ba'i go skabs mtshom yang med de sdug bsngal/ ji skad du/ tha ma tsan dan dus mtha' nung / daskyal me rnams ni bdun 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'di na nyin gcig cang bung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang yin pa/ / dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu yis/ /dpe yang mi phod cha yang mi shā da do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /tshe tshad ni/ lo'i grangs las 'das pa smo ji gyi bskal pa la sogs par myong dgos/ grangs dmyal ba rnams kyi 115

tre chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i daspa tshogs/gnas ni/ gangs ri chab rom gyi khrod kha ba bu yug sprebs pa/ lus tshad tsha dmyal dang mtshungs/ sdug bsngal grang pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pas mnar ba/ tshe tshad kyang dpag tu med par myong dgos so/ /rgyas pa bsam na tsha grang gi dmyal ba de dag re re nas dang nyi tshe nye 'khor thams cad kyi sdug bsngal la zhib tu bsam/ da de lta bu'i tsha grang gi dmyal ba gang du skyes kyang dam pa'i chos bsgrub khoms sam mi khoms yang nas yang du bsam te dpyad sgom dang / yang de ltar dpyad nas sems chad de gar yang 'gro mi btub na 'das pa'i rjes su mi 'brang / ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i 'phro mi mthud par bcas bcos med par 'jog sgom byed/ yang rtog pa zhig 'phro bar rtsom na yang dpyad/ yang 'phro mi 'dod dus 'jog dpyad 'jog res mos byed pa yin/gnyis pa yi dwags kyi gnas ni/ zag ma dang rdo gseg gis gang ba/sdong dum mes dzig pa mang po dang / dug tsher rags po tha thor yod pa/ chu skam pa'i gram pa skya khrog ge yod pa/ na bal skam po mang po g.yeng ba/ lus ni bskal pa'i rus pa'am/ shwa mong skam pa'am/ mar skog gyong bo lta bu/mgo bo ni ja rdza tsam/ mgrin pa rta rnga tsam/ sto ba yul ljongs tsam/ yan lag 'jag skya tsam/ yi dwags gcig song ba'i sgra la shing rta 'khor lo lnga brgya drud pa'i sgra tsam dang / lhu tshig nas me stag dmar chal chal byed pa/ sdug bsngal ni/ yi dwags rnams la dbyar ni zla ba'ang tsha/ dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang ba/ ljon shing thog gu can mang po mthong yang med par gyur ba dang / rgya mardo 1ṭwāṃn po mthong yang mthong ba tsam nas gram par 'gro ba/ lo du mar

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/btsal yang bza' btung mi rnyed/ snabs lud sogs bsngos pa cung re rnyed kyang kha khab mig tsam nas mi 'gro/ rgya la cung zad song yang phal che mgrin pa rta rnga tsam nas dug gis skam/ cung tsam nang du song yang sto ba mi gang zhing mtshan mor me 'bar bas nyams thag pa'i sdug bsngal tshad med pas mnar ba'o—/ /tshe tshad ring mtha' mi lo khri dang bung tshad ma nges so/ /gzhan yang mkha' rgyu yi dwags rnams kyi sdug bsngal sogs yang yang bsam/ de lta bu'i gnas su skye na dam pa'i chos bsgrub khoms mi khoms la dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom/gsum pa dud 'gro'i gnas ni/ phal cher gling bar mun pa mun nag gi gnas lag pa brkyang bskum tsam yang mi mngon pa'i gnas su/ lus ni nya dang chu srin gyi rigs ri'i rgyal po ri rab la dkris lan gsum la sogs par 'khor ba/ chung ba rdul phran dang khab rtse la sogs pa'i rnam pa/ sdug bsngal ni spyir glen cing gti mug pa blang dor la rmongs pa/ bye brag che chung rnams phan tshun za ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ de ma zad mi yul gyi dud 'gro rnams kyi sdug bsngal dang rmongs pa bcas la yang zhib tu bsam nas de dag chos bsgrub pa'i dal ba yod med la dpyad 'jog spel ma bsgoms dang mi khoms pa'i nges shes snying nas skye 'ong / ngan song gsum po ni gtso bo lus la sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa myong bas lus mi khoms pa yin/bzhi ba lha tshe ring po ni gtso bo 'du shes med pa'i lha la zer/ de'i gnas ni/ bsam gtan bzhi ba'i byang shar mtshams na nag ngam me ba'i tpanas su'am gang du 'chi sar/ dge sdig gi 'du shes med pa'i sdu~X du

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/bskal chen brgyad re'i bar du gnas/ de las 'pho ba na log ltas ngan song du 'phen pa dang / gzhan yang gzugs gzugs med kyi lha sor skyes rnams ni ting nge 'dzin gyis rtag tu myong nas yun ring gnas/ 'dod lha phal cher yang 'dod yon la g.yeng shing skyo shas chung bas de dag gi gnas su skyes na chos bsgrub khoms mi khoms la dpyad 'jog spel ma bsgoms/ mdor na ngan song gsum po thams cad mi khoms pa'i gnas dang bde 'gro gsum las lha mi khoms pa'i gnas ste rigs drug las bzhi mi khoms pa'i gnas yin na/lha min logs su ci'i phyir ma bgrangs snyam na 'gro ba rgyud lnga gye tshe lha dang dud 'gro gang rung bsdu ba las med pas don gyi de dag gi khongs su 'du bas mi khoms pa'i gnas yin snyam/ 'o na 'dzam bu gling las gzhan pa'i gling gsum yang mi khoms pa'i gnas yin na gang du bgrangs zhe na/ mtha' 'khob bam kla klo'i khongs su don gyis bsdu dgos snyam ste 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ 'khor rnam bzhi mi bzhugs pa'i sar mtha' 'khob gsungs pas so/ /mu stegs pa dang mun skal dag ni logs su phye zin pas so/ mdor na lho 'dzam bu'i gling lung rtogs kyi chos dar ba'i yul dbus las gzhan pa'i sor skyes kyi 'jig rten thams cad mi khoms pa'i gnas yin pas zhib tu re re nas bsam na go ba rgya chen skye ba 'gyur ro/ yul dbus la'ang log lta can dang skugs pa gnyis yod par 'chad 'gyur ltar ro/ /de yan chad mi ma yin pa'i mi khoms pa rnams la zhag gcig bsgoms/thun re la cha gsum byas pa'i phyi ma gcig la skyabs 'gro 'don par gsungs pas skyabs 'gro'i dmigs rim bsdus tsam 'dir bshad de de 118

— snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/yang 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de las rang gzhan sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i skyes bu chen po'i blos/ rang nyid gang du 'dug pa'i sa phyogs thams cad rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zhing khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i gzhir/ dpag bsam ljon shing yal ga lnga ba/ lo 'dab dang me tog 'bras bu gun sum tshogs pa la rin po che'i 'phyang 'phrul dril g.yer la sogs pas rnam par brgyan pa nam mkha' dbyings kun khyab pa'i dbus su seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rma rgyan rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mtsho rgyal dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dar dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing / zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dbu gtsug tu rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs shing / gzhan yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang / rgyud sde chen po drug dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pas mtha' nas bskor ba/ mdun gyi yal ga la sangs rgyas shākya bub pa sogs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sprul ba'i sku'i rnam pa can rnams dang / g.yas kyi yal gar nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun/ g.yon gyi yal ga la shā ri'i bu dang / mo'u gal gyi bu la sogs pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun 'phags pa'i tshogs/ rgyab kyi yal gar chos dkon mchog glegs bam brtsegs pa'i rnam pa can kha dog dmar po 119

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ā li kā li'i rang sgra sgrog pa/ de dag gi bar mtshams thams cad ye shes dang las las grub pa'i chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bar med du gang ba/ thams cad kyang mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan dpag tu med pas bdag nyid la rjes su brtse zhing 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por mngon sum du bzhugs par bsams la/ de'i mdun du rang nyid/ rang gi g.yas su pha—/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du gnod byed/ mtha' skor kun tu rigs drug gi sems can thams cad lus gus pa'i thal mo sbyar/ ngag nas skyabs 'gro'i tshig 'ur dir gyis brjod/ yid kyis 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla ma la 'dren pa/ yi dam dang sangs rgyas la ston pa/chos la lam/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i zla grogs zhu ba'i tshul gyis bdag cag rnams khyed la bsten/ khyed la 'bul/ khyed las gzhan pa'i skyabs dang re sa med pas ci mdzad khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i gdung ba drag pos skyabs su 'gro bar mos te/ dkon mchog gsum dngos bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum: rtsa rlung thig le'i rang bzhin byang chub semasaX ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor la: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: zhes skyabs 'gro ci 'aspub tu bya/ mthar skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan la sogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par bsams la sems 'dzin med kyi ngang du cung zad re mnyam par gzhag go /120

da snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/lnga ba kla klo ni/ blo las su ma rung bas dam pa'i chos la mi mos shing bsgyur mi btub par 'tshe ba chos su smra ba'i lugs srol ngan pa/ lung rtogs kyi snang ba med pa'i yul klo kha khra sogs mtha' 'khob sum cu rtsa gnyis rnams rang bzhin mi gzugs lta bu yod kyang srog chags gsod pa dang ri dwags bshor ba sogs sdig pa'i las thabs la mkhas shing spyad pa chos sgrub pa'i skal ba med pa yin/ de ma zad da lta bod kyis yul phyogs 'ga' lung rtogs bshad sgrub kyi snang ba med pa'i rkyen gyis rgan gzhon thams cad la chos kyi sgrob gso ma theb par srog gcod kyi las thabs kho na la brtson nas chos byed khul rlom pa rnams kyang 'tha' 'khob kla klo'i khongs su bgrangs chog pa 'dra snyam—/ de la yang bsgom tshul gong dang 'dra/drug pa log lta can ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di las phyi rol tu gyur ba'i log lta can rtag chad du lta ba'i mu stegs pa thams cad yin te/rang gi rgyud log ltas bslad nas yang dag pa'i chos la mos pa med pas dang /chos dar ba'i sar skyes kyang tshe snga phyi las rgyu 'bras dkon mchog gsum med par 'dzin pa'i log par rtog pa'i rigs can rnams kyang chos tshul bzhin /ṭwāṃ —/pa la/ mi khoms pa dge slong legs skar lta bu rnams yin/ sgom tshul bdun pa/ sangs rgyas ma byon pa'i zhing mun pa'i bskal pa ni/ sangs rgyas snga ma'i bstan pa nub phyi ma'i bstan pa ma byung ba'i bar du skyes pa'am sangs rgyas rnams byon pa'i sgron ma'i bskal pa bzang po 'di lta bu ma yin pa'i 'di'i log tu mun bskal drug cu 'byung ba gsungs pa sogs mun pa'i 121

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ —bskal pa mang po 'byung la/ de'i dus su skyes na dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra tsam yang mi grags shing dam pa'i chos kyi snang bdadzwabral ba'i zhing stong pa yin pas mi khoms pa'i gnas yin te/ sgron ma'i bskal pa la'ang gzhan mi khoms pa yod na mun pa'i bskal par lta ci smos te/ nyin mor mig gis ṭāsprag/sa ma mthong na mtshan mo'i sgag nag tu mi mthong bzhin no/ /sgom tshul brgyad pa skugs pa ni/ spyir ngag skug pa la zer ba de yang smra shes don gob mi'i mtshan nyid ma tshang bas mi khoms pa'i gnas yin kyang / yid kyi dbang bo skugs te shin tu blun rmongs su gyur pas chos kyi go brda ci ltar sprod kyang mi 'phrod pa rnams kyang chos yang dag par bsgrub mi shes pa'am yid chad nas phyir ldog pas mi khoms pa'i gnas yin/ de dag la chos bsgrub tu khoms mi khoms legs par brtag nas dpyad 'jog spel ma bsgoms/ mi'i mi khoms pa rnams la zhag gcig /brgyad por sdom ste zhag gcig khyen dal ba la zhag gsum mo/ skugs pa ni ngag dang sems las su ma rung bas ngag yid gnyis ka mi khom pa yin/chos sgrub pa'i 'du shes med pa'i lha tshe ring po dang / 'du shes tsam yod kyang sangs rgyas kyis stong ste bstan pa'i snang ba med pas mun pa'i bskal pa la skyes pa dang / snang ba yod kyang de la 'jug pa'i blo med pas kla klo dang /'jug par tsam 'dod kyang sgro skur gyi mthar kung ba'i log lta can bzhi ni yid mi khom pa'o/ /de ltar mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad du ma skyes pa rang rgyud rten gyi chos byed pa'i dal khom yod par la dga' ba sgom zhing / slad nas 122

—da wa snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ da 'di 'dra ba'i lus rten shin tu rnyed dka' bas da res chos la ma 'bad na bdag gi mi lus don med pa'o snyam du yang nas yang du bsgom/gsum pa thun gyi rjes bsngo ba ni/ mtshan nyid pa dang rjes mabun pa gnyis las/ mtshan nyid pa ni rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid byams snying rje byang chub sems bsngo ba dang smon lam la sogs pa'i rnam par shar ba'i lta ba'izen pa de yin/ rjes mthun pa ni/ de ltar bun 'di'i nang bsgom pa'i dge ba 'dis mtshon bdag gis sngar bsags zin pa'i dge ba/ ma 'ongs pa na bsags par 'gyur ba'i dge ba/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi zag med kyi dge ba/ sems can thams cad kyi zag bcas kyi dge ba thams cad blos gcig tu bsdus shing skum te sdom nas sems can thams cad srid pa khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te rdzogs ba'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du bsngo/ de yang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyis 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i tshul du ji ltar bsngo ba de bzhin du bdag gis kyang bsngo bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i nas/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo dang / dus gsum gshegs pa'i la sogs sngo ba dang smon lam rnams brjod pas bsngo ba mtshan nyid pa'i go chod/des na chos theg chen mdo sngags gnyis kyi nyams len thams cad dam pa gsum las mi 'da' bas/ sangs rgyas go 'phang bsgrub pa la dam pa gsum las mang mi dgos/ nyung na mi 'du ba'i rang bzhin can yin te/ sbyong gzhi bden pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i bde gshegs snying po la/ sbyong byed lam tshogs gnyis kyis sbyang bya sgrib pa gnyis po sbyangs nas sbyangs 'bras sku gnyis 123

tram̐ chen mtshophuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da kyi go 'phang thob pa la dam pa gsum las gzhan mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rjes kyi rjes ni/ dpyad bshags bsngo ba dang / thun mtshams gyi 'phen pa la sogs sngar bshad pa ltar bya/ khyad par rang bsgom bya gang la thug pa de thun mtshams la'ang yang yang de ltar bsam pa bya ba gal che'o/ /gnyis pa 'byor ba la bsam pa la'ang gnyis las dang po rang 'byor lnga ni—/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ mir gyur yul dbus skyes dang dbang po tshang —/ /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad pa ste/ /rang 'byor dam pa lnga yang tshang gyur zhing / /zhes gsungs/ de ltar mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad du ma skyes pas chos yang dag par sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen brgyad po dang bral ba'i rten thob kyang / da dung chos yang dag pa sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen nam 'byor ba yang dag pa tshang dgos pas de tshang ngam mi tshang legs par brtag nas bsgom dgos/ thun gyi sbyor ba'i chos rnams sngar dang 'dra/ dngos gzhi 'byor ba la gnyis/ rang 'byor lnga'i dang po mi'i lus rten gyi 'byor ba ni de yang mi lus rin po che 'di ma thob na bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dam pa'i chos rang rgyud la thob pa'am sgrub pa'i skal ba dang mi ldan te/ ngan song gsum lta ci bzang shos lha dang lha min rnams kyang sor thar gyi sdom pa mtshan nyid pa'i snod du ma gyur pas chos yongs rdzogs sgrub pa'i skal ba dang mi ldan/ de na da res skyes pa bud med kyi dbang po dang ldan pa'i rten gun sum tshogs pa mi'i lus rten thob pa'i tshul la dga' ba yang yang bsam ste bsgom tshul sngar dang 'dra/ gnyis pa yul dbus skyes pa yul gyi 'byor ba ni/ mi lus thob kyang dam pa'i chos 124

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/mtshan nyid pa lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can la 'chad nyan bsgom sgrub med pa'i yul mthab 'khob sum cu rtsa gnyis gling gsum dang bcas pa rnams su skyes na chos dang mi mjal ba las/ da res chos tshigs kyi yul dbus bod chos ldan gyi yul gru rnams la mtshon na sngon bod kyi rgyal po lha tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de'i rgyal rabs lnga na spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i ring la dam pa'i chos kyi srol btod/ de'i rgyal rabs lnga na lha sras khri srong lde btsan gyi ring nas bzung dpon grub lo paṇa rnams kyi bka' drin las sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma ltar shar ba mdzad pas chos tshigs kyi yul dbus yin/ 'on kyang sngon gyi dus su bstan pa la 'phel 'grib ci rigs byung ba ma zad nye ba'i lo bcu phrag kha shas kyi sngon nag phyogs kla klo'i dpung gis gnod tshabs chen por byas pa'i rkyen gyis chos tshigs kyi yul dbus gshig la nye yang dus ngan gyi g.ya' yis ma gos pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu gser ril phreng ba lta bu mang pos dngos sam brgyud nas bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa slar yang dar ba'i dus skabs sprin bar gyi nyi zhu lta bu 'di dang phrad pas chos tshigs kyi yul dbus yin pas yul gyi 'byor ba/ de lta bu'i bstan pa rin po che gnas pa'i yul la skye dka' ba'i tshul la yang yang sngar ltar dga' ba bsgoms/ gsum pa dbang po yon tan gyi 'byor ba ni/ dbang po sgo lnga gang rung ma tshang na rab byung gi sdom pa'i snod du ma gyur zhing / dad pa'i rten sku gzugs la sogs mjal ba/ thos bsam gyi yul gsung rab rin po che blta ba dang / nyan pa la sogs pa'i skal pa dang mi ldan pas chos yang dag pa'i snod du mi rung na 125

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/de lta bu'i tshul rnams la yang yang bsam te tshang na dga' bar bsgoms/bzhi pa las mtha' ma log pa bsam pa'i khyad par gyi 'byor ba ni/ las mtha' log pa zhes rngon pa dang smad tshong ma dang / shan pa bya ba nya ba rku ma la sogs rigs brgyud ngan pa rnams su skyes nas/ chung ngu'i dus nas las kyi mtha' log lam du zhugs te rtag tu sdig pa mi dge bcu dang / mtshams med lnga sogs rang gis byed pa dang gzhan la byed btsug pa dam pa'i chos la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i rigs thams cad dang / 'di lta bur dang po ma skyes kyang phyis yul dus grogs sogs kyi rkyen las 'byung nye ba yin/ mdor na sgo gsum chos 'gal gyi las byed tshad las mtha' log par zhugs pa yin pa gsungs pas shin tu ma brtag na rang re chos pa rlom pa'i stong shom can rnams la tshang dka' snyam/ de la yang yang dpyad 'jog spel bsgom byed nas tshang na dga' ba bsgom ma tshang na thabs du mas tshang na ci ma rung /tshang bar gyur cig bdag gis tshang bar bya/ tshang ba zhig dkon mchog gsum mkhyen snyam du 'brel ba bzhi ldan 'di khyi dang bye brag gong 'og kun la 'gre/ lnga pa dad pa'i 'byor ba ni/ dad pa med na chos la yid mi phyogs pa las/ da res dad pa'i gnas ma nor ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtshan nyid pa lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can la rgyu mtshan shes pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa thob pa ni yang dag pa'i chos kyi sgo ma nor pa yin pas rang 'byor lnga'i gtso bo yin/ de las gzhan 'jig rten pa'i lha dang mu stegs pa'i bstan pa sogs la ji tsam dad kyang 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las skyob mi nus la/ 'di yang thos bsam la brten pa'i shes rab shin tu 126

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/bzang po zhig med na rgyu mtshan shes pa'i dad pa 'ong dka' bas tshang sla ba zhig min pas don 'di yang yang bsam dgos/ 'di lnga po ni chos yang dag par sgrub pa'i cha rkyen rang ngos la stos nas tshang dgos pas rang rgyud skal ba'i 'byor ba zhes bya/ rang 'byor la zhag gnyis sgom/gnyis pa gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ sangs rgyas byon dang chos gsung bstan pa gnas/ /gnas phyir zhugs dang gzhan gyi snying brtse ba/ /gzhan 'byor lnga ste dal 'byor bco brgyad po/ /rang la legs par tshang pa'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /snying nas brtson pas thar pa bakha par bya/ /zhes pa'i don ltar/ de yang rang 'byor lnga tshang yang da dung gzhan 'phyor lnga ma tshang na mi phan te/ dper na rang la mig yod kyang mtshan mor sgron me sogs med na gzugs mi mthong ba bzhin no/ /dang po ston pa khyad par can gyi 'byor ba ni spyir bskal pa zhes ba srid pa chags gnas 'jig stong bzhi'i yun la ming du grags/ sangs rgyas byon na sgron bskal dang / ma byon pa la mun bskal zer/ sgron ma'i bskal pa dang mun bskal gnyis res mo'i byung ba ma zad mun bskal shin tu mang bas sangs rgyas byon pa'i bskal pa dang shin tu 'phrad dka' na yang / da res sangs rgyas stong byon pa'i sgron ma'i bskal pa bzang po dang phrad/ yang sgos skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgya ba'i dus 'dir sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i sgron ma'i bskal pa dang / khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa byon pa'i bskal pa dang thug pas shin tu dga' ba yang dang yang du bsgoms/ gnyis pa bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'byor ba ni/ sangs rgyas byon kyang bstan pa 127

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/dam pa'i chos ma bstan na sangs rgyas ma byon pa dang khyad med de/ bdas cag gi ston pas rdo rje gdan byang chub shing drung du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad nas/ zhag bdun phrag bdun du chos ma gsung par lta bur yin—/ der ma zad bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyang chos sgo shin tu dam drag pa'am/ gdul bya dman pa'i rkyen gyis yang dag pa'i dam pa 'i chos ma gsungs na sems can la dngos su phan dka' ste/ jo bo smri ti tsā na sogs kyi lo rgyus lta bur yin/ des na da res sangs rgyas shākya thub pas chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor te skal pa dang 'tshams pa'i sku'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan nas theg pa rim pa dgu'i chos kyis gdul bya smin grol du mdzad pa ma zad/ rtogs pa'i rang rgyud grol/ bugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin pa'i dpal mgon bla ma dam pa rnams kyis myur lam 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam sngon 'gro dngos gzhi dang bcas par gsungs pa'i bskal pa dang 'phrad pas shin tu dga' ba yang dang yang du bsgoms/ gsum pa bstan pa gnas pa'i dus kyi 'byor ba ni/sangs rgyas byon chos gsungs kyang bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs nas bstan pa nub na mun bskal dang khyad med par las/ da res bstan pa 'di la gnas tshad lnga brgya phrag bcu ste lo lnga stong du yod pa las/ phal cher nub la nye ba'i dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus la sleb nas bstan pa shin tu nyag phra ba'i dus 'dir/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa dngos ma nub par yod pas bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'byor ba tshang ba yin pas dga' ba yang yang bsgoms/ lung rtogs kyi dam pa'i chos bshad dang sgrub pa med pa'i sa 128

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/phyogs 'ga'i dge 'dun gzugs brnyan pa rnams kyi ni dam pa'i chos 'chad nyan dang bsgom sgrub gang yang med pa ma zad cho ga'i 'don stangs tsam yang legs par mi shes pa'i bstan pa rtags tsam 'dzin pa la yul phyogs rang ngos nas dngos su bug tshar 'dug pas bstan pa nub pa dang 'dra 'dug snyam/ bzhi pa bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa rang gi skal bas 'byor ba ni/bstan pa gnas kyang rang nyid bstan pa'i sgor ma zhugs na lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rang rgyud la mi lon te/ nyi ma shar yang dmus long la mi phan pa dang / rang gis ma btung na rgya mtsho'i 'gram bldad kyang skom pa mi sel ba bzhin no/ /zhugs pa de yang chos zhus lo dang thob lo tsam gyis mi 'ong ba ma zad/ tha na yang dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum la yid ches kyi dad pa srog la babs kyang mi ldog pa zhig med na kha ton byed lo dang ser gos gyon lo dang 'chad nyan byed lo sgrub par byed lo sogs kyis bstan pa'i sgor nugs yin pa'i nges par med pas rang rgyud la zhib tu brtags dpyad byed pa gal che ba yin/ tshe 'di dang phyi mar 'khor ba'i phun tshogs kyi ched du gas smon dang 'jigs skyob kyi sgo nas zhugs na'ang lam zhugs dngos su min la/ 'o na ji ltar zhe na thar ba'i lam sne zin pa la 'khor ba mtha' dag la snying po med par shes nas thar ba'i lam du gnyer ba'i nges 'byung gi blo bcos ma ma yin pa'i sgo nas chos sgor zhugs pa'am theg chen lam sne zin pa la byang chub sems bcos min gyis zhugs na ni lam gyi sne zin bstan pa'i sgor nugs pa zhes bya gsungs/ 'di ni shin tu yang tshang dka' bas tshang mi dzing yang yang dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgoms dgos te/ nges 'byung rgyud 129

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ldan gyi gang zag yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa lhag pa'i thugs rje'i 'byor ba ni/ zhugs su zin kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ma zin na mi phan ste/bka'u rgya che/ lung grangs mang / shes bya'i mtha' la zad pa med pas bla ma'i gdams ngag la ma bsten par chos thams cad kyi sand ba5sa nas nyams su len mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /jo bo rjes/ lde snod gsum kha ton du 'chad shes shing / chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid la mkhas kyang / nyams su len pa'i dus su bla ma'i gdams ngag gi lag len med na/ chos dang gang zag ya bral du 'gro gsungs pas so/ /des na bla mas zin pa ni gal che'o/ /de yang bstan pa'i sgo zhugs mdog dang bla ma bsten mdog mang yang 'khor bar snying po med par shes nas thar ba'i don du zhugs pa dang bla ma'i brtse bas rjes su bzung nas bstan pa'i gdams ngag rnams rang gis gdams ngag thams cad gnad dril nas thugs dam rnams nyams su len shes pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma las dkon pas rang la tshang mi tshang legs par brtag nas tshang na dga' ba dang ma tshang na tshang ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos/ 'di yang dpyad 'jog bsgom dgos/ chos yang dag par sgrub pa la cha rkyen med du mi rung ba 'di rnams gzhan la stos nas tshang dgos pas gzhan rgyud skal ba'i 'byor ba lnga zhes bya 'di dag la'ang zhag gnyis/de ltar dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu ste bco brgyad po legs par tshang na ni dal 'byor bco brgyad ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che zhes nyi ma de ring nas 'bod chog de ma yin pa'i mi lus gzhan ni stong log mkhan dang snying po med pa sogs zhes bya yi chos sgrub pa'i rten min/ gsum pa rnyed pa 130

snying thig zhag brkya'i sgom rim/dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed dka' ba ni/ 'di ltar pan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ dal 'byor mi lus thob pa 'di/ /pho sgo mtho bas ma lags te/ /bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mi lus 'di ci 'dod 'dod du thob par ma yin/ sgyu tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung snyin sogs pha phyin drug gis grogs byed rkyen smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar nas thob dgos/ de yang dal ba thob pa la tshul khrims rnam dag srung dgos/ 'byor ba thob pa la sbyin sogs phar phyin drug gi dge ba mang po bsags dgos/ de yang dal 'byor thob pa'i ched du rkyen smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar dgos na/ dang po tshul khrims la phyi so sor thar ba'i sdom pa la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa nas dge slong gi gnyis brgya lnga bcu'i tshul khrims bar zhib tu bsam na yid rton rung ba dka' ba dang / nang byang chub sems pa'i bslab bya rtsa tsung bco brgyad la sogs pa/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig la rtsa ba'i tsung ba bcu bzhi sogs la bsam na grangs tsam yang bgrang ba dka' na༄khaskestse lta ci smos/ des na dal ba'i rgyu tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhig nyin mo'i skar ma las dkon/ gal te yod na'ang 'byor ba'i rgyu sbyin sogs dge ba'i chos yar dkon mchog mchod pa dang / mar ngan slong la sbyin pa ci 'dra gyin rang la brtags na de yang shin tu dkon/ gal te tshul khrims bsrungs/sbyin sogs byin yod na rkyen smon lam rnam dag gis mtshams sbyar yod med ci brtags na de'ang dkon/ gzhan yang zur gnyis tshang ba'i byang chub sems sdo sa zin pa'i tshul khrims sogs yod na ni mchog ste/ mthar thug sangs 131

tre chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/rgyas 'grub pa dang / gnas skabs lha dang mi'i rigs bzang po rnams su lus rten khyad par can shugs la 'byung ba yin te/ me bus na du ba shugs la 'byung bar bzhin no/ /de ltar zhib tu dpyad de bsam la dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom dgos/ de ltar brtags na sngon bsags bsod nams kyi mabus da lta'i lus bzang 'di thob kyang / rnyed par dka' ba'i tshul rnams la bsam te dal 'byor la snying po zhig ma lon na/ dpal sprul rin po ches 'brog pa zho 'thung sa/ rong pa rgog li za sa zhig la mi skye nges pa red ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na mi gtsang ba'i rang bzhin can gyi lus 'di la snying bo dam pa'i lha chos dge ba zhig gis lon thub na tshe stod bas tshe smad sogs kyid nas skyid bde nas bde bar 'gro ba yin/ snying po ma lon na sdig pa 'ba' zhig sgrub nas tshe stod bas tshe mad sogs sdug nas sdug gi gnas su 'gro bas snying po yang dag zhig e lon blta dgos/ snying po len tshul la skyes bu gsum gyi lam nas lon lugs du ma yod kyang / khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i myur lam dang 'phrad dus 'dir sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i lam yang dag par la brten na lo dang zla bas 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i go 'phang thob pas de'i lam nas snying po zhig len na ci ma rung snyam du 'dun pa/ lon par gyur cig snyam du smon lam/ lon pa zhig bdag gis bya snyam dam bca'/ lon nus par dkon mchog gsum mkhyen snyam du gsol 'debs te 'grel ba bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas yang dang yang du thun dang thun mashāms zus te dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgoms dgos so/ /rgyu 'di la zhag gtwesdu /

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/bzhi pa dpe grangs kyi sgo nas lhad dka' ba ni/ rgyu'i sgo nas de ltar dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di lhad dka' ba bstan pa ma zad/ dpe dang grangs la bsam kyang rnyed dka' ste/ dang po rlabs chen pos rnam par daspugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i steng gi gnya' shing gi bu ga dang / zhabs kyi rus sbal gyi mgrin pa 'azad pa las kyang mi lus thob dka' bar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ me tog gi snam las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'jig rten du 'byung ba'ang dka'/ mir gyur pa dang dal ba gun sum tshogs pa'ang shin tu rnyed par dka'o/ /de'i dbe zhig bstan par bya ste/ shā ri'i bu/ dper na sa chen po 'di rgya mtsho gcig tu gyur te/ de'irang na gnya' shing bu ga gcig pa zhig pod la/ rul sbal zhar ba zhig kyang yodade/rgya mtsho chen po glel rlung yas ldang ba dang mas ldang ba zhes bya ba ldang/ /rus sbal zhar ba de yang lo brgya brgya zhig lan cig phyir 'byung ba rab tu myur ba'i gnya' shing gi bu ga gcig pa der rus sbal zhar ba lo brgya brgya zhing phyir 'jing ba'i mgul ba chud pa smra yi/ log par rtsang ba las phyir yang phyir 'gyurab3 de ltar ma yin te/ de ltar log par snang ba rnams kyis mir mgur ba rab tu dka' ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang brtsig dzos kyi zhal ba 'jam po'i ngosasran ma chags pa las mi lus chos ldan thob dka' bar gsungs te/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ zhal zhal mog la sran ma chags srid kyi/ /mir gyur na yang yul dbus skyes pa dkon/ /ci dang / de bzhin du khab rtse gyen du bstan pa la sran ma chags bka' ba dang khab mig tu ras yug mi tshud pa dang / u dum wa ra 'jig rten du 133

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs 'byung dka' ba dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rnyed par dka' ba rnams las kyang dal 'byor gyi mi lus chos ldan shin tu rnyed par dka' 'o/ /dpes mtshon pa'i don ni/ gting mtha' mi mngon pa'i ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong ba'i 'gro ba rnams rgya mtsho lta bu dang de dag blang dor la blongs pas rus sbal long ba lta bu rnams de las thar dka' bas lo brgya re las steng du mi 'bud pa/ lha mi'i lus rten rgya chung zhing nyung bas bu ga gcig pa lta bu/de yang dge ba'i rkyen la ltos dgos pas rlung gis ded pa lta bu'i dpe rnams kyis don mtshon te dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom/ gnyis pa grangs kyi khyad par bsam pa ni/ dal 'byor thob pa de tsam du ci dka' yul rnams su me mang du mthong ngo snyam na de ni rtogs dasbyod zhib mos legs par ma brtags pa'i gtam ste/ spyir beems can lus thob pa las ma thob pa'i bar do'i sems can mang ste sha rul sogs la nub re'i ji snyed kyi 'bus khengs par sogs kyis mtshon nus/ lus thob pa'i nang nas ngan 'gro mang bde 'gro nyung de las mi nyung de las chos ldan gyi dal 'byor dkon te/ ngag 'don las/ sems can tsarma gyi grangs dang rim pa la/ /bsam na mi lus thob pa srid mtha' tsam/ /zhes pa ltar/ dmyal ba ni shin tu mang ba mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam la/ de las yi dwags nyung bas nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ de ltar 'gre ste yi dwags dang dud 'gro/ dud 'gro dang bde 'gro'i mang nyung dpe'i sgo nas gsungs/ gzhan yang dmyal ba ni sa chen po'i rdul tsam/ zhes pa nas lha dang mi ni sen mo'i steng gi rdul tsam las med par gsungs pas mi lus thob dka' la/ ngan song gsum las nyung shos dud 'gro gsungs kyang /134

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/byings gnas rgya mtsho chen po la mchis pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ kha 'thor ba sa gzhi ri klung bar snang thams cad khengs pa yod de/ dbyar dus sa gzhi mthu ba tsam dang / grogs tshang gcig dang chu 'khyil gcig gi srog chags gnas pa 'dzam gling mi la med pa lta bu mang ba dang / lha mi'i 'gro ba ni de la ltos natsād mtha' tsam du nyung ba dang / lha las kyang mi'i 'gro ba nyung / mi'i 'gro ba gling gzhan rnams las 'dzam bu gling gi mi nyung / gling 'di'i mi la bsam na rgya dkar nag mon lho bal/ rdo sog rigs la sogs pa'i yul dang snang 'dus re re na 'tshogs pa'i mi rnams kyis sdig pa'i las sna tshogs byed pa'i mi ni ches mang la/ de rnams las chos tshigs kyi yul dbus su skyes pa ni nyin mo'i ska ra ma tsam dkon/ yul dbus tsam skyes kyang dus ngan snyigs mir yul dus gang zag spyi srol ngan pa'i skyon gyis sdig pa'i las thabs sna tshogs nyin re bas nyin re je dar lo re bas lo re ji rgyas 'gro bzhin pas dge ba byed par ni shin tu dkon/ gal te dge ba byed pa rlom pa tsam yod na'ang ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge sbyong ni shin tu dkon/ ngur ga gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba po khas 'che ba tsam mang du yod na yang phyi'i spyod pa ra min lug min rgya min bod min skya min ser min gyi gos chas spras nas thos bsam bsgom pa'i yon tan la blo kha tsam yang mi phyogs khar tshong so nam dgra 'dul gnyen skyong shwa rgyan 'chal g.yeng la sogs pa'i ngan spyod dang dkor kha grong chog rnyed tshol 'bul sdud zhal rtse dpang po sogs tshe 'di'i rdon kho na la spyod nas mi tshe stong par zad pa ni mang ba mngon sum pa'o/ /byung zad tsam thos bsam sgom pa la blo phyogs par yod na'ang phal cher tshe 135

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/'di ba tsam gyi don kho na la zhen nas chags sdang dgag sgrub phyi tshes re dogs la sogs pas don med byed par mang la/ de rnams la ni dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che zhes mi bya ste/ mi yi gru la brten nas sdug bsngal gyi chu bo 'khor ba las bsgral dgos na de dag gis ni khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal chen po'i chu bo las rang gzhan sgrol mi nus pa'i phyir te/ bsam sbyor gnyis ka med la/ des na rang bstan pa'i rjes su zhugs pa'i gang zag nges 'byung gi blo'am byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa zhig gam/ tha na'ang mchog gsum la yid ches pa'i dad pa srog la babs kyang mi ldog pa zhig med na dal 'asnyor bco brgyad po tshang ba ma yin par gsungs pas tshang ba ni srid mtha' ma bkag tsam mam nyin mo'i skar ma las dkon ba.āoṃde lta bu tshang mi tshang brtag te dpyad 'jog bsgom/ tshang 'dug na dga' ba bsgom ste da res 'di lta bu'i shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor rnyed pa 'di yid bzhin gyi rnar bu rin po che rnyed pa las kyang brgya stong gi do zla med kyang sngar mdo med du lo de tsam zhig thal da ni 'di chud zos su ma song ba yang dag pa'i dam pa'i chos spyi dang khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len la tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa zhig mi med dbeen pa'i ri la ma nus na nga re ngan/srog la babs kyang de ltar sgrub dgos snyam pa'i dam bca' dang zhe mna' drag tu bskyal dgos te rang re rnams tshe 'di'i bya byed thams cad zin dus ni med cing don 'bras chung / 'chi dus phan nges lha chos kho na yin pas tshe 'di'i bya ba gzhan lta ci slob khrid 'khor 'dab gnyen 'dun sogs gang la'ang mi chags par dben par 'gro dgos/ ma tshang na tshang ba'i thabs la 136

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/sgo kun nas 'bad dgos te/ nga re ngan nga chos sgor zhugs mdog byas nas lo grangs de tsam song / bla ma sangs rgyas dngos las lhag par de tsam dang mjal/ chos theg pa rim dgu'i zab chos dbang lung khrid gsum/ man ngag rgyab rten dang bcas pa de tsam thob kyang rang skal ba dman pa mar skog gyong po ltar yin pas sa lam gyi yon tan rgya cher lta ci dal 'byor bco brgyad kyang tshang mi 'dug da dung de bzhin lus na 'chi khar chos med blo 'gyod dang bcas phyi mar 'gro nges pas da thabs shes ci drag gis tshang ba zhig bya dgos snyam du dus dang rnam pa kun tu bsams/ dpe grangs la zhag gcig bsgom/lnga pa 'phral byung rkyen gyi mi khoms pa brgyad ni/ gong du bshad pa'i dal 'byor bco brgyad po gal te tshang na'ang 'phral byung rkyen gyi mi khom pa brgyad po dang ma bral na dper na lug bco brgyad yod na spyang ki byung te gcig bsad na bcu bdun las med/ gnyis bsad na bcu drug las med pa lta bu 'phral byung rnams de ring med na sang nyin 'byung nye/ thun mgor med kyang thun 'jug tu 'byung nye ba sogs yin pas rang rgyud la zhib tu brtags nas so sor gnyen po bsten dgos/ de yang yid bzhin mdzod las—/ /dug lnga 'khrugs dang blun rmongs bdud kyis zin/ /le lo can dang las ngan mtsho chen rdol/ /gzhan dbang 'jigs skyob chos ltar bcos pa ste/ /'phral byung rkyen gyi mi khoms rnam pa brgyad/ /ces pa'i don/ dang po dug lnga 'khrugs pa'i 'phral byung ni/ dgra gnyen la chags ldang la sogs dug lnga'i nyon mongs shin tu rags pa rnams ni/ res 'ga' chos sgrub 'dod tsam skyes kyang dug lnga dbang btsan pas phal cher de'i dbang du song nas chos mi 137

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/'grub la/ de dag gi mnyen po 'dod chags la mi sdug pa/ zhe sdang la byams pa/ gti mug la khams kyi rab dbye rnams bsgoms/ nga rgyal gyi gnyen po dman sar bzung nas phyag 'tshal ba/ phrag dog gi gnyen por rjes su yi rangs rnams bsgom/ gnyis pa blun smongs ni/ shin tu blun pa'i rigs can rnams ni/ chos sgor zhugs kyang chos kyi tshig don phran bu yang shes mi nus pas thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa'i skal ba med/ de ni chos spong sogs sngon gyi sdig sgrib che bas lan pa yin la/ de'i gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa dang / shes rab bskyed pa'i lha mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgom bzlas bya/ gsum pa bdud kyi bshes gnyen gyis zin pa ni/ lta spyod log par ston pa'i bdud kyi bshes gnyen gyis zin na blo log lagodu bsgyur bas yang dag chos dang rgyab 'gal la/ de'i mnyen po dge batshibashes gnyen yang dag yin min thog mar brtag brtag tshul mang yang thugs rgyud la byang chub sems yod med brtag dgos/ med na de dang 'grogs pa spongs nas bud 'gro dgos/ bzhi pa le lo can/ chos la slob 'dod yod kyang brtson 'grus cung zad med pa'i le lo can ni/ le lo dang phyi bshol gyi dbang du song ste chos mi 'grub/ de'i mnyen po mchog tu gyur ba 'chi ba mi rtag pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i don snying nas dran cing gus rtag sbyor ba'i brtson 'aspus rtsom dgos/ lnga pa las ngan mtsho chen rdol ba ni/ dang po bla ma mjal/ bar du thos bsam byed pa/ tha ma bsgom pa'i dus su brtson 'grus byas kyang sdig sgrib che bas rang rgyud la yon tan mi skye ba dang / na tsha sogs bar chad kyi rkyen las ngan gyi mtsho chen rdol ba byung na rang byas kyi las 138

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/'bras mi shes par chos la yi chad skye ste/ nga la yon tan mi 'byung nges par red snyam pa dang / nga la 'di lta bu 'ong ma babs snyam du sems skye/ de'i mnyen po chos la yi chad mi skye bar dka' spyad dang / las 'bras bslu med la yid ches bskyed nas rang gi sngon gyi las ngan la 'gyod bshags byed dgos/ drug pa gzhan 'khor bran g.yog ni/ rang la rang dbang med par gzhan gyi bran g.yog tu gyur pa rnams ni chos byed 'dod yod kyang gzhan dbang du song nas bsgrub tu mi bcug de'i gnyen po de las thar pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos/ bdun pa 'jigs skyob ni/ tshe 'di'i lto gos sam gnod pa gzhan gyis 'jigs nas de'i ched du chos la zhugs kyang zhe thag pa nas chos la nges shes med pas sngon gyi bag chags rnying pas chos ma yin pa la spyod/ de'i mnyen po nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag pa zhig gis zin pa byed dgos/ brgyad pa chos ltar bcos pa ni/chos su bcos nas yo byad dang rnyed bkur dang / snyan grags sgrub pa'i gzugs brnyan pa rnams kyi ni dam pa'i chos gzhan snang du chos pa ltar bcos kyang rang blor tshe 'di kho na don du gnyer bas thar pa'i lam dang bral ba la/ gnyen po 'jig rten tshe 'di sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor gyi nyes dmigs shes nas spang dgos/ 'di rnams tshang mi tshang brtag tshang na dga' bar bsgom ma tshang na tshang thabs 'bad/ bsgom tshul 'dra 'phral byung zhag gcigadrug pa ris chad blo yi mi khom pa brgyad ni/ rigs chad ni 'di brgyad po gang byung na thar ba byang chub gsum gyi rigs dang bral bas na rigs chad rdang / rang rgyud dang thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gnyis so sor bral 139

tram̐ chen mtshosuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ ——bas na ris chad ces bya/ de yang yid bzhin mdzod las/ 'ching ba dam ldan kun spyod shin tu ngan/ /'khor bar mi skyo dad pa cung zad med/ /mi dge sdig spyod chos la sems pa bral/ /sdom dang dam tshig ral ba zhes bya ba/ /ris chad blo yi mi khom rnam pa brgyad/ /ces pa'i don/ dang po 'ching ba dam ldan nam 'dod sred zhags pas bcings pa ni/ tshe 'di'i nor rdzas longs spyod bu nor gnyen 'dun dgon gzhi'i thabs bkod la sogs pa'i 'ching ba dam pos bcings pas de dag gi don du 'bad pa'i rtsol sgrub kyis g.yengs pas chos gyed long med/ 'di'i mnyen po mi rtag mtha' bzhi'i bsdus pa'i nyes dmigs dran pas chags zhen gyi 'khri ba gcod dgos/gnyis pa kun spyod ngan pa ni/ rang gshis ngan pas mi gzhi til 'bru tsam med cing kun spyod shin tu ngan pa phal ni yang dag pa'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad kyang dam pa'i lam du bsgyur mi bub pas gnyen po med gsungs/'on kyang sgo gsum zhi dul la brten nas rang sems chos kyis 'dul dgos/gsum pa 'khor bar mi skyo ba'am skyo shas chung ba ni/ ngan song dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad dam tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal ji lta bu la'ang sgrag pa'i blo gtan nas mi skye na chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu nges 'byung gi blo rtsa ba nas mi skye/gnyen po srid pa'i nyes dmigs shes nas nges 'byung gi blo skyed dgos/bzhi pa dad med ni/ yang dag pa'i chos dang bla cha/ la dad pa med na bstan pa'i 'jug sgo 'gags te thar pa'i lam du mi tshud pas/ gnyen po chos dang bla ma'i yon tan la bsam te phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa 'chang dgos/ lnga pa mi dge sdig spyod kyi ris chad ni/ mi dge sdig spyod la dga' bas sgo gsum nye140

snyingazigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ da da —bar ma zhi ba ni dam pa'i yon tan dang bral te chos las phyir phyogs/ gnyen po rgyu 'bras la yid ches nas dge sdig gi 'bras bu bde sdug la bsam te sgo gsum dge bar 'bad sngar byas la bshags sdom byed/ drug pa chos sems bral ba ni/ yon tan dge ba dang chos kyi snang ba med pa khyi'i mdun rtswa bzhag pa ltar gyur na chos la spro ba med pas rang rgyud la yon tan mi skye/gnyen po chos dang 'phrad dka' ba'i tshul shes nas chos la don gnyer byed nas sgo gsum chos 'gal gyi las spong dgos/ bdun pa sdom pa nyams pa ni/bun mong theg pa la zhugs nas sems bskyed dang sdom pa ral na ngan song las 'gro sa thed pas mi khoms pa'i gnas las mi thar/ gnyen po lhang ba 'byung ba'i rgyu bzhi yang dag shes pa byas nas/ rtsa bzhi las gcig nyams kyang gzhan gsum bsrung dgos/ dang po sdom pa blang nas ma nyams na ma ga gal te nyams na'ang chos bzhin bshags pa byed na bstan pa'i rgyal ma bsgreng / bdud kyi rgyal mtshan snyil pa po gnyis 7/ 'dra bas ji mi snyam du mi bzhag par snying thag pa nas bshags bsdams dang / tshul ldan gzhan 'ang yi rang gul na rang tshul ldan du 'gyur ba yin/ khyad par tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i thabs sam gnyen po ma nor pa byang chub sems yin zhes jo bo rjes gsungs/ byang sems kyi smon 'jug gnyis nyams na thun gyi drug cha las ma 'das gong bshags na rtsa nyung mi 'gyur bas bshags dgos/brgyad pa dam tshig ral ba ni/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa la zhugs nas bla ma mched grogs la dam tshig nyams na rang gzhan phu nga la sbyor bas dngos grub gyi skal pa chad pa yin/ sngags sdom nyams na byang sems bzhin gnyen pos 141

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/sleb dgos/ sngags sdom thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig tu 'du bas—/ sku'i dam tshig bla ma mched lcam gyi sku mi brnyas/ gsung gi dam tshig de dag gi gsung mi bcag yi dam lha'i bzlas brjod la 'bad/ thugs kyi dam tshig gsang ba bcu po bsrung ba dang bla ma mched lcam thugs mi dkrug par 'du ba yin/ mi khom pa'i gnas 'di dag rnams dang bral nas dal ba'i chos rnams rang la tshang mi tshang yang yang dpyad de bsgom tshul sngar dang 'dra rshatrī / /da/ 'gyur ba thon pa'i bar du cis kyang 'bad dgos ris chad zhag de lta bu'i mi khoms gnas 'di dag la legs par ma brtags na deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ chos byed kyi gzugs brnyan pa/ gzhan lta ci gdugs zhabs kyi sprul sku/ rta thog gi bla ma/ chos grwa'i mkhan po/ ri khrod kyi chos pa/ sgrub sde'i sgom chen/ bshad grwa'i mkhas pa/ rgyal khams kyi bya btang la sogs bzang por zlos pa thams cad kyang mi khom pa'i rgyu 'di dag gi dbang du song nas chos yang dag pa'i lam du mi 'gro bar mi lus stong zad du byed pa mang bas/ gong du bshad pa'i dal 'byor gyi chos sum cu rtsa bzhi po 'di dag tshang ngam mi tshang legs par brtag tshang na dga' ba bsgom shing da res yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyis mtshon du med pa'i mi lus rin chen 'di chud zos su ma shor ba chos yang dag zhig sgrub nas dal 'byor snying po lon pa zhig bya snyam du snying thag pa nas bsam dgos te/ klong chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyis/ rigs kyi bu nyon cig mi lus lan cig thob pa 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag go /dam 142

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/pa'i chos dang mjal ba ni bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin no/ /zhes pa nas bal bod rgya mtshams kyi gnas chen dang gnas phran byen rlabs can thams cad du rig pa gtad med skyid sdug ro snyoms na dga' shi skyid/re dogs cham brdal gyi ngang nas bya rgod snyi las shor ba bzhin dengs shigaces gsungs pa ltar 'o skol rnams kyis mi tshe lhag ma chos kyis mthar phyin pa byed na dga' nges pas dus dang rnam pa kun tu dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom ste ma tshang na tshang thabs la bsgrims dgos te dper na lha sar 'gro bzhin pa'i tshe yang 'gro 'dod dor mi nyan pa bzhin yin/ 'di rnams las gcig ma tshang na'ang chos rnal ma sgrub pa'i skal ba med pa yin/ des na gru yod dus chu las bsgal ma thub na phyin chad thabs med pa ltar lus rten zang so thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bde myur gyis bgrod pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms dus ma 'bad na phyi nas 'di 'dra rnyed pa lta ci 'og nas 'og tu 'gro ba las med pas stor ba soms bskyed/ dngos gzhi dmigs med/ rjes bsngo ba dang bcas pas dben par dal 'byor gyi chos 'di rnams bsgom pa 'tshal lo skal bzang kun/ de yan gyis dal 'byor rnyed dka' song /gnyis pa tshe mi rtag pa la bdun las/ dang po phyi snod 'jig rten la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ sbyor ba'i chos rnams 'dra/ thun gyi dngos gzhi la/ bskal pa bzang po'i 'jig rten 'di'i sngon du 'jig rten sa gan gcig zhig nas stong pa'i bar bskal nyi shu rdzogs rjes 'di chags pa'i go rtsom pa yin/ de yang snod mas nas yar chags te sems can khyi ༵ṭwāṃn

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dbai tshogs/gyi bsod nams kyis 'og gzhi yid mkha' rnam dag gi nam mkha' mthing gar mthing gsal mu khyud chos 'byung gi dbyibs can chags/ de'i steng rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang nag rgya gram gyi rnam pa can dang / de'i steng sprin gser gyi snying po can las char babs pas chu dkyil dkar gsal skum po'i rnam pa/de'i steng ri rab gling bzhi gser ri 'khor yug lcags ri dang bcas pa chags/ bcud kyi sems can yas nas mar chags te/ srid rtse nas bzung ste dmyal ba'i bar du rnam rtog je rags je rags su song ste mar rim gyis chad nas dmyal ba'i sems can gcig skye ba'i bar la bar bskal nyi shu la chags dgos/ de nas gnas pa'i mgo brtsams te skye sgye rnams tshe lo dpag med nas bcu ba'i bar du 'grib pa ya thog ring mo/ de nas brgyad khrir yar 'phel/ bcu'i bar mar 'grib pa la bar khug gcig de 'dra bco brgyad rdzogs nas/ yang tshe lo dpag med bar du 'phel mar brgyad khrir 'grib pa la ma thog thung ngu ste bar bskal nyi shur gnas pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa'i rwa ba sra zhing 'thas pa bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa 'di dag kyang mthar mi rtag ste de nas brgyad khri nas 'jig pa'i mgo brtsams te zhing 'di'i dmyal ba na sems can gsar skye gcig mi skye bar dmyal ba gzhan du skye/ skyes zin las srab pa gnas gong mar gle rdo rje gdan du las ngan tshab chen bsags pa chos spongs mtshams med byas pa rdo rje slob dpon dang 'gal ba 'ga' zhig ma gtogs dmyal gnas stong par gyur/ de nas yi dwags dud 'gro rnams de bzhin stong / de nas mi rnams bsam gtan gnyis pa'i thems thob nas bsam gtan gnyis pa 'od gsal 144

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/gyi gnas su skyes/ 'dod lha drug po yang de bzhin bsam gtan gnyis par skyes/ bsam gtan dang po yang gnyis par 8sa nas/ bsam gtan dang po nas dmyal ba'i mazil gnyis kyi bar na sems can kha nas rlung rgyu ba gcig kyang med par 'gyur la/ desar char mi 'bab ji shing nags tshal nas ri gling rgya mtsho dang bcas ba thams cad med par byed pa yin te/ rim pas mkha' la ) ma bdun 'char par 'gyur pas/ gcig gis ji shing nags tshal thams cad bsregs/ gnyis pas chu klung ldeng ka ma lus bskams/gsum pas chu klung chen po thams cad bskams/ bzhi pas mtsho chen ma dros pa'ang bskams/ lnga pas mtha' yas rgya mtsho ma lus bskams/ drug pas sa chen gangs ri bcas pa bsregs/ bdun pas ri gling 'khor yug bcas pa bgregs nas me rtse gcig tu gyur pas rlung gis thur du ded nas ngan song gi gnas stong pa rnams bsregs nas/ du sa mtha'i me de dmyal pa'i me dang 'azad pa na dang po dmyal mes dus mtha'i me gyen du bsregs/ las stobs shugs btsan pas dus mes dmyal me thur du bsregs nas dmyal gnas gong ma rnams bsregs/ mnar med bsregs pa dang lhan du de'i sems can lhag marams ga 'byed 'dzum tsam la zhing gzhan gyi mnar med du skyes/ de rna 'tshe rtse gyen du log pas tshangs pa'e gzhal yas stong pa rnams kyang ge gis te de man chad stong ste thal phung gcig tu gyur pa la de ltar me yis lta zhi dun zhig pa'i rjes bsam gtan gnyis pa'i lha rnams gsum par 'a sa pas/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gnas nas sprin chu'i snying po can gas pa las char gyi rgyun gnya' shing tsam/ bshol mda' tsam ma nga po bab 145

tre chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/pas 'od gsal gyi lha gnas thal phung dang bcas pa lan tshwa chur thim pa ltar 'jigade ltar chus 'jig pa bdun rdzogs nas/ bsam gtan gsum pa rnams bzhi pa'i sems thob nas 'phos pa la/ 'og gzhi rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyen du 'u ru ru langs te bsam gtan gsum pa'i lha gnas man chad thal ba rlung gis gtor ba ltar 'jig nas nam mkha' stong pa gcig tu gyur pa'i bar du bar bskal nyi shu la 'jig pa'i bskal pa'o/ /stopa pa gcig tu gyur pa'i yun bar bskal nyi shu ste/ bskal pa chags gnas 'jig stong bzhi po'i yun la bar bskal brgyad cu tham par la bskal pa chen po gcig ces btags / de ltar gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa bye ba phrag brgya stong gsum 'jig rten gcig gi nang du chud pa thams cad mnyam du zhig nas mthar thams cad kyang nam mkha' gcig tu gyur te stong skabs yod na/rang re mi lus shi kha'i sprang ma lta bu 'di la rtag brtan ci yod snyam du mi rtag pa yid 'khul nus pa zhig yang yang dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom/ thun gyi rjes sngar dang 'dra/ 'di la zhag gcig/gnyis pa nang bcud sems can la bsam te mi rtag pa bsgoms pa ni/de ltar phyi snod 'jig rten mi rtag pa ltar nang rang lus snod/ rnam shes ni bcud kyi sems can lta bu/ dang po nye len gyi rnam shes ma'i mngal du zhugs nas skyes pa'i bar chags pa/ byis pa nas na ba'i bar gnas pa/ 'chi nad theb nas 'chi ba'i bar 'jig pa/ 'jig tshul yang dkar lam chu 'jig dmar lam the 'jig nag lam rlung 'jig brgyal ba stong pa'i skabs te chags gnas 'jig stong bzhis mi rtag pa yin/ khyir sems can srid rtse nas 146

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/mnar med bar yod do cog thams cad 'chi ba'i gnas las thar pa gcig kyang med de skye ba yod na 'chi ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ des na skyes nas ma shirishag thong zos dogs gsum med par grub pas so/ /bye brag 'dzam bu mi ba'i tshe la nges pa med pa ma zad da ni dus ngan tshe thung gnod mang gi mtha' matsā sa pas myur du 'chi nges/ skyes nas bzung tshe la bsnon pa thed par bri ba dang bcas pa/ bshas lug gsod sar khrid pa bzhin myur du zad/ 'chi bdag bdud po ni nub ka'i grib so bzhin tshur tshur 'ong bas nam 'chi dang 'dir 'chi nges pa ni med/ sang tsam mam do nub tsam mam da dbugs 'byin 'jug byed pa'i bar mi 'chi ba'i nges pa ni su la'ang med/chub mo nyal nas nangs mo yar longs rgyu med par 'chi ba sogs du ma mthong tho ngon sum gyur kyang/ da lta rang re rnams nam zhig 'chi dgos lhasaya tsamakhas / nam 'chi nges med myur du 'chi nges pa'i 'du shes rgyud la ma skyes sa/ rtag 'dzin phyi tshes re dogs kho na la g.yengs/ tshe 'di'i bu nor lto ngas sbyod zas gos gnas mal dgon gzhi thabs bkod sogs bde skyid lha nasum sgrub pa'i bya rtsol 'ba' zhig la zhen pa'i skabs 'dir/ 'chi 4 bur du 'ong nas drung du slebs tsa na/ thabs gang gis kyang bzlog sdo tshed par 'chi bdag gshin rjes zhags nag ske la bzhag dus/ las ngan 2 sa ma 'grub pa rang cag gdong sngo ham me/ mig mchi ma skya tsa re/ skad cho na sna tshogs dang / mgo rkang lag lngas yob yob byed bzhin/ tshe phyi ma'i sdomawo cher ya nga ba'i gnas su khrid 'gro ba ma gartogs/ dpa' bos bkye sa/ ba ri sos bsgo sa/ rgyu zas kyis bslu sa/ bros sa dang gab sa/ skyabs dang 147
