4 chen mtsho pu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/skyob pa/ mgon dang dpung gnyen/ thabs dang thugs rje gang yang med de/lcags kyi sgam chung srub med pa zhig tu bcug nas dpa' bo rnon po'i mtshon thog 'bum phrag mang pos bskor nas bsdad kyang bsrung rgyu dang gab rgyu spu rtse tsam yang med/ de ma zad sman pa'i rgyal po dngos su byon kyang tshe zad pa'i 'chi ba bzlog mi nus pas/ dus da lta nyid du le lo dang phyi bshol gyi dbang du mi 'gro bar 'chi khar phan nges kyi dam pa'i chos yang dag pa zhig sgrub dgos snyam pa'i ngang nas mi rtag pa'i tshul rnams la yang dang yang du blo sbyongs/ 'di la zhag gsum/gsum pa dam pa'i skyes bu la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ sems bskyed dang ldan pas 'di ltar bsam pa bya ste/ sgron ma'i bskal pa bzang po 'di la spyir sngon du sangs rgyas rab bdun 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas theg pa gsum gyi chos kyis soms can dpag med bde la bkod kyang da ni thams cad sku mya ngan las 'das pa ma zad bstan pa thams cad kyang rim gyis nub nas da lta shākya seng ge'i bstan pa'i lhag zhabs tsam ma gtogs med/ bye brag da lta'i bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas nyan thos 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu byon pa thams cad kyang ming gi lhag mar gyur/ de las gzhan yang 'phags pa'i yul du bka'i bsdu ba mdzad pa'i dgra bcom lnga brgya/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ grub thob brgyad cu sogs sa lam gyi yon tan la dbang 'byor ba/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa du ma byon kyang / da ni de lta bu byon no zhes pa'i lo rgyus tsam las med/yatwe4 /sa bod 'dir yang rmo rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i chos 'khor bskor

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/skabs su rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ yer ba'i spub chen brgyad cu la sogs byon/phyis su yang mar mi dwags gsum/ gong ma rnam lnga/ jo brom yab sras/ rje yabawag dam pa rgyagarakongagacig lab sgron sogs sa dge bka' brgyud sogabhāmi chen bgrang la 'das palhan pa dang / khyad par gying ma'i so zur gnubashasum/ khyud glingamongawas/ rong klong rnam gnyis 'jigs med gling pa mi pam rnam rgyal/ dbal dgorgyal po la sogs pa nas rigs bdag mtshungs med bla ma dam pa sku zhi ba gshegs na rnams kyi bar mkhas shing gub pa balhas pa'i skyes bu mes mi mig chus mi khyer sas mi non g.yang la mi nga 'byung bzhi'i garnad pa bral ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa thams cad byang ma ra mi rtag pa'i tshul mdzad de sku gshegs pa dang bstan pa dar nub ci gas byung nas mtshan gyi lhag ma tsam las mi bzhugs na/ rang re las ngagagyi sbyas/ rkyen ngan gyi rlung gis ded/ bag chags ngan pas mtshams sbyar 'byung ba'i gung po la sems kyi rgyud bsten pa tho yor lta bu 'di dang 'khorarin skya min sger min 'di snang kho na la zhen pa'i g.yag rgod khyu tshogs lta༄ 'gi rnams la nam 'jig dang 'dir 'jig nam 'bral dang 'di 'bral gyi nges par med nges snyam du yang yang bsgom nas dge ba la da nas brtson pa sha bca'/ 'di la zhag gcig / she bzhi pa skye dgu'i bdag po la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ 'di lha ga'i dbang po brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / dbang rgyug khyab 'jug 'khospong chen po rgyas pa dang / grog mkhar ba la sogs pa gzugs bzang ba/rna bajid che ba/ tshe bskal par bub pa/ rig pa'i yon tan che ba/ spyan 149

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/dang mngon shes mnga' ba/ rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa dag kyang 'chi ba'i gnas las ma thar te shi ba'i gnas skabs yod pa dang / bye brag mi yul 'dir stobs 'byor mngon par mtho ba'i gser gyi 'khor lo sogs kyis dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyal po mang po dang / khyad par rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po nas bzung rgyal po shar nub gyi stobs 'byor rgyas pa du ma byung ba dang / yang sgos bod gangs can gyi smongs 'dir rje gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung mang po byon pa ma zad kun las khyad par du 'phags pa chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi sku ring la chos srid gnyis ldan gyi mnga' dbang srid na mtho bar yod pa sogs kyang / da lta de lta bu byung ba'i gtam tsam ma gtogs med pa dang / gzhan yang sde dge'i chos rgyal rin byon dang rgya bod hor 'jang sogs kyi sa skyong mnga' dbang btsan po ji snyed byung ba phal cher ming gi lhag ma tsam gyur ba'i skabs la bsams na/rang re'i gnas khang longs spyod 'khor 'bangs mnga' thang sbrang ma'i tshang tsam 'di dang bdag cag lta bu'i lus 'di la rtag brtan dang snying po ci yod de bas da lta dam pa'i chos sgrub snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis thun du byas nas bsgom/ 'di'ang zhag gcig /lnga pa dpe don sna tshogs la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ 'di ltar spyir bskal pa'i 'phel 'grib la bsams kyang mi rtag ste/ bskal pa dang po'i mi thams cad rang lus 'od kyis snang bas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkhar 'gro/ bdud rtsi'i zas za ba sogs lha dang mnyam pa'i bde skyid yod spyang / rim gyis nub ste 'di lta bur gyur/ da dung tshe bsod mar mar bri ste 150

da snyingazigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/tshe lo bcu ba'i bar je ngan je sdug 'gro/ de'i dus nad mtshon mu gsum gyis phal ra shide dag rgyu ni las nyon sdig pa byas pas byung / lus pa rnams gcod spang ba sogs byas pa rim gyi yar 'phel/ yang mar 'grib/desung khug pa bco brgyad rdzogs nas yar 'phel dpag med bar 'gro/mthar bskal pa 'jig tshul gong du bshad pa ltar mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin yin/ bye brag dbyar dgun ston dpyid kyi 'gyur ldog dang / da lo dang song dzod khar sang dang de ring / da nangs dang do dgong / da lta'i chu tshod kyi nir cha sogs thams cad 'gyur nas rim pa mi rtag pa'i tshul la dpag kyang mad brtan med de tshe lo yis zad/ lo zla bas zad/ zla ba zhag gis zad/zhagaskrus tshod kyis zad/ dus tshod skar chas zad de 'gro bas sna phug gi dbugs rta rnga tsam 'di chad pa la chu bur bas sla bas snying po med/ khyad par rang re gnas pa'i yul phyogs/ grong dang dgon sde sngon dar ba rnams ltams/ sngon rgud ba rnams dar ba dang / sngon dbul po dang nyam chung sogs ras 1ba drag stobs 'byor 'phel/ rang khyim gcig pa'i pha ma yang mes sogs kyang shi /spun sring du ma yang ming gi lhag mar gyur/ lo snga ma dang da / da lta dang song phod sogs su yul la bltas na 'gyur ldog sna tshogs pas /brtag rang gi sgo phyugs ra lug rta khyi bya phag sogs la brtag na shes/ lo ra 'i gong gi mi thams cad shi nas gcig kyang med/ da lta sa steng gi mi sha la cad lo brgya song dus gcig kyang mi lus/ mdor na skyes tshad 'chi ba dang / bsags tshad 'dzad/ 'dus tshad bral/ brtsigs tshad 'gyel mtho tshad kung ba'i rang bzhin las ma 'das/ de bzhin du dgra gnyen gyid sdug 151

tre chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/bzang ngan rnam rtog sogs la zhib tu daphyad na thams cad kyang mi rtag de ltar dpe don du ma la bsams kyang / ya ki srid pa'i rtse mo nas/ ma ki dbyul ba'i gnas ris yan chad rtag pa dang brtan pa cung zad kyang med pa 'apo 'gyur 'phel 'grib kyi rang bzhin du yid ches nas tshe 'di'i phun tshogs la snying po med par shes dgos/ khyad par gces pa bskyangs pa'i lus sgems kyi tshogs pa 'di de ring gi dus 'di tsam la'ang mi 'bral pa'i nges pa med pas chos la 'bad dgos/ yang sgos da skabs chos dang bla ma dge ba'i sgrogs po'i rkyen las/ chos la sgrub 'dod kyi snang ba tsam yod kyang so skyes 'du shes la rtag brtan med pas/ dam bca' dang snying rus tshad med kyi sgo nas tshe dang ba pa snyoms pa zhig byed dgos snyam du yang yang dpyad 'jog bsgom/ 'di zhag gsum/drug pa 'chi rkyen nges thed la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ 'di la gsum las dang po nges par 'chi ba la bsam pa ni skye 'gro sems can yod do cog thams cad nges par du 'chi ste/ sngar ma shi lus pa med pa'i phyir dang / skye ba yod na 'chi ba'i chos nyid du grub te/ 'dus byas kyi rang bzhin yin pas skad cig re re song bas tshe 'dzad/ tshe los zad lo bas zad zla ba zhag gis zad zhag dus tshod kyis zad dus tshod skad gcig re res zad de 'chi bas so/ /tshe ring lo brgyad cu bsdad pa dang / tshe bung zhag gcig lon pa gnyis ka'ang tshe zad de shi na med lugs 'dra bas tshe la snying po med/ gnyis pa nam 'chi nges thed la bsam pa/ de ltar nges pa 'chi ba yin pa sdu ṭwāṃd nam 'chi nges pa'ang med de/ lo na chung bas mi phan mthun rkyen

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/zasagos sogakāsdidapas miphan/ da lta nad med snyakā pas mi ṭwāṃn sbyags ⑫gas lang ba mnga' thatta gardon par ༵ lasagang nayang ṭwāṃyo bami bdeng / gal gang kyig da nadi rgyu mtshan py-isuṭwāṃ sa da dgog de yang sangs rgyas sopy-is shes pyi 'a tsarnyi / 'a zhes lung ba na pa'am/ ya~X narasdo la mkhri/ṭwāṃpasamatho pa'am/ yaṭwāṃn gshin je chos rgyalha sa 'a ṭwāṃm nani nge da tshes ṭwāṃka' meb naṭwāṃ ṭwāṃg ni red yod na py-i gags/ ṭwāṃrib ṭwāṃ/ lanapa da/ tshad rshashes/ yi 'phen pa gzar 'bab chu ltar myur du 'gro bas natrī ⑫ nges pa med de/ spya ridri tsam kāng do nub tsarno dang song nyin tsam la 'adku pa zad nas 'phro ba trīng ṭwāṃs/ maṭwāṃdadaltaṭwāṃs za'aphro sto/ ṭwāṃtaṭwāṃ trīshad 'ame las yid 'tshe/yidabugs nang sdi da tsam la yang 'ab sa ༵ da pamen/kyi 'phanapaza/ kā / sangs rgyasposmanags sman/ dpagadas dbakā / phyag na gi sa baṭwāṃng bakta zung phan/ gnas dang grogs yul dang 'ar ba gang sa kyang phan ma ྾ 'phen pa ma zad kyang glo bur gyi rkyen nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/no da//// /kyi/////rdo rwa // /ste/ na nga phrag bapyibye/ 'gasuṭwāṃ brgyasbyag cuchi la gsadang tsho/rkyechu dug /yadī sa dbye da gcan gzaṭwāṃ gas sa 'a pa ma zad 'a py-i la sa gas chis kyang 'phralarī'aspriṭwāṃṭwāṃngatrī dang / dus kyatrī ma sa tshor mngal du 'a ba sogs rangachi nga 'chomilas rnyi metrī par nganas /rdordongadapyadachi/ ṭwāṃsum pa 'a dus sa na ṭwāṃpy-in sa tophan pa ba/na ltar 'a ba dus la babs dus dam pa sa ma gags grwa 'a53ra

tre chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/blon 'bangs longs spyod gnyen bshes gang gis kyang mi phan par thams cad bzhag nas 'gro dgos pa ma zad/ tha na gces par bskyang ba'i lus kyang shul du bzhag nas gcer bu lag stong mchan du bcug ste tshe phyi ma'i lam po cher 'gro dus grwa 'khor blon 'bangs gnyen bshes la sogs pa'i don du bsags pa'i sdig pa'i 'bras bu thams cad bgo bsha' byed du med par rang gis khur nas thams cad blos mi thong bzhin du 'gro ba ma gtogs med pas/de'i dus su gnod byed sdig pa ma gtogs med/ phan byed lha chos ma gtogs med nges pas dam pa'i chos sna re yod na de dus skyabs dang bskyob pa mgon dang dpung gnyer bla na med pa de gcig pur yin pas da lta nyid du blo sna phyin ci log rnams tshar gcod nas snying po lha chos zhig skub dgos/ de la skyes bu gsum gyi lam las skyes bu chen po'i lam byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslang ste/ lam thams cad kyi mthar thug myur lam 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam nas 'chi chos rnam dag zhig tshe dang sgrub par snyoms pa zhig bsgrub na/ na dga' shi skyid kyi ngang nas skye 'chi'i bar lag gyes/ 'chi med gnyug ma'i btsan sa zin pa zhig 'ong nges pas/ de 'dra zhig mi byed re shi snyam pa dang / de lta bu'i dam bca' de gtong re shi snyam pa'i dam bca'i lcags kyu gnyis pa res zin par gyed pa ni dam bca' kun la gal shin tu che'o—/ /de ltar thun dang thun mtshams phyes te thun gyi dngos gzhi la dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom dgos/ 'di la zhag gcig /bdun pa 'dun pa drag po la bsam te mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ 'di ltar dus dang gnas skabs kun tu 'chi ba mi rtag pa kho na bsgom shing 'gro 154

snying zigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ da 'dug za nyal thams cad la 'jig rten 'di'i spyod lam gyi tha ma yin no zhes thalatu yang brjod yid la'ang dung nge bsgom dgos pas gtso bo rjes thob 'a rgyamun mtshams kyi nyams len yin kyang / thun la'ang 'di ltar bsgom dgos bdag nyid gnas gzhan du 'gro ba mos nas der 'chi'am 'dir e sdog mi shes snyam pa dang / de bzhin du ngal stegs la sdod pa bsgoms 'dir 'chi'am snyam/ bya ba byed pa bsgom nas 'di 'chi'am snyam pa dang / zas za b.ras nas 'dir 'chi snyam pa dang / dben par sdod pa mos 'dir 'chi snyam pa dang / tshogs 'dus su phyin pa mos 'dir 'chi snyam/ mtshan mo nyal ba mos 'dir 'chi snyam/ de bzhin nangs mo ldang ba gtam smra ba rtse mo byed pa la sogs mos nas de dang der 'chi ba 'ong nges snyam du bsgom/ gzhan yang rang mes tshig pa chu dang g.yang la lhung ba dang / gcan gzan dang / thog dang / dug dang / mda' gri mdung sogs kyis dngos su gnod pas 'chi la zug pa mos nas da ci byed nges par du 'chi'o snyam du 'dun pa drag po yid kung nge 'gro ba re bsgom/ de nas 'di ltar bsam thun nang 'di za nyal 'gro ba sogs dngos min yang thun mtshams dang mtshams grol ba'i dus de dang der rnams la ngas 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom thub pa'i 'dun pa drag po re 'ong na ci ma rung / 'ong bar gyur cig 'ong ba zhig bdag gis bya/ de ltar nus pa bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam du 'brel ba bzhi ldan gyi 'phen pa drag po yang dang yang du bsgoms na rang gi smon lam dang dkon mchog gi thugs rje goms pa'i mthu sogs kyis thun mtshams sogs su skye sla ba yin te/ nub mo nyal dus 'di lta bur ldang ba bya snyam na de dus sad pa bzhin no/ /khyad par 155

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/thun nang 'dir nges par 'chi 'ong snyam du yang yang bsgom/ nga da shi 'ong shi 'ong snyam nas bsdad pa gcig pus mi chog 'chi ba la phan pa'i dam pa'i chos yang dag bsgrub dgos/ dang po sgrub rgyu'i chos ni lam sngon 'gro nas dngos gzhi'i bar cha tshang zhig bla ma dam pa las nyan cing sgro 'dogs bcad nas mkhas grub stong gi gshegs shul mi med dben pa'i ri la tshe chos mthar phyin byed dgos snyam pa'i 'phen pa gtong dgos/ 'di la'ang zhag gcig /khrin mi rtag pa la'ang zhag bcu gcig go /'dul ba las/ dge slong brgya la gdugs tshod yon dang bcas pa sbyin pa bas 'dus byas mi rtag par sems pa skad cig ma mchog go gsungs/ pha dam pas/ mi rtag pa 'di rgyud la skyes na/ dang po chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du brtson 'grus kyi lcag byed/ mthar 'od gsal chos sku thob par byed gsungs/ de lta bu mi rtag pa bsgom pa'i phan yon tshad med par gsungs pas rgyud la ma skyes bar du bsgoms na 'du shes thams cad las mchog tu gyur pa gsungs/ goms pa'i tshad ni/ nyin mtshan kun tu mi rtag pa la yang yang bsams na snang ba thams cad 'jig par mazong bas phyi yul la mi zhen pa'i blo gting nas skyes pa dang dge ba la brtson 'grus me 'bar ba 'dra ba'i blo skyes pa dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs sngangs skrag pa thun mong ma yin pa snying nas skyes pa dang 'chi tshe cis kyang mi phan par shes nas tshe 'di'i bya ba 'dor ba dang /skad cig tsam yang tha mal sos dal du mi sdod par sgo gsum chos la spyod pa dang / las 'bras kyi rnam par smin pa mazong pas nges 'byung skyo shes skyes pa dang nam 'chi nges med du shes pas gang la yang blo stos mi 'cha' ba rnams ni 156

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/mitag pa snying nas goms pas so/ /'dis ni tshe 'di la zhen pa dang le lo'i gnyen po yin/ mdor na dal 'byor rnyed dka' la bsams te dal ba la tshur du nga por lon pa dang / tshe mi rtag pa la bsams te blo sna 'phral du ga danas chos sgrub dgos so/ /gsum pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams pa la gnyis te/ spyi dang bye bragasha /dang po la drug las/ gnas gang du 'khor ba ni/ 'di ltar rnyed pa dada' ba'i dal 'byor thob kyang yun ring sdod longs med par mi rtag 'chi tha'idabang du 'gro/ shi nas kyang me shi ba lta bu ma yin pa skye ba gang rung zhig zedadagos/ skye ba zhig blangs phyin chad 'khor ba'i gnas las ma 'das pas/ga la khams gsum 'khor ba srid rtse nas mnar med bar gyi lha lha min mi dang dud 'gro yi dwags dmyal ba ste rigs drug gang rung du 'khor/ gnyis bsasems can su 'khor na 'khor ba'i sems can pha ma stsar pa thams cad ga gshas gcig gi phan tshun pha ma dang dgra gnyen btang snyoms gsum ma rgya sapa gcig kyang med/ gsum pa dus nam 'khor na 'khor ba thog ma med dzhaphan da lta'i bar du skye ba 'di ma blangs bya ba med pas 'di'i ma ni 'di'o//de'icasani 'di'o/ /zhes sems can gcig gi ma brgyud pa'i grangs sa chen 'di ril bu rgya shug tshig gu tsam dril te bgrangs kyang sa thams cad zad par 'gyur gyi re re'i ma byas pa'i grangs mi zad gsungs/ da dung lam rgyud la brten nas kun 'byung gi sa bon ma spangs na 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khor dgos/ bzhi ba tshul ji ltar 'khor na sdug bsngal kho na'i rang bzhin can gyis 'khor ste de'i dus su rang nyid chung ngu grog jir gcig pur skyes pa'i 157

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ mgo dang rkang lag bsdoms te gcig tu spungs yod na ri'i rgyal po ri rab las kyang mtho/ kha zas rgyab gos med pa dang / 'khyag ltog skom gsum la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong nas ngus pa'i mchi ma ma skam bsags na rgya mtsho chen po las lhag dmyal bar skyes nas zungs zhun khol ma kho na rang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po bzhi las lhag zhig btung ba'i sdug bsngal myong / mdor na sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyis khyab ste/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las—/ rgyal po chen po/ srid pa 'di ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen chen pos/ 'di ltar mi rtag khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos/ /rnam par 'gyur bas shin tu sdug bsngal te/ /sdug bsngal 'gyur dang 'du byed nyid gsum gyis/ /grong khyer drug gi 'gro kun nyam re thag/ /ces gsungs pa ltar de lta bu rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong nas 'khor bas me yi klong / spu gri'i thang srin mo'i gling dug sbrul gyi gzeb lta bu yin pas rmi lam gyi bde skyid gnyid sad tshe med pa lta bu'i tshe 'di'i snang ba'i phun tshogs la yin brtan med pas ci bya/ de bas thar ba'i don yang dag pa'i chos la gnas par bya dgos/ lnga pa rgyu gang gis 'khor na/rgyu min dbang phyug sogs kyis ma yin/ rgyu med ngo bo nyid las byung ba'ang min/ 'o na ci zhe na bsod nams cha mthun dang mi g.yo ba'i zag bcas kyi dge ba la brten nas mtho ris 'thob pa dang / bsod nams ma yin pa mi dge sdig pa'i las kyis ngan song du skye bas gcig nas gcig tu 'khor ro/ /drug pa dpe ji ltar 'khor na/ 'khor ba zhes bya ba de rdza mkhan gyi 'phang lo'am/ zo chun gyi khyud mo'am/ bum nang gi bung ba bzhin rigs drug gi 158

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/gnas rnaṭās sdo gshāgapy-i sa gaṭwāṃg tu 'aṭārab la zer/ redeṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ltar /nga 'khorab ba ba gyibalatshoche/taṭwāṃ 'dugate da sade trī 'ar 'khor ba sdug baṭwāṃṅgi rgya ma se las thar gtapy-i / ba ṭwāṃ garsha rdo sangs rgyas 'phang ma mas can thamasabye da se na du skyebapangog da/ spyang gāgluspe du gnad sbyi turnyisdus nas bye ba mas bad /sa ri dpyad 'ag la ma dang sa ba ba gsum sa nyams su blang / /chu //tha/ tha///zug/ /spyo /mi :ri'ar ba sdugatshe bsngal zhi dang brag dang khyad paramo dmyal ba sbyag —snarnamasabasam ṅgizhan ga/gab/labaṭwāṃltad ltab ltaramyon ra ra ༵nga ngaṭwāṃ rang ma rgakā rno kās sna sa kau sdug kṣiṃl nga ba ze lha kyida'akās sduṭwāṃlhutrī py-i nga sapas ltarazlom/skyeyang migs py-i ltas ga da sa da/sa pa tsam las nga tās trī sapa ji shātā'ags/kādang sdukā bakṣiṃ 'dran/'i daspyiṭwāṃ su ges dus /// da bdag skye ṭwāṃbasazhe ga rsha ṭwāṃs da lta bar dayo ba dang par da myal rno ba rgyu sdang de nas py-isags pa du masnyidarje pas shāmis trīb dasami snyaṭwāṃ pa'i dang / ra rsha pa ṭwāṃms la nga drag tu ma/nyin//daso'i ba thab//la'abad das / / pochi gas pa ri sdugaco bsngal yo brag tu bsam pa py-i ṭwāṃg las dang ni //sab dzo/nas ktaṭwāṃ'i ṭwārgyad dpas/nyikhridang dmyal ba/da /gi /nas gangs zhi ga dpagatshad sre ṅgitās pan bang ma gyi chags pa/ sa ga thams cad lcags ga dang lung pa mgasdu

tre chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/sol the las byung ba lta bu tha mal sa rdog pa bzhag sa tsam yang mi mngon pa/me rtse mun nag spu gang ba 'bar ba/ chu me mur steng nas mdag me rdo bsregamatshon cha'i char ba 'beebs pa/ sa gzhi thams cad gcan gzan nam mkha' la bya sha zan gyis gang ba/ lus ni 'doms pa bzhi pa/ lus mdog khrag tshos lta bu/ pags pa srab pa sha tshag dam pa mig ltar reg bya sran mi bzod pa/ migazur gsum pa spa dang kha spu dmar ser skyes pa ba spu gzeng ba yan lag rags pa/ sto ba che ba spyi'u tshugs su 'gro ba sogs shin tu nyam thag pa nyin mtshan med pa bcad gtub la sogs sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig thung ba'o/ /sdug bsngal tshul dang tshe tshad ma nges te rim pa 'di ltar yang sos ni/ gong du bshad pa lta bu'i gnas su dmyal ba'i beems can kun rdzus te skyes nas phan tshun dgra mi sha bor mthong pa'i zhe sdang gis mtshon cha brdog res 'ba' zhig gyed pas shi ma thag nam mkha' las yang sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra rlung grang mo dang bcas pas lus la reg tsam gyis yang sos nas las ma zad kyi bar du sdug bsngal sngar ltar myong dgos pa'o/ /tshe tshad ni mi lo lnga bcur lha rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i zhag cig tu bajis pa'i lha'i lo brgya la yang sos kyi zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya la myong dgos/ zig nag ni/ gasken rje'i pho nya 'jigs su rung ba rnams kyis lus mgal dum bzhin du bsrangs pa'i khyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thig brgyad dang / bcu drug sogs su btab nas lcags kyi sog le rnon pos khyi bo nas rkang mazil la bug gi bar gshog cing / de ma thag 'byar nas yang gshog pa'i sdug bsngal dpag nyu med do/ /tshe tshad ni mi lo brgya la sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i zhag ga tu bajiso 160

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/pa'i lha'i lo stong la zig nag pa'i zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo stong thub pa'o/ /bsdus 'jomasani/ lcags gtun chen po'i nang du sems can mang po tho zang the 'bar bas ti bzhin du brdung 'a ga byas kyang mod la sos pa dngakong 'a gzaga'askurang ja mo la sogs pa'i mgo badzhan 'dra ba'i bar dusnang wags bgigadu bcar ba'i kug bajil myong ba'o/ /tshe tshad mi lo gnyis brgyar 'a bzal gyi zhag gcig tu bajis pa'i lha'i lo nyis stong la bsus 'joms gyis zhag gcig byas pa'i rang lo stong gnyis bar du myong dgos/ du 'bod ni/ lcags bsregs khang pa sgo med pa'i nang du lcags zhun bskol bar 'tshod cing lus la me 'bar bas thar ba'i dus med snyam du 'o doga'abod pa'o/ /tshe tshad mi lo bzhi brgya dga' ldan gyi zhag gcig de'i lo ba stong ngu 'bod kyi zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo stong bzhi sdug bsngal ba'o/ /ngu 'bod chen po ni/ lcags khang 'bar ba nyis rim du bcug nas thes baphreg cing sgo 'grigs pas sdug bsngal zhing gshin rje'i me'i tho bas 'asna ma pa'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ mi lo brgyad brgya 'phrul dga'i zhag gcig byas pa'ika lo brgyadastong ngu 'bod chen po'i zhag gcig ste/ de lta bu'i lo stong zag brgyad gyi bar sdug bsngal ba'o/ /drug pa tsha ba ni/ lcags kyi yol gor khro bukhol ma'i nang du sems can grangs med 'tshod cing sdug bsngal/ steng du thon pa'i'as la mgo la tho lum bsnun nas dran pa nyams pa'ang bde bar sgogapas sug bsngal/ tshe tshad ni mi lo chig stong drug brgya lha gzhan 'phrul pa bang byed kyi zhag gcig lha'i lo chig khri drug stong tsha ba'i zhag gcig tu sa ba'i rang lo khri phrag gcig dang drug stong bar sdug bsngal myong ba'o/ /161

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/rab tu tsha ba ni/ lcags khyim me 'bar ba'i nang bsreg cing gsal shing rtse gsum pa me 'bar bas rkang mthil gnyis dang 'og sgo nas 'dzugs shing phrag pa gnyis dang spyi bo nas phug ste/ lcags bsregs kyi snam bus lus phyi nas dkri bas shin tu sdug bsngal/ tshe tshad mi los gzhal yul 'das pas bar bskal phyed du myong dgos/ mnar med ni/ lcags khang me 'bar ba 'khor lhag pa bcu drug gis bskor ba'i nang du lcags bsregs sol ba ri rab tsam spungs pa'i dbus sems can grangs med bcug stag gzig gi spud pa bus pas me dang lus gnyis med du bsregs pas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba shin tu rags shing 'o dod 'bod pa'i sgra tsam las lus dngos mi mngon/ thar 'dod rgyun chad med par skye yang mi thar/ me sgo cung phye tshe bros snyam pa na/tho ba sogs kyis bsnun nas khro chu khar sdugs pa sogs dmyal ba snga ma bdun po'i sdug bsngal kyang tshang bar myong dgos/ tshe tshad bar bskal gcig tu myong dgos de las lhag pa mnar smyu med pas na mnar med ces bya/mtshams med byas pa dang / sngags la zhugs nas rdo rje slob dpon nam bla ma dang 'gal nas log lta skye ba sogs skye ba'i gnas yin pas bla ma dam pa dang srog la babs kyang 'gal mi rung / las gzhan gyis 'dir skye mi nus/ de ltar tsha dmyal brgyad po 'og ma 'og mar tshor ba bdun 'gyur gyis rags pas sdug bsngal bdun 'gyur gyis che ste/ tha ma tsan dan dus mtha' dang /dmyal me rnams ni bdun 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang yin pa/ /des ni da myal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang / /dpe yang ma mchis char yang mi phod 162

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/trīzhesagasungasapa'o/ /deltabu'i tsha daskyalarnakāsatrī gnas luṭwāṃsdugabapy-il lhu sogaṭwāṃ la bsam /sdu sang yangarapyad 'ashig la mar bsna na babye gdaga'ashrī rnagabaspyo pagange mas gin tu sdug ༵nga sding trī sha mi sdol gyisasagashe na dris 'byudngha bsamapa//rtoras basmibyāji rna// thor na drakā kā'in gzo 'aṭwāṃ gsapa ba / lta sto sdug bsngal / bras gaṭwāṃ smo dang bral na ma rung /ma du 'dun pa daṭā / bral ba gyur ga snyam pazhi na rsham datrī/ bralabazlo ngasabyasnyatrīpadam bcakta dang / bral bdi ga dan snakā gsum ma nus da/ da du myuji ba da / 'dug sa 'a ru ༵ra bkye ga ra nas nyag sung gatrīl baṅgibasapakhyen/ blamargyalab ma hud dpa' bo khyod thuXshā blotā pa snan ma yab snasdu lugs la rang sdon yid pyi kās shu // ga das ga/zlos pa na/ gasbyis dag tu de ba rgyu //lopoṭwāṃsarnamasalaso'adabasbyopy-isadang/'i na chad las 'dra sha sa/stogs nas py-id kyang da ṭwāṃm pa tāmabaṭwāṃ'adagos so/tshe/dazangarang lus khatrī py-i phug pa'aji/ /ga phra tsamajig pa'am/ ra / / pa tsatsā yang batrī na/ / dag di sdug bsngal ltar ṅgizod nus / da'ajugade las/da ltaspyubasngal 'a tsam zlong /ci/ṭwāṃdag mikā bzod /zla khus na/dis na dashāl ba sdusbri bsngal rgyu// ba zlog da/ /sto //sungs 'a rnams ga mar 'a/ tsha dmyal rnams la zhag gnyis //ste //de/ ////ḍi shas pa grang dmyal brgyad / 'i gnas ni/ mtha' thams 6ṭwāṃd

tram̐ chen mtshosuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da gangs ri chen pos yongs su bskor ba/ chab rom gyi thang chen po mi bzad pa'i khrod/ kha ba dang bu yug gi rlung reg bya shin tu grang mo'i rgyun du brdabs pa'i gnas su snang ba'i rten skar ma'i 'od tsam yang med pa'i mun nag chen mo/ dro ba'i rten lhan pa tsam yang brten pa'i skal ba med par/sngon byas las 'bras thog tu smin pa'i sems can de dag gi lus ni tsha dmyal dang mtshungs/ sdug bsngal ni/ de lta bu'i gnas su gcer mo grang ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyams pas lus la chu bur thol thol theb ldog tsam mang po rdol ba ni chu bur can/ chu bu de dag rdol nas rmar song ba chu bur rdol ba/ grang ba'i zug ju bsran mi bzod pas so 'tshir bas so tham pa/ smre sngags rgyun 'chad med par 'don pas a chu chu/ skad gdangs chag pas shugs ring kyi hud 'don pas kyi hud 'don pa/ phyi'i lpags mdog sngon por song ste bzhi tshal du gas pa utpal ltar gas pa/ nang gi sha dmar por mngon pa brgyad tshal du gas pa padma ltar gas pa/ de las kyang dmar nag tu gyur te bcu drug dang so gnyis grangs med par gas pa padma chen po ltar gas pa/ gas pa'i rma nang srin bu lcags kyi mchu can mang pos za ba'i sdug bsngal sogs mi 'dra ba brgyad la ming mi 'dra ba brgyad do/ /tshe tshad ni/ grong khyer ko sa la'i bres gzhal ba'i bcu tshad nyi shu shong ba'i gzhong pa tel gyis gang ba/ de las chu bur can gyi lo brgya re na til re re myungs pas til thams cad zad pa na chu bur can gyi tshe tshad rdzogs pa yin la/ lhag ma bdun por de las rim pa nyi shu re'i 'gyur gyis tshe je ring sdug bsngal je che yin no/ /de ltar grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad po'i gnas lus sdug bsngal tshe tshad bcas la yang yang dpyad 164

snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ da wa'ajogaspelamar byesgom/ da lta ṭwāṃguṭwāṃ dus gceṭwāṃ butrī skad sbyagatsam py-id ba'igrangalhags kyi snyig bsngal yang rshad na/ der py-i na 'i ṭwāṃr bad nga rgyud sapalabashagatrīmaṣṭṛngarje/ ra sa pa mas can gle shā bsgom / sogs sngar ltar kā das sa gsum tshang bas nyams //'che/mas kṣiṃ'aji zhag gatrī/kho kyigasu pa nyi nye 'ar /gnas 'ar ba mnar med phyogs so /ste/ /sgyu 31( 1 ( /sdi/ the mi /bye(son/'imamur ṭwāṃkā/ /ṭwāṃs snadaṭwāṃ/yoman cha thang / rshal lo mari ṭwāṃ/sa shākā kā gas na ba bapo med/'omardomasaban shalaṭwāṃse nga da/ lus/bye/thoda~X trīr kās / mnaṭwāṃ grio mas ṭwāṃn las srab pa py-iṭwāṃ ra na rgyang nga sbyi bas ṭwāṃzang ste//canamanganas dga'atshi cin pas/ thal tshan nyi mdapy-i 'babye ji du nusdo naṭwāṃ sha rus py-i nga sdugabasngal/thostegs pa ri myagakā 'ad / kyi ban du ṭwāṃng nga naṭwāṃ chu klung mdeng /zhiyun ༵ bas tsharsha mis dga' 'thungadun/ ṭwāṃṭwāṃgagardzu mid/khyi kyi gtsang ba thams cad bsdus kyang da 'osardospyi ṭwāṃ rdo tshosogs ṭwāṃ rul dri nga ba 'bus g.yengapo ba'i kāng du shād bo bar /khri/ nang ḍā na rnyi lcags mchu ṭwāṃn mang sa 'gasasngongapo sdug bsngal/mchospu ṭwāṃng / tshoyanga'ilasatharapasathangazhin nyams dga' /ji ༵ nas kā pakā man chaskye thanga'i dakta thug sa ga thams cad lcags sa pas thur ma ༵ rtswa ltar kā pa nga du ktang pa ṭwāṃ~Xs bkāg rsha phug gan bzhag na gan gug pa bag pa yang sa 65nga

da tram̐chenamatshophu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/bzhag na sngar ltar phug pas sdug bsngal/ bzhi pa ral gri'i tshal ni/ yang de las thar nas nags tshal nyams dga' ba mthong ba la dga' nas rgyugs pas der nags tshal ci la yod/ ral gri'i tshal dang thug lcags kyi sdong po la ral gri mang po lo ma ltar skyes pa rlung gis bskyod pas lus dum bur gcod cing yang 'byar nas gcod pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba'o/ /lcags kyi shal ma ri ni/ btsun 'chal sdom nyams 'dod log spyod pa rnams skye ba'i gnas yin/ri'i drung du slebs pa na ri'i rtse nas sngar rang la dga' gdung yod pa'i grogs kyis 'bod par mthong nas phyin pas/ lcags sdong lo ma thams cad thur bstan pas 'bigs shing / pags pa rnams bshus/ sha rnams phrul/khrag 'thor/ rtsa rgyus rnams so mang gis bal shad pa ltar skya sham sham song /la la ri rtser phyin tshe bya lcags kyi mchu can dang khā dang bya rgod la sogs pas sha 'thog cing mig tshil 'bru/ yang ri'i rtsar 'bod par mthong nas phyin pas / lo ma thams cad gyen du bstan pas brang nas rgyab tu 'bigs shing ri'i rtsar slebs dus lcags kyi skyes pa dang / bud med me 'bar ba 'jigs su rung bas 'khyud nas mgo bo khar bcug ste bldad pas 'gram khug gnyis nas klad pa skya cir gyis 'ong bas sdug bsngal/ gzhan yang chu klung bzang po rgyang ring nas 'bab par mthong ste phyin nas 'bog ma thag thal tshan gyi chu bo rab med nang sked nub tu tshud de sha rus tshig nas phyir bros pa las/ gshin rje'i skyes bus bsrung bas yun ring du sdug bsngal/ nye 'khor lhag pa bcu drug gi tshe tshad bar bskal phyed du sdug bsngal bar dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs/ nyi tshe ba ni/ gnas lus sdug bsngal tshe tshad sogs mtha' gcig 166

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/tu ma nges te/ridangargyamadku 'gramatāngasarte dngagyichabarom/ shing da~Xbasdo snang /khang padang༄ga ri sogs 'ag na khams gang na'ang rod gyi/brago rnadubacarabarang/ ṭwāṃyinangagā'abum padangame/ chabasrem snasasarus smyo da nang du 'dapagidang/ nangasnyigapa sa / shingashangalabarjodagatub byas pas rang yan lag dang nga lag bcad par nyer len /sa sdug bsngal ba datā / gtun dang / phyags ma // /zu bdangaka dngaka ka trī dang/ dbu byedngha/shāg padang/ ba dag sab ma dang / da spyad dang / la gas pa rtag tu thekosauzhing spyod pa'i gzugs su 'du shes pas sdug bsngal de dag myong ba ste/che/the/:rinye) 15 sna /spremakhyeg nga blalha nagache /na dazlo de da /rapa rgyasags rgyus lta bu / nyi nye 'aṭwāṃ dag sdug bsngal sogs la bsam nas dpyad 'jogashā dku bsgom/'a gnyis la zhag gnyis/de/rdor //khril brgyad/ graṭwāṃdamyalabargyad/ nyi tshe nye 'khor gnyis derababargyad sdugabasngaṭāgs ṭwāṃbyams go spral tsamamayin pa raṭwāṃ kār dpyatrī nas datā par ga trītsum nga rshang nyid gnas /ma/ / man sumase sa kār bam dang 'gas skrag snang sdo tshad ༵da ga sa/ ji mas ga tu blangs pa tsam la sdug bsngal tsam da na da/sdu su skyekā na ltar bzod de/ bshesaspringalas/ dmyalazlobrisapa dang jis pa daṭwāṃ / /dran daṭwāṃ bklag daṭā gzugs su ṭwāṃs rnams /rdo sa/ /'gatrī pa bar 'gyur na bzad pa/ /rnam na nyams su mas smos 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs/ de rnams su skye ba'i rgyu ni6 dīng

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/res kyang tshe rabs 'di dang gzhan du bsags pa grangs med pas dmyal ba de dag tu myur du skye nges te tshe 'di dang daskyal ba'i bar na dbugs rgyu mi rgyu 'di las med pas/ des na da res dal 'byor thob/ bla ma dang mjal/zab rgu'i gdams ngag nyan/ sangs rgyas rang lag sgrub tu yod dus 'dir sos dal du skad cig kyang mi sdod par dam pa'i chos yang dag pa la 'bad nas/ sngar byas la 'gyod bshags drag po byed pa dang / phyin chad srog dmar po 'di la babs kyang de dag tu skye ba'i las bsags re shi snyam pa'i dam bca' dang / da lta der skyes pa'i ma sems can rnams la snying rje drag po bsgom/ de dag thams cad da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du ngan song gi gnas ris las thar na ci ma rung / thar par gyur cig thar par zhig bdag gcig pus bya/ de ltar thar par dkon mchog gsum mkhyen snyam du dus dang rnam pa kun tu bsam nas yid skyo lhung nge ba'i ngang nas 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa log pa zhig dgos/ de ltar ma yin pa spyir 'khor ba'i sgos ngan song gi khyad par dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal la sogs ji tsam go yang go lo thos lor bzhag nas nyams su ma blangs pas 'jigs snang tsam yang med na chos kyi dred po skal med sems pa rdo ba'i rang bzhin can yin nges te/de nyid las/ sdig can dbugs dbyung 'gags pa tsam zhig gi /dus kyis bar du chod rnams dmyal ba yi/ /sdug bsngal gzhal yas mthong nas rnam ktoṭā shā// //mi 'jigs gang lags rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs gnyis pa ngan song gi gnas gnyis pa yi dwags ni/ byings gnas kyi 168

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ —gnas ni/ lcags kyi grong khyer chen po rgyal po'i khab kyi 'og dpag tshad lnga /spro// 1—1 //re///spyi ////5tsam drodas ༵ na da par bshad 'as pa zhi trīgasamya ngan tharnyi rtog ṭwāṃ sa pa da zlo'angabashadasnang /rdo ṭwāṃ gagi klung thams cad ṭwāṃ lha kha tsā/gemyayo ngam tharsha zag ma ༵ngasdo gakā trī gang ba/ pochu shul rwarngo ga po tā payo/ nga shul yi nga ṭwāṃdī rsha gapamang / duspra rags tha ra da ṭwāṃ/ zhirid du nga nga kun tu bag gra~X ba ///dang /pomakhar rgyu ris kā ༵nga thams cad na khyab pa ltar da/mo na sgra dang kha spu gyiṭwāṃ zlo gagasapa/ bskalapaṭwāṃsapa'amame/ nga skakā paktam/rimar gago nga ltabupaṭwāṃsadangarusapashibar sha stod pa lus ma nga da trī/ ma ja rdza tsamasto ga khung / lhung nga rgyu ma nga ma pabala'abyaṭwāṃb ༵na pa rta ṭwāṃ tsam/ sdu yul ngas tsam/ṭwāṃng kāg dzo'ab sbya kha py-ib ga py-i/phozas ma ṭwāṃn du da py-ibaṭwāṃgs ṭā/ shā sa //drirjodas gsum 'i gtsa pa/ dwakṣiṃ gameg ngatsha batsha sgra la phrong rta trībargyadrud pa sgra mdang /tshalhu gas ni stapy-i la la 'a ba/sha garṣa lto ga bsngal dbyar zla ba'ang la dgun tsa py-i'aṭwāṃ grang ba/skongasigi 'aṭīs ṭwāṃn dang / chu klung la bltas ṭwāṃ thom sa ṭwāṃs/'izas myo sa go mang /derna ṭwāṃratrītsaṭwāṃ yadī boses/ ltabuge sdus sdu/la ༵ dpy-i/ ṭwāṃṭwāṃkhri ba rgyu ga nger ṭwāṃ dashā 'aṭwāṃr gas sto/ tshad zlo mtha' chi mi nas tna hā ma sa bsatshengs ṭwāṃṭwāṃ lnga tha trīg ṭāng ra ṭwāṃnga' ci'agyurajis / /gaṭwāṃn yang tshad tshab gag dwags zhag gag tu bas pas rang lnga brgya thub pasdu

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/gsungs/ dbye na byings gnas dang mkhar rgyu gnyis dang po la'ang gsum las / phyi'i sgrib pa can ni/ lo grangs brgya phrag mang por chu'i ming tsam yang thos ma myong bas shin tu bkres skom gyis gdungs/ dus rtag tu bza' btung 'ba' zhig don du gnyer nas yan lag gi lhu tshigs 'khrol zhing lto ba ma theg par sdug bsngal bzhin thang chad chad du 'gro yang cung zad kyang mi rnyed—/ res rgyang ring na chu klung dang / smon shing thog gu can mthong nas der sngar bzhin 'gro ba nas sleb tshe chu klung thams cad gram pa dang / khra ma'i sdong por gyur ba dang / yang zas skom mthong nas phyin tshe skyes bu go mtshon can du mas srung bas ded nas mtshon chas deg cing sdug bsngal/ tsha grang go ldog pa la sogs phyin ci log gi snang ba dang ldan bas sdug bsngal yun ring myong ba'o/ /gnyis pa nang gi sgrib pa can ni/ kha khab mig tsam pas rgya mtsho'i chu 'thungs kyang mgrin pa rta rnga tsam du ma tshud pa'i bar la kha'i dug gis skam pa dang / cung zad re song yang sto ba yul ljongs tsam mi khengs pa dang / sto bde tsam song na mtshan mo'i ring la me 'bar zhing glo snying nang khrol bsrigs cing sna nas du ba 'thul bas sdug bsngal zas skom cung zad rnyed pa rnams rnag khrag dang thal ba tho lum 'bar ba sogs su gyur nas snga ltar kha nas mi 'gro ba sogs sdug bsngal myong / 'gro 'dod dus sto ba yul sngongs tsam yan lag 'jag skya tsam gyis mi theg pas sdug bsngal shin tu che/ gsum pa sgos khur gyi sgrib pa can ni/ yi dwags re re'i lus la srog chags mang po'i tshang bcas nas de'i khrag dang sha la za ba'am lus lha bas gang ba phru gu mang por song te de rnams kyis za ba la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang skyid 170

/ste:sgo :)14:rdong ga zhag brgya ma ma/sdug gi rnardzu grangs ma ngesasprakāng du ma yod de/ gro ba/na skyes / ba byebari yi rwags yuladubyonapa rgyusalasogasaswāltabupy-i/ dgarnaṭwāṃs 0 mazad nasnyetsās sa bajig /nga 'ag ṭwāṃradapadang/gri sa dang / tsug rang ci sha rshacad ṭwāṃ za rsha dang man par lha ba rdo ba ktoyi paṭā zas surid das ṭwāṃ gsanatunyamasdug pa'o// lta bukro rshags kānas sa'i gang du sa kyangatsho gnasayo lus 'i tshad rnams dang bas ma ga gyur pa sdugabasngalaṭwāṃgs dpa ñtsa bcakā la ṭwāṃng dang rdo du thu/ dang thun mtshamatrī sa nas thun la dpyad 'akta la ṭwāṃrabam/'azornamasalazhag gcig/ lorang sasnga tsam za ṭwāṃ ma sa na rāgatho bsngala'i 'dra 'dug grang4tshad thed pa la chu yi nga tsam yang sa pa gnas su skyes na ji rto /zhi/der skyesapa'i ma sems /na rnapy-is la byams dang snying rje bsgom/thodaspyogi jir ser sna dang 'juṭwāṃ gatrī skye sgo ṭwāṃs las bsags pa grangs zed bas 'argyad bshags /nga / chad po rsha thabs kā 'bad dgos so//da/ /rngom/trīlasab /tebatsanargyalaji 'dre ma mo 'u rang la sogs /daspyo gas rnams/ rtagatu'anogasakhoskrag dngartso'akhrul snaṭwāṃ'aba' rna da/ bsam pa ngan pas gzha/ gad nar barsha ṭwāṃs 'i ma thag dasong du 'gro ba ṭwāṃṭwāṃ / sngar /zlo da nawa sogs gang ba tshoṭwāṃ ba zhagabodun phralha mtshaṭwāṃs su nga /nye gzhapy-ilaspoṭwāṃdodapardon la gzhan kā gabod rakā la phan/ du sogs rtsar na ༵sa dag ma'i ltadang 'gas gas btang / sngags pa nus ldan sa dīnan

tram̐ chen mtshophuchosagrwa'idaspatshogs/ da bsregs 'phangs gsum byas pas sdug bsngal/ phan tshun stobs che chung gcig gis gcig gsod pa dang / phyin ci log gi snang ba spyi mthun 'char/kha cig bya dang khyi la sogs pa'i gzugs byad yid du mi 'ong pa yod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab/ de dag gi sdug bsngal sogs dang /der skyes pa'i sems can la byams pa dang snying rje bcas yang yang dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom/ 'di la'ang zhag gcig go /gsum pa ngan song gi gnas gsum pa dud 'gro ni/ gnas ni 'og gzhi rgya mtsho chen po chu gter bzhi'i khyen dang / gling pa mun nag gi rgya mtsho'i nang dang kha 'thor ba lha dang mi'i gnas sa chu ri lung gang na'ang yod/ lus ni sbrul dang chu srin sogs che ba ri rab la lan mang 'khor ba dang chung ba rdul phran dang khab rtse lta bu'i bar rkang mang/ rkang bzhi rkang gnyis rkang med kyi rnam pa sna tshogs yod/ tshe tshad thung ba yud tsam dang / mchog ring bskal par gnas pa'ang yod/ sdug bsngal ni/ dang po byings gnas mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na nya dang / chu srin dang / dung dang / sbal ba dang / 'bu srin la sogs pa chang 'gag gi sbang ma bzhin shin tu mang ba/ skyob pa'i rten gnas med pas rlabs kyis bdas te nges med du 'khyams/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig za ba ste/ che bas chung ba rnams gyur mid byed/ chung bas che ba'i lus thal mar 'bigs shing za/ che ba re'i lus la chung ba mang pos tshang bcas nas za bar byed/ klu rnams la nyin re bzhin bye tshan gyis bsregs cing mkha' lding gi za ba sogs rtag tu dgra byung gi dogs pas sdug bsngal/gling bar dang rgya mtsho chen po 'dom gang man chad mun pa 'thibs sa rang 172

snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ da wa rang gi yan rdog trīrkyarsha bskum byed patsamayaṭwāṃmimathongabasashiṭwāṃtuskosdugagle kā/la/kyib ba gyi skabs cung zad kyang da ṭwāṃr tsha grang bsos ma na gi sdug bsngatrī sa spyam pa kun tu mnar ba sdug bsngal gas la she dri tu bshām nas sgo shaṭwāṃ sa 'byung di/ bshagaṭwāṃ pa dam bca'/ ma sa na drakā gas baṭwāṃ la ṭwāṃdra/'a la sdu/ gagayogasapakokhakūrakyi ba / lha kāng byel na da pa rnams py-ing blupy-i chojas dang bal da sdug bsngal na la da/ khyad par yul //// //sde /sde rdo /ji /a 'ani bdag tu ma bzung ba trī ṭāng ṭwāṃgs gcanaso gzan trīgs pa /ra rās kham byeng yang bag bye ba babyen du za ba sogs 'asogs skraṭwāṃ shas ba kāl da/bye khras 'u dang 'uzlo 'bu ṭwāṃd ༵ gas gag ga gan zas rtsidaṭwāṃsasdug ṭwāṃ~Xl/ na pa snyigaṭwāṃ sa shaso pags rwa shā chu paṭwāṃdang gla so la gas pa nyid du rgya dang so mdaṭwāṃ gas rabang da du gad pas rang lus da kyaṭwāṃ rang gagrod padzo rgyur gyur tutrīgabasngal/ ba/garnyibazung rshagād 'artamaso 'bru gaṭwāṃg kṣiṃcepy-is pa ṭwāṃms / ra sbyi nga ngas paṭwāṃ ṭwāṃd saṭwāṃ theb /min ga ge lta bzho sdug bsngalagro las sa pa lha kṣiṃ sa/ cog du khal kāl ba na nasarmo 'armo bdang/ batho ba dang /bya gad /hā/ /sna 'gas pa dang / sa ba dngatso/ spu'agasapawang / bal sa rna pa dang / gzhashā yang rdung py-i dang /bags pa dang /gibagachi pa dang /gi padang/ gnasbyiga'asonapadang/ lcags thaṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ 'angs pa rnas kha bshas rwar 'ang ba gas sdug bsngal bsam sa khyab dī pya

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/spyod pa yin la/ khyad par gla klo'i rigs kyis dmyal ba dngos lta bu'i 'phrul chas sna tshogs kyis ngan gsod byed pa mngon sum du mthong thos byung ba'i sdug bsngal la sogs la spyod pa'i pha ma sems can las ngan pa rnams mthong tsa na/ de rang nyid yin pa'i blo bzhag nas sdug bsngal ji tsam 'dug zhib tu bsam nas dpyad 'jog sogs yang yang bsgom/ 'di yang zhag cigaspyir dud 'gro thams cad dang khyad par rang la bsten pa'i dud 'gro rnams dang / tha na 'bu sbrang sdi shig yan chad thams cad la byams brtses skyong ba dang tshe thar srog slu ci 'aspub byed dgos te/ thams cad la bde sdug tshor ba yod pa dang pha ma yin pa la khyad med do/ /de dag skye ba'i rgyu gtso bo gti mug yin pas spang dgos/ de ltar ngan song gsum po gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs dos drag la rgyun ring bar spun zhing rmongs pa chos kyi snang ba med pas slar yang dug gsum gyi sgo nas ngan song gi rgyu sgrub pa kho na las med/ de dag tu skye shor na thar ba'i dus med/ da lta rang cag rnams mdzub mo me dang yud tsam 'phrad pa'am/ dgun grang sgang stod g.yog tsam phud pa'am/ nyin gcig tsam bza' btung med par 'dug pa'am/lus la 'bu sprang dang wi shig gis so btab pa'i sdug bsngal lam/ skra nyag ma gcig 'thog pa'i sdug bsngal dang / khur cung zad yud tsam 'gel ba'i sdug bsngal sogs la mtshon dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal bzod thabs gtan nas med/ de dag tu skye ba'i rgyu ni tshe 'di dang gzhan du bsags pa grangs kyis mi chod/ da sos dal du sdod mi rigs te/ zhi ba lhas/ dmyal ba yi ni las byas na/ /bdag nyid ji ltar bde bar 'dug /ces pa ltar yin pas/174

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/sngar byas 'gyod bshags/ phyin chad sdom pa sogs zhe thag pa nas 'bad/der skyes pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje drag tu bsgom nas thams cad ma gi gis sangs rgyas kyi sar drang bar bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed nas/chus dang rnam pa kun tu ngan song gi sdug bsngal dran nas sems skyo lhung nge la ring nas tshe chos mthar phyin pa zhig bya snyam du dam bca'i 'phen pa drag tu bya ba brjed mi rung ngo / /7 —bzhi pa mtho ris gsum las dang po mi ni/ de ltar ngan song gsum du cas na kug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin kyang mtho ris rnam gsum ni bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge 'bras yin pas da lta skyes pa rnams bde zhing skyid pa sten ma pa dang / phyin chad bde 'gro thob pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya jigs so snyam na/ mtho ris la bde ba med nges te/ ji skad du/ mtho ris rnams ma bde ba'i skad de yang / /nges na mtho ris la'ang bde ba med/ /cu pa ltar ro/ /de las dang po mi la gnyis las dang por rtsa ba'i sdug 'a mi gsum las/ dang po 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ mi rnams la da lta bde 'tho'i rten rnyed nas skad cig mar bde ba ltar yod kyang rtag mi thub par bag ma blangs nas bro brdungs pas khang pa sgrub nas sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba lta bu dang / phan pa'i zas zos pas ngoms shing skyid par yod dus zin rdzobar langs nas/ nad drag po glo bur du byung ba dang / da lta skyid pa da 'phro la nor rgyugs dgras ded pa dang / khang zhing mes tshig pa/ phyi rol phyi gtam ngan thos pa sogs 'phral du sdug bsngal bar 'gyur pa'i tshul mngon bum pa mang po sems thog tu blang nas bsam na/ spyir 'khor ba'i gnas 175

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dbai tshogs/ris 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum thob mnga' thang sogs ltar snang ba gang la yang rtag pa brtan pa spu tsam yang med cing / mthar sdug bsngal ba kho na las ma 'das pa yin pas/ de dag gi don rnams la yang yang thun du byas te bsgom/ des na da lta bde skyid nyi tshe ba yod tshe chos yang dag ma 'grub na sdug bsngal byung dus 'grub dka' ba'i tshul la bsam te brtson 'grus bskyed/'di zhag cigaganyis pa sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ni/ sdug bsngal snga ma ma sangs bzhin du sdug bsngal phyi ma gcig brtsegs pa dper na/ mdze thog tu phol byung ba dang / phol thog tu rma gtugs pa/ pha shi ba'i steng du ma shi ba/nor phyugs dgras ded pa'i steng du mi gces pa shi ba lta bu rnams te/ 'khor ba'i gnas ris 'di gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi steng du sdug bsngal brtsegs pa kho nas dus 'da' ba las bde ba'i go skabs skad cig ma tsam snatrī /da pa yin pas zhib tu dpyad nas blo spyong dgos/ 'di la'ang zhag gsum pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni/ da lta rang re gnas mal longs spyod zas gos sogs 'jig rten gyi phun tshogs bde bar rlom pa rnams kyang dngos su sdug bsngal ltar mi mngon kyang don du sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kho na las ma 'das te/ zas zos pa gos gyon pa gnas khang dang longs spyod rgyan dang ston mo la sogs pa thams cad kyang srog gcod pa la sogs mi dge sdig pa'i rgyus sgrub pa/ bya byed thams cad kyang sdig pa'i g.yo bkol 'ba' zhig las mi ༵/ga pas/ 'di thams cad kyi 'bras bu ni sdug bsngal kho na yin/

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dper na da lta rang re skyid por baji ba'i kha la za rgyu ja dang rtsam pa zho dang 'o ma mar dang sha chang sbrang rtsi gro ma 'chu ra tshod ma sogs bza' btung gi rigs thams cad byung sa'i phug dang las ka sogs la ltos/ rgyab la gyon rgyu 'khrug tsha ru wa zhwa ko lham sram gzig sogs dang / gnas khang longs spyod sogs mdor na rgyu rdzas thams cad gang la bsams kyang sdig pa kho nas bskubs pa zhig ma gtogs med pas/ 'di thams cad kyi 'bras bu mthar ni ngan song gi sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa la spyod dgos pa yin pas/ da lta skyid por snang ba thams cad kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal kho na yin/ des na 'di la zhib tu ma bsam na tshe 'dir zhen nas mi lus stong zad du 'gro ba'ang gtso bo 'di rnams la thug yod pas nan tan yid la yang yang dpyad pa zhib tu btang nas bsgom dgos/ 'di'ang zhag gcigaganyis pa la gnyis las dang por skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal chen po bzhi las/ dang po skye ba ni/ mngal du 'jug rgyu'i bar do'i gnas skabs kyang sdug bsngal 'di ltar yod de/ brgyal sangs pa na shi ba ngo ma shes nas nye du sogs kyi drung du song nas nga 'di na yod zer kyang de rnams kyis mi mthong mi thos/ da nga shi'am snyam nas grib ma dang / rkang rjes yod med sogs brtas pas nges par shi 'dug snyam nas shin tu skrags pa'i rkyen gyis/ 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi/ ya nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum sogs shar pa dang / de dus las dag pa rnams dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i bsu mas yar gyi zang thal du 'gro/mtshams med sogs byas pa rnams gshin rje'i skyes bu mang po'i snang bas mar gyi zang thal du 'gro/ gzhan rnams zhag zhe dgu'am bdun gsum dang bzhi 177

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/la sogs tshad ma nges/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags skye na mgo thur bstan du 'gro snang dang / dud 'gror skye na gog nas 'gro snang dang / lha mir skye na mgo gyen bstan du 'gro snang shar/ las kyi rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes yod pas gar 'gro nges med dang log lta dang log pa'i snang ba mang / sdug bsngal sna tshogs la spyad nas dri tsam gyi zas la brten/ yang dag ma yin 'du shes bcu 'byung ste/ bsod nams 'bring du bsags tha/ rnams skye gnas 'bring du 'dzin te rtswa'i spyil bur 'jug go snyam pa dang / bsod nams ma bsags pa skye gnas ngan pa rnams lo ma'i khyim du 'jug go snyam pa dang / rtsig pa'i bu gar 'dzul lo snyam pa sogs kyis/ bar do'i sdug bsngal gyis mtshams sbyar nas phyi ma'i sdug bsngal gyi mgo brtsam/ pha ma 'khrig pa spyod pa de thag ring nas mthong ste 'gro/ der phyin pa dang gal te phor skye na ma la chags/ pha la sdang ba 'byung / mor skye na pha la chags ma la sdang ba dang / chags sdang gnyis kyis pha ma'i khu khrag gi dbus su dri za nye bar len pa'i rnam shes zhugs te/ 'bras kyi khu ba'am zho'i spris ma lta bu bdun phrag dang po skor la mer mer po zangs tsha ba'i nang nas brngos pa tsam du sdug bsngal ba dang / mar 'khyags lta bu bdun phrag gnyis pa la nur nur po'i sdug bsngal/ srin bu grog ma 'dra ba bdun phrag gsum pa la ltar ltar po dang / de bzhin du mkhrang gyur dang / gor mo la sogs 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs kyi sdug bsngal mang po nyams su myong / rim pa dbang po thams cad rdzogs pa'i gnas skabs na/ mngal gyi nang dogs cing dri nga ba mun nag gi nang / btson khang tshud pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ kha zas tsha mo zos pas mes nang du bsregs pa 178

snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ da lta bu/ grang mo zos pas chu grang du bskyur ba lta bu/ nyal na ris non pa lta bu 'grangs na brag bar bcar ba lta bu/ bkres na g.yang lhung lta bu'i sdug bsngal sogs yod/ de nas zla grangs rdzogs nas btsa' dus las rlung gis mgo mjug bsgyur te/ btsa' sgor drangs pa na gyad stobs po che zhig gis rkang pa nas bzung ste rtsib ngor brgyab pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod/ rus pa'i bar nas byung tshe lcags kyi 'jur mig nas drangs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ sgo dogs pas bu shi ba'am/ yang na ma bu gnyis ka 'chi ba'am/ min kyang shi la thug pa'i sdug bsngal/ btsas nas stan du lhung dus tsher ma'i dong du lhang ba lta bu/ phru ma bshu dus gson pags bshus pa lta bu/ mi gtsang byi dor byed dus tsher lcag gis brabs pa lta bu/ pang du blangs dus bye'u khras khyer ba lta bu la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong / tsog pur bsnyal dus mi gtsang 'dam du tshud stog skom na tsha sogs ci byung yang ngu ba las med/ de ltar skyes nas lang tsho 'phel ba ltar snang yang don du 'chi ba la je nyer 'gro/ tshe gang zin med 'khor ba'i bya ba bsgrub nas sdig pa 'ba' zhig dang 'brel bas ngan song gi rgyu byed pa sogs dang gong gi sdug bsngal la bsam na lan gcig mngal du 'jug pa'ang sus nus da res ma sems can thams cad skye ba'i 'khor ba zad pa zhig bya dgos snyam du yang yang dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom / 'di la zhag gcigaganyis pa rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar na tshod 'phel te lang tsho dar la babs te dkar la dmar pa'i mdangs chags kun gyi yid du 'ong ba stobs rtsal dbang thang sogs 'gran du med par lta bur gyur kyang /179

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ —zin med 'khor ba'i bya ba phan chung nyes mang gi las la g.yeng nas ma tshor yengs ma lam du rgas pa'i grong sgo la slebs/ phyi 'byung bzhi rgud pas lus stobs nyams/ de yang dbang po nyams pas mig mi gsal bas gzugs mi mthong / rna bas sgra skad mi tshor/ rtses ro mi tshor zhing / smra ngag gi sdeb mi thon—/ yid kyis brjed nges dang bzod sran chung zhing bying 'thib che bas 'thom yo re ba gyur/ kha dog nyams pas gdong byad sngo sgog dang skya skam du song / gnyer mas gang / spa skya bor song / dbyibs nyams pas kha'i so lhung zas mi choms shing tshig ldab ldib tu smra/ drang por skyes pa'i lus de'ang sgur zhing khog yan lag 'khyog por song / lus kyi drod shor bas gos srab na mi dros/ 'degs byed kyi stobs nyams pas lji na mi theg 'dod pa'i longs spyod la dga' yang spyod pa'i mthu thed/ kun gyis brnyas pas yi muga'abyung ba 'khrugs pas nad dang gnod pa mang / yar ldangs mar bsnad 'gro 'dug bskul bskyod thams cad kyang mi nus bzhin du dka' bas byed pa la sogs sdug bsngal mtha' yas so/ /des na rgas pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod par 'chi bar smon yang / don du 'chi ba la nye bas shin tu skrag pa sogs sdug bsngal ngan song gi 'gro ba dang 'dra bar myong bas da ni rga shi med pa'i byang chub gcig 'grub par bya dgos snyam du yang yang bsgom pa spyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo / /'di'ang zhag gcigagasum pa na ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ lus 'di nyid 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can yin pas/ cha snyoms tshe stobs dang gzi mdangs lang tsho dar ba'i mi rgod ci lta bu zhig yin kyang / cha ma snyoms pa'i tshe phyi 'byung bzhi 180

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/'khrugs—/ nang rtsa rlung 'khrugs/ bar du lus rlung mkhris bad kan la sogs nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba'i sdug bsngal 'char/ gnyid bya ltar song bas mtshan mo gnyid mi 'ong / nyin mo nyin ring / 'khun pa g.yag ltar 'khun/ zug gzer me ltar 'bar yang bya thabs bral/ lus kyi stobs shor/mal gyi steng du kung / lus bsgrul bskyod tsam yang mi nus/ g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab gang du nyal yang mi bde/ dris lan khong pa'i gting nas skad ngag mi thon bzhin du smra/ zas skom gyi zhen pa bral/ sman gyi ro kha tsha skyur gsum dang gtar sreg gi sdug bsngal sogs mi 'dod bzhin spyod dgos/nad mi sos kyi dogs/ shi yi dogs/ gnyen bshes dang longs spyod sogs bral gyis dogs/ phyi ma ngan song du lhung gi dogs pa dang / gdon bgegs sogs kyis gnod pas rang gi rang gsod pa dang / mdze sogs nad ngan theb na gson yang shi ba dang 'dra bar mi'i khyu nas bud/ spyir nad pa kun rang g.yog rang gis mi nus/ rgyud snga las gyong nad tshig za bas gzhan g.yog la 'gu dka'/ yun ring na nad g.yog kyang sun nas ji bzhin mi nyan/ rus mgo pags pas g.yog shi mig gson la lta ba sogs sdug bsngal mtha' yas pas da res zug rdu thams cad dang bral ba'i thar pa mchog gi bdud rtsi thob par bya dgos snyam du yang yang blo sbyong byed dgos/'di yang zhag gcigabazhi pa 'ji ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'chi ba yid la med pa'i gnas skabs glo bur du 'chi nad drag pos thebs pas snying mi dga' rim gro rkyen bzlog gis mi phan/ sman dang dpyad mi zug 'chi ba ni shes pas shin tu 'ji/ṭwāṃ1/

tram̐ chen mtshosuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da phan pa'i thabs zad/ mal gyi tha ma na nyal/ zas kyi tha ma ni za yang yi gar mi 'ong / gtam gyi tha ma ni zlo/ gos kyi za la ni gon/ gnyen gyi tha mas ni bskor/ pho tshod dang snyems pa'i gdeng shor/ tshe 'dir spro yang sdod dbang ni med/ dbugs snga mas phyi ma ni mi slebs/ 'khrul snang dang gshin rje'i sun ma ni slebs/ skyas chen po 'degs la thug bshol ni mi thebs/ gnod gcod sdug bsngal ni rang kho nas myong / ma dran na dga' ba'i sdig dang rnam smin ni dran nas 'argyad pa dang skrag sngar skye/ dran na dga' ba'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni mi dran/ tshe 'di'i bu nor longs spyod mnga' thang 'khor grogs dpag med yod kyang khyer dbang dang khrid dbang ni med/ blos ni mi thong / rjes su ni mi 'brang / tha na gces pa skyong ba'i lus kyang shul du bzhag dgos pa'i dus/ sngar rang dbang yod dus 'chi chos ma 'aspub snyam pa'i blo 'argyad me ltar 'bar nas brang sgog dang lag pa 'thab nas brang sen rjes kyis bkang ba sogs ma shi gang nas ngan song gi sun ma speb te/ snang ba thams cad 'jigs spag dang tshor ba thams cad sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig skyes/ 'byung ba sdud dbugs ngar/ 'du shes 'khrul/mgo rkang lag lngas yob yob byed bzhin mig skya log ge gdong sngo ham me/ tshe 'di'i snang ba nub 'jig rten pha rol ni 'gro/ bar do'i snang ba rnams shar/mgon dang skyabs ni med/ gcer bu lag stong mchan du bcug nas 'gro dgos na/ de lta bu'i phyi ma'i lam chen ya nga ba der de ring gi nyi ma 'di tsam la'ang 'gro mi dgos pa'i gdeng ni su la'ang med/ gal te tshe lhag cung zad re yod ring 'dir phan nges pa'i lha chos rnam dag re brtson re ren te/ 'chi 182

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ba ni rgas gzhon su la 'ong nges par med pas/ da sngar yan chad 'chi ba ma dran pas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gnas mal dang zang zing la phyi tshis/ nye du dang 'brel can la sogs kyi ched du chags sdang thongs gsum gyi dus 'da' ba ni mtshang re che/ da ni tshe chos sgrub la snyoms pa zhig ma nus na nga re shi snyam pa'i dam bca'i 'phen pa drag po dang bcas yang yang dpyad 'jog bsgom/ 'di'ang zhag gcig goganyis pa la bzhi las dang po dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad kyi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ dgra dang ma 'phrad gong nas 'phrad kyi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal/phrad tsa na mi bub dogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ zhe ldang gi zug rngu mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal yod/ de yang phan pa med pa'i longs spyod dang 'byor ba thams cad la nyin mtshan rgyun du 'tsho skyong sogs brel do kho na'i ngang dus 'da' yang dgra dang thun mong du gyur te/ nyin gyi jag pa/ mtshan gyi nun ma/'phar spyang dang gcan gzan sogs kyis 'tshe bar bgyid de/ khyir longs spyod dang 'byor ba ni ci tsam yod pa de tsam du de bsags pa dang / bsung dang / spel ba sogs kyis sdug bsngal shin tu gdung bzhin rang la mi dbang ba'i khar tshe 'dir srog gi bdud du 'ong ba dang phyi ma ngan song gi rgyu las med pa dang / gser gyi snod dang mi mtshungs pa'i mi lus rin chen 'di don med sdig pa'i g.yog bkol du zad pas shin tu skyo ba dang / 'byor ba tha na rta gcig yod na sdug bsngal rta tsam mang po yod la/ 'byor ba med na 'di phyi kun tu bde zhing skyid pa dang 'jigs pa med pas sngon byon gyi rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin longs spyod nor gyi chags zhen thams cad rtsa ba 183ji

tram̐ chen mtshosuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da wanas bcad de/ jo bo bka' gdams pa'i gtad sa bzhi po phugs nor du bsten nas/ 'tsho ba bya tshol tsam la byas nas dben pa'i ri la dam chos kho na sgrub nas 'chi nus par zhig dgos snyam du 'phen pa dang bcas yang yang blo sbyongs/ 'di la zhag gcigaganyis pa gnyen byams pa dang bral gyi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal ni/'khor ba'i sems can thams cad rang phyogs la chags/ gzhan phyogs la snang / nye du 'khor 'bangs gnyen bshes kyi phyogs su zhen nas de dag dang ma bral tsa na'ang bral gyi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ bral tsa na rang nyid shi ba bas kyang thu ba'i sdug bsngal/ na shi'i bya byed dgos sgrub kyi sdug bsngal/ de rnams bral ba'i chos can yin pas phal cher shi ba'am yul gzhan du 'khyar ba dgra dang gnod pa la sogs nyen pa na/ de dag gi sdug bsngal de rang la byung ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ khyad par pha ma ni bu la brtse bas de la 'khyags stog skom pa dang 'gro 'dug bya byed na shi sogs kyi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal kho nas nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu mnar/ yang phan skyob spu tsam med pa ma zad 'di phyi kun tu gnod pa tshad med par byas/ chos phyogs nas bsam na pha ma sogs bu la brtse nas rgyu zas longs spyod byin/ chung ma bsus nas 'khor ba'i 'ching thag dang thel/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshong so nam byed tshul sogs sdig pa'i las thabs du ma bslabs/ ngan song gi gting nas mi thar ba zhig byed pas de dag las gnod pa med pas gnyen kyang gnyen du ma nges/bu dang bu mo sogs la tshe gang bsags pa'i rgyu zas longs spyod thams cad phongs med du byin kyang ngo so med/ yang byin kyang yang slong / rnam kun 184

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/lan chags kyi dgra lta bu las phan pa med/ des na bu dang bu mo sogs la zhen nas rang nyid khyad du gsad kyang rang gshis kyi dgra bo dngos dang 'dra bas skyo ba skye dgos pas yang yang dpyad 'jog thun du byas nas bsgom/'di'ang zhag gcigagasum pa 'dod pa thog tu mi khel pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'di ltar 'jig rten khams 'di na rang dang rang phyogs la bde skyid mi 'dod pa ni gcig kyang med rung de ltar 'dod pa ltar 'ong ba ni su yang med/ rgyal du re nas g.yul la phyin pas rang bsad pa dang / khe 'dod pas tshong la phyin pas dgras bcom ste sprang por gyur pa sogs tshe 'di'i bde skyid longs spyod rnyed bkur snyan grags sogs 'byung du re bas 'bad rtsol dang rtsol sgrub ji tsam byas kyang / rang la sngon gyi las dbang zhig med na 'phral du lto 'grangs pa tsam yang mi 'ong zhing / rang gzhan 'di phyi kun tu sdig sdug la sbyar/ grub nges pa ngan song gi gting nas mi thar ba zhig grub pa ma gtogs ci yang med/des na 'bad rtsol ri bo tsam byed pa las bsod nams me stag tsam bsags na dga' ba yin pas/ grub dus med pa 'khor ba'i bya byed kyis ci bya/ de la thog med nas da bar 'bad kyang sdug bsngal kho na las mi 'dug da sngon tshe 'di'i ched du mi tshe gcig gi stod smad la 'bad pa tsam/ chos la 'bad yod na da tsam sangs rgya ba'am min kyang ngan song gi sdug bsngal gtan nas myong mi dgos pa zhig ni 'grub nges/ da ni chos dang bla ma'i bka' drin las spang blang gi mtshams shes pa'i skabs 'dir 'grub dus med pa'i 'khor ba'i bya bzhag thams cad dug bzhin spangs nas 'grub nges pa dam pa'i chordo 8rdo

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/lam 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po ma sems can thams cad kyi don du mi med dben pa'i ri la dus da nas bzung ste 'chi la thug gi bar du brtson dgos snyam pa'i dam bca'i 'phen pa drag po dang bcas te yang nas yang du dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom/ 'di yang zhag gcigabazhi pa mi 'dod pa thog tu 'babs pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ gang zag su la yang sdug bsngal de rnams 'dod mkhan gcig kyang med na'ang / sngon gyi las dbang gis mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal de dag kho na la longs sbyod/dper na rgyal po'i mnga' ris/ phyug po'i bran 'khor rnams rang dbang skad cig med par mi 'dod bzhin du de dag gi dbang du gyur nas sdug bsngal du ma gtad kyang bya thabs bral/ de ma zad bza' tshang nye 'brel gnas mal longs spyod bde skyid snyan grags rnams dang mi 'dod bzhin du 'bral ba dang —/ khyad par bla ma mched grogs dal 'byor mi lus 'di yang mi 'dod bzhin du 'bral nges pas/ yid brtan med la/ khyad par snyigs ma las kyang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ gnas grogs longs spyod gang la bsam kyang mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ sdug bsngal gyi bsu skyes kho nas mnar ba'i tshul rnams la zhib tu bsam nas/ gang la yang yid brtan med cing sdug bsngal ba'i rgyu 'bras las ma 'das pas tshe 'di don med sdug bsngal gyi gdos thag bcad de/ 'di phyi phan nges pa'i lha chos bsha' ma re sgrub snyam du dam bca' dang bcas yang yang dpyad 'jog ca/ shes drin dran sogs dang 'brel bas bsgom/ 'di'ang zhag gcigades na mi yul gling bzhi'i 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag rang cag 'dzam 186

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/bu'i gling par skyes pa rnams da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bde ba'i gnas skabs spu tsam yang med pas sdug bsngal kho na la spyod/ da dung lo dang zla ba zhag dang dus tshod snga dro dang phyi 'phred tsam re song bzhin dus je snyigs bskal ba wān/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sems can gyi bde skyid thams cad rimaci ba bzhin nyams dma' ba la bsam nas skyo ba bskyed/ mdor na 'khor ba'i sdug bajil tsam go nas spang 'dod tsam yod pas phyi mar ngan song lta ci lha yi bde ba'ang thob 'dod tsam med kyang / tshe 'di'i btsan phyug snyan grags la yid smon 'chor ba dang / 'khor khyim sbrul gdug pa'i tshang lta bu la zhabs 'debs dang / chos phyi bshol du lus na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma shes pa'i rtags yin pas mi la sdug bsngal mang ba dang bde skyid nyi tshe ba la yid brtan med pa dang / sdig pa'i rnam smin shin tu gyi ba rnams la zhib tu bsam nas tshe 'di blos thong ba zhig gal shin tu che'o/ /lnga pa mtho ris kyi gnas gnyis pa lha min gyi sdug bsngal ni/ gnas ri rab kyi nang nas mar gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar yod/ dpal 'byor longs spyod pod kyang 'phen byed mi dge ba nga rgyal phrag dog gis 'phangs pa'i rgyus/lus de grub pa tsam nas phrag dog gi 'du shes rags/ rang gi sde ris phan tshun yang mi mthun pas 'thab rtsod kho nas dus 'da'/ yar lha la dpal 'byor longs sbyod yod pa dang / dpag bsam shing las 'dod rgu 'byung ba shes nas de'i rtsa ba rang yul na yod pas/ phrag dog mi bzod pa skyes nas 'thab tu 'gro/ 'thab pa'i tshe lha min rnams bsod nams mthu chung bas mi 'greng bdun tsam dma'/ lha rnams kyis rdo rje dang mdung thung dang mda' bo 187

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/che la sogs char bzhin 'bebs pa sa gsod pa dang / brdog pa dang / yan lag gcod pa'i sdug bsngal drag po 'byung / mgo bo bcad pa ma gtogs lha rnams lha'i bdud rtsis gso bas mi 'chi/ lha min rnams mi ltar gnad sa gang du phog kyang 'chi bas rtag tu pham/ lha'i glang po'i sna la ral gri'i 'khor lo btags pas lha min 'bum phrag du ma gsod pa sogs rtag par 'thab rtsod kho na la spyod/ de'i gzugs brnyan gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du kun snang zhes pa'i mtsho la shar bas dmag ma log pa'i gong nas nye du rnams mya ngan gyis gdung bar bshad cing / de'ang lha min rnams la rigs bzhi ste/ tshe dpal lha'i rigs/ gdug pa klu'i rigs/ srog gcod srin po'i rigs/stobs ldan gnod sbyin gyi rigs te phal cher nag po'i phyogs kho na las med/de'i phyir lha min gyi gnas na yang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa'i tshul la snying thag pa nas skyo ba dang bcas yang yang snying rje chen pos bsgom zhing dam bca' dang 'phen pa drag tu bya'o/ /'di la zhag gnyis/drug pa mtho ris kyi gnas gsum pa lha'i sdug bsngal ni/ gnas ni rim rab bang ri bzhi ni rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha gnas gnas shing gser ri dang ri dang nags tshal gyi lha nyi zla sogs kyi lha rnams 'di'i khongs su gtogs/ 'dod lha'i gnas dang po yin/ ri rab kyi steng dbus rnam rgyal pho brang brgya byin gnas sogs sum cu rtsa gsum zer/ 'di gnyis sa la brten pa'i 'dod lha yin/ de'i steng 'thab bral/ de'i steng dga' ldan/ grong las dgon pa'i tshul yid dga' chos 'dzin na rgyal tshab byams pa bzhugs/de'i steng 'phrul dga'/ de'i steng gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha gnas yod/188

snyingathigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ da 'di bzhi nam mkhu' la gnas pa'i 'dod lha ste drug go /spyir gson pa'i gnas skabs bde skyid longs spyod yod kyang 'dod yon la rnam par g.yeng bas chos sgrub blo mi skye/ bskal pa gnas kyang skad cig gi snang ba'ang med par yengs ma lam la tshe zad de 'chi la thug 'dod lha drug po gang yin kyang 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal myong dgos/ de rnams 'chi ba nye ba na 'chi ltas lnga po rim gyis shar bas 'chi bar shes te sdug bsngal/ ma rmos pa'ilo tog yal/khrus kyi rdzing bu yang skem/ 'dod 'jo'i ba yang shi /dpag bsam sdong po'ang skem—/ lha zla bo dang lha'i bu mo rnams kyis kyang 'chi bar shes nas drung du mi nye / rgyang nas me tog 'thor te smon lam btab/ rang gcig pur lus pa dang / phyi ma gar skye shes pas sdug bsngal ba'i gnas su skye ba mthong nas 'pho ba'i sdug bsngal ma sangs bzhin nyung ba'i sdug bsngal nya bye tshan la bsgres pa lta bu'i 'o dod 'bod bzhin lha'i zhag bdun du myong nas sdod dgos / de'ang shi nas lhar skye ba ni srid mtha' tsam ste mir skye ba'ang ches nyung / phal cher ngan song du skye la/ de'i sdug bsngal myang dgos par shes nas—/ 'pho nyung gi sdug bsngal gnyis kyis mya ngan sems la zug pas dmyal ba las kyang thu ste/ dran pa nye bzhag las/ lha yi gnas nas skung ba yis/ /sdug bsngal rab tu skye ba gang / /de la sems can dmyal ba yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang lha bsod nams che chung gis sems spa bskang ba dang / gnas nas skyod pa'i sdug bsngal dang /'dod lha 'og ma gnyis dus rtag tu lha min dang 'thab cing rtsod pas lus gcod pa dang gsod pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myang dgos so/ /189

tram̐ chen mtshophuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ dngha khams gong ma gzugs dang gzugs med gnyis na 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal mngon gyur pa med kyang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal las ma 'das/'phen byed kyi las zad nas gnyid sad pa dang mda' nam mkha' 'phangs pa'i shugs zad pa bzhin gnas ris 'og mar lhung nas sdug bsngal rgyun mi chad pa myong dgos pas lha yi lus thob kyang yid brtan med pas ci bya/ de bas thar ba mchog gi go 'phang zhig sems can gyi don du thob par zhig bya rshaṭwāṃṭī /snyam du spyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo/ /'di'ang zhag khyon 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs zhag nyer brgyad do/ /de ltar 'gro ba'i gnas rigs drug po 'di dag gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/sdug bsngal gyi yo langs/ sdug bsngal gyi 'khrul 'khor kho na las ma 'das pas/ me'i 'obs/ srin mo'i gling / mtshon cha'i rtse mi gtsang ba'i khang pa lta bu bde ba'i go skabs spu tsam med par yin pa'i tshul rnams la zhib tu bsams nas/ 'khor ba'i gnas ris 'di la ya ki srid rtse nas ma ki dmyal ba gdan la thug pa yan chad gang du skyes kyang skyid pa dang bde ba'i go skabs cung zad med pa spyir shes dgos pa ma zad/ khyad par mi yul gyi bye brag rang gi pha yul dang zhing khang pha ma spun grogs nye 'brel dang nor rdzas longs spyod sogs 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs rang bzhin sdug bsngal skyid bde nyi tshe ba 'gyur ba sogs la zhib tu bsam nas snying po mi 'dug snyam du zhen pa gting nas log pa mkhris nad can la btso zan byin pa lta bu zhig dgos te/ mdor na rnam grangs du mas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la go lo thos lor mi bzhag par 190

snying thigazhagabargya'isgomarim/ da byākāthopashā'agyur bathonapa'amabloyarati bskyed 'aṭwāṃ bte zhig bsgoṭwāṃ nas 'asbyag ste 'a / zlo thams cad la skye snarsha napy-i ga thar batshe lasdo ṭwāṃ sa sha 'a// bachokṣiṃdag ṭwāṃr bye ṭā ga da dgos/kho 'i trī byab sha mi nga na zlo cho lta bumi kā da de byas kyang slara'i 'chor ba na mazhi ṭās pa sdu sdi 'i ṭwāṃ/ nyesaṭwāṃdaṭwāṃpa sa zlong dag ṭwāṃ ga sha stsosu nasbyal phyipy-ire domadang 'al gas tāng da lakṣiṃ lto da par bya snyid po mes ṭwāṃs tharshas trīd rgyang trī ra nas ṭār rsha —rag la kā tā paji kā pa ṭwāṃ nyes kyaṭwāṃ da shābs sdo/kho lta /lha / la 'angab rgyu 'askyer ba sa tāgarsha maso pa 'a na pa thag pa nas rgyud la ma the bar sna bam das 'i/ / ba pathelasaṭwāṃ'arnyis bsamatho pa /deng ṭwāṃ bkau pa sdukā bsngasnamu ra tso gid pagro 'ar ba ma kāmanabye dag pe ba / ṭwāṃ da ban sadabang saṅgimibarshakā/ rgyupy-i dpa gzhanayarshasdid/ rnamapa da du ṭwāṃ ge ṭwāṃphyo na la rshan nas 'a/nga ṭwāṃkā da ga rgyu 'arnyis na dgo gardo spang nga/ste da bami snaṭwāṃ sgrub pa la nga gawakaspra 'bad das/ la gsumakyi/ sparshabya da las/ bsgrub gā /da/ ba las/ thams cad las rang ban du bstan pa dang gsum /rdo// //)/ /rdoX////rdo //spyi///ste/gedaṭwāṃ lade rgyu dang 'bras ṭwāṃr baṅgim ༵ gsalasdodang / ra dri the las la mu mtha' kyitā pa geg da nakāng thamaṭā cad bsakās — nas bsdu na/ lus da ba gsum gas bcu/ /dang 9 la

tram̐ chen mtshophuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da wa— —srog gcod ma byin len 'dod log dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sbyor ba sems bskyed pa sogs sngar dang 'dra/ 'di ltar mi dge ba thams cad kyi las kun nas slong byed dug gsum yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ 'dod chags zhe ldang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba'o/ /zhes pas dug gsum po ngo bo nyid kyis mi dge ba dang / des bslang ba'i las la mtshungs ldan gyi mi dge ba zhes bya/ nyon mongs pa de dag yul yid 'ong las 'dod chags/ mi 'ong ba las zhe sdang bar ma las gti mug rnams 'byung la/ kun slong de gsum gang rung gi sgo nas mi'am dud 'gro la sogs gzhi sems can de ma nor bar shes pa/ de la bsam pa gsod sems skyes pa/ gri mda' sogs kyis sbyor ba gsod thabs lag tu blang nas gnad la bsnun pa/ de dag lus sems kyi tshogs pa gyes nas mthar srog dbang 'gag par byed na yan lag rdzogs pas nyes pa lci/ spyir sems can thams cad la srog las gces pa med pas nyes pa che la de las kyang dkon mchog gi rten bzhengs pa dang /dge ba sogs la bsnyad btags nas srog gcod sdig pa'i las byed pa ni lhag par yang snyi'o/ /de las kyang pha ma gsod pa dang / dgra bcom pa gsod pa gsum ni mtshams med kyi las te bar do med par mnar med du 'gro ba'i rgyu yin/ mi gsod pa ni pham pa'i rgyu'ang yin/ ma zad srog bcad gong na sdig gzhan med zer ba ltar nyes dmigs shin tu che/ da lta bla ma dang dpon po bza' dpon dang bag ma sogs ni dngos sam brgyud nas srog gcod kyi nyes pa chen pos gos pa gsungs par bzhin mngon sum yin la/des na shan pa sogs lta ci smos/ lar mi thams cad kyis rkang 'og nas 'bu 192

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/rngodapa ṭwāṃng /sa pa'i dus ṭwāṃd ṭwāṃṭwāṃ tshul du gsod pa sogs mthong dnga'i ma ma ngabapobadapa ṭwāṃngs sa sod/ gzhanayang pha ma dngaso'adrab ma rgan rnaṭwāṃs ṭwāṃbyed nasade zaṭā gas dang pho/ bshas lug gas bsad das sha 'daṭwāṃ kā da pa 'aṭwāṃl duza dpakābasaman/ ga/na /sdu/ dang na nyi lapy-i kyarsha thutsha/ gaṭā bsadi nas gsod rgyu kā gru yang sog na lakā gas sa sdu ra ṅgi na/ sa na gad pa dadngha gtā ca/shākā pa / yomajug rang ma sdokhan rshacasatso thaṭwāṃs casdo la ga ༵ tsā 'dra ṭāradapatrī/drilas sbyig gami sha 'a ṭwāṃ thug da pha shes ldan ra skya kun sa tsam yang na chad gsol ba dam le re rtsa(tha maraX//nga khas ṭwāṃ le mad ṭwāṃchal/po thome kyi tsusto sa pa man na pa /sorgyal lta bupy-i ba bye 'o btsan ṭwāṃgaṭwāṃ gi pa py-ing le/ dmag la gas pas das su 'akā kā ba thogs dirangasaman narnyidang/byerkunaṭwāṃlta bus bdag byis maleng sar zas blangs bdaṭwāṃ da kā 'jab /sna ma sbyi paran pa mchog dngapy-ib// la /sna pakyi skabs bye ༵༵ bslu da ṭwāṃn dasdo /dang lta/ ga ṭwāṃgasayi pa gaṭwāṃ sa phangol rgyurdzas na pa /sa len yi par rnyi pa min/ sa na das ༵ rku bakṣiṃ sakhegapy-inarnaṭwāṃs ba rdog na kāphal sa ṭwāṃsam yang /gyigashe sgyus gong tsam da bskusaṭwāṃdasadangakhyadasbyipakātrīn sa sa das pa ma zad//dri/kā gā kā /mas ṭwāṃng ṭwāṃ ba ra gzugasare brnya/ 'chang ba rnapy-is te nga la bal bar thugs bsam bas na dga' sdu /

tram̐ chen mtshophuchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da ———rtag tu de la g.yeng nas slob gnyer sgrib sbyong sogs rnam dkar gyi chos la blo mi phyogs pa ma zad dus khoms kyang med la/ khyad par tshe 'di kho na la zhen pas nges 'byung gi sgo 'gag rgyun du g.yo sgyu'i bsam ngan 'ba' zhig la gnas pas phan sems byang chub sem sa dang rgyab 'gal ba dang / tha na mtshan mo nyal dus kyang tshong rtsis gtong nas rtag tu 'khrul ba'i gzhan dbang du 'gro/ mi ring pa ngan spyod sna rgya la 'jug nas las kyi mtha' log pa sogs 'byung bas rtsa ba nas spong dgos/ dge tshul slong dang dge bsnyen yang dag rnams kyis nu ba dngos sgor gcig tsam byas na sdom pa rtsa ba nas nyams na tshong sogs chen pos lta ci smos/ ma byin len 'di yang sdis pa'i yan lag bzhi sngar ltar yod/ rku rngon 'gro mi la gro chas phran bu re'i skal skur yod kyang gsod brkus nyes pa thams cad la nyam po yod pas spong dgos/ gsum pa log g.yem ni/ tshangs spyod dge bsnyen yan chad rab byung rnams kyis mi tshangs spyod rtsa ba nas spong dgos pas zhib par gzhan du blta nas shes dgos/ 'di ni khyim pa'i khrims yin pas khyim pa yin kyang khrims dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ log g.yem de'i nyes pa che shos gzhan gyi sdom pa gtong ba'i rkyen byas pa dang / gzhan yang rang gi khu ba phyung ba dang / gzhan gyis bdag pa dang / gla brngan sprad tshar pa dang / rang dbang yin kyang nyin mo dang —/ bsnyen gnas bsrungs ba dang / na ba dang sbrum ma dang / mya ngan gyis non pa dang / zla mtshan yod pa dang / bang ma sang ba dang / dkon mchog gi rten yod sar bsgrod pa dang / pha ma dang rigs kyis srung ba dang /ma smin pa'i gzhon nu ma dang / kha dang bshang lam la sogs par bsgrod pa 194

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/stasheyul dus gnas skatrīs ṭwāṃ sgo /sa logaspyo g.yema'i gyise rnamapa tha dad pa yod //shā sa /sa sdug bsngal rgyu da ba la da pa mas can la byams ////zu // 1)//ji 1 / lha / 1(1 111 gsapa ngaṭwāṃ bye ba bzhilasadang rdzun la gsum las dang dkuṭwāṃ bslu rshas sa rang ༵ṭwāṃ rdzun / ba thamakā cad kā rdzun phal pa thosang/gsadepadame ba la phanaso na da/ gaṭwāṃl sapa da/ ṭāg // sdo da/chengan nganasbyibasngal dache/ sangs rgyasal na ba tho las bshād ṭwāṃbakādapa~X rdzuṭwāṃ na podang/ gasbyam sha lo bapa~X ba/ man sad ṭwāṃkā da dī ba lta ṭī rang ṭwāṃ da na tan tod ṭwāṃ ltaṭā smra ba thamaṭwāṃ caṭwāṃ dho bla ma rdzun na/ demar pasdu nga kā na/ nibakā gagaṅgi pa la ༵skur pa 'bas ༵/kyigamisapaphraṭwāṃnyi/ mnaphrayogaphra gasna la/rgya/dadang nga da sa mashān gas mnyam sdo da pa ṭwāṃ 'as la de da mji dang /mi gnasaṭwāṃnasmras ṅgi dadngha'altarabyaṭwāṃn/ni tsa 'i 'dra minayi pa ltar da da~X sa macin rnyim phramasodardo stodakyi de jiṭwāṃ/bye da mthun sdo galho// gdig dru/du ṭwāṃ ro/zhes la gden nyid kyang / byes kā 'a tāng 'a / bu ra lha nyaranatrī/sho snasaphramasalhadapalamigaphra ra/bye dag las ste sa go sa dkyi 'asdonabyen ṭwāṃ thupy-is mthupy-i paṭwāṃ da pa dang /ma'i ra kṣiṃng sngakās mi sa na pabye bla sdo ṭwāṃr danyen dache dī dang /rmo phan na mthun par da pa na tu sa pa / /sdusdum

tre chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/pa tshig cab ni/ pha rol la mtshang nas brjod pa dang / skyon brjod dang ngan du smras pa thams cad de/ dper na skyon du yod pa rnams la/ long ba/'on pa/ rkang chag sogs su brjod pa lta bu dang / ngag 'jam po yin yang don gyis pha rol po'i yid mi bde bar byed pa'i tshig rnams kyang tshig tsub tu 'du la/ gzhan yang bla ma dam pa'i drung du bla ma dang mched grogs sogs la mi snyan pa sna tshogs brjod na khyad par du nyes pa shin tu che'o/ /bzhi pa ngag kyal ni/ gong du gsum po ma yin pa'i nyon mongs can gyi ngag glu sgrung /bud med dang dmag dang chom rkun la sogs chags snang skye ba'i gtam mang po 'azel thed du smra ba sogs thams cad yin/ khyad par gzhan gyis chos nyan 'chad byed pa dang / kha rton dang bzlas brjod byed pa dang / dbe 'dun gyi tshogs gral nas ngag 'khyal sna tshogs smras nas mang po'i dge tshogs gcig gis gcog pa dang / cho ga'i bsnyen mtshams su ngag 'khyal smra ba dang /rang gis dge spyor ngag 'chal dang bsres nas byed pa sogs ni/ rang dang gzhan/ 'di dang phyi ma thams cad la gnod pas bla ser rnams kyis khyad par du dug ltar spangs nas rgyun du smra ba bcad pa'am nyung na legs 'dugagasum pa yid kyi mi dge ba la'ang gsum las dang po brnab sems ni/gzhan gyi rgyu sa yid du 'ong ba la de nga'i yin na ci ma rung / de ngas lon thabs zhig ci drag snyam du yang dang yang du yid tsam gyis gzhan nor la 'dod pa skyes pa thams cad yin/ gnyis pa gnod sems ni/ gzhan la zhe sdang dang / khong khro'i soms kyis ngas 'di la gnod pa 'di lta bu bya'o snyam pa dang / gzhan gyi dpal dang 'byor ba la mi dga' zhing / 'di 'di tsam 1pyi6

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/tsho bde nasnaskyid na/ jinatan 'di lta shāmed kā ci ma rung snyam pano sogs//sdo/ sdu gad pa byung na do la dga' ba zlom dngha gsako gzhanacho lagad tshu trī pathamasacad //gsusnapa ga lta yo/ nganasdi mag gaspram la tan dpar lta ba ṭwāṃng / da ba la phan phyiṭwāṃ dang / ga pa la sa pa theb nas rgyu 'bras sod paraltab dang/ py-ibathamasacad baṭwāṃnango/rte da dang dbang phyugado gas rtag pa lta ba trīng /yo sa thamardo cad glu da ma 'a rdos trīng ba 'ad pa chad lta // gas da/zhi dag 'igazhung ste zhes trī su zhugs pa'am/ 'inakyangarangaban ṭwāṃ rgyaṭwāṃbanobaka' rtse blon bla ma lung /sgromakhazlo pa gzhung gang la yazlo bayin no snyam ṭwāṃ smo rna/ za ba dazlo / snyi zeskur dpalothams /dkyang galta cinaskye/ / cu las ga lta to dī ba ltar ga spra rgyuhā lha skad gag rtes kya~X sto gi sa cad gaṭwāṃ 'a/minatrī pa trīr da/ daspranaṭwāṃn myukā/ getharabazlopy-i/ 'bye/ sogapab/gas pa yul da pa da ba zlocu dang py-i ba snas ṭwāṃ ba tu yang yangabaṭwāṃm saṭwāṃ'aṭwāṃ ba/gas/ sonachadaspyom ṭwāṃs/sesdugabasngal rgyu tsā thosnyi trīn pa rsha babacu garsha la da pa'i py-i ṭwāṃs zlon shāms sko nga mi drasna / bam ṭwāṃs bdag ldos dam paci sa 'ar sgyuratrīnarshad /mas kāpalas gathub/ martsorung / shābapasdo ma ga nga nas 'arshab ma chong bar du rnyi/sa sa ṭwāṃkā par byazhi/ / ba kha 'grub rdzur dasgon mag gsum ma snyam pa 'al ba ba dang sa zhag gag bam/ 97

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/rjes kyi bya ba rnams 'dra/ mi dge bcu'i nang bsres nyes pa che shos ni/'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzod kyi mdo las/ 'od srung pha yang yin la rang sangs rgyas kyang yin pa gsod pa 'di ni srog gcod pa'i nang nas ma rung ba'o/ /dkon mchog gi dkor 'phrog pa 'di ma byin len pa'i nang nas ma rung ba'o/ /ma yang yin la dgra bcom ma'ang yin pa la nyal bo byas pa 'di 'dod pa'i nang nas ma rung ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la bskur ba 'debs pa 'di ni rdzun du smra ba'i nang nas ma rung ba'o/ /dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa 'di ni phra ma'i nang nas ma rung ba'o/ /'phags pa rnams la mi snyan par brjod pa 'di ni tshig rtsub por smra ba'i nang nas ma rung ba'o/ /chos thos par 'dod pa rnam par g.yeng bar 'dod pa 'di ni tshig kyal ba'i nang nas ma rung ba'o/ /yang dag par song ba dang zhugs pa rnams kyi rnyed pa 'phrog par bsam pa 'di ni brnab sems kyi nang nas ma rung ba'o//mtshams med pa byed pa ni gnod soms kyi nang nas ma rung ba'o/ /lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa ni log rtog gi nang nas ma rung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu la bsam pa la/ mi dge ba bcu po'i 'bras bu ni re re la'ang bzhi bzhi yod de/ rnam smin dang / rgyu mthun dang / dbang gi dang / skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ bcu po gang yin kyang kun slong zhe sdang gis byas na dmyal bar skye/ 'dod chags kyis byas na yi dwags/ gti mug gis byas na dud 'gro skyes nas sdug bsngal so sor myong dgos/ yang kun slong chags sdang 198

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/rmongs gsum shin tu chen po dang rgyun ring pos las bsags na dmyal ba/'bring gis yi dwags/ chung ngus dud 'gror skye ba yin no/ /skyes na yun ring sdug bsngal myong dgos te/ dper na yul khyad par can la tshig ngan smras pas bram ze ser skya'i lo rgyus lta bu dang / sems can gcig gi srog bcad kyang bar gyi bskal pa zhig dmyal bar gnas dgos par mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs pas sngar byas la 'gyod bshags phyin chad sdom sems/ der skyes pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje drag po bsgoms nas dge bar brtson par gal che'o/ /gnyis pa rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu ni rnam smin myong nas ngan song las thar te mi'i lus rten la gtso bo myong ba yin la/ dbye na byed pa rgyu mthun dang myong ba rgyu mthun gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngon srog gcod pa zhig na da lta yang srog gcod la dga' bas chung dus nas 'bu sbrang sogs mthong tshad gsod pa dang / sngar ma byin len pa zhig yin na da yang rku la dga' ba'i mi lta bu bcu bo so sor dang 'dra ba'i las la ngang gis dga' ba yin/ der ma zad dud 'gro rnams la yang / khra dang spyang ki sogs ni gsod la dga'/ byi ba sogs kyi la dga' ba rnams kyang byed pa rgyu mthun yin/ gnyis pa myong ba rgyu mthun ni/ bcu po re re la'ang gnyis gnyis te/ sems can gcig gi srog bcad kyang srog lan lnga brgya 'jal dgos pa sogs mtshon sngon srog gcod pas da lta tshe bung ba byis pa chung ngu 'phral la 'chi ba lta bu dang / nad mang ba mi kha cig tshe gang por nad kyis mi gtong ba lta bu yin/ ma byin par blangs pas longs spyod dbul ba ni mi tshe tshong dang rku jag dkor la zad kyang 199
