tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/mi phan pa'i dbul phongs can rnams lta bu yin pa ma zad tshe rabs phyi ma'ang yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal myong dgos pa dang tshe 'di yang je dbul je sprang 'gro bas 'bad rtsol bas bsod nams chung ngu la 'bad na dga' nges/ cung zad re rnyed na yang 'phrog shor ba sogs dgra zla dang thun mong bar 'gyur/log g.yem gyis khyim thabs mi mjos shing lhod pa can dang / dgra zla lta bu 'byung bar gsungs pas log g.yem spong zhing sngon las la bsam nas bza' 'khrugs mi byed par bzod bsran bskyed dgos/ rdzun smras pas rang la skur 'debs mang ba dang / gzhan gyis bslu bar byed pa mang ba yin pas rang la ma nyes kha yog sogs byung na de la rtsod pa sogs mi byed par sngon las 'dzad pa yin pas drin che snyam du dga' ba sgom dgos/ phra ma byas pas 'khor g.yog mi mthun pa dang / bdag nyid la grwa 'khor sogs kyis rgol ba mang ba yin pas las la 'gyod bshags sogs byed dgos/ tshig cab smras pas rtag tu mi snyan pa thos shing / rang gi smras pa yang 'thab mo'i tshig tu gyur ba yin pas rtas tu 'jam por smra ba la bslab dgos/ ngag bkyal smras pas rang gi drang por smras kyang gzhan gyis bden du mi 'dzin pas tshig mi btsun pa dang /mang po'i nang du gtam bshad lta bu rang nyid sgobs pa chung ba 'byung ba yin/brnab sems kyis yid la bsam pa mi 'grub cing mi 'dod pa thog tu 'babs/ gnod soms kyis 'jigs spag dang 'tshe ba mang / log ltas lta ngan la gnas shing / g.yo sgyus rang gi sems 'khrugs pa 'byung ngo / /gsum pa dbang gi 'bras bu ni/ yul la smin pa ste/ srog gcod kyis sa phyogs nyams mi dga' zhing g.yang sa can sogs srog la garnad pa can du 200

da snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/skye/ ma byin blangs pas lo tog la sad ser sdang / ljon shing la 'bras bu mi chags/ mu ge yod sar skye/ log g.yem gyis bshang rtsi dang 'dam rdzab sogs yid mi 'ong sar gnas dgos/ rdzun gyis 'byor ba mi brtan zhing rtag tu shes pa rtabs shing skrag pa'i yul rkyen dang 'phrad/ phra mas yul gcong rong can la sogs bgrod dka' bar gnas dgos/ tshig cab kyis tsher ma can la sogs sa phyogs yid mi bde bar skye ngag 'khyal gyis so nam byas kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung / dus tshig log cing mi brtan par skye/ brnab sems kyis lo tog nyes shing gnas dus ngan pa'i sdug bsngal mang po 'byung /gnod sems kyis rtag tu 'jigs pa dang 'tshe ba mang ba'i yul du skye/ log ltas 'byor ba nyung zhing skyabs dang dpung gnyen med par skye/bzhi ba skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu ni/ mi dge ba'i las gang byas pa de mang por 'phel nas/ skye dang tshe rabs rnams su sdug bsngal mu mtha' med par brgyud pa dang / slar yang las ngan gong nas gong du 'phel nas 'khor ba mu mtha' med par 'khyams par 'gyur ba yin pas blo ldan rnams kyis 'bras bu'i sdug bsngal 'di rnams la yang dang yang du zhib par dpyad nas blo sbyong nan tan byed dgos/ 'di'ang zhag gcigade ltar rgyu mi dge ba dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal so sor la dpyad pa gting tshugs pa song na da gzod rgyu 'bras gnyis rang rang so sor tho gtug nas yang dang yang du dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom pa 'di'ang zhag gcigades na 'bras bu sdug bsngal mi zad par bskyed byed kyi rgyu sdig pa mi dge ba bcu sogs ni dug dang 'dra bas zhe thag pa nas tha na mi lam du'ang 201

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/mi byed pa'i smon 'dun gyi 'phen pa drag pos spong dgos te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ de ltar mi dge bcu po dug 'dra bas/ /sems shes rnams kyis rab tu spangs 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na ngos lkog gang du'ang spangs nas lha dang bla ma sogs kyis mi khrel ba zhig gal che ste/ ji skad du/ ma mthong bzhin du sdig pa byed pa dag /dug zos bzhin du bde bar mi 'gyur te/ /lha dang rnal 'byor ldan dang de bzhin du/ /rnam dag mig gis mi mthong mi srid do/ /zhes par ltar ro/ /gnyis pa bsgrub bya dge ba'i las la yang rgyu 'bras gnyis las dang po ni/khyir bsgrub bya dge ba'i las de bsam gyis mi khyab pa mu dang mtha' med pa zhig yod na'ang / de bsags pa'i sgo nas bsdu na lus kyi dge ba gsum sogs kun nas slong bar byed pa de la/ rin chen phreng ba las/ ma chags mi sdang gti mug thed/ /des bskyed las ni dge ba'o/ /zhes pas/ mi dge bcu sgrub mi nyan bsam nas phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi dge bcu mi byed bsam pa'i dam bca' de mi dge ba bcu thong gi tshul khrims yin/ des na rang bzhin du srog mi gcod pa lta bus mi 'ong bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang dkon mchog gi rten la sogs pa'i drung nas blangs na mchog go min kyang gnas dus soms can 'di dang 'di lta bu'i srog mi gcod snyam pa sogs sdom pa yang dag par blangs pas kyang chog gal te gtan nas spong mi nus pa'i khyim pa rnams kyis kyang lo zla zhag la sogs par dam bca' byas na'ang phan yon che bas shes nas spong dgos/ de'i phyir dathe/ ba bcu zhes pa ni/ mi dge ba bcu spangs shing de'i gnyen po dkar po'i phyogs nyams su 202

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/len pa de yin/ dge bcu khyad par ba ni/ srog gcod spangs nas sems can gyi srog bskyab pa dang / ma byin len spangs nas sbyin pa gtong ba dang /'dod log spangs nas tshul khrims bsrung pa dang / rdzun spangs nas bden par smra ba dang / phra ma spangs nas 'khon pa skum pa dang / tshig tsub spangs nas snyan par smra ba/ ngag 'khyal spangs nas kha ton byed pa/ brnab sems spangs nas gtong sems 'chang ba/ gnod sems spangs nas phan sems bsgom pa dang / log lta spangs nas yang dag pa'i lta ba rgyud la bsten pa rnams yin pas zhib tu dpyad nas rang rgyud la 'dris par byed dgos pas 'phen pa dang dga' ba sogs drag tu bsgom/ 'di la zhag gcigaganyis pa dge ba'i 'bras bu la'ang sngar ma ltar bzhi bzhi yod pas dang po rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni/ dge bcu sgrub pas rnam smin mtho ris gsum gang rung du skye/ de yang ma chags pa'i dge ba'am dge ba chen po bsam gzugs kyi ting nge 'dzin dang 'brel na khams gong ma/ zhe sdang med pa'i dge ba'am 'bring bo 'dod lhar/ las 'bras la ma rmongs pa'i dge ba'am/dge bcu chung ngus mir skye bar gsungs/ 'dod chags sogs dug gsum dang 'dres ma'i dge bas rim par bkres 'phong mi/ 'thab rtsod lha min/'pho cing 'do da lha gsum du skye bar yang bshad do/ /gnyis pa rgyu mabun ni/ byed pa rgyu mthun tshe rabs thams cad du dge ba byed pa la spro zhing dge ba gong 'phel du 'gyur/ myong ba rgyu mthun ni/srog gcod spangs pas tshe ring zhing nad nyung / ma byin len spangs pas longs spyod dang ldan zhing dgra rkun med/ 'dod log spangs pas khyim thabs 203

tram̐ chen mtshoguchosagrwa'idapetshogs/ da mdzes shing dgra zla nyung / rdzun spangs pas kun gyis bstod cing byams/ phra ma spangs pas 'khor g.yog gus/ tshig rtsub spangs pas snyan par thos/ngag 'khyal spangs pas tshig btsun/ brnab sems spangs pas bsam don 'grub/ gnod sems spangs pas 'tshe ba dang bral/ log lta spangs pas lta ba bzang po rgyud la skye/gsum pa dbang 'bras ni/ yul la smin pas sngar mi dge ba'i 'bras bu de dag las ldog ste phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis 'byor bar 'gyur ba yin/bzhi pa skyes bu gyed 'bras ni/ dge ba'i las gang byas pa de mngon par 'phel nas/ bsod nams rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba yin pas bde ba'i sna/ rsha sbya dhidi rnams la yang yang dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom/ 'di la'ang dge ba'i rgyu 'bras so sor tho gtug nas zhag gcig sngar ltar bsgom/gsum pa thams cad las kyi rang bzhin du bstan pa ni/ 'di ltar 'khor ba'i bde sdug dang mtho dman mi 'dra bar thams cad kyang sngon rang rang gi las dge sdig bsags pa 'ba' zhig gis byas pa yin la/ da lta dge sdig mi 'dra sna tshogs byas pas 'phral du mi mngon yang tshe phyi ma rnams su las byas pa chud mi za/ ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad par las dkar nag kho nas rjes su 'brangs nas 'khor ba'i gnas su myong ba'i dus la babs tshe bde sdug sna tshogs par zin pa'i sung bo 'ba' zhig gi steng du myong nges la las myodī 0/ po ni sangs rgyas yar bcad rgyu med/ sems can mar bcad rgyu med

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/par sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyis myong dgos pas rang re rnams sdug bsngal myong ba'i las yod pa dang myong nges pas dge sdig gi las chung ngu la'ang spang blang byed dgos te phra mo res kyang 'bras bu chen po 'gyin pa'i phyir ro/ /bslab pa'i gnas phra mo tsam 'gal na yang nyes pa tshad med pa gsungs na chen pos smos ci dgos/ las de la mtha' gcig tu bsam sbyor dge bas lha mi'i bde 'byor thob pas gcig tu dkar ba'i las dang / bsam sbyor gnyis ka mi dge bas ngan song gi sdug bsngal che shos myong bas gcig tu gnag pa'i las dang / bsam pa dkar la sbyor ba gnag pa'i las rang 'dod zad pa'i byang sems chen po la lus ngag gi mi dge bdun gnang bas mi nag mdung thung can bsad pa lta bu dang —/ bsam pa gnag la spyor ba dkar ba'i las tshe 'di'i kun slong gis dge ba sgrub pa lta bu dang / thang 'ga' gnyis ka dkar ba dang / thang 'ga' gnyis ka gnag pas gling bzhi'i mi dang lha 'thor bu rnams su skye ba bsam sbyor 'dres ma'i las yin/ des na las dge sdig byed pa po ni sems kho na yin pas dge bshes 'ban bzhin du dus rtag tu sems la brtags nas dran shes bag yod kyis sdig pa spong dge bar byed dgos so/ /las de dag smrin tshul la mthong chos myong 'gyur tshe 'dir smin par nyi 'og gi rgyal khams lta bu dang / skyes nas myong 'gyur kyi las tshe 'di 'phos ma thag byed po rang gi smin par mtshams med pa'i las lta bu dang / lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur kyi las skye ba phyi ma phan chad la nges par smin par mi rta sogs bsad pa'i las lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas sdig can tshe 'dir bde 205

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i daspa tshogs/ba tsam dang / dge ba can tshe 'dir sdug bsngal ba yang yod pas rgyu 'bras kyi gnas zab mo la nges shes bskyed par las lta ba mtho mdog gis rgyu 'bras khyad gsod dang las 'bras la yi chad skye mi nyan/ las de yang 'bras bu myong nas 'dzad pa'am/ gnyen po stobs bzhi dang byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes pa sogs kyis zad par ma gtogs bskal pa brgyar song yang rang bzhin du chud mi za bas myong dgos/ dge ba'ang dge rtsa zad pa'i rgyu bzhi sogs kyis 'dzad pa las gzhan chud mi za/ las de dag rtsi yang byed tshul la dge sdig gang yang bsam sbyor gnyis kas rtag tu byed pa'i kun slong dang /mngon zhen gyi kun slong drag pos dge sdig gang byas dang / dge sdig gang yang 'gyod pa med cing yi rang dang bcas bas gnyen po med pa'i kun slong dang gsum yod pa dang / yon tan gyi zhing dkon mchog gsum dang khyad par rdo rje'i bla ma dang / phan btags pa'i yul pha ma sogs dang / sdug bsngal ba'i yul nad pa sogs la brten pa'i dge sdig gi las gang bsags kyang phan yon dang nyes pa kyi ste/ bshes spring las/ rtag dang mngon par zhen dang gnyen po med/ /yon tan gtso ldan gzhi las byung ba'i las/ /dge dang mi dge rnam lnga chen po ste/ /de bas dge ba spyod la nan tan mdzod//ces gsungs/ gzhan yang rten dang / bsam pa ngo bo dus khyad par can la brten pa'i dge sdig gang yang stobs che ba dang / de dag gi sdog phyogs rnams yang ba'i las su shes dgos/ de lta bu'i las de myong ba la snga phyi'i go rim ni/ dge sdig gnyis kyi 'bras bu gang lci ba de sngon du myong / gyi yang mnyam na 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor gang gis nye ba de sngon du myong la/ de yang 206

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/mnyam na sngar goms shugs gang che de sngon myong / de yang 'dra na sngar byas pa'i go rim ltar gang sngon du byas pa de thog ma nyid du smin pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rang don du ngan song gis 'jigs nas mtho ris kyi bde ba don gnyer gyi bsam pas dge bcu dang bsam gzugs brgyad bsgoms pas mtho ris thob pa srid pa sgrub pa'i las dang / rang don du 'khor ba mtha' dag las nges 'byung gi blos bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab nyi tshe bas zin pa'i rang lam dge ba bcu sogs sgrub na theg dman thar pa cha mthun skyes bu 'bring gi lam zhi ba sbyor ba'i las dang / gzhan don rdzogs byang don gnyer gyis thabs shes khyad par can gyis zin pa'i dge bcu sgrub na skyes bu chen pos lam zhi ba mchog mi gnas pa la sbyor ba'i las yin pas dge bcu khyad par las kyang khyad par 'phags pa 'dir la 'jug dgos so/ /de ltar tha snyad du rgyu 'bras bslu med rmi lam lta bu 'di don dam rang bzhin ma grub pa'i gnad kyis rten cing 'azel bar 'byung ba'i 'khor 'das kyi rgyu 'bras 'di dag 'byung ba yin no/ /mdor na las dge sdig dkar gnag dang / las rtsi yang / mthong chos sogs myong tshul/ smrin pa'i go rim/ las kyi phan gnod sogs gong du bshad pa rnams la legs par bsams nas yang yang dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom ste/ spang bya mi dge ba'i las la bshags pa dang / 'gyod sdom bya/ bsgrub bya dge ba'i chos zab mo myur du sgrub pa'i blo bcos min rgyud la skye ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos/ thams cad las kyi rang bzhin bstan pa 'di la zhag gsum/ khyon las rgyu 'bras zhag dgu'o/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang las rgyu 'bras bsam pa gnyis 207

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/kyis srid pa khams gsum rigs drug po sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes nas las 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin sgrub nas tshe phyi ma'i snang shes las blo ldog pa'am 'khor ba mtha' dag la yid skyo nas de las thar 'dod kyi blo bcos min nyin mtshan kun tu skye na blo ldog pa yin no/ /de yan chad kyi blo ldog gi chos rnam pa bzhi po'i don mdor bsdu na/dal 'byor rnyed dka' la bsgoms nas dal ba'i rten 'di la chos yang dag par zhig sgrub nas snying po zhig lon dgos snyam pa'i blo bcos min zhig skye dgos te/ mkhan chen padma badzras/ don la da res kyi lus rten 'di'i steng nas chos shig 'grub na 'grub pa yin/ de ma 'grub na phyi ma chos rnam dag zhig sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i mi lus yid bzhin nor bu 'di 'dra ba mi rnyed thag chod yin bsam nas tshe 'di'i bya bzhag so tshis thams cad blos ling gis btang nas chos kho na la dril 'dod pa zhig dgos pa yin pas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa rgyud la e skyes des shes/ zhes dang/ mdor na tshe 'di'i che thabs chos brgyad kyi so tshis kho na las snying thag pa nas 'chi chos don du mi gnyer na dal 'byor rnyed dka' ma shes pa'i rtags yin/ zhes gsungs/ tshe mi rtag pa'i tshul la bsgoms nas dal 'byor rnyed kyang tshe la nges par med pas long med du shes nas deng nas bzung ste nyin mtshan kun tu brtson 'grus kyis lcag gis brabs nas nam 'chi nges med kho na sems nas chos yang dag par myur du sgrub pa zhig dgos te/ de nyid kyis/ mdo don tshe la nges pa med pas da nang snga zhogs 'dir chos shig ma 'grub na/do nub nyi ma nub la phyogs dus nga e yod ci shes snyam pa dang / do nub chos 208

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/shig ma 'grub na sang nyin nyi ma 'dzam gling la shar dus nga me yod ci shes snyam nas nyin mtshan skad cig kyang chos phyi bshol du bzhag nas tha mal du sdod mi phod pa zhig dgos rgyu yin pas tshe mi rtag pa rgyud la ye skyes des shes/zhes dang / chos ba 'dod tsam yod kyang sang bya gnang byar lus na tshe mi rtag par ma shes pa'i rtags yin/ zhes gsungs/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms nas 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes nas nges 'byung dang snying rje'i blo bskyed nas srid pa'i bde 'byor la zhen pa gting nas log par zhig dgos te/ yang de nyid kyis/ mdo don 'khor ba'i bde 'byor rnams kyang sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras su shes nas zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang nyag gcig don du gnyer ba las/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid lag tu 'ong yang dang du mi len na/ da lta'i gnas skabs kyi btsan phyug 'byor gsum phran bu re la lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de rnams la yid smon mi lam tsam du yang mi gyed par ma zad skyugs nad can gyis zas mthong ba ltar zhen pa gting nas ldog pa zhig dgos te/ des 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs da la e skyes shes pa yin/ zhes dang / 'khor ba spong bar 'dod kyang /tshe 'di'i btsan phyug snyan grags la yid smon 'chol na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma shes pa'i rtags yin/ zhes gsungs/ las rgyu 'bras bsgoms nas dge sdig rgyu 'bras kyi rnam grangs rnams shes nas dge sdig phra mo tsam yang mig la thur ma bzhin du 'dzems nas spang blang bya ba zhig dgos te/ yang de nyid kyi gsung las/ don la las rgyu 'bras bslu med kyi tshul la nges shes gteng nas 'khrungs te/ ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung la yid ches kyi dad pa 209

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/brtan pas don med du rtswa sngon gcod pa dang / sa la ri mo 'bri ba sogs mi dge ba dang / lung ma bstan gyi las phra mo tsam yang ji mi snyam du mi bzhag par 'jigs pa'i sems kyis ldog pa dang / mig phabs te blta ba dang / chu dang me tog gis dkon mchog mchod pa dang / sems can nyam chung ba rnams la byams pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las sogs dge ba'i las phra mo tsam la yang ji mi snyam du mi bzhag par spro ba'i sems kyis 'jug par byed na/ dge sdig gi las rags pa rnams la lta ci smos te srog gi phyir yang dge sdig gi 'jug sdog khyad du mi gsod par gus pas sgrub pa zhig dgos te/des las rgyu 'bras la yid ches skyes e yod shes/ zhes dang / chos sgrub lo byas kyang dge sdig phra mo khyad du bsad nas nyes dmigs la mi bsam par ngag gi gtam dang lus kyi bya ba byung rgyal du gtong na las rgyu 'bras ma shes pa'i rtags yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /'jigs med rta mgrin yon tan mgon pos/ mi lus thob pa da res tsam/ /lhad dka' 'jig sla'i rang bzhin phyir//'chi nad thebs 'dra'i 'du shes kyis/ /long med rgyud la bsten cig ang / /dge dang mi dge'i las 'bras 'di/ /nam yang bslu ba med pa'i tshul/ /bsam nas blang dor phra mo yang / /ma nor zhib tig mdzod cig ang / /'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho ste/ /de las thar pa myang 'das kyi/ /go 'phang mchog rab bla med kyi/ /yon tan du ma'i gter gyur pa/ /shes nas thar pa don gnyer blo/ /bkros pa zas la 'dun pa ltar/ /nyin mtshan rgyun du bskyed pa ni/ /nges 'byung yin no med thabs med/ /ces gsungs so/ /chos rje dam pa 'jigs med phun tshogs 'byung gnas kyi zhal nas/ /dal 'byor rnyed 210

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dka' tshe la long med cing / /las 'bras bslu med 'khor pa'i sdug bsngal la—/ /yang yang bsam nas 'khor ba'i chos kun la/ /zhen pa med pa'i nges 'byung rgyud la bsten/ /zhes dang / /blo ldog rnam bzhi chos kyi rtsa ba ste/ /'di nyid rgyud la ma sbyar tha mal ba/ /thos bsam dgrar langs chos spang las ngan rgyu/ /sgom pa tshe 'dir zhen pa'i gsos su 'gyur/ /de phyir zab zab mtho mtho'i chos rnams la/ /dang po'i dus nas mtho nyab mi snga bar/ /'khor bar zhen chags lhod por ma gyur bar/ /snying gi dkyil du 'di nyid bsten par rigs/ /zhes gsungs/ rigs bdag mtshungs par med pa rje ma ti sa ra'i zhal nas/ rnyed dka' dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /don med 'jig rten bya bas mi g.yeng bar/ /sgo gsum rtag tu dge la 'bad nas su/ /don chen snying po lon dgos snying gi bu/ /tshe 'di mi rtag rtsa kha'i zil pa 'dra//'chi bdag ser bu nam sleb mi shes pas/ /tshe 'dir zhen pa'i rtag 'dzin 'khrul snang rnams/ /spang nas mi rtag sgoms shig snying gi bu/ /'chi dus dkar nag 'bras bu rjes 'brang ste/ /dge sdig las kyi sa bon gang btab kyang / /'bras bu bde sdug bslu med so sor 'byung / /rgyu 'bras phra zhib byed dgos snying gi bu/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i klung dang mtshungs/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs drag pos mnar/ /thar med chu srin kha ru bslebs dang 'dra/ /'di la zhen log mdzad cig snying gi bu/ /zhes gsungs/ /mtshungs med bka' drin sum ldan chos rje padma skal bzang rin po che'i zhal nas/ /chos dang chos min mi shes chos pa'i gzugs/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis bag med 'phyan gyur na/ /lo zla'i dmag gis mi tshe'i dpung bcom ste/ /don 211

tre chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/chen snying po'i nor bu 'phrog kyang srid/ /tshe phyed gnyid dang de phyed bya bas brel—/ /de yi phyed ka lto gos g.yog tu rgyug /cung zad dal khom med pa'i mi'i lus rten/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis khol po nyam re nga / /dal 'byor tshang ba'i lus rten rnyed par dka'/ /'gro ba'i tshe srog rlung nang mar me 'dra/ /'khor ba gang skyes sdug bsngal gcong rong ste/ /thar ba'i lam mchog myur du bsten par rigs/ /zhes dang / /rnam mang 'dod yon srid pa'i bde 'byor la/ /dang po nyid nas chags bral ma gyur kyang / /mi brtan bslu brid sgyu ma'i gar mkhan gyi/ /rang mtshang mthong ba'i zhen log bskyed pa gces/ /zhes dang / yun thung mi tshe'i nyi ma zer la nye/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi so ba bang re mgyogs/ /long med sgrub la brtson pa ma bskyed na/ /phyis 'dir 'gyod pa'i mchi ma su la 'dor/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na rang cag rnams snying nas chos don du gnyer na dang po blo ldog gi chos 'di bzhi la brten nas nges 'byung gi blo bcos min zhig rgyud la e skye blta dgos/ de yang 'khor ba mtha' dag la gting nas zhen pa log nas dus rnam kun tu thar pa thob 'dod kyi blo shugs drag la rgyun mi chad pa skye ba zhig la nges 'byung zhes bya/de yang ngan song gsum la dngos su 'gro 'dod par su la'ang med pas zhen blo de ldog mi dgos kyang der skye byed kyi rgyu mi dge ba rnams spong dgos/ lha dang lha min la yang chos thar pa'i phan yon dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs cung zad go ba rnams kyis de dag tu skye bar mi zhen pa shas che bas de'i blo ldog dgos pa nyung / 'o na zhen blo ldog dka' nges par gang yin snyam na/rang cag mtho dman drag zhan med par mi yul 'dir skyes nas 4 yul 212

da wa snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/sogs goms shugs che ba'i sa cha yul ris khang khyim nye 'brel sogs zhen yul spyi dang / khyad par pha ma gnyen grogs spun sring gnas mal longs spyod rgyu nor dgon gzhi 'khor slob sogs la zhen 'dzin snag pos 'chings pa'i blo ngan goms kyi zhen pa 'dis rtag 'dzin phyi tshis re dogs chos brgyad 'dor len kho na la brten nas tshe 'di don med du zad par ma tshad sdig pa mi dge ba mang po sgrub nas 'khor ba mtha' med du lhang nges pas/ tshe 'di'i snang zhen gyi blo 'di ldog ma bub na mkhas btsun ston sgom sogs ming ci che yang don med kho nar 'gro nges pas/ de'i gnyen po blo ldog gi chos spyi dang /khyad par tshe mi rtag pa nam 'chi nges med bsgom nas long med rgyud la brten/chos min gzhan gyis mi phan pas cis kyang dgos med du shes nas skyes pa'i yul spangs/ pha ma sogs nye du'i 'brel thag bcad/ 'du 'dzi kun spangs chos brgyad mgo snyoms/ mi chos ling gis skyur/ khyim dang nye 'brel gnas gzhi dgon pa'i thabs bkod nyi tshe ba rnams btsan thabs su spangs nas phyir mig mi lta bar chos pa'i phugs nor bcu po rang rgyud la bsten nas 'tsho ba mtha' gnyis ma lhung tsam gyis mi med dben pa'i ri la ma sems can thams cad kyi don du tshe chos mthar phyin pa zhig sgrub nus na/ pha gcig rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi gshegs shul ma nor pa yin pas/ bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs—/ pha ma sems can gyi drin len 'phrod/ bstan pa'i rgyan du gyur/rang gi dal 'byor don yod song bas/ tshe 'dir skyid/ phyi skyid/ bde nas bde bar byang chub kyi go 'phang gi lam du slebs pas sangs rgyas rang lag tu yod par nges pas gsol 'debs dang smon lam 'dun pa dang dam bca' 213

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/drag pos sems rgyud rang dbang du thul ba zhig dgos so/ /de ltar ma yin pa tshe 'di'i 'dun pa rtog ngan dug ro lta bu khong du lus na 'phral gyi a gsar dang nges 'byung spu sud mas snang ba 'ur ste ser gos gyon mdog bla mar bsten mdog skra bcad sdom zhu byed nas ri khrod sogs gnas mdog thos bsam rgya gang che dang grwa sar gang che phyin nas mkhas mdog dang btsun mdog gnas nges med du 'grim nas bya bral mdog /dbu phyag rdzogs gsum gyi lta ba mtho mdog sgom skyen mdog lo mtshams dang zla mtshams sdod mdog chos de tso'i 'don pa ltar rjes brjod byas nas 'gro don dang gdul bya skyong mdog grags 'ur dang stong shom gyis rten gsum bzhengs pa dang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhal phye mdog sogs las bzang po ci lta bu 'ig sgrub mdog byas kyang chos brgyad kyi snon mar/ sdig pa'i g.yo bkol/ 'khor ba'i sna 'dren/ byur gyi g.yab mo/ mthar log pa'i las la 'jug pa las med pas rang sems chos kyis 'dul nas dal 'byor snying por lon pa zhig dgos te/ spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ sems la spang blangs bya zhing / dang po thog mar tshe 'di'i skyid 'dod thams cad spangs nas/ tshe blos gtong ba zhig chos pa thams cad kyi thog mar bya dgos so/ /zhes gsungs/ kun mkhyen chen pos mdor na rang rgyud chos dang ma 'dres na chos pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam gyi ni dgos pa mi 'ong / zhes gsungs/ dpal sprul rin po ches/ g.yo sgyu'i tshul gyis gye spyod bcos bcos zol ma'i mkhar la re zhig brten yang / /rtog ngan dug ro khong du nyal ba/ /'chi kha tshun la mi mngon mi srid/ /ces dang / rang don sugs bcug bya ba'i zhor la//214

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/'phralasdobabasna'iṭwāṃṭwāṃsgoṭwāṃbapa/ /bstanadospya ṅgis zhes kha/byedade/'i/bstan py-i dades de na sod 'draspre//bstan ba sa ṭwāṃṭwāṃn na sgrub pa//bltanatrīspya 'aṭwāṃ nga nga rshang tsā/detsho/zlon rsha 'byung gapy-is rgyal /na na 'in//'o/ nas baṭwāṃs py-i methuspyi/rto/sa dang //'a baṭwāṃg oṃsagrwasachogrwagan/ /kākha ṭwāṃ da ngo batshal trīṭwāṃ rkyarsha / /'a ba drananaṭā ṭwāṃ bye ṭwāsam pa/ /da rang stod na 'i trīr //sadangadzi/ /da pa sa ṭwāṃ /ṭwāṃtrī naspri/ /na ṭwāṃ sadi 'aṭwāṃgaktol ṭwāṃm sdon snyengango/ /'dun ṭwāṃ byir py-itad spracho//'a gas kā 'dra // /ri/trī gagazu// kā bas ma sa ṭwāṃ/ /yatrī dag ṭā py-ing na/tshong /re/lung cegs na taṭwāṃ gang du nga kta/mi/gakā marje sa /rdo did ma da/ /sa gaṭwāṃngs / /'aṭwāṃm man chi py-im blos sa//mji mo 'a yang ṭwāṃma'abyungacha dal/ /sa kyarnyi 'a tshes ci snabaṭwāṃng se/bla ma gdams ngag gapy-id du bstun byaṭwāṃ ri/po/che gag /yin masaguthagabaca/// /sagasungazlo// na sa//rlos ṭā maglibazuṭwāṃ pa'i/tsho/mkhas snar loms dang rnosam gtan mas gyi/garatshe ngadi 'in patsho nga ༵ nga garshadra//sa gsungs/gyi/sa kā//de 'armo phun ṭwāṃsna /bas ma ra paṭwāṃ/yi/gtan phapy-i rdo bablo ṭwāṃ ba / /ngas pa 'ad gathuce lums da na /pas/ /mi tsheg ktas 'bad trīsabyang chub bsgrub/ /sa tigasungs/skye/ btsunatshe ma losdu ngami nas lha sa bya /ma na/ phyi/dad pa gang nas sa pa na// ga lta ba/ /ban pa nga ra 'brang ba na/ /gnyen 'dun 25

tre chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/bdud kyi bshol 'debs yin/ /bden no ma snyam 'khri ba chod/ /zas nor bdud kyi so ba yin/ /'dris shing ngan no 'dzin chags spongs/ /'dod yon bdud kyi zhags pa yin/ /'ching bar nges so zhen pa thongs/ /gzhan grogs bdud kyi bu mo yin/ /bslu bar nges so khong zon gyis/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra yin/ /thar bar dka' yis myur du bros/ /lar thams cad bzhag gnas 'gro dgos na/ /dus da lta bzhag na don can lags/ /mi nga zer de tsho nyan skyod na/ /bu khyod la lha chos kyi skal ba yod/ /ces gsungs/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug gis/ /chos kyi nyams len sna gcig ma grub kyang / /khyod nyid chos par rloms par kye ma blun/ /chos kyi dang po tshe 'di blos thongs pa/ /rang gi rgyud la 'dug gam mi 'dug stos/ /zhes gsungs/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis/ dang por 'khor ba mtha' dag la yid 'byung ba'i skyo shas shig med na/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs ci byas thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu las mi 'da' bas/ bskyed rdzogs sogs zab pa yang re zhig bzhag nas nges 'byung ma skyes bar du 'bad dgos gsungs/ khro phu lo tsa bas/ tshe srog lha bar ma shes shing / /zhe nas 'chi ba ma dran na/ /dge phyogs mang po byas gyur kyang / /da dung tshe 'di'i lag cha yin/ /zhes gsungs/ 'gro mgon rin po ches/ tshe 'di'i mkhas btsun bsgom chen yang / /tshe 'di'i mkhas lo btsun lo 'dod/ /mtshams bcad ya them yi ge bris/ /mi dang mi 'phrad sgom chen yang / /tshe 'di'i sgom chen bzang lo 'dod//sbyin gartong byas kyang tshe 'di yi/ /byas lo gtong lo kho na 'dod/ /dper na chu la gye btab 'dra/ /tha na dkon mchog mchod pa re/ /byas kyang mi yi 216

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgocha: rim/mthong du re/ /rnam rtog mi dran dgu dran 'dis/ /ci byed rnams la 'dis slebs pas/ /dge stor ci byas lo lor 'chor/ /thams cad lo ba'i lta bas khyer—/ /des na tshe 'di'i rnam rtog la/ /mdung re 'debs dgos skyes bu kun / /'di la mdung re ma thebs na/ /mkhas btsun ston sgom thams cad kyis / /ngan song gsum gyi sgo mi khegs/ /ngan song sdug bsngal ma bzlog pa'i / /mkhas pa btsun pa sgom chen gyis/ /dgos pa ci yod mdo don shor/ /mi tshe gril gyis grwa sar bsdad/ /rgas kha tshe 'di ma spongs pas/ /gnas gzhi dgon pa'i zhen pa byas/ /sde 'khrugs la sogs sdig pa rnams/ /byas nas gnas dgon shul du bzhag /rang nyid mnar med me nang du/ /'gro ba thams cad mi rtag pa/ /ma bsam pa yis len pa yin/ /mdor na 'chi ba mi rtag pa//bdag gi rgyud la ma skyes na/ /gsang ba 'dus pa mi zab ste/ /'chi ba rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe/ /skyabs 'gro tshig gsum zab pa yin/ /mthon po'i chos la snyegs snyegs nas/ /g.yang du lhung ngo skyes bu kun/ /de tshe zab mo'i gdams ngag kyang / /phyi nang log pa nyid du 'gyur/ /ces gsungs/ blo sbyong chos kyi sgo 'byed las/ de ltar bsam pas tshe 'di'i 'dod pa thams cad la zhen pa log /de 'phel bas 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa log pa zhig byung na/ de tsa na thar ba'i lam sna zin pa zhes kyang bya ste/ de med na ci yod kyang lam sna mi zin/ de byung na gzod chos pa'i khyur tshud pa lags so/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i zhal gsung gi gdams ngag ston pa dngos kyi zhal skyin lta bu 'di rnams la zhib tu bsam nas tshe 'dir blos thong ba'i gsang ba zab mo 'di rgyud la 'byongs nges su blo sbyongs dgos so/ /de yang mi'i rgyud 217

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/la snying rus dang dam bca' brtan po sems stobs kyi gcod khams che ba rdo bcag pa 'dra ba zhig med na blo mang 'dod sred can gyi rgyud la 'byongs sla ba zhig min pas gzab dgos so/ /de yan chad kyis blo chos su 'gro ba'i thabs ma nor pa blo sdog gi chos bzhi song ngo / /lnga pa thar pa'i phan yon ni/ de ltar blo ldog rnam bzhis 'khor ba mtha' dag las blo ldog nas da 'gro sa zhig btsal dgos pas/ thar pa'i phan yon dran dgos la/ de yang thar pa nyan thos rang rgyal rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te byang chub gsum gyi go 'phang gang thob kyang / yon tan zhi ba bsil ba gya nom pa spang dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid rang rang gi gzhung sogs nas bstan pa'i 'bras chos rnams bsam/ de yang bdams kha zhig skor na/ da res mi lus thob chos theg pa chen po dang 'phrad pas dge ba bcu tshad med bzhi pha phyin drug sogs la bsten nas lam zab mo nyams su len skabs la khel bas/spang rtogs phun sum tshogs par stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi sogs bral smin gyi yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rgyan pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can 'khor ba ma stong bar du ma sems can thams cad la brtse ba'i 'phrin las rtag khyab lhun 'grub tu 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid can yin pas/ de'i yon tan dran nas de don du gnyer nas go 'phang sgrub dgos/ de thob byed kyi rgyu ni dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas bzung ste blo sdog gi chos bzhis rgyud las rung du byas nas/ chos lam du 'gro ba la skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste lam dngos gzhi yongs rdzogs kyi bar re re nas rang gi phan yon de rnams yang yang dran dgos/ de yang skyes bu chen po'i lam la zhugs nas de'i lam gyi rim pa kun 218

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/slong byang chub kyi sems/ dge rtsa theg chen thar pa cha mthun de gang yin na/ring lam tshogs gnyis kyi lam nas bskal pa grangs med gsum sogs su byang chub sgrub par dang / nye lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi lam nas tshe gcig sogs kyis byang chub sgrub par dang / myur lam gyi ka dag khrigs chod dang na 'grub thod rgal gnyis kyis lam nas lo dang zla bas sangs rgyas 'grub la/ de lta bu lta ba chen po gsum gyi lta ba de rtogs sgom mthar phyin na/ mdo lugs la sangs rgyas dang / sngags kyi lugs la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa ni 'bras bu yin/ mdor na nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin/bdag med gnyis rtogs kyi shes rab kyis zin/ byang chub sems kyis zin pa'i dge ba che phra gang sgrub kyang theg chen thar pa cha mthun gyi dge rtsa yin/la de gsum las myur lam 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs kyi spros bcas spros med sogs kyi dbang thob dam tshig rnam par dag pas rgyud bsdam nas/ ka dag khregs chod dang kun grub thod rgal gnyis kyi lam nyams su blangs pas lo dang zla bas 'pho ba chen po'i sku bsgrub pa yin pas myur lam —nyams su len dgos snyam du lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan rnams yang yang dpyad 'jog spel mar sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas bsgom nas thar pa la skam pa chu 'dod ltar brod pa skye 'jug dgos/ 'di zhag gcigadrug pa bshes gnyen bsten pa la gsum las/dang po bla ma brtag pa ni/ de lta bu'i lam de lha la sogs pa gzhan sus kyang ston mi shes la/ de sus ston nus na bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gis ston pas/ mtshan nyid ldan pa zhig brtag nas 219

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i daspa tshogs/bsten dgos/ spyir sor byang sngags gsum gyi bla ma'i mtshan nyid mang por bshad kyang / khyad par med du mi rung ba bugs rgyud na rin chen byang chub sems yod med 'di gtso bo brtag nas myur lam gyi lta ba la'ang go myong rtogs pa yod med yang dang yang du rgyu mtshan gsum gyis brtag dgos te/lam rim las/ rgyang drung pra sen mkha' 'gro yis/ /ci nas brtags te bzang ldan na/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di la zhag gcigaganyis pa bla ma bsten pa ni/ tha ma zang zing gi 'bul ba/ 'bring lus ngag gi zhabs tog rab bsgrub pa'i mchod pa ste bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs gsum gyi sgo nas bsten pa'am gtso bo sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas nas byang chub ma thob bar du bsten dgos pas/ dang por thos bsam gtso bo dang bar du thos bsam sgom gsum po dang / tha mar sgom pa gtso bo byas nas bsten nas bla ma dang 'gal ba'i las srog la babs kyang mi byed pa ma zad gsung gi zur tsam yang mi bcag nas shes pa lnga dang ldan pas gsol 'debs dang bcas skyo ngal med par 'chi sos kyi sman ltar 'bral med du bsten/ khong gi snying ltar gzu lum dang ris chod mi bya bar bsten/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar bsnyen bkur la tshad bzung mi bya bar bsten dgos/'di'ang zhag gcigagasum pa dgongs spyod bslab pa ni/ bla ma dam pa de'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod rnams la bltas nas rang gis kyang de 'dra ba'am de las lhag par re byed dgos snyam du bsam mo/ /de yang bla ma'i thugs dam gyi mthil gtwe2 dīn de rang rgyud la lon par byas nas de ltar du bslab dgos/ 'di

da da da wa snyingathigazhag brgya'i sgom rim/ la'ang zhag gcig go/ /'di dag zhib par gong du bshad zin pas der gzigs nas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su len dgos/ shin tu gal che'o/ /khyon thar pa'i phan yon dang bshes gnyen bsten pa la zhag bzhi'o / /des phyi yi sngon 'gro la zhag drug cu re gsum song /gnyis pa chos lam du 'gro bar nang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed bsgom pa la gsum las/ dang po tshad med bzhi'i blo spyong ba ni/ jo bo rjes/ phyi ba nang pa skyabs 'gro'i khyad/ /theg pa gong 'og sems bskyed khyad/ /ces gsungs par ltar blo ldog gi chos bzhi la brten nas nges 'byung bcos ma min pa skyes kyang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang ma ldan na theg thar pa cha mthun gyi dge rtsa mi 'gyur bas blo sbyong nan tan byed nas sems rgyud 'gyur ba thon pa bya dgos/ de yang srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa mas cad bdag rang gi don sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pas bskyed par yin bas dgra bzhin spang nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde zhegs thams cad gzhan don 'ba' zhig sgrub par las byung bas/ bsam pa spyang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dgos/ de ma skyes pa skye ba'i thabs dang theb pa mi nyams pa dang mi nyams pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i thabs la rgyas pa byed na tshad med bzhi/ 'bring byams snying rje gnyis/ bsdu na snying rje nyag ma gcig po 'di bsgom dgos/ tshad med ces pa'i don dmigs pa'i yul/ rnam pa'i blo/ de'i 'bras bu tshad med pas tshad med zhes pa yin/bshad pa'i go rim byams pa nas smos kyang / bsgom pa'i go rim btang snyoms nas ma bsgom na gzhan rnams tshad med du mi 'gro bas/ dang po 221

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/btang snyoms nas bsgom dgos/ de yang sems can bde ba rgyu 'bras dang ldan 'dod byams pa'i mtshan nyid/ sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bral 'dod snying rje'i mtshan nyid/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa dga' ba'i mtshan nyid/ sems can chags snang gnyis dang bral 'dod btang snyoms kyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs bcas tshad med rnams dmigs rnam sprad nas bsgom dgos pas/ soms can bde dang mi ldan pa zhig byams pa'i dmigs pa yul dang / rnam pa blo bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan par 'dod pa yin/ sdug bsngal ba zhig la snying rje'i dmigs pa yul dang / rnam pa sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral bar 'dod pa yin/ bde ba rgyu 'bras ldan pa zhig la dga' ba'i dmigs yul dang / rnam pa bde ba de dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa yin/ rang gzhan gyi rgyud kyi chags sdang gnyis la btang snyoms kyi dmigs yul dang / rnam pa de snyoms nas phan 'dogs par 'dod pa yin/de lta bu'i tshad med bzhi po dmigs rnam sprad nas bsgom/ dmigs med kyi tshad med ni las dang po bas sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad la blo sbyangs/ rtogs ldan zhig yin na mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog ye shes kyi rtsal byams sogs bsgom pa yin/ tshad med rnams la de dang de'i ting nge 'dzin te bsgom lugs dpyad bsgom 'jog bsgom gnyis re yod la/man ngag lugs kyi dang po btang snyoms bsgom pa la/ bun gyi sngon 'gro rnams thams cad la 'dra/ dngos gzhi la/ rang gi g.yas su dgra/ g.yon du gnyen bsam nas/ dang po rang gi dgra gnyen gnyis la chags sdang slong nges pa zhig byas nas/ de nas 'dir dus gsum la bskor nas bsam 222

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dgos te/ deng skabs pha ma sogs rang phyogs la shin tu chags/ dgra sogs la sdang zhen mi bzad par byed pa 'di yang ma brtags pa'i skyon yin te/ tshe rabs snga ma rnams su da lta'i dgra 'di rnams kyis kyang rang gi pha ma gnyen bshes grogs dga' mdza' sogs byas nas brtse bas 'grogs/mthun pas bskyangs/ phan btags pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab pas gnyen yin/ da lta phar rang gis dgrar 'dzin yang tshur dgrar gzung ba'i nges par yang med/ gal te bzung yang gnod pa skyel mi nus pa'ang yod/gnod pa tsam bskyal yang dpa' kha dang rgyal kha thob nas snyan grags 'phel ba'i rgyu byed pa dang / rang dang gzhan gyi thabs kyis de'i yid dang bsnan nas 'jam po'i tshig gam rgyu zhig gis shad sbyangs te mthun par byas na/ na tshun nang 'grigs nas gnyen du 'gyur ba yang yin/ chos kyi lugs la tshul khrims lo brgyar bsrung ba bas/ bzod pa nyin gcig bsgoms pas dga' ba sogs gsungs pas/ bzod yul dgra la rang gi bzod pa bsgom nus na dgras phan btags pa yin pas na dgra min/ ma 'ongs pa na yang dgra 'dis pha ma sogs byas nas phan 'dogs par 'gyur snyam du bsgom/yang dgra 'di'i skye ba thog ma med pa nas dgra byas gnod bskyal/ da lta dang ma 'ongs pa na yang gnod bskyal bas dgra 'dis phan gnod gnyis ka byas/de bzhin du pha ma sogs da lta'i gnyen rnams la yang da lta chags 'dug pa red ma gtogs mno bsam zhib tu btang na/ tshe snga mar gnyen rnams kyang dgra byas nas nor dang srog 'phrog pa sogs grangs kyis mi chod/ tshe 'di la yang bu tshas pha ma bslus pa dang gsod pa sogs byed pa yang yod/ gal te 223

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/mthun pa ltar yod na ni/ de la sdug bsngal dang mi 'dod pa sogs byung na rang la byung ba las kyang thu/ bu pha ma'i sdig grogs su song / pha ma bu la garnad byed du song / chung ma bsus nas 'khor ba'i 'ching thag dang 'brel/dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshong so nam sogs mi dge'i las thabs la sbyor nas snyir 'khor ba sgos ngan song las gtan du mi thar ba'i gnod pa byas/ chos phyogs la yang rang gi chos yang dag pa zhig bsgrub par 'dod kyang de dag gis bshol 'debs dang / pha ma bu rgyud sogs blos ma thong bas chos phyi bshol du lus nas/ dang po bla ma dam pa dang mjal ba/ bar du chos bsgrub pa/ tha ma tshul khrims bsrung ba la sogs ma byung ba'am/ yang na pha ma sogs kyi don sgrub nas rang gi tshul khrims zhig ting 'dzin nyams/ shes rab rgyad pa yang 'di dag gis lan/ des na tshe sngon dgra'i lan chags kyis da lta gnyen du gyur kyang / da lta'i gnyen gyi lan chags kyis phyi mar dgrar 'gyur pas 'dis dus gsum kar dgrar byed pa yin/ yang pha ma sogs gnyen 'di'i 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas drin gyis bskyangs pa sogs phan btags/ da lta dang ma 'ongs pa na yang 'di dag gnyen du gyur nas phan btags pa yin pas gnyen gyis kyang phan gnod gnyis ka byas pa yin pas/mdor na dgra gnyen gnyis kas phan gnod byas pas gnyen la phan btags 'dod dang / dgra la gnod bya 'dod med pa'i blo zhig skye na gti mug btang snyoms zhes bya ste 'di la brten nas btang snyoms tshad med 'ong dgos pas dang por 'di la blo sbyongs nan tan byas nas dgra gnyen gnyis ka ma'i yul du dang phan 'dogs pa'i yul du stoms pa zhig dgos/ de ji ltar bsgom na 224

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ma shes drin dran drin len gzo 'dod bsgom dgos pas 'di ltar nam mkhas gar khyab sems can gyis khyab/ sems can gyis gar khyab las snang sdug bsngal gyis khyab/ las snang sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can thams cad thog med nas rang gi pha ma gnyen bshes la sogs ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ de'i nang nas da lta'i ma 'di bzhin dgra 'dis kyang bdag gi ma lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par byas te/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas zhig gi mdun du dgra dang bdag gnyis bsdad nas skye ba 'di'i sngon ma la 'di mi zhig gi ma byas/ de'i sngon lha zhig gi ma byas sogs rim gyis gsungs/bdag gis sa chen po 'di rgya shug gi tshig gu'i ril bu tsam dril nas bgrang kyang dgra gcig pu 'di'i ma byas pa'i mtha' sa yis mi long / rgyu mtshan thog med nas da bar 'khor bar 'khyams pas sa lag pa tsam zhig gi steng nas lan grangs mang po skye ma myong sa/ 'chi ma myong sa med pas 'gro ba phal che ba mngal skyes yin pas ma med par skye mi shes la dgra 'di'i ma lan grangs mang por byas par bsam pa ma shes pa yin/ drin dran la 'jig rten phyogs kyi drin dran pa bzhi ni/ da lta'i dgra 'di'i ma byas dus/ rang gi nyer len gyi rnam shes bar do na 'khyams shing zas kyi dri tsam la brten nas 'gro tshe sngon las dang / pha ma 'du phrod kyi rgyu rkyen las mngal du zhugs nas/ zla dgu ngo bcu'i bar mngal du bzung / sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad khyad du bsad/ mas zas kyi dwangs ma dang lus kyi zungs thams cad bu'i lte ba nas brgyud de bu'i srog gi gsos su byed nas lus bskyed pa ni lus bskyed pa'i drin / de nas phyir btsa' dus gson po zer na mgo mi khyogs pa/ shi bo 225

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/red zer na dbugs ma chad pa/ nya re nyo re ba de ma drin mo che des shi rgyu shi ma bcug rul rgyu skam ma bcug par a ma la bu skyes byung snyam pa'i dga' so chen po zhig bzung / brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyangs/ 'dzum pa'i mdangs phyung / snyan pa'i ngag gis bos/ lag sor mo bcu'i pang du blangs nas 'chi ma bcug pa srog byin pa'i drin/ de nas kha zas med lag nor med rgyab gos med de la ma drin mo ches zas kyi dang po mngar ba'i nu zho byin/ gos kyi dang po sha drod la bcar/ cung zad za nus pa'i dus su stogs su ma bcug par zas gang bzang dang gang zhim mang po byin nas zas khas snyod/ mi gtsang lag pas phyis/ 'brang ltog lag pas byug skom du ma bcug par btung ba tsha grang 'dzub mos tshod bzung nas byin/ 'khyags su ma bcug par gos kyi rtse mo gang 'jam gang dro mang pos bu la gos byed nas rang la mi mkho bu la byin pa lta bu ma yin te ma rang gis yar mchod mar sbyin mi bra/ shi bo'i rgyab tu gtong ba dang gson po'i za gyon mi bra bar/ de yang ci bde rnyed pa ma yin par sdig sdug khyad du bsad nas bsags pa'i longs spyod thams cad bu la byin pa sogs yo byad bstabs pa'i drin yin/ de nas za shes 'gro shes dus zas za tshul/ gos gyon tshul/ 'gro ma shes pa la 'gro tshul/ smra mi shes pa la a pha gyis/ a ma gyis la sogs pas 'jig rten gyi tha snyad thams cad legs par bslab pa ni 'jig rten bstan pa'i drin yin/ chos phyogs nas da lta'i ma la mtshon na dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di yang ma drin mo ches bskyed/ chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen zas gos gnas mal yo byad rnams kyang bsgrub/ dgra lta bu la mtshon na/ bzod pa sgom pa'i yul 226

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dang —/ ma sems can la brten nas dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/bar du rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu la bslab pa'i yul yang ma sems can yin/ de gnyis la brten nas mthar mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa yang yin pas chos phyogs nas yang drin che/ de dag ni drin dran pa yin/da ni drin dang ldan pa'i ma rgan des sngon chad khe dang rgyal kha bu la byin/gyong dang bub kha rang gis blangs nas drin gyis bskyangs na/ bdag da res theg chen gyi chos dang mjal/ bla mas rjes su bzung / khe nyen shes pa'i dus 'dir sngar a mas nga'i skyid sdug la bltas pas da nga'i res la bab pas a ma'i skyid sdug bu ngas blta dgos snyam du bsam pa ni drin gzo 'dod yin/de ltar dgra la ma shes drin dran drin gzo 'dod skyes na/ de nas da lta'i ma dang pha dang sha nye dang / sring mo sogs nas bun grol khar sems can thams cad dgra gnyen chags sdang med par ma'i yul du snyoms pa bsgom pa de btang snyoms tshad med bsgom pa yin/ de ltar yang yang dpyad nas bsgom tshe sems chad nas 'gro mi 'dod tshe/ 'das pa'i rjes mi 'brang / ma 'ongs mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i rtog pa 'phro mi mthud par ci gnas su bcos su med par bzhag pa btang stoms kyi ting nge 'dzin yin/ yang 'phro 'dod pa dang yang dpyad/ de ltar dpyad 'jog res mos byed nas zhi gnas bsgom/dmigs med kyi btang snyoms bsgom na don dam par chos thams cad spros pa dang bral ba/ tha snyad du stong dang rten 'byung 'gags pa med par mnyam pa la nges shes drangs te bcas bcos med par 'jog pa lhag mthong bskyed pa'i thabs yin/ thun gyi rjes ni thams cad 'dra/ de nas thun mtshams thams 227

tre chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/cad la sems can chags sdang rtsod 'dug pa rnams la dmigs nas/ 'di dag gi rgyud kyi chags sdang gnyis po dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bral bar gyur cig snyam pa smon pa dang 'brel ba/ bral na ci ma rung snyam pa 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ bral ba zhig ngas bya snyam pa dam bca' dang 'brel ba/ bral ba zhig dkon mchog gsum mkhyen snyam pa gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba bzhi po la yang yang bsam dgos/ thun nang btang snyoms bzang po zhig bsgom pas rgyud cung zad 'gyur ba thon kyang / thun mtshams ma bsam na sngar gyi rang rgyud ngan pa'i shul du yang lhung 'ong bas/ thun nang bas bun mtshams su bsgom pa 'di gal che bas dge rtog cung zad skyes tshe yun bsrings nas mnye dgos te/ dper na ko gyong chu nang sbangs nas rlan du gyur kyang yang dag ma mnye na slar sngar bzhin gyong 'gro ba bzhin no/ /de ltar bsgom nas bun mtshams la yang dgra gnyen la chags ldang btang nas thams cad pha ma'i yul du snyoms pa dgos/ btang snyoms zhag gsum/gnyis pa byams pa bsgom pa la/ sngon 'gro thams cad 'dra/ dngos gzhi la btang snyoms kyis chags sdang zhi nas pha ma'i yul du snyoms pa de la byams pa bsgom/ thun mgor khol bur bcad nas bsgom mjug tu sems can thams cad la bsgom/ dang po rang gi rtsa ba'i ma de mdun du gson dus ltar dngos su bsam/ de yang tshe ring yin na rgas pa'i lus kyi byad dbyibs ltar dang min na nad kyi mnar ba sogs nyam thag pa'i skabs bzhin bsam nas/ da lta'i ma 'dis sngon yang bdag gi ma lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par byas te ma yi bug mtha' sogs mar shes/ drin dran pa la bdag gi lus 228

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/'di dang po nas bongs tshad rdzogs pa/ sha lus rgyas pa/ kha dog legs pa cig gnam nas kung ba dang sa nas skyes pa lta bu ma yin par ma'i stor mer mer sogs las rim gyis za dgu ngo bcu la mas zas zos tshad kyi bcud kyis mar the la sdong rkya bzhag pa bzhin ma rang gi lte ba nas brgyud nas na tsha sdug bsngal thams cad bzod par byas nas lus bskyed pa'i drin dran/ btsa' ba'i dus ma'i kha'i rus pa'i tshig ma gtogs thams cad bye/ ma bu gnyi ga gshin yul gom gyed song bas zhag bdun tsam 'khrig pa yid la dran kyang spag 'ong ba'i sdug bsngal myong / skye tshe dang po nas gos gyon/ rgyan btags/nor skal bzung / rgyags phye khur nas 'ongs par med pa shi bo yin na dbugs ma chad sogs/ phyir ltas na rigs drug gang nas 'ong mi shes/ snga ltas na yul gang thon mi shes pa'i dus mas bdag po ma byas na myur du shi nges la/ mas dang po phru ma bshus/ 'o ma dron mos dkrus/ lte thag bcad nas 'chi ma bcug pa sogs srog byin pa'i drin dran/ de nas mas stogs su ma bcug par zas kyi dang po mngar ba'i nu zho sogs yo byad btab pa'i drin dran/ de nas ma rang gi snying thang du bzhag pa lta bu'i brtse ba'i sems kyis 'grogs/ phan sems kyis bskyangs te sogs nas tha snyad thams cad shes pa'i bar du bskyangs pa'i 'jig rten bstan pa'i drin dran/ chos phyogs nas phan btags pa'i zhing gnas mal yo byad thams cad mas bdag la bstabs/byams pa bsgom pa'i zhing yang yin pas mas nga la phan btags/ rang gis de sngon ma la phan ma btags shing ma rgan gyis kha ta bsgo brlag re byed na de la mi nyan zhing sngo rgog ma khyod shi khyod na sogs ngan smras dang brdung gtsog sna 229

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/tshogs kyis drin chen lag pa rdo brdung byed pa de dag drin ma dran pas lan/da ni drin dran nas drin gzo dgos te/ ma 'di'i 'dod rgyu zas gos gnas mal sogs tshe 'di'i bde ba nas mngon mtho lha mi'i bde ba thams cad 'dod/ tha na nyi ma dron po zhig gi bde ba dang ja zhim po phor gang btung rgyu'i bde ba'ang 'dod de sdug bsngal phra mo tsam yang mi 'dod kyang / bde ba'i rgyu dad nges 'byung byang sems/ bde ba'i 'bras bu lha mi'i bde ba nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang gi bde ba'i bar mi ldan sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras la khor mo yug tu spyod pa'i ma drin mo chen/ bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang mi ldan pa de dmigs pa yul dang / rnam pa blo ni ma 'di skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du bde ba'i rgyu/ rgyu 'bras yid ches kyi dad pa/ 'khor bar zhen log gi nges 'byung / gzhan phan don gnyer gyi byang sems sogs dang /bde ba'i 'bras bu mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bar gyi bde ba'i 'bras bu thams cad dang ldan na ci ma rung /ldan par gyur cig ldan pa zhig bdag gis bya snyam pa dang / ldan pa zhig dkon mchog la gsol ba gdabs te/ kye ma kye hud dkon mchog sogs dang / bla ma rgyal ba sogs dang / dpa' bo khyod la sogs brjod/ khyad par sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bde ba la bdag gis bkod pa'i phyir du byang chub sgrub pa ni shes rab kyis rdzogs byang la dmigs pa'i zur gnyis pa'ang yin/ de ltar dpyad bsgom yang yang byed nas bde ba'i ngad dang ldan pa'i tshe bkag 'brang med par sems ci gnas su bzhag pa 'jog bsgom mam byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin/ dmigs med ni 'khor 230

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/gsum po snang la rang bzhin med pa'i nges shes ngang bzhag pa'am mi rtog ye shes la mnyam par bzhag thun rjes bsngo smon dpyad bshags 'phen pa sogs 'dra/ thun mtshams thams cad la byams pa'i lus kyi las pha khu rgan rabs dang tha na sgo zog sogs thams cad la brdung bdeg la sogs spangs/ngag gi las tshig cab mo dang mi snyan par brjod pa thams cad spangs/sems kyi las sems can gyis 'dod rgyu'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba thams cad bsam pas yin na sgrub/ sbyor bas yin na skub dgos/byams pa bsgom pa la zhag bzhi'o/ /'byongs pa'i tshad ni rang bde bar 'dod pa'i blo med par sems can kho na bde bar 'dod tsam na byams pa 'byongs pa yin/ byams pa bsgom pa'i phan yon tshad med par gsungs so/ /gsum pa snying rje ni/ sbyor ba'i chos sems bskyed sogs 'dra/ dngos gzhi sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje bsgom pa ni/ las dang po pas thog mar skye sla zhing soms snyi ba'i phyir rang gi rtsa ba'i ma nas bsgom pa'i dbang du byas na/ ma rgan gyi phung khams skye mched rgas shing dman pa'am/ bkros shing sgom pa/ na zhing tsha ba/ 'jigs shing nyam nga bas dpa' 'khongs nas 'dug bshag gsal bar rang gi mdun du bsam/ dang po mar shes pa la da lta'i ma yin pa la gsar du shes ma dgos kyang thog med nas lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par ma byas pa'i lung rigs rnams dran dgos/ drin dran pa ni/ga re nga da lta lus kyi lang tsho dar/ sems kyi bla shed rdzogs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bla mas rjes su bzung / dge sdig gi blang dor shes/231

tre mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/dam pa'i chos sgrub rgyu yod pa 'di/ nga rang pho rgod nas min/ blo rgya che nas min/ gzhan gyis grogs byas nas min/ stes dbang gis byung ba min/ 'di rnams su'i drin yin na/ a ma rgan mo drin chen ma 'di'i drin las yin/snying re rje da lta ga shed na ci 'dra yod ang / bdag dang po nas lus kyi sha khrag rgyas shing bongs rdzogs pa kha dog mdzes po zhig gnam dang sa nas byung ba min/ nga dang po sto bar bathung nas sha khrag dang zas kyi dwangs mas rim gyis spel/ ngo tsha dang na tsha/ sdug bsngal thams cad bzod nas lus bskyed pa'i drin dang / de nas phyi rol du btsa' dus mdzes gtsang can kha lag 'phrod pa nus stobs can zhig byung ba min/ mi gtsang ba'i nang gi srin bu bzhin nyams chung ba/ skyug bro ba/ skang bas lus mi theg rtes mgo mi theg par nyar re nyor re/ shi la khad pa zhig yod pa de ma mas pang du blang /lag sor mo bcu'i bar du bzung / mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ snabs lud khas bsal/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ brtse ba'i sems kyis nyin mo sto mi dran mtshan mo gnyid mi dran par bsam rgyu dang dran rgyu nga las med pa zhig byas te me chu las bskyabs/ g.yang sa las bzung / gnod pa ni bsal/rim gro ni byas te/ mi snyan pa grags kyis dogs/ shi yis dogs/ na yis dogs nas/ mo dang sman/ rtsis dang gto/ bsrung skud dang bsrung ba bklog dang cho ga la sogs yang dang yang du byas/ a tsa ma snying re rje/ nga rang na ba las mo rang shi na dga' ba snyam/ snyan pa'i ngag gis bos te/ dga' 'o/gces phrug sems rten/ ma lo sogs 'jam pos brjod nas shi rgyu shi ma bcug pa sogs srog byin pa'i drin yin/ bdag dang po nas kha zas ldan/232

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/lag nor ldan/ rgyab gos ldan/ 'khor grogs ldan/ yul rus rgyus yod zhig 'ongs pa ma yin par de mas zas kyi dang po mngar mo'i nu zho blud/ skan mar rtses byin/ stogs su ma bcug par zas gang zhim gang mngar byin/ skom du ma bcug par btung ba grang mo lag pas sro/ tsha mo la sus 'debs nas spud—/ 'khyags su ma bcug par dang po lus kyi drod la bcar/ gos gang 'jam gang mdzes gang dro thams cad phangs med du bskon/ 'ardzongs su ma bcug par rgyu nor longs spyod thams cad nga la byin/ de yang rang la ma mkho bar byin pa min te/ rang gis ltog dus za ma bra/ skom dus btung ma bra/grang dus gyon ma bra/ tshe 'dir dgos dus spyod ma bra/ phyi ma'i don du yar mchod pa dang mar sbyin pa ma bra/ ma rang gi 'di phyilo bhāku'i bde ba la ma ltas par sdug gi shas thams cad ma rang gis khur/ bde skyid bde ba'i dngos po thams cad bu nga la byin pa ma zad/ tha na gos leb gcig dang zas kham gcig lon tshad nga la bsogs/ longs spyod de rnams kyang rang ga bde dal gyis ma rnyed de sdig pa mi dge ba srog bcad ma byin len sogs sdig zas longs spyod kyis gsos/ tshong khe spog gi dus mna' dzun g.yo khram sogs kyi sgo nas nyin mtshan kun tu nang ba mo lham dang / nub skar chen zhwar byas/lha sha khyi la byin/ gdong sha mi la byin/ mchi ma'i skom pa dang / rgyu ma'i ske rags byas/ sprang gla g.yog sogs kyi sgo nas mi dang 'dzing / khyi dang rtsod nas bsgrub pa'i zas nor dang / zhing so nam gyi dus su yang rkang khrag rdo/lag khrag shing / rkang lag ser kha/ rkang chu ser ma song bar nyin gyi mi/mtshan gyi khyi byas nas sdug 'bad rtsol gsum gyis bsgrub nas nyin mo'i so ba/233

tre chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/mtshan mo'i mel tshe sogs kyis bsags srung spel ba'i zas rnar thams cad bu la byin nas da dung 'di bas 'byor 'di bas skyid na ci ma rung snyam pa sogs dus rnams kun tu sems pa yo byad byin pa'i drin dang / bdag dang po nas shes rgya dang mthong rgya can dang / bsam shes dang smra shes can zhig 'ong ba med de/ pha ma rig dus dang skom ltogs na tsha sogs byung tshe ngu ba dang /rkang lag g.yob pa tsam ma gtogs ci yang mi shes shing mi nus pa zhig yod skabs / ma drin chen mas skad cha cung zad smra shes skabs smra ba bslabs te 'di la a pha gyis/ nga la a ma gyis/ kho la sha nye gyis/ mo la sring mo gyis sogs dang / cung zad long thub tsam nas lag mgo nas 'then te/ ldang lugs dang 'gro lugs bslabs/ zas za pa dang gos gyon tshul sogs nas bzo rig la sogs sna tshogs bslabs nas/ byis pa gzhon pa/ gzhon pa dar bab sogs nas da bar du bskyangs nas mi mnyam pa dang mnyam/ mi 'dra pa dang 'dra bar byas pa yin/ mdor na nga cung zad 'gro ba dang smra ba sogs byed nus pa'i tshe mo la sangs rgyas thob pa tsam gyi dga' spro byed nas yang yang bslab pa sogs 'jig rten bstan pa'i drin yin/ dang po chos bsgrub pa'i lus rten bskyed cing zas gos sogs mthun rkyen ba ba/ bar du sems bskyed pa dang sbyin sogs bslab pa'i yul/ mthar sangs rgyas nas 'phrin las 'jug pa'i gnas sogs yin pas chos phyogs kyi drin rnams dran dgos/ da lta'i ma 'di'i tshe rabs snga ma rnams su ma lan grangs mang por byas dus kyang drin chen pos bskyangs pa sha stag yin te khra dang spyang ki stag gzig sogs kyis bu la gces skyong byed pa'i tshul rnams dran dgos/ drin 234

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/lan gzo ba ni/ ma drin mo che de la 'dod rgyu bde ba 'dod kyang de'i rgyu dge ba sgrub mi shes/ lam ston bla ma ni med/ gal te yod kyang bka' bzhin dase ba mi sgrub cing / mi dge ba la 'chol nyog tu spyod/ spyir 'khor ba dang sgos ngan song gi sdug bsngal rgya cher lta ci/ tha na me stag phra mo phog pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yang mi 'dod kyang / rgyu 'bras blang dor la rmongs pas nga'i ched du bsags pa'i sdig pa tha na mgo shig gcig pu bsad pa de kho nas kyang ma rgan ngan song gi sdug bsngal las nam yang mi thar par song nges te/ ma shi bar yod na ni da dung yang nga'i don du re dogs kyi bsam sbyor sdig dang sdug bsngal ngan pa mang po sgrub nas tha na rmi lam tshun chad du 'khrul snang dang sdug bsngal gyi dra bar tshud nas yod/ shi ba gyur na ni sdug bsngal bden pas dngos dang kun 'byung gis brgyud nas gnod de/ tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal gyis skyego/ phyi ma'i sdug bsngal gyis bsu/ bar do'i sdug bsngal gyis mtshams sbyor nas da lta dmyal bar tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yang na yi dwags bkros skom gyi kug bsngal/ yang na dud 'gro glen rmongs bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal sogs cang nas bsdad yod nges pas ma drin mo che de sha tsha snying rje snyam pa'i snying rje mchi ma 'khrugs pa bskal chen gyi me 'bar ba ltar snying khong rus pa'i gting nas snying 'khul 'gro ba tsam bskyed/ de lta bu'i ma rgan sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras can de snying rje'i dmigs pa'am yul yin/ rnam pa sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang gtan du bral bar zhig byung na ci ma rung / bral bar gyur cig lham pa dang / de nas 'di ltar bsam ste/ ga re yid smon 'ba' zhig bsgom pas ci phan/ da lta ni ngas ma rgan la khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 235

da wa tram̐chenamatshosu chos grwa'i daspa tshogs/bsal ba'i nus pa med pa ma zad/ gang du skyes yod pa tsam yang mi shes/dmyal ba'i tsha grang la tha na rlung sil bu tsam dang/ drod me stag tsam zhig gis sdug bsngal yang bsal mi nus/ yi dwags bkros skom la zan changs ba gang ngam chu thig pa tsam zhig kyang skyel mi nus/ dud 'gror skyes pa la 'jigs pa las skyobs pa dang cung zad tsam gyi ngal gso ba yang sbyin ma nus na ci byed/ de bas na 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag las skyob nus pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin 'dug pas/ ma rgan 'di sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras mtha' dag las bdag gcig pus dus da lta tshe 'di la skyabs nus pa'i ched du myur lam 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po la brten nas bdag gis sangs rgyas thob par byas nas ma rgan 'khor ba las bsgral ba bya snyam pa dang / de ltar 'gyur bar bla ma dkon mchog gis byin gyis rlobs shig snyam pa'i gsol 'debs te 'brel bar bzhi ldan dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom par bya dgos/sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras so sor gye ste 'che'i ba bzhi ldan yang bsgom/ byams pa sogs la'ang 'asge de nas gsod du nye ba dang sdug bsngal bzhin pa'i sems can mi dud 'gro sogs la dmigs te/ de rang ngam a ma rgan mo yin pa'i blo bzhag nas 'jigs skrags sdug bsngal 'di dang 'di lta bu la dngos su sbyor ba la mi bzod pa'i snying rje bsgom/ sdug bsngal de dag dang bral bar gyur cig sogs dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom/ yang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sgrub pa'i shan pa dang rngon pa sogs la dmigs te khong khro med par blang dor la rmongs pa 'di rnams snying re rje rgyu mi dge sdig pa'i las 'di dag dang gtan du bral bar gyur cig bral na ci ma rung / bral ba zhig blang dor gyi gnas 236

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ston te ngas bya/ de ltar dkon mchog gsum mkhyen snyam pa gsol 'debs bya/de ltar pha dang spun dang sring mo dang a khu a de sogs nas rim gyis bsgom ste mthar nam mkha'i gar khyab kyi sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gsum sogs sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras thams cad bral bar gyur cig sogs bsgom pa dpyad 'jog spel mar bya/ dmigs med 'khor gsum snang la rang bzhin med pa'i nges shes drangs/ thun rjes rnams 'dra/ thun mtshams sems can mthong tshad la bsgoms/ snying rje'ang zhag bzhi/'byongs tshad ni/ rang la gces par 'dzin pa'i gdos thag chod nas/sems can thams cad la sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i blo tshig tsam ma yin pa skyes na snying rje 'byongs pa yin no/ /phan yon ni/ sbyan ras gzigs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa las/ chos gcig yod na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du bzhag pa lta bur 'gyur te/ gcig gang zhe na 'di ste snying rje chen po'o/ /zhes dang / kham lung pas/ byams snying rje bya ba'i nga tsam thos pa yang bsod nams dpag tu med pa bsags pa yin zhes stozhe la ngas pa sogs mang ngo / / bzhi pa dga' ba ni/ sngon 'gro'i bskor 'dra/ dngos gzhi la yang rang gi ma la/ ma shes drin dran/ drin gzo 'dod kyi byams pa dang snying rje gnyis bsgom la/ de nas skye sla phyir rang gi ma rgan la zas gos gnas mal/nor dang longs spyod thob dang mnga' thang / dpal dang 'byor pa/ rigs dang grags pa/ bde zhing skyid pa cung zad re yod pa de la dmigs pa'am mas yen la/ rnam pa'am blo de la dga' bar blta/ dgos par blta/ med ji 237

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/thabs med par blta zhing dga' ba bsgom/ ma rgan gyi skyid kyi 'bras bu dang de'i rgyu dge ba cung zad re yod pa de ma nyams ma god par gong nas gong du 'phel zhing bde ba'i rgyu dge ba dang 'bras bu bde ba de dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig ma bral na ci ma rung / mi 'bral ba zhig bdag ngas bya snyam pa dang —/ gsol 'debs bya/ de ltar ma rgan la bde ba'i rgyu 'bras thob yod pa de mi 'bral bar gong nas gong du 'phel nas gnas skabs mngon mtho lha mi dang / mthar thug nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang gi bar du gong nas gong du 'phel bar gyur cig 'phel na ci ma rung /'phel ba zhig ngas bya snyam pa dang / de'i ched du dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom/ dang po ma nas skye sla ba'i yul rang gi nye ba dang mdza' bshes/ de nas bar ma rnams/ de nas rang la gnod pa'i dgra dang mtha' sems can thams cad la bsgom/ 'khor gsum rang bzhin med pa'i nges shes drangs/ thun rjes thams cad 'dra/ thun mtshams su yang dga' ba phrag dog gi gnyen po yin pas/ gzhan bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa rnams la mi bzod pa'i phrag dog gi blo ngan 'di yod ring /rang skyon ngos mi zin gzhan gyi yon tan mi mthong / don med gig pa tshabs chen sog 'gro bas de rtsad nas spangs te dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dga' ba bsgoms/ mdor na thems can thams cad ma yin/ nga bu yin snyam nas/ ma'i bde ba thams cad bus sgrub dgos pa la/ ngas sgrub ma dgos par sems can rang gis bde ba rnyed pa la dga' ba bsgom pa las phrag dog gtan nas byed mi rung / mched grogs sogs zos bsam sgom pa 238

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dang 'gro don mnga' thang sogs rgyas pa la dga' ba bsgom dang rang gi thos bsam sogs mi nyams pa'i dgos pa yod pa ma zad bstan pa mi daspugs ba'i rgyu ma nor ba'ang yin pas mchog rnams kyis kyang thugs nyams bzhes — 'tshal/ dga' ba'ang zhag gsum/'byongs pa'i tshad ni gzhan gyi bde 'byor la nam dzong phrag dog med pa'i dga' ba dam pa skye ba na yin no/ /phan yon ni/ brgyad stong pa las/dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa tshad med pa/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mi 'phrogs pa gang gis/ bla na med pa'i phun sum tshogs pas mngon par mthong ba nyid thob par byed do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na rgyun du nad pa dang dbul phong ngan song gi 'gro ba sogs la ma shes drin dran drin gzo 'dod kyis tshad med bzhi ka dang / gzhan sems can gang yang byams sogs gang rung gi yul du ma gyur pa med pas rang gi rgyud la ma skyes bar du bsgom dgos pas zhag grangs tshang tsam ma yin par nan tan bya dgos te/ de ltar tshad med pa bzhi po 'di dag byang chub kyi zulas mtshan nyid pa rang rgyud la skye ba'i rgyu ma nor ba yin par ma zad bla thed༅nga༅ba kyi go 'phang sgrub par la thog mtha' bar gsum kun tu med mi rung pa yin/ tshad thed bzhi po de yang bsdus te go slar byas na kun la phan 'dod kyi bsam pa bzang po zhig la 'dus pas dus dang rnam pa kun tu bsam pa bzang po kho na la bslabs dgos/ de ltar byas na tshe 'di'i 'dod don thams cad 'aspub/ dkar phyogs kyi lhas srung zhing sangs rgyas byang thems thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob/ ci byas dge bar 'gyur zhing 'chi kha 239

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/gnod gcod mi 'byung / phyi ma lha ma'i go 'phang thob/ mthar bug sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur bas tsab tsob tu rang rgyud la mi brtag par chos phyag bskor sgrub pa la 'jug khul las/ rang rgyud la bsam pa bzang po re skye thabs la 'bad pa gal che'o/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa dngos la/ ngo bo dbye ba sems bskyed tshul dang gsum/ dang po zur gnyis sam don gnyis dang ldan pa byang chub sems bskyed kyi ngo bo yin te/ zur dang po'am don dang po sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te snyam pa snying rjes sems can la dmigs pa yin/ zur phyi ma'am don phyi ma kug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya snyam pa de shes rab kyi rdzogs byang la dmigs pa yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/blo stobs kyi dbye bas gsum ste 'dod chen rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed/mnyan pa lta bu ye shes dam pa'i sems bskyed/ dpe med pa ji bo lta bu'i sems bskyed dang gsum mo/ /sa mtshams kyis dbye na tshogs skyor na mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la lhag bsam dag pa'i sems bskyed/ dag sa gsum du rnam par zin pa'i sems bskyed/sangs rgyas sa na sgrib kun spangs pa'i sems bsgro'o dang bzhi'o/ /sems bskyed rang gi ngo bos dbye na kun rdzob sems bskyed dang / don dam sems bskyed gnyis yod/ kun rdzob sems bskyed la'ang smon pa dang 'jug pa sems bskyed gnyis nang gsas dbye yod/ gsum pa ni/ gong du bshad par ltar tshad thed bzhi la bsgom pa nan tan byas nas de dag la blo legs 240

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/para'abyotrībadang skye/byakā chukā sems sdom cho ga la ltos dgos pas bla ma las swā tshuṭā ṭwāṃs banyed ṭāg ga sdur bya/rgyunaduyangabaṭwāṃb btus las/rna ba trīsagan dan/ngogs bcu kā bzhugs pa sazlos rgyas dang ca sbyab mas dpa'arnams mapye kṣiṃ du bams nas/ marsha bdag snyed bas sdong sbyar la blangasna te/ sa ṭwāṃsungs par ltar/rang sa byang sdozan tshe'altarabaṭwāṃrshadas tho/ 'iṭwāṃs can thamapy-i cad sdug bsngal dang bral te rnam masmo 'phang beeb pa da dungs rāpa ṭwāṃng churnyi mchogartsasems bskyed/ 'ju/matrīl yangarangaṭwāṃsadago phar son dzo bamib par bsam nas/ nas ktas ṭācu nachi gabye dadīs gakyil dusonganas/ zhibyang chub deng ra sdos ṭār gas sa ba gsum gyi ga ba/nga / ji gnyis rdorajishāsayinal/camubagasumakyi/ ltar sngon ba gags sogs ma gde ne tshigasnga ma gnyis sa rgyal ba sbyas bcas trī sngon smon pa byang —skocabugs ji ltar bam rno dang / ma ga/sa ṭwāṃ py-ijug ṭwāṃ byang dzi ṭwāṃltarasaṭwāṃs/ garshald dpa yul rte ga ste mganyis sa bdapy-i sa ṭwāṃng rgyal trī sras dang gi smon pa byang chub ṭwāṃg tu mas bgyid pa dang /ru sa tshod nas rim sa baspab par ba'o snyam ga gabarjod pa'i tha ma la rgyal bawas bcas kyis thabs 4lo/ 'kho gcas pas de ma thag skye ba yin cing / bdag gis legs sha ma 111/de /snyerje / sgyu kyi 1re/da par sam la ba sa ba dang bcas pa da la bzhag24nga

tram̐ chen mtsho gu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/dus bdag tshe sogs kyis 'jug rang gzhan dga' ba bsgom dgos/ de ltar thob pa'i sems bskyed de mi nyams shing gong du 'phel ba'i phyir du dus dang rnam par kun 'di ltar yang dang yang du blang dgos/ de yang mdun mkhar sems bskyed kyi dpang por skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing ji bzhin gsal gdab/sems can thams cad la ma shes drin dran sogs kyi sgo nas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas sngon gyi rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzad spyod rlabs po che la bslab cing / 'khor ba na sems can gcig kyang mi gnas pa/ de tsam du brtson 'grus brtsam mo snyam pas/ ho/ sna tshogs snang ba chu zla'i sogs grangs mang brjod/ skabs 'di'i sems bskyed gong 'og blo sbyong skabs thun re la cha gsum du bgos pa'i phyi ma gcig la bsags dgos pa dang grangs khri gsum gyis chog par gsungs kyang ci thon bya zhing 'bum lnga'i grangs su mi bgrang / bun mthar rnams su tshogs zhing la mos gus dung dung byas pas/lha tshogs rnams mtha' nas rim gyis 'od du zhu nas dbus kyi bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus la jim/ bla ma yang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis de dag gi thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems rang rgyud la lhang gi skyes par bsam/ thun rjes byang chub sems mchog rin po che sogs bsngo smon gong dang 'dra/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa 'di ni chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi snying po/ yod na des chog med na thabs chags/nad brgya sman gcig sman dkar po gcig thub lta bu yin/ 'di la ma bsten pa'i dge ba gzhan tshogs bsags pa/ sgrib pa sbyang ba/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags 242

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/bzla ba la sogs chos nyams su len pa thams cad ci bzang snyam yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu mi 'gyur la/ byang chub kyi sems 'di rgyud la skyes na chos gang bsgrub thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gro ba ma zad ltar snang mi dge ba dang gnyid dang bag med gyur pa sogs kyang byang chub chen po'i rgyur 'gro bar gsungs so/ /des na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rang rgyud la byang chub sems nyag ma re skye ba'i thabs la sgo du ma nas bslab/ byang chub sems kyi man ngag ston pa'i bla ma la bka' drin lhag par dran te sangs rgyas dngos mthong gi mos gus bya/ mdor na byams snying rje byang chub kyi soms rang rgyud la nges par skyes pa zhig dgos kyi/ don sems thog tu ma blangs par sems bskyed 'bum phrag mang po bton kyang snying po til 'bru tsam yang med do/ /de ltar byang chub sems bskyed pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par yod pas spyod 'jug sogs las shes par byas nas dus kun dran na byang chub kyi sems mi nyams pa sogs dgos pa tshad med mes stor mjug kun tu dran pa bya dgos/gsum pa skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang mi nyams pa gong nas gong du 'ji ba'i bas smon 'jug gi bslab bya la gnyis las/ dang po smon pa'i — ma rang bakhu ba las/dnghadang tho dag gnan mnyam pa bsgom pa ni/ spyir byang chub kyi sems mi nyams pa'i bsasku smon pa'i mas te/ nyams byed kyi rgyu ni bdag rang 'dod ba pa'i bsam pa dang de'i grogs khong khro gnyis yin/ ji ltar nyams na sems can blos btang gis zur dang po nyams/ rnam mkhyen blos btang 243

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/gis zur phyi ma nyams pas so/ /zur gnyis po nyams na rtsa ba'i rtsang ba byung tshar bas yan lag tsam ma nyams kyang phan pa med la/ 'di ltar pha bsad lta bu'i gnod byed zhig la khyod kyis nga la zer nas rang 'dod kyi bsam pa de bslang nas khong khro skye bas de la phan 'dogs kyi blo btang ba yin/ sems can gcig blos btang na nyams tshar ba yin te dbyug pa mang po lhan du bsdam yang gcig blangs na gzhan rnams shugs kyis 'thor ba ltar ro/ /rnam mkhyen blos btang yang sems can gang rung blos btang na der phan phyir sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i blo yang mi 'byung bas don gyis blos btang ba'am/bdag gis soms can gyi phyir du byang chub spyod pa la bslab mi nus snyam nas bla shor ba sogs byung na rnam mkhyen blos btang bar 'gyur la/ de ya nga rang 'dod kyi bsam pa la thug pa ma zad so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom dang dam tshig nyams pa'ang 'di la bug pas rang 'dod skub pa'i nyes dmigs kyis 'khor bar 'khyams pa dang / byang chub sems kyi phan yon gyis sangs rgyas thob par rnams dran dgos/ mdor na rang 'dod yid byed kyi 'gong po 'dis gnas skabs rgyal ba'i sras kyi sa'i yon tan dang / mthar bug thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad rang la 'khor du mi ster pa yin pas/ byang chub kyi sems la brten nas 'di phud dgos/ ji ltar na bdag gzhan mnyam pa brje ba gzhan gces gsum la blo nan po sbyong dgos—/ de yang thun gyi sngon 'gro'i bskor 'dra/ dngos gzhi la bdag thog med nas bdag gzhan ma mnyam pas bdag dang bdag gi phyogs la chags/dgra dang dgra'i phyogs la ldang bas 'di phyi'i nyes dmigs thams cad byung la/244

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/da ni chags sdang gnyis po btang nas rang 'dod sgrub pa'i blo ngan goms 'di'i skyon shes nas rang gzhan gnyis gzhi sdong chus sdong byed dgos te/'di ltar nam mkha'i gar khyab kyi sems can nga'i ma yin/ nga bu yin/ ma rnams drin chen yin nged ma bu skyid sdug mnyam pa yin bsam na rang 'dod kyi blo ngan de zhi 'gro/ de yang nged gnyis kas bde ba 'dod mnyam sdug bsngal mi 'dod par mnyam pas bdag gzhan sems can kun gyi bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis po lhan sgrub bsam sbyor gnyis kas byed pa'i byams pa bsgoms ste/ ma sems can rnams kyis bde ba'i rgyu sgrub mi shes shing lam ston kyang med/ yod kyang mi sgrub/ nga ni bla ma dang mjal/ theg chen gyi chos dang 'phrad/ chos pa zhig yin mdog byed na/ sems can gyi bde ba ngas sgrub dgos pas sems can kun la gnas skabs mthar thug gi bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyi dang ldan par gyur cig sogs 'brel ba bzhi ldan bsgom/ yang sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis po lhan bsal byed pa'i snying rje bsgom/ de yang sa can thams cad la ma shes drin dran sngar ltar bsgom nas/ drin gzo ri sa can kun la bde ba 'dod kyang mi ldan/ sdug bsngal mi bsngal gyi 'bras bu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis dngos su sa ci thun 'byung las dang nyon mongs gnyis kyis brgyud de gnod snag bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral bar gyur cig dngha chi ci de ltar bsam pas yin na sems can gyi mgo ra ba zhig dgos/ sbyor bas yin na/— 4— nga la lham yod gzhan pa la med na lham 245

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ya lham ya byed nas rkang ya gnyis kyi sdug bsngal dang / rkang ya gnyis kyi bde ba lhan myong byed nus pa zhig dgos/ btang stoms dang dga' ba gnyis po'ang ma shes sogs tshang ba re bsgom/ de yang sems can thams cad ma'i yul du snyoms pa'am bza' mi'i yul du snyoms pa bsgom nas/ dper na rang gi bu chung bas lha ma'i bde ba myong / 'bring gis nyan rang / che bas sangs rgyas kyi bde ba myong ba la bdag gis 'bad rtsol ma dgos par rang rang gis bde ba'i 'bras bu myong ba la dga' ba bsgom/ rgyu dad sogs thob pa la dga' ba bsgom/ bde skyid 'di dag ma nyams ma god par gong nas gong du 'phel na ci ma rung snyam ste bsam pas dga' ba bsgom/ sbyor bas bde ba lhan sgrub byed dgos/ de ltar tshad med bzhi'am byams snying rje gnyis sam/ yang na snying rje gcig pu bsgoms/ de kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems yin/ don dam byang chub sems ni 'khor gsum po snang la rang bzhin med pa'i dpyad stong gyi nges shes drangs/ thun gyi rjes 'dra/ 'di la zhag gsum/bdag gzhan mnyam pa 'di lam dus bsam sbyor gnyis kas mnyam pa dang / 'bras dus bdag gzhan gyi chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i thabs yin pas bun mtshams sogs dus rnams kun tu gal che bas nyams su len par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bdag gzhan brje bar bsgom pa ni/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa de legs par goms pa na/ brje bar bsgom dgos/ de yang dpal sprul rin po ches rdzi bo'i phying pa'i dpe gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ bdag 'dzin 'gong po 'di 'gong bkar byed dgos/ bdag gzhan brjes pa'i bsam pa la 246

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/'gong rdzong gi cho ga zhes btags dgos/ de bsgom pa la sbyor ba 'dra/dngos gzhi dang po ma shes drin dran sogs kyi rtogs pa bskyed de de'i mtshams su bsgom dgos/ de yang dang po rtsa ba'i ma la snying rje chen pos len pa ni/ ma rgan da lta skyid bzhin yod dam sdug bzhin yod bsam na sdug bzhin yod de/ tshe 'dis sdug bsngal gyis ded/ bar do'i sdug bsngal gyis mtshams sbyar/ phyi ma'i sdug bsngal gyis bsu ma byed de 'bras bu sdug bsngal gsum gyis gdung gi yod pa dang / rgyu chags sdang rmongs gsum/ las mi dge bcu lta bu'i sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral bar gyur cig bral na ci ma rung / bral ba zhig ngas bya/ bral ba zhig dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs dgos te/ kye ma kye hud sogs dang / bla ma rgyal ba sogs dang /dpa' bo khyod la sogs kyis 'dod don la gsol ba 'debs/ de yang 'pho ba rgyang 'phen tsam gyis mi phan te ma drin mo che'i sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis bo de da lta nyid myur ba nyid/ 'dug sa 'di ru bdag la smin par gyur cig sminar ci ma rung / smin pa zhig ngas bya/ smin pa zhig bslu med dkon mchog gsum mkhyen snyam du gsol ba 'debs/ byams pa chen pos gtong ba ni/ma ma mngon mtho dang nges legs bar gyi bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig sogs 'brel ba bzhi ldan bya/ de tsam gyis mi phan pas nga'i da lta'i bde ba cubacad bo 'di nas bzung lam dang 'bras bu sangs rgyas bar gyi bde ba thamaspocad ma drin mo che la da lta nyid / myur ba nyid/ 'dug sa 'di ru gdan sa'i ru zin par gyur cig sogs gong bzhin bya/ de dag dmigs goms bla jirarlung gi rta la bskyon pa ni/ ma rgan gyi sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras 247

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/gnyis po rlung nag po'i rnam pas tshur dbugs dbyung ba dang mnyam du bdag gis rlung nang du jub pa dang lhan cig sna nas zhugs te snying nang gi bdag 'dzin 'gong po la sib sib thim pas bdag sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang ldan/ma rgan de gnyis dang bral bar bsam/ de ltar bsam sbyor gnyis kas yang yang bsam/ yang bdag gi tshe bsod nams kha rje dbang thang lus longs spyod/ bde skyid bde ba'i dngos po thams cad rlung dkar po'i rnam par bsang dud chad pa bzhin sna bug nas thon te rlung jir 'gro pa dang mnyam du mas rlung nang du jub pa dang chabs cig bdag bde ba rgyu 'bras dang bral/ma gen de gnyis dang ldan par bsam/ de ltar bsam zhing spyor bas bde ba phra mo nas sgrub dgos/ de nas pha dang spun sogs nas mthar mkhar khyab kyi sems can thams cad la gtong len gnyis po sngar bzhin yang yang bsgom/de dag ni zur gnyis tshang ba'i byang chub kyi sems yin pas/ khe dang rgyal kha sems can la byin/ gyong dang bub kha rang gis len par zhig yin/ bdag gzhan brje ba la nang gses yod pas/ dang po 'dzin stangs bajes pa ni/sems can thams cad nga yin zhes mtho ris gsum lus kyi stod dang / ngan 'gro lus kyi sgad yin par ngar 'dzin dgos/ yang na sems can thams cad nga'i ma yin/ nga bu yin zhes nga yir bar 'dzin dgos/ gnyis pa gces 'dzin brjes pa ni sngar bdag gces par 'dzin pa'i blo ngan de dor nas/ da sems can thams cad gces par blta/ dmar bar blta/ dga' bar blta/ dgos par blta/ med thabs med par blta/ gsum pa bde sdug brjes pa sngar dro dro thams cad rang la blangs/ 'khyag 'khyag thams 248

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/cad ma la gyin pas da ni de ring nas dro dro thams cad ma la byin/ 'khyag 'khyag thams cad rang la bskor te mdor na bde skyid bde ba'i dngos po thams cad ma sems can gzhan la byin/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal thams cad bdag rang gi steng du blangs pa yin/ gzhan gces par bzung ba'i yon tan gyis tshe rabs kun tu bde nas bde bar 'gro zhing mthar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa dang / rang gces par bzung ba'i skyon gyis skye ba thog mtha' med par sdug bsngal gyi gnas 'khor bar mu mtha' med par 'khyams pas/ bdag gzhan du bzhag gzhan bdag tu bzung bar blo sbyong zhing / ngag tu yang / kyid na bde ba tshogs su bsngo/ /phan bdes nam mkha' gang bar shog /kug na gzhan gyis sdug bsngal khur/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par shog ces dang / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas/ /bral nas bdag gi rgyud la smrin gyur cig /bdag gi phan bde'i dge tshogs ma lus pa//ma gyur 'gro bas thob nas sangs rgyas shog /ces pa 'di za nyal 'gro 'dug la sogasastod lam thams cad du tshig gis sbyangs dgos/ de ltar yang yang tshig gis sbyangs te 'di yang zhag bzhi/tsun’sa thams cad 'dra/ thun mtshams sogs su lam khyer 'di ltar / skyid rgyu 'bras gnyis po phra rags ci byung na byang chub sems kyi nas bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis ka byams pas gzhan la ga rnag bsngal rgyu 'bras phra rags ci byung na lam gyi bar chad du mi 'asgro bar len par bsgom nas skyid sdug gnyis ka lam gyi ngo bor 'gyur ba'i bas la 'bad/ mdor na chos brgyad kyi mthun phyogs bzhi 249

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa' dpe tshogs/ —gtong zhing mi mabun phyogs bzhi blangs dgos/ log gnon ni/ rang gi mgo na ba tsam re'i steng du/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal yod do cog blangs nas bdag mgo na ba'i sdug bsngal 'dis 'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal myong go chod/ na na na go chod/ tsha na tsha go chod/ shi na shi go chod nas thams cad sdug bsngal las grol bar shog snyam du bsam pa dang / yang rgyu chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rtog pa rang rgyud la skye tshe rtog pa de dag dran nas de'i steng du sems can kun gyi rgyud kyi dug gsum la sogs pa'i mi dge'i rtog pa dang las te sdug bsngal gyi rgyu rnams bdag gi rtog pa 'dis go chod/de rnams kyi rtog pa rnams bdag la smin/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar shog cig snyam du rang rgyud la blangs/ khyad par yongs su bzung ba'i gzhi gsum po btang dgos te/ rang gi da sngon lus thams cad don med du song / da ni de ring nas sangs rgyas kyi bar lus che phra mtho dman gang dang gang blangs pa de dag bzang dad pa dag snang / ngan chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis 'brel ba'i 'gro ba kun gyis mthong thos dran reg tha na ro rul gyi dri tsam myong ba sogs thams cad kyi nad gdon na tsha sdug bsngal mdor na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba dang / rgyu las nyon thams cad zhi zhing sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis po dang gtan du bral ba'i rgyur 'gyur par smon/ yang rang lus mthong thos dran reg kun gyi rgyud la bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis po thob par smon lam gdab/ de nas da sngon longs spyod rnams kyang don med du zad/ da ni de ring nas dma' sprang zas tsam nas mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod kyi bar thams cad la bzang po dad 250
