snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/pa dag snang ngan chags sdang rmongs sogs kyi 'brel ba bzang ngan ji byed pa'i yul la mthong thos sogs kyi sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis zhi/ nad dang na tsha/ gdon dang sdug bsngal bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis po de rnams kyi rgyud la skye bar smon lam gdab/ mdor na rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad mthong grol/ thos grol reg grol du smon lam btab/ de ltar 'grub par dkon mchog gi bden pa brdar/ yang dge rtsa dus gsum bsags pa rnams la'ang chung bsod nams cha mabun gyi dge ba phra mo nas bzung mthar thams cad mkhyen pa'i zag med kyi dge ba rgya mtsho lta bu'i bar gyi dge rtsa de dag la bzang po dad pa dag snang / ngan pa chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi 'brel ba'i sems can thams cad la 'brel tshad don ldan gyi smon lam gdab/ dkon mchog gi bden pa brnar/ de lta bu'i bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems 'di ni/ byang chub sgrub pa la med du mi rung ba'i chos mthar thug pa yin pas/ sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyis thugs dam gyi mthil 'di la mdzad pa yin te/ dge bshes 'chad kha bas lo drug la khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin/ gyong dang bub kha rang gis blang zhes pa'i don 'di la blo sbyong kho na byas te bsgoms pas bdag gces 'dzin gyi 'khri ba gtan med du gyur/ gzhan yang bdag cag gi ston pa sngon shing rta 'dren pa'i dmyal bar skyes dus kyi lo rgyus dang / mdza' bo'i bu mor skyes pa'i lo rgyus lta bu rnams yin/ bdag gzhan brje ba 'di ni tshe 'dir yang na tsha sdug bsngal la sogs zhi ba dang / lha 'dre dang gdon gegs 'dul ba la sogs la yang 'di las lhag pa med pas/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu bdag gces 251

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/'dzin blo 'di dug ltar spang te/ bdag gzhan brje ba 'di bsgom pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /de dag gis bdag gzhan brje ba song /gsum pa bdag bas gzhan gces bsgom pa ni/ de ltar sems thog nas bdag gzhan brjes brjes byas nas soms kyi steng nas chos brgyad blang dor la ro snyoms pa'i mthu thob nas/ gzhan gces bsgom dgos/ de yang sngon 'gro 'dra thun gyi dngos gzhi la/ bdag de ring nas bzung 'khor bar gnas rung dmyal bar skyes rung / na ruji tsha rung nyams nyes ci byung yang 'dra ste bzod par bya/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro la sogs pa'i rigs drug gi sdug bsngal 'di bdag gi steng du smin par shog cig bdag gi bde skyid bde ba'i dngos po sogs sems can thams cad la btang bas khong la rdzogs par shog cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas yang yang bsam dgos te/ srid rtse nas mnar med bar gyi sems can thams cad la mar shes/ drin dran drin gzo 'dod kyi rtog pa bskyed/ sdug bsngal bral 'dod skabs/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu sug bsngal gsum dang / rgyu chags sdang gte mug sogs nyon mongs dang / des kun nas bslang ba'i las mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med lnga/ nye ba lnga/ snyi ba bzhi log pa brgyad la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis po dang bral bar gyur cig bral na ci ma rung / bral ba zhig bdag ngas bya snyam/ dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab/ de tsam gyis mi phan te da lta nyid myur ba nyid du bdag rgyud la smin par gyur cig snyam du bsam sbyor gnyis kas len/ nges par smin pa zhig byung na sems can kun gyi sha tshab khrag tshab rus tshab shi tshab na tshab sogs 252

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/byed nas dmyal ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal bdag gis cong ste go chod par bsam/ yang na sems can gyi grangs bzhin bdag lus mang por gyur nas de dang de'i tshab ma byed nas sdug bsngal myong kyang bzod snyam/ yang na lus chen po gyur nas stod mtho ris sgad ngan song du'am/ dmyal sogs de dag gi sdug bsngal zhib tu bsam nas de dag rang gi myong ba bsam nas rgyud thog la blangs/ de thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral nas mtho ris nas sangs rgyas bar gyi bde ba thams cad myong nas re re bzhin sangs rgyas thob par bsam/ de dag nga'i dge rtsas thob pa yin pas nga re dga' snyam du sems can gcig gi don la bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar du dmyal bar 'dug dgos kyang bzod snyam pa'i 'du shes bskyed/ byams pa chen pos btang ba ni/ nyi ma de ring nas bzung lus longs spyod dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad la ma byin sa med pa/ sa chen rdul dang mnyam pa mang po sbyin 'dod kyi bsam pas byin pa yang yang bsam/phyin chad lus dang longs spyod la kha la srab rgyab tu sga bzhag pa dang / 'phrog pa sogs gnod pa ci byas rung de dag la rag las pas bdag tu mi 'dzin pa bsam/ yongs su bzung ba'i gzhi gsum de ltar btang na dngos su gzhan la phan brgyud nas rang la phan pa sgrub pa yin no/ /thun rjes 'dra 'di'ang zhag gsum/thun mtshams sogs su bdag gzhan brje ba sems kyi steng nas goms shing 'byong nas/ las dang po ba'i skabs 'di sbyor ba lag len gyi steng nas kyang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyong nas bdag bas gzhan gcesdu 3

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/sgrub dgos/ delang so skyes skabs nas 'ong ba yod de bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa lta bu yin/ mdor na thabs shes gnyis la brten nas bdag 'dzin bcad dgos pas/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang / brje ba dang /gzhan gces kyi thabs 'di gsum gyis rang 'dod yid byed kyi rtog pa de mgo non tshul gyis bcad/ de nas thabs byung don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis bdag 'dzin drung nas 'byin te bcad dgos/ des na dang po kun rdzob byang chub sems yang yang bsgoms zhing gtan la phabs nas/ de nas don dam byang chub sems la gtso bor sbyangs dgos/ bdag bas gzhan gces sogs mtshan nyid pa mthong lam du 'byung bas gzhan don sgrub pa dngos su nus pa'i mgo sleb pa yin/ tshe gang gi nyams len des chog rgyal po byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyisakren pas las dang po bas tshe skyid sdug rtag pa mi 'ong bas thams cad lam du khyer shes dgos/ de yang rang la skyid rgyu 'bras ci byung na 'di 'dzin 'dug mi nyan/ lus longs spyod dad nges 'byung byang sems sogs ldan tshe khong khro sogs kyis ma 'jom gang sems can la sbyin dgos/ sdug bsngal mdze sogs nad kyis mnar ba/ gdon gyis gzir ba—/ grib kyis non/ sems kyi sdug bsngal sogs mi 'dod pa ci byung yang bdag tshe rabs snga ma'i mi dge'i 'bras bu myong 'gyur rnams dkon mchog thugs rjes tshe 'di la smin pa yin pas/ 'di'i steng sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad myong go bdag gcig pus chod par bsam rgyu chags sogs skyes na dkon mchog gi thugs rjes bya gtong ba yin pas 'dis sems can kun gyi 'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs thams cad kyi go chod 254

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/nas de dag gi las nyon bag chags thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig snyam—/ de ltar lam du khyer bas bskal pa grangs med kyi sdig sgrib 'dag pa dang tshogs rdzogs pa yin no/ /gsum po de dag ni smon pa sems bskyed mi nyams gong 'phel gyi thabs yin no/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa beems bskyed mi nyams par byed pa'i rgyu phar phyin drug la bslab par bya ba la rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu yod kyang bsdu na/phar phyin drug la 'du/ de yang bsdu na dmigs bcas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / dmigs med ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis sam/ thabs shes gnyis su 'du/ de yang nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin/ thabs snying rje chen pos zhi mtha' mnan/ shes rab stong nyid rtogs pas srid mtha' mnan nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das job gyed de nyan rang gi phar phyin nyi tshe ba las 'das pa'i phar phyin yang dag yin pas/ mos spyod kyi gang zag gis dbu dang yan lag gi sbyin pa sogs dngos su gtong mi nus pas bsam pas btang zhing sbyor bas bsrung ba ma gtogs btang na rtsang ba'i rgyur 'gyur bas des sbyin sogs dang shes rab la mos pas spyod pas na phar phyin btags pa ba yin/ mtshan nyid pa ni mthong lam gyi rtogs bya rtogs nas bzung sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i bar na/ mnyam bzhag spros bral dang rjes thob phar phyin bcu po rdzogs pas sa dang po nas dngos su dbu dang yan lag btang nus pa ngo bos stong kyang / rnam pa'i cha nas sbyin sogs shar bas 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rdzogs par byed pas mtshan nyid pa yin/ phar gyin drug po de/ ring lam nye lam myur lam gsum las myur lam gyis bslab 255

da tram̐chenamatshophu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/nas—/ des tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho lta bu rdzogs par byed pa dang / sems can rgya mtsho lta bu smin par gyed pa dang / zhing khams rgya mtsho lta bu yongs su rdzogs par sbyang dgos/ de lta bu'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de la ngo bo dang dbye ba gnyis las/ thun la ngo bo rnams bsgom nas thun mtshams su dbye ba sogs bsam dgos pas/dang po sbyin pa la/ thun gyi sngon 'gro 'dra gsol 'debs skabs bla ma'i thugs rgyud kyi sbyin pa'i yon tan rang rgyud la skye bar bsam zhing bugs yid bsre mnyam par bzhag 'di gong 'og kun la gang sgom dran shes dgos/dngos gzhi la gtong sems sgom dgos te/ sbyin rgyu dngos po ni lus dang longs spyod dang / dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba rnams te/ dang po sems can thams cad mar shes/ drin dran/ drin gzo 'dod kyi rtog pa bskyed de/ bdag nyi ma de ring nas bzung sbyin bya lus 'doms gang gru bzhi 'di nas mthar sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi yongs su bzung ba'i gzhi gsum po bsdom nas sbyin yul ma sems can kun la/ dgos ched bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis sgrub pa dang / sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis bsal ba'i cha rkyen du tshul ji ltar na lan dang rnam smin la re ba med par gtong ba yin/ byin pa yin/bsngos pa yin/ lus la brdung bdeg sogs bsam ngan sbyor cab/ ngan pa chags sdang smongs gsum gyi 'azel ba dang / bzang po dad pa dag snang gi 'brel ba thams cad 'azel tshad don ldan gyi smon lam gdab/ bun nang sogs la bsam pa'i steng nas gtong soms rgyu mtshan dang 'brel ba yang yang du ṭwāṃtwe nas/ sbyor bas sbyin pa chung rim nas nus tshod dang bstun te bslab

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dgos / khyad par ser sna can rnams kyis rang gi dngos po lag pa g.yas g.yon spo zhing gtong sems sbyangs/ de goms nas rim gyis tshod ma la sogs dngos su gtong / mthar gyis mgo dang yan lag sbyin pa'i bar du gtong sems goms par sbyangs dgos/ bun gyi rjes 'dra/ 'di la zhag gsum/thun mtshams sogs su gtong sems dang ma bral bas spyor ba lag len la 'debs dgos/ de yang mchod sbyin gnyis ka sbyin pa'i phar phyin yin pas/dang po zang zing gi dngos po lta bu la mtshon na sprang po zhig mthong na dga' zhing des byin cig ces pa'i sgra thos tshe mi dga' spangs nas dngos po che chung la ma ltos pas bsam pa ser sna med pas bzang shos de sbyin/ da lta bdag 'di las med kyang phyin chad lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa sprang po 'dis gtsos sems can rnams la sbyin dgos bsam nas 'dzum pa dang bcas lag gnyis brdar te sbyin/ yang slong na ma khro bar yod na yod tshod dang bsnan nas sbyin/ med na tshig gis shad sbyangs/ sbyin pa de 'bras bu dang bcas pa len pa pos gtsos sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ba dang smon lam bya/ de la gtong ba tshogs lam/ gtong ba chen po spyor lam/ shin tu gartong ba mthong lam pa'i skabs yin/ mchod pa la skyabs gnas rgya mtsho dngos su gsal la mchod bya mar me rdog po gcig lta bu/ mchod tshul sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas mchod dgos/ dngos gzhi la 'khor gsum po snang la rang bzhin med pa'i nges shes drangs/ de dag lan dang rnam smin la re ba med par ser sna'i gnyen po 'gro ba'i mchod sbyin byed dgos/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ chos bshad pa sogs gzhan rgyud dge la stor ba'i thabs byed pa 257

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/de yin/ 'on kyang rang 'dod ma zad pa'i las dang po pa so so'i skye bos chos gzhan la bshad kyang phan thogs dka' ba ma zad/ dang po chos bshad nas gzhan snang bsgyur nus ltar snang yang / 'phral gyi nges 'byung sru sud ma yal ba'i dred po chos sdug sdom dang dam tshig nyams nas 'di med phyir med du gyur na/ bstan dang der 'dzin gyi zhabs 'dren du 'gro nyen che bas/ gzhan don gzugs brnyan pa la mi snga ba dben par byams snying rje byang chub kyi soms la blo sbyong na khebs che bas/ chos bshad kyis rnyed nor bsdu ba sogs spangs dgos/ 'on kyang kha don mtshungs pa'i gang zag bslab gsum ldan pas bstan pa dang 'gro ba la lhag blo chen pos chos kyis phan pa mdzad na snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gal che'o/ /gzhan yang las dang po bas ri rtse sogs su song nas kun slong dag pas na mo ārya dam pa sogs kyis mdo 'don pa dang —/ bsang dang gsur chu gtor dang lus sbyin la sogs kyi mjug tu sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs chos sbyin byed pa des chog rang don zad dus zhi bde dang sos dal skad cig mi bsdad pa gzhan don gtso bor bya dgos pa'i dus yin / mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa ni/ sems can skyabs med sogs la skyabs dang mgon sogs byed pa dang / khyad par 'dus byas dge rtsa thams cad las srog skyabs pa phan yon che bar gsungs pas dbang yod rnams nas ri rgya dang klung rgya sdom pa dang / gzhan dag gis bsha' lug sogs bslu ba dang —/ tshe thar gtong pa/ 'chi la nye ba'i 'bu sbrang skyabs byed pa dang / sha bcad pa sogs thabs sna tshogs kyis sems can la phan pa brtson dgos/gnyis pa tshul khrims la thun thun mtshams med par tshul khrims bsrung 258

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ba dang 'bral med bya dgos/ thun gyi sngon 'gro 'dra/ dngos gzhi la sems kyi steng nas spong sems yod na tshul khrims yod/ med na tshul khrims med pas spong sems dang / spong sems de dam bca'i lcags myu gnyis pa res zin dgos pa yin/ des na mi dge bcu nas rdzogs pa chen po'i dam tshig gi bar rnams re re nas nyes pa'i cha mi byed pa'i spong sems dang / de lta bu'i dam bca' de gtong re snyam pa'i dam bca'i lcags myu gnyis pa res zin dgos/ dang po sems can thams cad la mar shes/ drin dran/ drin gzo 'dod kyi rtog pa skyed pa rnams 'di dang 'og ma thams cad la sbyar dgos/dang po sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis de ring nas bzung sangs rgyas ma thob bar du sems can gsod na nga shi ni yin/ gzhan la gsod bcugaci na nga shi ni yin/ gsod pa la yi rang byed na nga shi ni yin snyam du spong sems re dang / dam bca' de srog dmar po la babs kyang gtong re kan snyam pa'i dam bca' gnyis pa re bya dgos pa 'og ma thams cad la 'gres/ de'i mthun phyogs srog skyabs dgos/ yang bdag mu ges shi na yang spyir ma byin par dang khyad par dge 'dun pa'i rgyu nor sogs khab cig len re len du bcug re/ len pa la yi rang byed re shi snyam du dam bca'/ mabun phyogs sbyin pa gtong dgos/ yang bdag gis mi tshangs pa spyod re shi snyam pa dang khyad par btsun pa pho mo phan tshun 'khrig pa'i gtam tsam dang lag pa thug tsam re byed na shi snyam du dam bca'/ mthun spyogs tshangs par spyod dgos/ phyin chad ngas rtse 'di bcad song yang rdzun smra re snyam du dam bca'/ mabun phyogs bden pa smra/ phra ma smra ba 'dod pa 259

tre chen mtsho su chos grwa'i daspa tshogs/dang / smra bar gzo ba na/ kha la thal lcags rgyab/ brang khu tshur gyis brdung ste de smra na nga shi ni yin snyam du dam bca'/ mthun phyogs 'khon pa skums/tshig tsub dang ngag kyal kyang de bzhin spangs nas snyan par smra pa dang bzlas brjod la 'bad dgos/ khyad par grong chog dang bsnyen bsgrub tshogs mchod dang chos grwa sogs nas dbang po'i sgo bsdam/ ngag 'chal spong ste smra ba bcad/ sems gzhan du ma g.yeng ba'i sgo nas 'bad dgos/ yang nga'i snying dmar po 'di blang song yang gzhan gyi yo byad/ dkon mchog gi sdas la/brnab sems gyed re shi snyam du dam bca'/ mabun phyogs gtong sems sgom/yang sems can pha bsad kyi dgra bo yin kyang de rnams la gnod pa'i bsam stor ngan pa bsam ngan khong dug byed re shi snyam du dam bca'/ mthun phyogs snying rje sgom/ rgyu 'bras yang dag pa'i chos la spog lta srog la bab kyang byed re shi snyam du dam bca'/ de la yid ches kyis dad pa brten/ dge bsnyen gyis rtsa bzhi chang lnga po la mi byed pa'i dam bca' dang dam bca' lnga la dam bca' gnyis pa res zin dgos/ chang ni sor byang sngags gsum gang yin rung ting nge 'dzin gyi drod rtags khyad par can dug ha la zos kyang mi gnod pa'i dus ma gtogs rtswa rtse'i zil ba tsam 'thung mi rung / dge tshul gyi de lnga dang nyes byas zhib mo sum cu po rnams mi byed pa'i dam bca' sum cu/dge slong gi rtsa ba bzhi/ lhag ma bcu gsum/ spang nyung sum cu/ skung byed dgu bcu/ sor bshags bzhi/ nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis te mdor na nyis rgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum la dam bca' nyis rgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum/ byang chub sems dpa'i zab mo lta srol gyi lugs la/ rtsa nyung nyi shu dang nyes byas brgyad 260

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/cu la spong sems de'i grangs/ rgya chen spyod srol gyi rtsa ba bzhi la spong sems bzhi—/ nyes byas zhe drug la spong sems zhe drug bdag gi mgo bo bcad kyang bla'i ngas sems can blos gtong re kan snyam pa'i dam bca'/ 'jug sems phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs drug ma spong na nga shi ni yin snyam dam bca'/ rdo rje theg pa'i dam dzig ma hā'i rtsa rtsang lnga la spong beems lnga/ yan lag bcu la spong sems bcu/ ma nu'i rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum la dam bca' gsum/ yan lag nyer lnga la spong soms nyer lnga/ a ti'i bsrung du yod pa rim gyis pa'i dam tshig rtsa ba bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la dbye ba nyer bdun la spong sems nyer bdun/ yan lag gi dam tshig nyer lnga la spong beems nyer lnga/ baspung du med pa gcig char pa'i dam tshig bzhi la spong beems bzhi/ de ltar bsrung bya'i dam tshig bsrung ba'i gang zag srung ba'i phan yon gsum snang la rang bzhin med pa'i nges shes drangs/ bun gyi rjes 'dra/ 'di la'ang zhag gsum/bun mtshams sogs su mdor na gzhan la lus ngag yid gsum gyis gabasaba'i lasawa mo tsam yang spang ba nyes spyod sdom pa yin/ dge ba chos kud3 par phyin drug por bslab pa yin rung / las dang pos lus ngag yid gsum gyis dge ba phra mo tshun la brtson pa dge ba chos sdud yin/ sems can don byed ni mthong lam thob tshe bku dngos bzhis gdul bya rnams bsdus nas soms can smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa yin/ dasprer na shig gcig la ma na na/ de bzung nas 'di thems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du mi gsod snyam pa nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ de'i srog skyob pa 261

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims/ de'i dge rtsa gzhan don du bsngo ba dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims yin/ mdor na rang gi nus tshod kyi gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong na so thar/ gzhan phan gzhi bcas sgrub na byang sems/ sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du shes pa gsang sngags te sdom pa gsum gyi nang du 'dus pa yin/ des na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dge ba sna re nas sgrub/sdig pa mi dge ba sna re yin na spang / de thams cad dam pa gsum gyis zin pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i nges shes drang dgos so/ /gsum pa bzod pa bsgom pa ni/ ngo bo mi 'khrugs pa yin pas/bskal pa brgya'am stong gi bar du bsags pa'i dge rtsa dam pa gsum dang ma 'brel ba bsod nams cha mthun sbyin dang tshul khrims las byung ba rnams khong khro gcig gis thams cad skad cig la 'joms shing dmyal bar 'gro ba dang /bzod pa bsgoms pas gnas skabs gzugs bzang ba sogs yon tan gyis 'byor zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas thob la/ mdor na zhe sdang yod na byang chub kyi sems med de dper na me chu gnyis snod gcig la 'du mi rung ba ltar yin pas zhe sdang yod nas bzung byang chub sems yul gud rjes 'don gyed tshar ba yin/ byang chub sems yod na zhe sdang med de nyi ma'i mdun na mun pa bzhin yin/ des na zhe sdang gi rang 'bras mthar thug daskyal bar 'gro/bzod pa'i rang 'bras mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur bas/ bzod pa'i phan yon dang / zhe sdang gi nyes dmigs shes nas bzod pa bsgom dgos te/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med/ /de bas bzod la nan tan du/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis bsgom par 262

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de bsgom pa la zun gyi spyor ba 'dra/ dngos gzhi la—/ dgra lta bu zhig mdun du dmigs nas mar shes drin dran sogs kyi rtog pa bskyed de/ 'dis bdag la tshe rabs sngon ma rnams su phan tshad med btags pa ma tshad da lta'ang bzod pa bsgom pa'i yul byed nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la spyod bcug nas mthar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ster bas drin che/bdag ngas ni sngon chad spyang nga'i don du sdig pa mang po byas pas ngan 'gro'i kug bsngal tshad med myong / da lta yang nga la brten nas zhe sdang 'khon 'dzin 'phel bas 'di phyi kun tu gnod bskyal/ da ni nga'i bde skyid bde ba'i dngos po gang yod dang bde ba'i rgyu bzod pa sgom pa sogs kyi dge ba rnams 'di la sbyin/ 'di la bsngo 'di gnas skabs mthar thug gi bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang dus da lta nyid du ldan par gyur cig ldan na ci ma rung / ldan pa zhig ngas bya snyam/ dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab/ 'di'i sdug bsngal rgyu khong khro sogs nas/ 'bras bu dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag bdag gi rgyud la da lta nyid du smin par gyur cig sogs 'azel ba gsum ldan dngagasol 'debs bya/ des na 'di bzod pa'i yul yin pa dang / ma yin pa dang / nyon mongs gdon gyis smyos pas khong la rang dbang med pa dang /sor skyes kyi chos nyid yin pa dang / dge sdig blang dor mi shes pas khro ba'i yul ma yin pa dang / bdag bla ma dam pa dang mjal/ theg chen gyi chos dang 'phrad/ bzod pa'i phan yon sogs shes nas sgom du yod pas da phyin chad dmar mo'i srog la babs kyang khong 'khrugs par mi bya snyam du thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bzod pa yang dang yang du bsgom/ de nas rim 263

tre chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/pas mthar sems can thams cad la bsgom/ dmigs med kyi nges shes drang —/ thun rjes 'dra/ 'di la'ang zhag gsum/ /thun mtshams su dbye ba rnams sgom dgos pas/ gzhan gyi log sgrub bzod pa ni/ gzhan gyis rang la dngos su rdung deg dang / 'phrog bcom tshig ngan smra ba sogs dang / skog nas mi snyan par brjod pa sogs la zhe sdang dang khong khro mi bya bar slar la byams dang snying rje bskyed nas de dag la phan 'dogs dgos/ mdor na chos rgyud la skyes na lus ngag yid gsum dul du 'gro yang / de ltar min pa rang cag ni dge ba cung zad sgrub pa'am/srung sdom sna re dag pa'am/ thos bsam nyi tshe ba tsam byas nas nga rgyal gyis khengs nas/ gzhan gyi tshig gi smra lugs tsam la'ang nga dang nga'i nye 'brel pha ma sogs la smad byung sogs zer nas khro ling nge 'gro nas len du ngan smras skesogs byed pa de chos kyis sems la cung zad tsam yang ma phan pa'i rtags yin/ des na dus rnam kun tu byams snying rje la gzhi bcol te rang rgyud chos kyis 'dul pa ni nyams len gyi gnad ma nor ba yin pas sems la mi phan pa'i chos zab zab mo stong las kyang dga' ba yin/ dka' spyad bzod pa ni/dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i ched du dka' tshegs tsha grang thams cad khyad du bsad nas bsgrub dgos te/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems bla mdam pa rnams kyis thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa byas tshul gyi rnam thar mang po dran nas tshe 'di'i zhen pa thams cad rlung la bskur nas dben pa'i ri khrod 'chi nus pa zhig cis kyang byas nas chos skub dgos kyi/ tshe 'di'i bya ba dgra gnyen chags sdang / khyim gyi bza' dpon/ grong gi sdod gnas/264

snying jig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/skyid 'dod sos dal ngang nas chos grub pa su yang med cing ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ zab don la mi sgrag pa'i bzod pa ni/ zab mo stong pa nyid kyi gnas lugs dang khyad par rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs bya rtsol dang bral ba'i gnad la sogs thos pa na/ de dag la log lta mi skye zhing de dag gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa lon pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ mdor na zab mo'i chos dang de ston pa la snying thag pa nas mos gus bya ba las log lta skur 'debs byas na chos spong gi las tshabs che bas bskal ba grangs med dmyal ba nas mi thar bas spang bar bya ba gal che'o/bzhi pa brtson 'grus ni/ ngo bo brtson gang dge la spro ba ste sems dge ba la mchog tu spro ba brtson 'grus yin gyi/ mi dge ba la spro ba ni bya ba ngan zhen gyi le lo yin/ brtson 'grus 'ong ba'i thabs la dge ba'i phan yon dang /rig pa'i nyes dmigs sogs dran dgos/ khyad par byang chub sems kyi phan pon rnams dran nas bsgom dgos pas/ sbyor ba 'dra/ thun gyi dngos gzhi la/thems can thams cad mar shes drin dran drin gzo 'dod bskyed/ sems ma nga sa cad la bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis sgrub/ sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis bas phyir sangs rgyas skub dgos na/ rang ga sdad pas mi 'ong brtson 'aspus brtsam dgo ga de yang byang chub sems bskyed na ming don gnas 'gyur ba dang / skyes ma dpa' bo'i dpes nges pa'i sdig pa zil gyis gnon pa/ dus mtha'i the'i dpes ma nges pa'i sdig pa drung nas 'byin pa/ ljon shing gi dpes 'bras bu mi zad cing gong nas gong du 'phel ba sogs byang chub sems kyi phan yon rnams dran nas dge ba la kro ba bskyed/ de yang spro ba rgya 265

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i daspa tshogs/chen po yang dang yang du bskyed dgos te/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskal pa grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab par rdzogs smin sbyong gsum rgya mtsho ltar sgrub pa'i brtson pa dang / rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyis dka' spyad mdzad pa'i brtson 'grus kyi rnam thar rnams dran nas ngas de las kyang lhag pa'i brtson pa zhig da lta nas bzung mi sgrub na nam sgrub snyam pa'i dam bca' drag tu yang yang bskyed de bsgom/ mdor na dge ba la spro ba ngoms ngoms shig shig skye ba'i thabs sna tshogs la bsam ste yang yang bsgom/ dmigs med la nges shes drang / rjes kyi bya ba 'dra/ 'di la'ang zhag gsum/thun mtshams su dgye ba rnams dran dgos pas/ go cha'i brtson 'grus ni—/ dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis kyang dka' spyad dang snying rus de 'dra dgos na/ las ngan khur gyis non pa bdag lta bu'i ci'i phyir mi dgos/des na da res phun sum tshogs pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms skabs 'der dka' ba khyad du bsad/ ngal ba dang du len te dam pa gong ma rnams las lhag pa zhig ma thon kyang de 'dra ba zhig nges par du srog la babs kyang sgrub dgos snyam pa'i bsam pa rgya chen dran ma myong ba zhig rgyun du yod dgos/ de ni gyid lug pa'i le lo'i gnyen po yin/ mdor na rgya che ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/rgyun ring ba 'khor ba ma stong bar gzhan don du g.yel ba med par sgrub 'dod kyi bsam pa de yin/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus ni/ chos sgrub 'dod yod kyang phyi bshol du lus na chos mi 'grub pas/ sangs rgyas ma thob bar rtogs bya gong ma gong ma rtogs rgyu dang / spang bya spang rgyu yod pas tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad phar cog gis bzhag nas nyin mi dal/ mtshan mi nyal bar sgo 266

snying thig zhag brgyaṭwāṃ sgom rim/gsum chos med du skad cig kyang mi lus par phar phyin drug gi dge ba la sbyor dgos / de'i thabs la mi rtag pas skul ma btab dgos/ mdor na chos la le lo dang phyi bshol gyi dbang du skad cig kyang mi lus par ldar ma'i pang du skul zhugs pa ltar 'phral dang 'phral du chos la 'jug pa de sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus yin/ chog par mi 'dzin pa ni/ rang gi mtshams dang bsnyen sgrub sogs thos bsam sgom pa'i dge spyor cung zad re grub pa'i tshe/ de tsam gyis chog shes mi bya bar tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i dam bca' rdo la ri mo bris pa lta bu zhig nam yang brjed du med pa sems kyi gugs nor byas nas ji srid sangs ma rgya bar du brtson pa rgyun ring la shugs drag po zhig dgos so/ /mdor na bar chad gang gis kyang mi 'gyur ba dus dang gnas skabs kun tu/stotsad la phab/ gnyid srang la gcur/ rig pa gzhung la drangs nas/ sgo gsum sos dal dang chos med du skad cig kyang ma lus pa nyin bzhin chos la brtson pa thang lhod med par gzhu brdungs pa lta bu zhig nges par du dgos pas cis kyang mdzad 'tshal/lngababasam gtan la rgyu dang dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus 'du 'dzi dang sems rnam rtog las dben pa gnyis ma brten na bsam gtan mi skye bas/ dang po ni/ sbyor ba 'dra/ dngos gzhi la 'di ltar dpyad nas bsgom dgos te/ phyi yo byad nang sems can la chags pa spangs dgos/ de yang phyi yo byad bsags srung spel gsum mam brlag gsum gyi nyes dmigs dran dgos/ 'jig rten pas dbyar jag pa/ dgun rkun ma/ sdug 'bad ngal rtsol/ sprang 'khyams gla g.yog la sogs sdug sdig pa gnyis kyis bsgrub/267

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/chos pas dang po ka kha slob dus nas yi ge shes na kha sos 'gro zer nas kun slong tshe 'dir gtad nas bla grwa rang rang gi nus tshod kyis chos dang dmar zong brjes nas bsgrub pa yin/ srung pa la/ nyin gyi mi mtshan gyi khyi byed nas dgra skun gcan gzan la sogs pa las srung dgos/ spel ba ni/gcig bcu thog bcu brgya thog brgya stong thog tu e 'gro blta dgos pa'i sdug bsngal sogs dran dgos/ nang sems can la chags pa spangs thabs rgyas na blo ldog bzhi/ bsdu na mi rtag mtha' bzhi bsgom/ rang la bsam na dang po skye dus longs spyod spu tsam ded 'ongs pa med pas gcig pur skyes/ 'chi dus mdza' bshes sogs thams cad bzhag nas gcig pur 'gro dgos na/ da lta yang gcig pur dben pa'i gnas su tshe mthar phyin par 'dug dgos/dben par gnas dus gnas ngan ngon brag phug sogs dang / zas gos ngan ngon slong mo dang phyag dar khrod kyi gos rnams 'chang zhing 'dod pa bsod snyoms kyi mtha' la ma kung bar dang / ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' lus srog gi bar chad 'byung ba'i dka' spyod drag po spangs te mtha' gnyis ma lhung ba zhig dgos snyam du yang yang dran/ soms can gzhan la chags pa spyir spong dgos/ khyad par yul bud med la chags pa 'dis 'di phyi kun tu gnod tshabs shin tu che ba dug ha la lta bu yin pas de'i nyes dmigs rgyu sgrub dka' ba/ ngo botsā gtsang ba/ 'bras bu gnod pa mang ba sogs bsam nas spong sems shugs drag la rgyun ring ba bskyed nas mi sdug pa bsgom/ de yang bud med kyi lus lalpegs par brtags na/ kha dog dkar ba'i rgyu chu ser/dmar ba'i rgyu khrag yin pas don la khrag dang chu ser sogs mi gtsang ba du 268

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ —ma'i rang bzhin gyi rkyal ba yin/ mdor na dbyibs dang kha dog reg bya gsum la chags pa'i gnyen po rim pa bud med kyi lus de gcan gzan sogs kyis zos 'phro dum bu bsgos/ kha dog la rnam pa dmar ba/ bam pa/sngo ba/ 'bus gzhigs pa/ tshig pa'i rnam pa bsgoms/ reg bya'i gnyen po bud med kyi lus keng rus kyi rnam pa ku tshigs mtshams tshel ba'i rgyus pa phra mo ma gtogs sha pags kyi rnam pa med par sogs bsams/ rnam rtog dor ba la 'jig rten tshe 'di sgrub pa'i bsam spyor tha /sa cad spangs nas/ bsam rgyu dang dran rgyu dang / byed rgyu dang / sgrub rgyu chos las med pa ste chos nyag gcig rang 'dod yid byed med par dben par sgrub la sbyor nas tshe chos mthar phyin pa zhig 'ong bar gyur cig 'ong na ci ma rung / 'ong pa zhig srog la bab byung bdag gis byasgamam ba dang / gsol 'debs bya/ dben pa la ni sleb ma ga yul bud med sogs med pas de'i rkyen gyi nyon mongs thams cad nga gis zhi ba/ bya dang ri dwags 'grogs na bde ba sogs/ sngon byon mtshos rgyas byang sems bla ma dam pa sogs dben par brten nas grub pa she ho sha stag yin pas ngas kyang de ltar sgrub dgos snyam du dben pa'i yon na yang dran nas yang dang yang du dben pa la mos par bskyed //sdu// dmigs med kyi nges shes drangs/ thun rjes 'dra/ 'di la zhag mun mtshams sogs su dben pa'i yon tan 'don yon gyi nyes dmigs stan pa'i gzhung la dpe gzigs dang / 'du 'dzi spyir spangs dgos pa ma sa khyad par bud med gzhan lta ci ma dang sring mo yin kyang 'brel thag 269

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/sring dgos/ yo rgyan chen pos/ khyad par bud med ma sring yin yang bsten mi bya/ /zhes gsungs/ bud med kyi dbang du shor na 'dod pas bcings nas 'bud mi shes pas bud med dang / dge chos nag po byed pas nag mo zhes bya bas mnyam du 'grogs par mi byed/ gnas gcig sdod pa dang gtam mang po smra ba mi byed/ bza' btung lhan du mi byed/ grong dang nye 'dab thang dang chos grwa/ lam dang mtshan mo lhan du rgyu ba dang / rtse 'dris sogs bud med su dang yang byed par mi bya bar nad ngan bzhin 'dzems dgos/ khyad par khyim pa'i bud med gzhan las kyang rab byung ma la 'jom dgos te/khyim pa'i bud med ni rgyun du grong du sdod pa dang gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung bas dang / rab byung ma rnams 'brel 'dris kyi skabs mang ba sogs kyis gnyis ka'i bslab pa la skyon du zhugs nye bas so/ /rab byung ma gzhan las kyang bla slob gcig pa'i rab byung ma la sbrul gdug bzhin 'dzem dgos te/de dag dang gtugs 'brel byas nas gtam lan gcig smras na lan gnyis smra dgos pa sogs thag nye bas 'grogs 'dris la 'jom bag med par gyur nas/bslab sdom nyams nas rang gzhan phungs shing / bstan pa la gnod pas so/ /mdor na bud med su dang yang gcig pur gtam 'brel tsam yang mi bya bar dben par sdod nas 'chi nus pa zhig dgos pas snying nas dam bca' ba gal che'o/ /btsun ma rnams kyis kyang ldog ste skyes pa spyir dang grwa btsun rnams la chags pa sogs spong dgos te/ de yang yo rgyan chen pos/ 'khor ba spangs nas bud med btsun ma byas pa rnams/ /skyes pa'i 'khri ba chod la 'dul khrims gtsang mar srungs/ /khrim pa'i sa la ma 'gro btsun ma'i sde la 270

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/sdod / /kha ton bya zhing bskor ba phyag la nan tan skyed/ /bslab pa'i khrims la g.yo sgyu tshul 'chos med par srungs/ /btsun ma log na 'dir gshe phyi ma dmyal bar skung / /de bas sgems stobs skyed la tshul khrims dam par srungs/ /zhes gsungs/ khyad par rab byung dmyus ma rnams khyim du yun ring ba dang /bla sprul rnams kyi zhabs zhu btsun ma 'jog pa sogs ni gung 'dre khyim du khrid pa dang 'dra bas shin tu 'dzem dgos te/ btsun pa khyim du sdod na mna' ma sogs bud med rnams bslu khrid mkhas pa dang / rang sor skyes yin pas stabs 'grig na bslab pa nyams sla ba dang / zhabs zhu med kyang rang g.yog rang gi byed pa'am min kyang grwa pa gshis bzang mos gus che ba dang rang tshugs thub pa bzhag pa las/ rang gi sring mo lta bu'i btsun ma yin kyang py-ithe/ma/ dgos te/ tshobastan par gnod pa'i gzhi rtsa yin pa'i mtshon gzhi mang gnyis pa bsam gtan dngos la/ sbyor ba 'dra/ dngos gzhi la/ tshul khrims ma nyams pa'am nyams kyang chos bzhin bshags pa dang phyir bcos nas sdom gsum rnam par dag pa zhig gis bsam gtan bsgom dgos/bsam gtan gyi ngo bo mi g.yeng ba yin pas/ las dang po bas beems g.yeng mi 'jug pa sems can thams cad la ma shes drin dran sogs dmigs bcas bsam gtan byams pa dang byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin lta bu'i sems dge ba'i dmigs rnam rnams la dpyad 'jog spel ma byas te dran pa'i thag pas btags/ shes bzhin gyis bya ra byed/ bag pod bag ma lta bus zin par bya dgos/ nang sems mi g.yeng ba'i rgyu/ sngon song jes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs 271

tram̐ chen mtsho rgachos grwa'i dpe tshogagamadun mi bsu/ da lta yul du mi g.yeng ba rang sems grim stod gang dga' khams dang bskun nas/ de'i steng bcas bcos ma byed par 'jog pa yang yang bya/ dmigs med ni byams sogs gcig la cer zin mi bya bar ma bcos cog ge stod la bzhag dgos/ de ltar yang dang yang du byas na sems las su rung ba yin no/ /thun rjes 'dra/ 'di la'ang zhag gsum/thun mtshams dbye ba rnams dran dgos/ de yang byams sogs kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa na bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams zhen dang bcas pa'i zhi gnas rkyang pa sgom pa byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan zhes bya/ snga ma'i nyams zhen bral bas bsam gtan gyi ro myong med kyang stong 'dzin gnyen po'i phyogs la zhen nas sgom pa'i dus na don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya/ stong 'dzin gnyen po'i blo dang bral te chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin la gnas pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan zhes bya/mdor na dang po ni nga'i bde gsal mi rtog pa zhes bdag 'dzin gnyis sems la lus pas byis pa nyer spyod de tshogs lam gyi sgom pa gtso che ba dang /gnyis pa ni de'i steng du bdag gnyis rigs pas dpyad de stong pa zhi gnas dang zung 'jug goms pas don rab 'byed pa ste stor lam du gtso che/gsum pa ni dngos 'dzin dang stong 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i zhi lhag ro gcig pa gnas lugs spros pa dang bral b.rom pas de bzhin gshegs dge'i ste mthong lam du'o/ /drug pa shes rab ni/ ngo bo chos rab tu 'byed pa yin pas 'khor 'das lasdu7 /sum gyi chos thams cad yin la/ de dag gtan la 'bebs pa la

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/bden pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag zhib mo shes dgos kyang gzhan du shes par bya ba las 'di yi ge mang du dogs la/ bsgom dus thun dang thun mtshams gyes nas thun gyi sngon 'gro 'dra/ dngos gzhi la chos dang gang zag gi bdag med gnyis bsgom dgos/ de la dgag bya nges pa'i dbang du byas na rgyun la gang zag dang / mtshan nyid 'dzin pa la chos zhes gsungs/ des na phung po'i rgyun la dmigs pa gang zag gi bdag 'dzin dang de'i yul gang zag yin/de'i gdags gzhi gung po lnga chos bdag gi yul dang / de bden par 'dzin pa sogs chos kyi bdag 'dzin yin/ de yang snga ma'i 'dzin stangs rtag gcig rang dbang can du 'dzin pas/ bdag de phung lnga dang gcig tha dad dpyad pas/ gcig yin na/ bdag bzhin sung po'ang gcig yin dgos pa dang / yang na bdag kyang phung po bzhin mi rtag pa dang du ma dang gzhan dbang can 'gyur dgos pas bdag phung gcig tu ma grub/ gzhan yin na bdag phung tha dad du dmigs dgos na de ma dmigs pas bdag gzhi med du bsams/ bdag med kyang gung po tsam yod do snyam na ma grub ste/gzugs can rnams rdul phran bsags pa yin la/ de yang phyi rol gyi ri brag khang khyim sogs la dasbyod dgos/ de'i nang nas khang pa lta bu la brtags na/rdo dang jigs pa gyang dang shing sogs du ma 'dus pa'i rang bzhin las khang pa zhes gcig tu ma spub/ 'dus pa de bshigs na khang 'dzin ldog nas rdo la sogs par 'dzin/ rdo de yang rdul du ma bsags pas gcig ma grub/ rdul la'ang phyogs chas gyes na gcig tu rang bzhin ma 'grub pas de dag 'dzin par ltar don la mi gnas pas khang pa stong nyid tu gtan la babs/ stong 273

tram̐chenamatshosngichosagrwa'idape tshogs/bzhin rten 'byung 'ab/gas med du snang bas stong pa nyid kyang khang pa/ stong nyid las khang pa gzhan min/ khang pa las stong pa gzhan ma yin pas/ stong rten 'byung dbye bsal med pa'i snang stong zung 'jug tu nges shes skyes skyes su bsgom/ de ltar nag tshang dang ri gling ra ba skyed tshal nas gser ri rol mtsho ri rab la sogs bar brtag de nas nga'i lus 'di rtag snyam na ma yin te pha ma'i khu khrag yungs dkar bcu cha'i tshad nas je cher 'pheshā/ nas lus yongs su rdzogs nas btsa' zhing / byis pa nas rgan po'i bar rags pa 'gyur bas mi rtag phra ba skad cig gis chu rgyun bzhin mi rtag gcig pu yin snyam na ma yin te/ de yang sha dang pags pa dang khrag dang chu ser dang rus pa sogs du ma dang / gzhan yang so sum cu/ spa nyis khri chig stong / ba spu bye ba phrag gsum la sogs pa du ma cha shas kyi rang bzhin can yin/ rang dbang can yang min te/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang can yin pas so/de ltar lus la sdeb lnga phyes na lus 'dzin zhig sdeb la'ang sog pa dang dpung pa sogs phye bas sdeb 'dzin zhig lhu la'ang sha dang pags sogs phye bas lhu 'dzin zhig sha spags sogs phyogs chas phyes shing / phyogs cha rang bzhin med par dpyad pas lus stong pa'o/ stong pa nyid lus so/ lus las kyang stong nyid gzhan min/ stong nyid las lus gzhan ma yin pas stong rten 'byung dbye bsal med par spub pa la nges shes yang yang drangs/ de nas nang sems la dpyad dgos te/ de yang rtag gcig rang dbang can du 'dzin kyang ma grub te/ skye 'gags kyi zeng ba sha ra ra byed pa'i rang bzhin mi rtag pa yin/'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug la sogs mi dge'i rtog pa dang / dad 274

snying theg zhag brgya'e sgom rim/nges 'byung byang sems la sogs dge rtog du ma dang / za nyal 'gro ba sogs sngar byas dran pa'i lung ma bstan gyi rtog pa du ma'i rang bzhin can/ gzhan yang rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ sems byung nga gcig la sogs du ma'i rang bzhin yin/ yul gyi gzhan dbang can/ yul sdug pa las 'dod chags/ngan pa las zhe sdang / b.rom las gti mug skyes pa dang / gzhan yang 'khor ba la nges 'byung / myang 'das la dad pa la sogs pa yul gyi gzhan dbang can yin/ yang sems 'das pa med pas ma grub/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes pas ma spub/ da lta ba skad cig gis rang yal 'gyur pas mi spub/ de ltar dpyad na ma grub kyang rnam rtog thol thol da dung yang skyes pas yod do snyam na ma yin te/ sems la gzugs kyi dngos po yod na/ dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis las juyod mi srid pas/ skum po gru bzhi sogs dbyibs med cing /dkar dmar la sogs kha dog med/ skyes pa bud med sogs kyi gzugs su ma grub pas gzugs mthong rgyu dang / sgra thos rgyu sogs med/ des na sems rang bzhin med pas stong pa'o/ /ma dpyad na stong nyid las rten 'byung 'gags thed 'char bas stong pa nyid kyang sems so/ /stong rten 'byung dbye bsal thed pas sems las stong nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong nyid las sems gzhan ma yin pas/ de ltar dpyad sgom byed nas nges shes yang dag drang du 'jug yang yang sgom pas gar yang 'gro mi 'dod tshe mnyam bzhag dang rjes mthun pa blo bcas bcos med par ci gnas 'jog yang rnam rtog skye ba na dpyad yang 'jog pa ste dpyad 'jog spel mar byed nas bsgom pas sems la kha lo lob nas btang bzhag rung ba 'byung ba yin/ de ltar phyi nang gi chos 275

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/ thams cad la dpyad pa byed nas nges shes drangs pa'i blo de la ming yid daphyod kyi lta ba'am shes rab ces bya/ phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba ni 'di sngon du song nas sems kyi gnas lugs la brtags pa'i so so rang rig ye shes mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi lta ba zhes bya/ des na snga ma blo rnam rtog dang phyi ma blo 'das ye shes yin pas khyad gnam sa bas che/ de dag gzhan du shes dgos pas 'di mi spro/ mdor na dpyad na ma grub kyang ma dpyad na stong rten 'byung 'gags pa med pa'i rang bzhin sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du nges pa drang dgos/rjes rnams 'dra/ 'di la'ang zhag gsum ste des thams cad song /thun mtshams su dbye ba rnams la dpe ltas dang bsam dasbyod dgos/de yang thos pa'i shes rab ni/ chos kyi tshig don thams cad bla mas gsungs/rang gis nyan te gsungs pa bzhin go ba de yin/ bsam pa'i shes rab ni/bla mas gsungs pa rnams go lo zos lo mi bzhag par/ bsam gzhig gis gtan la phab/ de yang nges par dben pa'i ri khrod nyams len byed dus gnad gzhan la dri mi dgos par rang rkya thub nges su zhu mthar bcad pa de yin/ sgom pa'i shes rab ni/ shes nas nyams su blangs te bsgoms pas gnas lugs don gyi rtogs pa ma nor bar rang rgyud la skyes/ kho thag nang nas chod/ yin min gyi sgrog las grol te gnas lugs kyi rang zhal mthong ba de yin/ de dag gis 'jug pa'i bslab bya rnams song / de ltar tshad med bzhi dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i gzhung lam rgya chen po de dag thams cad mdo hril gyis dril na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can zhig la 'ub kyis 'dus pas rgyal bas chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong 276

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/gsungs pa thams cad kyang 'di dag rgyud la skye ba'i thabs su gsungs pa yin/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di dang bral na/ lta sgom zab zab 'dra yang sangs rgyas thob pa la mi phan/ rim gnyis kyi nyams len rnams kyang 'dis minan rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu 'akro yang / 'di dang bral na mu stegs pa'i lam dang khyad med/ des na bzang ngan mtho dman thams cad nas 'di kho na la rtsal du bton nas rang rgyud la ma skyes bar du spyong bar gyed pa gal che'o/ /khyad par bla sprul mkhan gsum dang beer mo ba dad zas dang gshin dkor za ba dang / shi bo'i yar 'dren byed pa rnams ni/ rgyud na byang chub kyi sems bcos ma min pa zhig med thabs med/ de dang bral na shi gson su la yang mi phan zhing rang la nyes sgrib mi dzid bskyed cing ngan song ru 'gro nges pas shin tu gal che'o/ /mdor na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du byams dang snying rje byang chub soms la gzhi bcol nas chos la thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral bar tshe gang por nyams su len dgos pa yin no/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa rjes ji ltar bya tshul ni/ /de ltar blo ga rnam bzhi dang sems bskyed yan chad la zhag grangs brgya dang brgyad la blo spyong tshad dang ldan par byas nas zhi lhag gi ting nge 'dzin la myong ba cung zad thon par bya/ gzod lam thams cad kyi ming rdo skyabs 'gro 'bum phrag kha skong dang bcas pa dang / sems bskyed kyang de ltar bya/ de nas rdor sems bsgom bzlas dang 'brel yig brgya 'bum phrag gcig kha skong dang bcas bsags/denas ma la yang de ltar bya/ de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs yan lag bdun pa'i bdag lus zhing sogs 'don bzhin rkyang phyag 'bum kha skong dang 277

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/bcas pa 'tshal/ de nas dngos grub sgrub pa dang / dngos grub bskul pa'i gsol 'debs gnyis po thun gyi stod smad byas nas sirnyi stong re'i mtshams su tshar re bldab/de'i 'gros kyis gsol 'debs bsnyen pa sirnyi 'bum brgya dang bcu gsum 'gro nges dgos/ de nas dngos gzhi thun mong ba bum dbang gi lam snying thig rtsa gsum sogs dbang bskur sngon du zhus nas/ bsnyen sgrub la 'jug tshe bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad gsal ba'i khrid rnams zhus te go don lhongs par bya/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ldan du dus grangs rtags gsum gang rung gi bsnyen tshad thon par bya/ de nas gsang dbang gi lam rlung dang gtum mo 'khrul 'khor lag khrid dang bcas pa la gnad du bsnun pa dang / sher dbang gi lam gzhan yang spro na bya/ gzod dngos gzhi thun mong min pa dbang bzhi pa'i lam gyi khyad par gyi sdon 'gro rnams nas ka dag khrigs chod kyi ngo sprod snyan brgyud rnams dang / thod rgal lag khrid bcas chig brgyud glin khrid du btab/ de dag gi rgyab skyor ye shes bla ma dang / mdzod chen bdun / snying thig ya bzhi sogs rang lugs kun mkhyen yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i zab chos sangs rgyas dngos lta bu rnams kyi bshad khrid smin rgyas su nus nas sgro 'dogs legs par bcad nas tshe chos mthar phyin pa'i chos rnam dag zhig sgrub nas na dga' dang shi skyid kyis skye 'chi bar do'i lam khyer la rang byan tshud pa zhig byung na rang drin rang la che zhing / bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs/ dal 'byor don yod byas/ pha ma sems can gyi drin len sod/ bstan pa'i zhabs tog grub pa bcas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis thon par lags pas snying la rus pa bcug nas chos ming don mtshungs pa 278

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/zhig cis kyang sgrub pa mdzad 'tshal/ /slar smras pa/ /gsum la skyabs song las 'bras yid ches ngang / /mi ldog dad pas srid 'dir dug can mtsho/ /mthong nas thar lam byang chub chen po la/ /ma rnams 'god na lam mchog 'di mid byung / /bdag nyid nyon mongs rba rlabs khyer bzhin du/ /'di bris rkyal rtsed zol 'di mi 'os mod/ /'on kyang rin chen nor gyis mtshon min pa'i/ /gzhung bzang mang po'i bcud dril snying po yin/ /de ltar legs bshad skya rengs gsar ba'i mdangs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs 'gro la bsngo/ /des mthus rgyal bstan gsor gyi nyi gzhon gyis/ /skye 'gro'i phan bde'i padmo bzhad gyur cig /ma rtogs log par rtogs pa'i skyon dbang gis/ /don bzang nor bu'i me long sgrib srid na/ /nyes tshogs 'di dang tshe rabs sdig dang sgrib/ /snying nas ye shes spyan ldan rnams la 'chags/ /bdag kyang da nas srid pa ji srid bar/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa dang 'grogs te/ /ma rgan nyams thag 'gro la sman slad du/ / 279

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/spyan ras gzigs mgon de dang mtshungs par shog /'di mthong dngos sam brgyud nas skal bzang kun/ /'dod pa bsod snyoms mtha' la mi lhung zhing / /chog shes chos mabun 'tsho bas dben ri la/ /tshe dang sgrub par snyoms pa'i rgyu ru smon/ /ces pa 'di ni snga sor rang la brten pa'i bla grwa jo ser sgrub sde dang ri khrod gnas pa sogs zhag brgya bzhugs skabs rang 'dra'i blo dman rnams la 'di 'dra'i khyer bde zhig dgos pa'i nyams myong byung ba dang / slad nas snying las nye ba'i mched po 'gas legs bskul gyi yi rang gnang ba dang / gnas chen mtsho phur gnas 'dus sgo 'gyed kyi 'gro don sogs tshad med kyi las bzang la spyod pa'i skal pa dang ldan pa'i rkyen sogs kyis kun bzang zhal lung dang de'i zin bris gnyis la gzhi byas gzhan yang sa dge bka' rnying gi khrid yig dang dam pa'i gsung sgros sogs la brten nas/ rab rgyan bcu bdun pa'i shing bya lo'i rgyal zla'i tshes bco brgyad kun mkhyen bla ma'i 'das mchod nyin yar mtsho bsam grub dgon rang spyil gser mdangs padma dgyes pa'i dga' tshal nas sprul ming kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis rang lo zhe gcig thog grub par bgyis pa'o/ /maṅga lo// //280

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/mdo khams gnas chen mtsho phur gnas 'dus sgo 'byed gser gyi lde mig bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bica bo rnyi sa twa ya/ ka dag rnam grol bde chen don gyi lha/ /'jig gzhom mi mnga'asnang srid dbang du sdud/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs mnga' lha srin bran du bkol/ /yo rgyan mtsho skyes rang byung rdo rje 'dud/ /khungs bub gnas yig dam pa'i gsung rgyun dang / /gdod ma'i gzhi yi gnas lugs rang rtsal las/ /gang shar ma bcos brjod 'dis skye 'gro kun/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan na don yod 'gyur/ /chos sku'i gnas ni rgya chad phyogs lhung bral/ /longs sku'i gnas mchog me tog rgyan pa'i zhing / /sprul sku'i gnas ni stong gsum mi 'jed khams/ /bye brag 'dzam gling 'di ru gnas yul dang / /dur khrod brgyad sogs bkod pas kun nas mdzes/ /khyad par ri mtho sa gtsang bod kyi sngongs/ /ston mchog thub pas zhabs kyis ma bcag kyang / /snying rje'i rang gzugs phyag na pad dkar 'chang / /ma rungs 'dul mdzad gu ru padma 'byung / /gub brnyes rig 'dzin bgrang las 'das pa yis/ /byin rlabs gnyer gtad zab chos gter du sbas/ kub pa'i gnas mdzad srung ma du bskos/ zhabs kyis ma bcag med pa'i gyin rlabs mdzad/ /lhag par gangs chen nyer lnga brag phug brgyad/ /chu bzhi smongs brgyad yang dben nyi shu lnga/ /mthong thos dran reg rig 'dzin sa 'god phyir/ /sgrub pa'i gnas sogs mdzad pa bsam mi khyab/ /de ltar gangs chen nyi shu rtsa lnga las/ /khyad 'phags 281

tram̐ chen mtsho su chos grwa'i daspa tshogs/shing rgu gangs kyi ra ba 'dir/ /stong gsal nam mkha'i lding khang mtho la dwangs—/ /mi 'gyur gangs dkar rtse mor sprin dkas 'khyud/ /rdza brag lhun rngam gtan 'khyil rgya mtsho zab/ /pha chu 'gros myur g.yu 'brug sgra skad ngar/ /nags tshal spang ljongs rab mdzes mi'i zhing khams/ /phyi tshul sa yi mtshan nyid kun nas tshang / /nang ltar gur pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i gnas/ /ma tshang med cing khyad par mgrin pa'i steng / /tsā 'dra rin chen gsang phug tshe ring ljongs//gnas pas bsnyen bsgrub nus pa'i rtags tshad myur/ /thugs kar mtsho dgon lnga rig dga' tshal gling / /gnas lnga rig pa'i shes bya kun nas rgyas/ /dwangs gsal mtsho chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum/ /gnas 'dir o rgyan rje 'bangs 'khor tshogs rnams/ /lo lnga bzhugs nas tshe yang phur gsum sgrub/de'i phyir padma dbang phug mtsho rgyal phug 'od gsal gangs phug 'ja' lus zang thal gug /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i tshogs khang sogs/ /mchog gi dngos spub thob pa'i sgrub phug gsum/ /shin tu ya mtshan rmad byung sgrub phug gnyis/ thun mong dngos spub thob pa'i sgrub phug gsum/ /mo rgyan sku rjes mtsho rgyal zhabs phyag rjes/ /rig 'dzin nyer lnga mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yis/ /rdzu 'phrul zhabs phyag rjes rnams gsal po yod/ tshe chu dang ni mkha' 'gro tshe zan dang / /byams sems dkar dmar lha sku rang byon yod/ /g.yu shug rtsa la dag byed khrus chu dang / /sman bla'i sku mdun nad sel sman chu yod/ /'od gsal thig le gzhi pheb la sogasapa/ /dam pa chos kyi gter kha gsum tsam yod/rdo rje gzhon nu'i gzhal yas g.yu mtsho yod/ /de ru tshogs 'khor ratna'i maṇḍal phul/ /bar chad sel zhing rang rang las skal mthong / /seng gdong 282

snying zig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/yab yum pho brang dmar nag mtsho/ /go mtshon sogs phul dus 'khrugs nad rnams zhi/ /ri chen dil 'bur brgya dang rtsa brgyad yod/ /chu mig brgya dang mtsho mo brgya rtsa brgyad/ /gzhan yang dam chos gter kha bcu gsum yod/ /o rgyan padma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yi/ /mngon sum zhal gzigs lung bstan nges par 'ong / /badzra gu ru ḍā dril rol mo'i sgra/ /chu bo thams cad ri lu tī la ya'i/ /dus kun mngon sum sgrogs shing dge mtshan ldan/ /gnas 'di nyin mophoja' zer pa tra 'khrigs/ /mtshan mo ye shes me dpung rab tu 'bar/ /ri mgo thams cad seng chen 'gying pa 'dra/ /ri skad thams cad stag mo mchong ba 'dra/ /de 'og ri rnams khro mos ral bsigs 'dra/ /mdor na sngon tshe pad 'byung rje 'bangs 'khor/ ma ṇi rin chen bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / /klong gsal snying po la sogs rig 'dzin gyis/ /zab gter sgo 'gyed 'dre srin dam la btags/ sku gsum phrin las 'gro 'dul byin rlabs mdzad/ /bar du drung pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho dang / chos dbyings rang grol srong btsan dpal gyi rje/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma gzhan phan mtha' yas dang / /padma badzra dpal sprul rin po che/ /padma bdud 'dul padma ma ti dang / /zhing skyong si tu gzhan phan bzang po dang / bdud 'dul gling pa gu ṇa'i ming can dang / bstan 'dzin nor bu padma chos kyi rje/ tha lagli ngag dbang nor bu dang / /'gyur med rdo rje a rig rin po che/ dza ka mchog sprul khra skya dpal ldan dang / /smyo shul a ngag nyin mo gter ston sogs/ /dam pa du mas bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal du byin rlabs mdzad/ /tha ma bsgrub brtson sgron ma tshe ring dang / /'khor lo'i mgon po padma skal bzang mchog spub dbang 283

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/dam pa lung rtogs rgyal mtshan sogs/ /grub brnyes rig 'dzin rim pa byon rnams kyis/ dngos sam brgyud nas bshad sgrub gnas kyi sgo/ /mdzad pa dkar pos skye rgu'i phan bde spel/ /gsang ba brag dkar gangs dkar chos sku'i gnas/ mtha' yangs gting zab dwangs mtsho longs sku'i gnas/ /rab mdzes g.ya' spangs nags khrod sprul sku'i gnas/ /gabeer mdog spangs ri 'jam pa sku yi gnas/ /rab dkar gangs ri padma gsung gi gnas/ brag ri mthing rngam phyag rdo thugs kyi gnas/ /dwangs gsal mtsho chen skum po zhi ba'i gnas/ /bkra shis spang thang gru bzhi rgyas pa'i gnas/ /nags tshal skug nag zla gam dbang gi gnas/ /brag nag gru gsum mthon po drag po'i gnas/ /lta ba dri med gangs dkar gnam la reg /sgom pa yengs med g.yo med mtsho mo 'khyil//sbyod pa skyon med sngon shing me tog bkra/ /'bras bu kun 'grub smongs kyi bkod pa mdzes/ /gnas 'di mjal dka' dal 'byol rnyed dkar mtshon//phu chu 'gros myur 'du byed mi rtag mtshon/ /brag nag grib srib 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mtshon/ sna tshogs 'bras bzang spud pas las 'bras mtshon/ /yang gsang rgyal ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams dang / sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /bla ma yi dam ḍākhri chos srung dang / /dam can gter bdag dkar phyogs gzhi bdag bcas/ /ma lus rdul snyed zhing gi rten dang brten/ /ma tshang med pa'i bkod pas kun nas mdzes/ /mdor na gnas mchog 'di yi yon tan kun/ /lha mchog 'jam dpal gzhon nus brjod mi lang —/ spyir na 'du ba bya lo kun yin yang / /khyad par lo 'dir gnas dus rten 'brel 'dzoms/ /skyabs gcig khyab bdag padma skal bzang dang / /grub 284

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/dbang lung rtogs rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis sogs/ /dam pa du mas rtse gcig zugs 'dun nas/ /gnas kyi sgo chen 'byed pa'i dus kyi skabs/ /dpag bsam zhing dang yid bzhin nor bu las/ ci ltar re ba skong ba de bzhin du/cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes dang po la/ /'du ba dang po sa ga zla ba'i nya/ /'du ba gnyis pa'o de bzhin drug pa'i tshes/ bcu yi nyi shar 'du ba gsum pa ste/ /gnas pa'i tshad ni lo 'di ma rdzogs par/ /khyad par 'du ba'i gnas ni mtha' yas zhing / /rdo rje gdan dang gnas dang yul gyi dpal/ /dur khrod brgyad dang bal yul song ge rdzong / /padma bkod dang tsa ri tsa gang gnas/ /rgya nag glang chen ri bo bya rkang can/ /spa gro stag tshang mchims gu shel brag gnas/ /ri bo rtse lnga yer ba la sogs pa/ /gzhan yang 'phags bod gnas chen gnas phran dang / /kha ba dkar dang nor bu yang rtse dang / /kha ba lung ri 'brang ri skug po dang / /bzhag bra lha rtse kaḥthog ka 'bum gnas/ /khro ri zil khro 'grong dil ge dzo dang / /lha chen zhi dal nor bu 'phel phyug sogs/ /dkyil 'khoragarto tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i do du dgongs nas/ /nyi zer rdul dang nam mkha'i skar ltar byon/ /dadarang dag snang dam dzig gtsang ma'i ngang / /sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshad dang ldan bzhin du/ /nang skor sirnyi dung chen gsum dang ni/ /bar skor sirdzi nung chen lnga ru 'gyur/ /mtha' skor sirnyi dung chen bcu yin te/ /rgyun du nang skor ji bye chen gcig /bar skor bye chen lnga dang mtha' skor la/ /sirnyi dung ra yod the tshom spongs/ /skor ba'i tshad ni bsdus na mtha' skor sha ga /bar skor brgyad dang nang skor nyer gcig yin/ /'dis kyang phyi mar 285

tram̐ chen mtsho phu chos grwa'i dpe tshogs/po ta la skye gsungs/ /rgyas na mtha' skor brgyad dang bar sum cu/ /nang skor bdun cu sdom pas brgya rtsa brgyad/ /gnas mchog 'di la phyag bskor sus byas na/ /gnas skabs 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba dang / tshe rabs las kyi nad las grol bar 'gyur/ mthar thug 'dus pa'i rig 'dzin pho mo rnams/ /rnga yab dpal ri padma'i zhabs drung du/ /nam zhig tshe 'phos lus rjes gyur ma thag /skyes nas sku gsum 'bras bu myur du thob/ /dga' ba gyis shig thar 'dod skal ldan rnams/ /gnas mchog 'di ru tshogs 'khor sus bskor ba/ tshe gcig nyid la rig 'dzin sa la 'god/ /tha ma rnams kyang yig drug dung phyur 'gyur/ /gnas mchog 'di ru dar cog sus 'dzugs pa/ /tshe gcig nyid la po ta la ru gshegs/ /gnas mchog 'di ru mar me sus phul ba/tshe gcig nyid la padma 'od du skye/ /gnas mchog 'di ru tshe thar sus btang ba—/ /tshe 'dir nyid la 'chi med rig 'dzin brnyes/ /gnas mchog 'di ru sgrub khang sus byas pa/ /o rgyan padma'i thugs klong rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gnas mchog 'di la mchod rten sus bzhengs pa/ /tshe 'di nyid la rgyal ba'i sras su skye / /gnas mchog 'di nyid zhal mjal tsam gyis ni/ /tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin thob/ /gnas mchog 'di yi mtshan thos sems can kun/ /ngan song skye sgo chod pa the tshom med/ gnas 'di'i sa rdo ji shing nags tshal kun—//sku gzugs phyag mtshan yig 'bru'i tshul du yod/ /gnas mchog 'di yi sa rdo chu thig rnams/ /kha ru reg tshad byang chub lam la 'god/ /gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis rlabs nus pas/ /'di ru khyi phag shi yang ring bsril 'byung —/ /dgon gnas gzhan la zla gcig sgrub pa bas/ /gnas 'dir zhag 286

snying thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim/ —gcig sgrub pas bsod nams che/ /don la zangs mdog dpal ri dngos nyid yin— /gnas mchog 'di la mi dad sgro bkur dang / /bstan dgra bsam sbyor ngan pa shom mkhan kun/ /tshe 'di mi dge mi rung sna tshogs 'byung / /shi nas rdo rje dmyal bar nges par skye/ /phyi yi sgo srung g.ya' ri lha btsan dang / /nang gi srung ma skyes bu ging bdud bcas/ /gsang ba'i srung ma gzi ldan yab yum dang / /spyi yi srung ma lha sman mched lnga yis/ /gnas 'dir srungs shig badzra sa ma yāX dge 'dis legs mtshon rnam dkar tshogs gnyis rgyun/ /gcig tu bsdus nas ma gyur 'gro la bsngo/ /des mthus rgyal bstan bshad sgrub rab rgyas shing / /'gro kun phan bde'i dpal gyis shis gyur cig /lhag bsam 'o ma'i chu gter rab dkrugs nas/ /legs bshad dri med mar gyi ril bu 'di/ /bcu bdun rab rgyan shing bya nag pa zla'i/ /lhag pa lha mtshams sbyor ba'i tshes bco brgyad/ /rang spyil gser mdangs 'chi med dga' tshal nas/ /kun nas dga' bas bris so masgolo// //287

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ padma tshul khrims/mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ karma tshe ring /snyeng thig zhag brgya'i sgom rim bzhugs so/ /si khron dpe sgrun tshogs pa dang /si khron mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gis par du bsgrun nas bkram/khring tu'u hru'u thung par 'debs 'gan 'khri tshad yod kung sis dpar/—2006lo'i zla8par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2 6lo'i zla8par par thengs dang po dpar/par grangs/ 0001da 15༷0dbai rtags/bo2glu7—5409—3307—0(2 97dpe rin sgor/ 18 00

— — gersha cirinosdu sta hwa dngha/— chi —1 — sna3 wi lke —ri — ——— trī/spyo ci kyai ri rke— ske —4 — — gyi— —sta tsho ci —trejerngu dzedzo〉me——smordo 6 rirme — trīshaṃtshi4 ne ri tshisnye shāngashe — rdonghrur sdo/ sdi—rtesmo rdzothonghru ṇa —byā 5ju —sdu dnghaca dhe rna—dze—4—gletrīX— ༷ ne 3meṅka rda— ༵de — sdo—— tre — —byedagon ṣkad grwa pa/
